Con una sola conexión gestionas todas tus marcas en lenguaje natural: crea y programa publicaciones en redes sociales (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok y YouTube), haz keyword research y seguimiento SEO, consulta Google Search Console y analiza Google Ads y Meta Ads — sin abrir ningún dashboard. Cada token está limitado a tu organización, con aislamiento estricto entre marcas. Pensado para agencias y community managers que quieren operar más rápido desde Claude.

items.name: Ableton Knowledge
items.subtitle: Ask Claude about Ableton products
items.description:
Ask Claude questions about Ableton Live, Push, Move, Note, Cloud, Link and Max for Live. Claude will search through product manuals, official release notes, knowledge base articles, and video tutorial transcripts to find relevant answers.
**Experimental** — This is a prototype and not an official Ableton product. Results may be incomplete, outdated, or incorrect. Always verify important information against official documentation.
**Privacy** — All searches run locally on your machine. This tool does not make any network requests or API calls beyond what Claude makes itself.
**We want your feedback!** Share your thoughts: https://forms.gle/HtjJy7jGyuBGCtmk8
**What's new in v0.8.1**
• Search official release notes for any product.
• More accurate knowledge base results with clearer article titles.
• Better answers
• Better video tutorial search.

items.name: AccuWeather®
items.subtitle: Hyper-local forecasts & alerts
items.description:
AccuWeather® provides hyper-local weather forecasts with real-time alerts and detailed updates. Access Minute-by-Minute® precipitation forecasts, hourly and daily forecasts, and severe weather notifications.
Use features including MinuteCast®, RealFeel®, RealFeel Shade™ Temperature, and live radar to monitor current and upcoming conditions wherever you are. Search any location worldwide and explore historical weather data and climate normals.
Widget Features: Current Conditions, MinuteCast™, Today/Tonight, Hourly Forecast (12 hrs), Daily Forecast (10 days), Historical Weather, Interactive Radar Map, and Government Alerts.

items.name: ActiveCampaign
items.subtitle: Autonomous marketing to transform how you work
items.description: Connect ActiveCampaign to Claude for autonomous marketing at your fingertips. Get real-time marketing insights and then take action, instantly. With this secure connection, you can manage lists, tags, contacts, and automations just by chatting with Claude. Ask Claude to pull yesterday’s email performance, get a contact’s phone number, create a new tag, or start an automation. All of that and more, fueled by the ActiveCampaign MCP Server.

items.name: Actively
items.subtitle: 1:1 account agents for GTM teams
items.description: Win more deals with Actively inside Claude by directly accessing your always-on per account agents that help you drive the next best action. Actively AI's per-account agents are synthesizing across all of your internal context (ex. CRM data, call transcripts, emails) and external signals to drive actionable intelligence. Designed for SDRs, AEs, AMs, and revenue leaders who need deep, contextual account knowledge, from meeting prep and deal strategy to territory prioritization, directly inside Claude.

items.name: Addepar MCP
items.subtitle: Bring Addepar portfolio intelligence into Claude
items.description:
Addepar’s MCP connector brings portfolio data and intelligence into Claude, enabling investment professionals to ask questions in plain language and receive answers grounded in their firm’s Addepar data.
Analyze a household’s holdings, market value, asset allocation, and performance. Understand alternatives exposure across capital calls, distributions, NAVs, and unfunded commitments. Review transactions, identify trends across clients, or gather the data needed to prepare for a quarterly review.
Unlike tools that analyze accounts in isolation, Addepar understands the ownership structures and relationships connecting a client’s complete portfolio. This allows Claude to provide a consolidated household view across accounts and entities, including public and private investments. Permission aware access helps limit the information retrieved to what each user is authorized to see.
Simply authenticate with your Addepar account. No API keys or manual configuration required.

items.name: Addgene
items.subtitle: Search Addgene's catalog of plasmids and viral preps
items.description:
Connect your Addgene account to search Addgene's catalog for plasmids and viral preps.
Addgene is a nonprofit repository for plasmids, viral vectors, and other materials developed by the global research community.

items.name: AdisInsight
items.subtitle: Pharmaceutical drug & clinical trial intelligence
items.description: AdisInsight gives Claude real-time access to the world's most comprehensive pharmaceutical drug and clinical trial intelligence database, powered by Springer Nature. Search and explore drug pipelines by developer, therapeutic area, development phase, mechanism of action, and 40+ parameters. Find clinical trials by compound, sponsor, indication, phase, and status. Analyze competitive landscapes by company portfolios. Generate interactive charts visualizing pipeline distributions and trial landscapes. Access detailed drug profiles including development history, adverse events, and regulatory milestones.

items.name: ADITUS Evo
items.subtitle: ADITUS Evo translates the complexity of modern events into clear insights and makes data-driven decisions easier than ever.
items.description: ADITUS Evo is an intelligent MCP connector that transforms complex event data into actionable insights. By seamlessly connecting AI assistants with the ADITUS Evo platform, it enables natural-language access to event operations, attendee analytics, ticketing, access control, and real-time business intelligence. Designed for speed, precision, and scalability, the connector empowers users to explore data, automate workflows, and make informed decisions through simple conversational interactions—turning complexity into clarity.

items.name: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
items.subtitle: Run reports using your metrics, dimensions, and segments
items.description: Access your Adobe Customer Journey Analytics data directly in Claude. Query metrics, dimensions, and segments programmatically to integrate cross-channel journey data from Adobe Customer Journey Analytics into your AI agents, workflows, and applications — and build analysis pipelines that match your own methodology. Pull metric data, create and manage segments and calculated metrics, and get instant answers directly in the conversation.

items.name: Adobe
items.subtitle: Design, combine, and edit with Adobe pro tools
items.description:
Adobe for Claude unlocks more ways to create and get work done by bringing in creativity and productivity capabilities across Acrobat, Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator, Firefly, Premiere, Adobe Express, InDesign, and Stock directly into your conversation. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — edit multiple photos, create assets, edit and organize PDFs, and resize video.
Key capabilities:
• Create and customize designs: Find templates for marketing materials, proposals, invitations, and more. Personalize text, replace and resize images, change colors, and refine designs in a live editor.
• Create, review, and refine PDFs: Turn designs into shareable PDFs, organize pages, edit content, redact sensitive information, add annotations, and review documents in an interactive viewer.
• Edit photos individually or in bulk: Adjust color and lighting, blur or remove backgrounds, straighten images, and expand or crop photos.
• Search, organize, and summarize content: Find Creative Cloud assets, summarize documents, and manage files directly from your conversation.
• Adapt assets for different channels: Resize and crop images for social platforms and other formats, then download and share the finished assets.

items.name: Adobe Experience Manager
items.subtitle: Manage your Adobe Experience Manager content
items.description: Create, edit, search, and publish pages and content fragments, and search for assets and generate renditions of assets in Adobe Experience Manager — simply by describing what you need instead of navigating the user interface, or write plain language code to update a page or campaign, schedule content for search, resize or convert an image, find and apply Smart Crop, create a channel-specific rendition for social and marketing channels, or find assets for the experience you are authoring. All changes respect your AEM permissions. Work faster, reduce repetitive tasks, and stay focused on what matters — your content.

items.name: Adobe Journey Optimizer
items.subtitle: Understand and troubleshoot your Journeys and Campaigns
items.description:
Inspect, summarize, and troubleshoot Adobe Journey Optimizer journeys, campaigns, offers, and channel configurations directly from Claude. Turn AJO's retrieve APIs into plain-language answers so you can check journey and campaign statuses, surface stopped or orphaned drafts, spot channel configuration issues and review your orchestration portfolio without parsing JSON or jumping across product screens.
The AJO MCP server is in beta.

items.name: Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker
items.subtitle: Drive CX Workflows
items.description:
With Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker, marketers and business practitioners, can use natural language to access insights, analyze customer experiences, and complete marketing tasks across Adobe CX Enterprise. Coworker helps marketers expedite and automate workflows, accelerate decision-making, and turn ideas into action without requiring deep product expertise. Built with enterprise governance and context, it delivers trusted assistance at scale.
Language Support: AI Assistant is currently supported in English only. Non-English inputs may produce inconsistent or erroneous results.
Personal Data: If you include personal data in your prompts, only add what's necessary and only if you have the right to use it.

items.name: Adobe Workfront
items.subtitle: Manage planning, projects, tasks, and approvals
items.description: Search, summarize, create, and update projects, tasks, workspaces, planning records and approvals directly from Claude. Make Adobe Workfront a native part of your AI workflow — an AI-powered work management agent that helps you stay on top of deadlines, surface risks, and move work forward faster.

items.name: Adspirer Ads & Performance Marketing Agent
items.subtitle: Your performance marketing and paid media agent — an Agent that plans, launches, and autonomously runs your ad campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and more.
items.description:
Adspirer is your performance marketing and paid media agent — an AI performance marketer that works like a member of your team. Tell it what you want to achieve, and it understands the goal, builds the right campaigns across the right platforms, and runs them day to day.
Create campaigns through conversation, not dashboards. Adspirer turns an objective like "more demos under a $50 cost-per-lead" into well-structured campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok — then keeps working after launch. It paces spend so budgets land where you want them, shifts money toward what's converting, continuously harvests high-intent keywords and prunes the negatives draining budget, catches creative fatigue before it costs you, and flags anything that needs a human call.
You set the strategy and approve the moves — new campaigns start paused, so nothing goes live without you. Adspirer manages multiple brands and accounts, and it's always adding new ad platforms.

items.name: Adspirer Retail Media Ads
items.subtitle: Retail media agent for Amazon Ads and Walmart Connect — Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display. Plans, launches, and optimizes your retail advertising campaigns with your approval
items.description:
Adspirer Retail Media Ads is your retail media agent for Amazon Advertising and Walmart Connect — an AI performance marketer for retail advertising that works like a member of your team. It plans, launches, and optimizes Amazon Ads and Walmart Connect campaigns with your approval on every spend-affecting change, with full campaign read and write access.
Create campaigns through conversation, not dashboards. Turn an objective like "grow units sold while holding ACoS under 20%" into well-structured Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns — then keep optimizing with your sign-off. Adspirer handles keyword research and match types, harvests converting search terms from the search term report, prunes the negative keywords and ASINs draining budget, builds product and category targeting, manages bids, placement multipliers and dayparting, paces spend across the day, shifts budget toward what's converting, writes and refreshes ad copy and headlines, and flags anything that needs a human call.
Walmart Connect campaigns run the same way — Sponsored Products across Walmart Marketplace, with item-level targeting, keyword and bid management, and the same budget pacing and wasted-spend controls.
Deep analytics across ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, impression share and spend, with wasted-spend audits and search-term reporting so you know where every dollar went, and placement-level reporting showing where you're winning and losing impression share.
Built for agencies and brands alike: multi-account and multi-marketplace management, client reporting across your whole book, and switching between brands and accounts in conversation.
You set the strategy and approve the moves — new campaigns start paused, so nothing goes live without you.

items.name: Adspirer Search Ads
items.subtitle: PPC and paid search agent for Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads) — does competitor ads research, plans, launches, and autonomously runs your search advertising campaigns.
items.description:
Adspirer Search Ads is your PPC and paid search agent — an AI performance marketer for search engine marketing (SEM) that works like a member of your team. It does competitor ads research, plans, launches, and autonomously runs search advertising campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads).
Create campaigns through conversation, not dashboards. Turn an objective like "more demos under a $50 cost-per-lead" into well-structured search campaigns — then keep working after launch. Adspirer handles keyword research and match types, harvests high-intent search terms, prunes the negative keywords draining budget, manages bids and bid strategies, paces spend so budgets land where you want them, shifts money toward what's converting, writes and refreshes responsive search ad copy, audits conversion tracking, and flags anything that needs a human call.
Covers Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns on Google Ads, plus Microsoft Advertising search and shopping. Includes wasted-spend audits, ROAS, CPA and CPC reporting, and Quality Score diagnostics. Manages multiple brands and client accounts — built for in-house teams and PPC agencies.
You set the strategy and approve the moves — new campaigns start paused, so nothing goes live without you.

items.name: Adspirer Social Ads
items.subtitle: Paid social agent for Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and TikTok Ads — researches competitor ads, plans, launches (paused) and autonomously runs your social advertising campaigns.
items.description:
Adspirer Social Ads is your paid social and social media advertising agent — an AI performance marketer for Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok Ads that works like a member of your team. It plans, launches (paused) and autonomously runs social advertising campaigns, with full campaign read and write access.
Create campaigns through conversation, not dashboards. Turn an objective like "more purchases under a $30 CPA" into well-structured campaigns, ad sets and ads — then keep working after launch. Adspirer builds and refines audience targeting with lookalike and custom audiences and retargeting, tests ad creative and catches creative fatigue before it costs you, writes and refreshes ad copy and primary text, manages bids and bid strategies, paces spend so budgets land where you want them, shifts money toward what's converting, and flags anything that needs a human call.
Competitor ads research is built in. Pull any brand's live Meta and TikTok ads from the public ad libraries, see what creative and angles are running, and brief new concepts against them.
Deep analytics and funnel diagnostics. Cross-platform reporting on ROAS, CPA, CPM, CPC, CTR, frequency and spend; conversion-funnel analysis from impression to purchase; and conversion-tracking audits across the Meta Pixel, Conversions API and TikTok Pixel so you know the numbers are real before you act on them.
Built for agencies as well as in-house teams. Manage multiple brands and client ad accounts from one place, switch between accounts in conversation, and run PPC and paid media reporting across your whole book.
You set the strategy and approve the moves — new campaigns start paused, so nothing goes live without you.

items.name: AdWhispr Ads
items.subtitle: Research any brand's live Facebook and TikTok ads, find your real competitors, and launch campaigns on Google, TikTok, and Meta from chat.
items.description:
AdWhispr gives Claude competitor ad intelligence and campaign execution.
Research: ingest any brand's entire public ad library from Meta and TikTok. Find verified competitors actually running ads in your niche right now, search ads semantically by concept ("social proof", "founder story"), pull a brand's TikTok ads with the proven winners first, and get real Google Keyword Planner data for any topic.
Briefs: generate a full competitive brief on any brand longevity curve, top hooks, longest-running winners, format mix, and a positioning verdict, with a downloadable PDF.
Execution: connect your own Meta, Google, or TikTok ad account once via OAuth, then launch complete campaigns from chat, Google Search, Performance Max, TikTok video, and Meta single-image or carousel ads from your own creative library. Every campaign is created paused with a preview-and-confirm step, so nothing spends until you explicitly resume it. Read performance, adjust budgets, and pause or resume campaigns conversationally.
Free tier included, no API keys to manage. Try: "Who has the best ads in my niche?" or "Launch a Google Search campaign for my store at $20/day."

items.name: Affinity
items.subtitle: Search, update, and prep deals without switching tabs.
items.description: Bring your Affinity data into Claude to search contacts, companies, and deals; prep for meetings using your actual notes and interaction history; and update records as deals progress. Every email captured, every meeting logged, every relationship scored by your firm is now available directly in the conversation.

items.name: Affinity
items.subtitle: Spend more time on your craft by automating repetitive tasks with Claude and Affinity
items.description:
The Affinity MCP server saves you time by automating repetitive tasks, or creating entirely new Affinity tools and workflows, that can be saved and reused when you need them.
Key capabilities:
- Automate repetitive tasks like naming layers or batch image edits
- Build new tools and workflows with custom dialogs directly in Affinity
- Save your favourite workflows as reusable scripts in Affinity's Scripting panel
Setup:
The Affinity MCP server runs locally on your device. It's only active when both Claude desktop and Affinity are running. You'll need to stay up to date with the latest version of the Affinity desktop app.
To enable the Affinity MCP server:
- Open Affinity by Canva
- Go to Settings, where you will find the MCP Server configuration options
The Affinity MCP server handles authentication through the Affinity by Canva desktop app, managed by Canva when you’re logged into the desktop app.

items.name: AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop
items.subtitle: List, sync & grow your TikTok Shop business
items.description: Bring your multi-channel commerce and affiliate operations into Claude. AfterShip Channels lets you publish DTC or Amazon products to your TikTok Shop, keep inventory, orders, and fulfillment in sync, and track how each TikTok Shop is performing. Discover relevant creators and influencers for affiliate promotion, find the right partners for your products and video content, and prepare creator outreach — all as a native part of your AI workflow. Get more done across your selling channels with less manual work and fewer tool switches.

items.name: AfterShip Post-Purchase
items.subtitle: Track shipments and returns with AfterShip context
items.description: AfterShip Post-Purchase for Claude makes shipment and returns operations as easy as having a conversation. Connect your AfterShip data and simply chat to search shipments, review delivery status and tracking timelines, spot exceptions, lookup specific orders, or review return and RMA details including refund progress, shipping status, returned items, and outcomes. Then act on what you find: with your confirmation, Claude can correct shipment records, retrack stalled parcels, mark a final delivery status, and move returns through approval, receiving, and resolution — always scoped to your organization and your own AfterShip role.

items.name: AgentMail
items.subtitle: Email inboxes for AI agents
items.description:
AgentMail gives AI agents their own email inboxes. Through this connector, an agent (or you, in Claude) can spin up a dedicated inbox on the fly, then send, receive, reply to, and forward email, with full thread context, drafts, and attachments, entirely through tool calls.
Unlike traditional email APIs built for one-way notifications, AgentMail is built for two-way conversations: an agent can read an incoming thread, understand it, and respond in context, just like a person would. This makes email a first-class communication and identity channel for agents, letting them sign up for services, coordinate with people, and talk to other agents.
Key capabilities exposed over MCP:
• Inboxes: create, list, get, update, and delete agent inboxes
• Messages: send, reply, forward, list, and update
• Threads: list, read, label, and delete full conversation threads
• Search: full-text search across threads and messages
• Drafts: create, list, read, update, send (with scheduling), and delete
• Attachments: retrieve attachments by ID, with text extraction for PDF/DOCX
Connect in seconds via OAuth using your AgentMail console identity. No API key required in Claude. Sign up free at console.agentmail.to.

items.name: Agility CMS
items.subtitle: AI pipelines for developers and marketers. Model content, author pages, publish updates, and manage media across multiple Agility CMS instances through natural language.
items.description:
Agility CMS is a headless content management system built for teams that want marketers in control and developers unblocked. This MCP server gives AI assistants authenticated access to your Agility instances so you can model content, author pages, publish updates, and manage media through natural language instead of clicking through admin screens.
27 tools cover the full authoring and publishing workflow. Discover instances, locales, containers, and sitemaps. Inspect or change content models, component models, and page templates. Retrieve, create, update, publish, or delete content items across multiple locales. Compose pages from zones and modules. Upload, browse, and remove media. Move items and pages through approval.
Works across multiple Agility instances under one account, so agencies and enterprises with several brands can switch contexts in a single conversation. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 against your existing Agility account, and the MCP server inherits the permissions you already have. Read-only users stay read-only. The server can't escalate access beyond what your account already grants.
Destructive actions are gated. Publish and unpublish ask for explicit confirmation.
Deletes require typing DELETE. On clients that support MCP elicitation, those prompts render in your own UI so the AI assistant can't satisfy them on its own.
Use it to scaffold content models from a spec, compose landing pages from a brief, audit cross-locale content, generate TypeScript types from your schema, migrate spreadsheets into product catalogs, or build a Next.js site with its content models in a single conversation.

items.name: agri-mcp.tcit.cl
items.subtitle: Manage farm operations in AGRI: labor tasks, harvest, irrigation, inventory, purchasing and cost reports.
items.description:
AGRI is a cloud farm-management platform used by agricultural operations across Latin America to centralize costs, labor tasks (faenas), harvest, irrigation, warehouse and payroll in one place.
This connector lets Claude work directly inside your AGRI environment. Ask it to review and create labor and machinery tasks, confirm daily crew work, register harvest tags and irrigation records, check stock and adjust inventory, issue goods receipts and consumption slips, raise and authorize purchase orders and invoices, and maintain catalogs (employees, products, providers, paddocks, warehouses, cost centers, task types). It also runs AGRI's operational reports — salary, product consumption, phytosanitary, cash flow, paddock performance and cost per kilo — so you can ask questions like "what did this paddock cost per kilo this season?" and get an answer from live data instead of an export.
Requires an AGRI account. Actions run with the permissions of the connected user and are scoped to that user's tenant; read tools are marked read-only and delete tools are marked destructive so Claude asks before making irreversible changes.

items.name: Ahrefs
items.subtitle: SEO & AI search analytics
items.description: Research keywords, analyze backlinks, track rankings, and monitor brand visibility across traditional search and AI platforms. Discover keyword opportunities, compare competitor performance, audit link profiles, and measure share of voice in LLM responses. Claude combines multiple Ahrefs analyses in a single conversation — asking clarifying questions, cross-referencing data points, and turning complex SEO metrics into actionable insights.

items.name: AI Producer by OpusClip
items.subtitle: Edit videos with AI
items.description: Create an editable talking-head video in chat. Upload footage, direct cuts, captions, reframing, and motion graphics, then open the AI Producer preview to refine or export.

items.description: Access to Aiera's financial data APIs, including live events, filings, company publications, and much more.

items.description: A comprehensive Desktop Extension for searching Airbnb listings with various filters including location, dates, guest count, price range, and more. Get detailed information about specific properties including amenities, policies, location details, and highlights. Respects robots.txt by default with option to override for testing purposes.

items.name: Airfield Directory
items.subtitle: Airfield Reports, fees and aviation data for GA Pilots
items.description: Your AI co-pilot for flight planning. Search 40,000+ airfields worldwide by ICAO code, name, or city. Get live METAR/TAF weather with runway-specific crosswind analysis and hazard decoding. Compare landing fees and fuel prices from Aerops. Read community pilot reports with insider tips on transport, facilities, and local quirks. Perform geo searches. View live airfield webcams. Plan routes across regions with smart filtering by IFR capability, fuel type, runway length, and community ratings. Free, public, no account needed.

items.name: Airmail
items.subtitle: Manage emails, calendars, contacts, and more from Claude using Airmail's MCP server.
items.description: Airmail MCP connects Claude to the Airmail email client for macOS. Read, search, compose, and organize emails. Manage calendars and reminders. Search contacts. The bridge connects locally to Airmail on your Mac. Data retrieved by AI tools is processed by your chosen AI provider.

items.subtitle: Craft content that wins AI search

items.name: Airtable

items.description: Bring operational data and context into the flow of your Claude conversations. You can ask questions, create and update records, and analyze your data—all through conversation. Use the data in Airtable as input to the work you're doing in Claude, like building a landing page using content you've organized in Airtable. Make quick updates to Airtable without leaving the chat. Airtable for Claude is ideal anytime you need quick access to structured internal data to inform your conversation.

Enjoy developer lifecycle support from knowledge search, to troubleshooting, to simulations and go-live testing. Use your sandbox credentials to get started!

items.name: Aiwyn Tax (formerly Column Tax)
items.subtitle: Estimate your federal & state taxes with Aiwyn's tax engine
items.description: Estimate your federal & state taxes using Aiwyn's tax engine that's filed over 1 million returns. Give Claude your tax documents (e.g. W-2s) and get a 1040 PDF back.

items.name: Aleph

items.description: Aleph connects Claude to your live finance data. Plug directly into a governed source of truth for clean, structured cross-system data from 200+ integrations: your ERP, CRM, HRIS, spreadsheets, data warehouse, and more. Ask questions in plain language, build reports, run analysis, and power automations across tools, with every output traceable back to the source. Works in Claude and Claude for Excel.

items.name: ALL Accor
items.subtitle: Search and book Accor hotels
items.description:
Discover, compare, and book the perfect room for your stay among 5,700+ Accor hotels and residences in 110+ countries from smart economy to exceptional luxury.
Whether you’re looking for a practical city breaks with ibis and ibis Styles to comfortable stays with Novotel and Mercure, lifestyle experiences with Mama Shelter and 25hours, or luxury escapes with Sofitel and Fairmont, Accor has a brand for every journey.
Ask anything "romantic spa hotel in Paris", "budget stay tonight under €150", compare options, explore the surroundings, and book seamlessly on ALL.com.
Simply describe the experience you’re looking for in the ALL Accor app using Claude.

items.name: AllTrails
items.subtitle: Find your next hike
items.description: Find your next outdoor adventure with AllTrails, directly in Claude. AllTrails is the world's most popular and trusted outdoor exploration platform, with more than 500,000 curated trails — complete with reviews, photos, and ratings from a community of over 90+ million trail-goers. From local walks to bucket-list adventures, AllTrails helps you discover new places and connect with the outdoors.

items.name: Alma
items.subtitle: Your nutrition data, inside every Claude conversation.
items.description: Alma is an AI nutrition coach that tracks what you eat, monitors 25+ micronutrients per meal, and scores your diet quality in real time using Harvard's Alternate Healthy Eating Index. Connect Alma to Claude and your full nutrition context comes with you: meals logged, nutrient gaps, Alma Score trends, and coaching history. Ask Claude questions about your actual diet, get personalized guidance, and close nutritional gaps faster. Built for anyone serious about eating better, from everyday health optimizers to GLP-1 patients and performance athletes.

items.name: Alpha Vantage MCP Server
items.subtitle: Stock market data: stocks, options, fundamentals, earnings, SEC filings, indices, news, exchange rates, commodities, and other trading signals to power your quantitative finance workflow
items.description:
Real-time and historical stock prices, quotes, and price history for any ticker, spanning stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, options, forex, commodities, and global indices. Licensed by major global exchanges for institutional-grade accuracy.
Access 200+ global market indices, ETF profiles and sector allocations, and top gainers/losers/most active tickers. Pull company fundamentals, financial statements, P/E ratio, EPS, market cap, and dividend yield.
Ingest earnings call transcripts, track earnings and IPO calendars, monitor insider transactions and institutional holdings, and review stock splits and dividends. Score news sentiment by ticker, and analyze options chains, put-call ratios, and volume/open-interest ratios for market positioning and sentiment analysis.
Query 50+ technical indicators (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger Bands, VWAP, and more), plus advanced rolling and fixed-window analytics for volatility, correlation, and performance metrics, ideal for backtesting and building trading strategies.
Check forex and currency exchange rates, global commodity prices (gold, silver, oil, natural gas, agricultural goods), and economic indicators like GDP, CPI, inflation, unemployment, treasury yields, and the federal funds rate.
Built for portfolio analysis, valuation modeling, quantitative research, and agentic workflows, from quick ticker lookups to multi-step financial analysis.

items.name: alphaXiv
items.subtitle: Fast search and full-text access over arXiv pre-prints
items.description: Fast retrieval (both keyword and embedding search) tools across the millions of papers in the arXiv corpus. Give your agent context on the latest research papers.

items.name: Alpic
items.subtitle: Manage your MCP Servers and MCP Apps hosted on Alpic
items.description: Manage your projects, debug deployments, and check analytics for any MCP server and MCP App you host with Alpic.ai

items.name: Amass Connector
items.subtitle: Life sciences intelligence, unified — publications, trials, drugs, genes, regulatory approvals, and patents in one cross-linked connector
items.description:
**The biomedical intelligence layer for AI**
Search and reason across 60M+ cross-linked life science records — including peer-reviewed publications, conferences, clinical trials, drugs, genes, regulatory approvals, and patents — from a single connector.
Instead of searching individual databases, Amass gives Claude access to a unified biomedical knowledge layer where entities are linked across sources, enabling richer retrieval, evidence synthesis, and scientific reasoning with full source attribution.
## What you can do
Use Amass to power workflows such as:
- Scientific literature reviews
- Drug and target discovery
- Clinical trial landscape analysis
- Regulatory intelligence (FDA & EMA)
- Drug approval and label comparison
- Patent landscape and freedom-to-operate research
- Gene, target and biomarker exploration
- Due diligence and competitive intelligence
- AI agents that require grounded biomedical evidence
## Included *Cores
**BioMedCore**
BioMedCore (43M+ records: peer-reviewed publications from PubMed/PMC and conference abstracts from society meetings)
**TrialCore**
1.2M+ clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov and international registries (ChiCTR, CTRI, EU-CTR, JPRN, IRCT, and more), linked to drugs, diseases, publications and regulatory outcomes.
**DrugCore**
22K+ harmonized drugs and molecules — including 5,200+ approved — with modality, mechanism of action, targets, development stage, synonyms, structures and ChEMBL relationships.
**RegulatoryCore**
7K+ FDA and EMA approvals, backed by 466K+ parsed document sections — labels, SmPCs, EPARs, review documents and regulatory history.
**GeneCore**
42K+ human genes enriched with target intelligence, druggability, clinical evidence, tractability, DepMap essentiality, safety liabilities and cross-links to drugs, trials and publications.
**PatentCore** *(Preview)*
16M+ life science patents with full-text search, CPC/IPC classifications, patent families, assignees, inventors and chemical compounds.

items.name: Amazon Selling Partner
items.subtitle: Amazon Selling Partner MCP
items.description: Connect your Amazon Seller Central account to Claude. Ask about sales, inventory, and listing performance and get recommendations grounded in your own data, not generic advice. Review and approve every action, without switching back to Seller Central. Currently in beta.

items.name: Amplitude
items.subtitle: Search, access, and get insights on your Amplitude data
items.description: Connect your AI workflows to Amplitude's powerful behavior analytics and experimentation platform. The Amplitude MCP server enables seamless integration between AI assistants and your product data, allowing you to search, analyze, and query charts, dashboards, experiments, feature flags, and metrics directly from your AI interface.

items.name: Android-MCP
items.subtitle: Lightweight MCP Server for Android Operating System
items.description:
Android-MCP is a lightweight, open-source tool that bridge between AI agents and Android devices. Running as an MCP server, it lets LLM agents perform real-world tasks such as **app navigation, UI interaction and automated QA testing** without relying on traditional computer-vision pipelines or preprogramed scripts.
**KEY FEATURES**
- **Native Android Integration**: Interact with UI elements via ADB and the Android Accessibility API.
- **Bring Your Own LLM/VLM**: Works with any language model.
- **Rich Toolset for Mobile Automation**: Pre-built tools for gestures, keystrokes, capture, device state, etc.
- **Real-Time Interaction**: Typical latency between actions ranges 2-4s.
**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**
- Python 3.13 or higher
- Android Debug Bridge (ADB)
Ensure ADB is installed and your device is connected/authorized.
- UV Package Manager
This MCP server requires UV, a fast Python package manager.
Installation:
`curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`
For detailed installation instructions, [see the UV documentation](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv)

items.name: AngelList
items.subtitle: Turn your fund into something you can talk to.
items.description:
Fund managers spend too much time on lookups that should be instant: capital call status, LP holdings, valuations, documents. AngelList MCP puts your entire fund at the other end of a prompt. Authenticate once to query capital accounts, distributions, and documents across every vehicle, backed by financials that refresh daily instead of once a quarter. It's the system of record your fund already runs on, now queryable from wherever you work.
Every answer comes with a path back to its source — ask for the underlying document to verify on your terms. Investment decisions get made on current numbers, LP questions get answered on the spot, and the workflows that used to take an email chain are handled in a single prompt. AngelList runs more of a fund's operations than any other platform — formation, banking, capital calls, distributions, taxes, reporting. AngelList MCP makes all of it queryable from wherever you work.

items.name: AnythingMCP
items.subtitle: Connect Claude to SAP, weclapp, DATEV, Odoo, Etsy, Shopware, Billbee, Sendcloud, Deutsche Bahn, Telegram, Bundesbank & 180+ business APIs — or turn any REST, SOAP, GraphQL or SQL API into MCP tools.
items.description:
AnythingMCP turns the APIs your business already runs on into tools Claude can use — without writing a connector.
180+ ready-made connectors, one click each:
• German & European business software: weclapp, DATEV, easybill, Billbee, Xentral, Personio, Lexware, Shopware, ScopeVisio, Odoo, Bitrix24, deutsche Bahn
• E-commerce & marketplaces: Etsy, WooCommerce, Magento, Amazon Seller Central, eBay, Kaufland, Vinted, Mercado Libre
• Shipping: DHL, DPD, GLS, Sendcloud, Shipcloud
• Payments & finance: Mollie, GoCardless, Adyen, Wise, Stripe, Bundesbank, VIES VAT validation
• CRM & sales: Pipedrive, Zoho, Close, Attio, Apollo, HubSpot
• Messaging & social: Telegram, WhatsApp Business, Discord, Reddit, Pinterest, LINE
• Open data: Deutsche Bahn, Destatis, Handelsregister, OpenPLZ, Companies House, Nominatim, NINA
…and many more.
Or bring your own API. Paste an OpenAPI/Swagger URL, a WSDL, a GraphQL endpoint, a Postman collection or a database connection string and AnythingMCP generates the tools, schemas and auth. Works with REST, SOAP, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQL Server.
Try asking:
• "What is the 10-year Bund yield today?"
• "Is DE811569869 a valid EU VAT number?"
• "Show my open weclapp quotations older than two weeks."
• "Which Etsy listings sold last week?"
• "Any active civil-protection warnings in Germany right now?"
Your credentials stay yours: every call runs with the API keys or OAuth tokens you configured, inside your own workspace, with a per-tool audit log. During sign-in you choose exactly which MCP servers Claude may reach, and you can change or revoke that any time — no reconnect needed.
Self-hosted (AGPL) or cloud. EU-hosted in Frankfurt, GDPR-ready. Built in Freiburg, Germany.

items.name: Apify
items.subtitle: Extract data from any website with thousands of scrapers, crawlers, and automations on Apify Store.
items.description: Apify is the world's largest marketplace of tools for web scraping, crawling, data extraction, and web automation. Get structured data from social media, e-commerce, search engines, maps, travel sites, or any other website.

items.name: Apify
items.subtitle: Extract data from any website with thousands of tools.
items.description: Apify is the world’s largest marketplace of tools for web scraping, crawling, data extraction, and web automation. You can use these tools (called Actors) to extract structured data from social media, e-commerce, search engines, maps, travel sites, or any other website.

items.name: Apollo.io
items.subtitle: Find leads by hiring and funding signals, enrich contacts, and manage outreach sequences
items.description:
Apollo is a B2B sales intelligence and sales engagement platform connected to Claude. Search Apollo's database for people by title, seniority, location, and time in role, and for companies by industry, size, technology stack, funding, hiring, and headcount growth. Find companies using a specific technology and the senior people who work there.
Surface hiring, funding, and headcount-growth signals from company data and job postings, then save people as contacts and companies as accounts and organize them in lists. Enrich people with work emails and, where available, phone numbers. Revealing phone numbers uses additional credits. Enrich companies using their website domains to find industry, headcount, revenue, and funding details, one at a time or in batches.
Keep your pipeline moving: create and search deals, log phone calls, and manage tasks. Draft personalized, multi-step email sequences and create them in Apollo for your review. Add contacts to existing sequences with your confirmation, and track sent emails, opens, and replies by sequence.

items.name: AppFolio Realm-X
items.subtitle: Operate your portfolio directly from Claude
items.description: Use Claude to get real work done in AppFolio. Go deep with data analysis and create reports and presentations, build and trigger complex workflows to run in AppFolio, and drive actions across leasing, maintenance, accounting, and communications. Your AppFolio user permissions securely govern all activity. Through this connector Claude gets more than just API access – it can talk agent-to-agent with Realm-X and handle multi-step processes from prompt to completion. Extend your AppFolio experience to Claude and get work done wherever you work best.

items.name: Aptus.AI - NextOS
items.subtitle: Aptus.AI NextOS in your assistant: what a law, regulation or court ruling provides on your point, with quotations and links to the full text on Aptus.AI.
items.description:
Aptus.AI - NextOS brings the Aptus.AI legal platform into your assistant. Today it gives your assistant NextOS's legal research: ask in natural language and it finds what a named law, regulation or supervisory document provides on your point, what a court ruling holds from its citation, or which legislation and case law bear on a question you describe. Each answer is a report in your language (Italian, English or French) with what each source provides, short verbatim quotations, the in-force status of the act and a link to the full text on the Aptus.AI platform. The connector retrieves and reports; your assistant draws the conclusions.
Coverage: Italian and EU law in depth; Luxembourg in depth for financial-market regulation; plus legislation and regulatory sources from other jurisdictions, including France, the UK, the US, San Marino, Hong Kong and Singapore. Case law covers Italy and the Court of Justice of the EU. Full list of sources: https://aptus.ai/en/enterprise/our-technology/#sources
Read-only: it makes no changes to your account and never returns the full text of a source. Requires an Aptus.AI account with an active subscription.

items.name: Articulate
items.subtitle: Build interactive training right from Claude
items.description:
Connects Claude to Articulate. Describe the training you're creating: topic, goals, who it's for, and how in-depth it should be. Then open and review the outline created for you in Articulate, and generate the full content for your interactive training. You can also search and browse your existing courses.
Key use cases:
- Create a training outline
- List trainings

items.name: Asana
items.subtitle: Connect to Asana to coordinate tasks, projects, and goals
items.description: Access Asana’s Work Graph directly from Claude to search, create, update, and track tasks, projects, and goals. Coordinate work across teams while connecting AI insights to real deliverables. Complements your Asana workspace with 30+ tools for seamless work management alongside your team’s existing workflows.

items.name: Ashby
items.subtitle: Search, analyze, and act on your recruiting data
items.description: Connect Ashby to Claude to get instant access to your ATS data including pipeline, candidate profiles, open roles, and applications. Ask questions, dig into hiring data, and take action by adding notes, moving stages, or sending emails directly from the conversation. Ashby connects Claude to your live recruiting data through secure user-level OAuth. Every request and action respects your existing permissions and your data stays protected.

items.name: Astravue App
items.subtitle: Manage projects, tasks, and team workload in one place
items.description:
Access your Astravue workspace directly from Claude to search, create, and
update tasks, projects, and spaces. Track overdue work, review blockers and
dependencies, log time, manage checklists and comments, and get a live view
of team workload without leaving the conversation.
Every request runs with your own Astravue permissions, so Claude sees exactly
what you see — nothing more. Write actions are explicit and scoped to the
work items you name.
Interactive task and project views open inline for review before you act.
Complements your Astravue workspace with tools spanning tasks, subtasks,
dependencies, custom fields, statuses, tags, time tracking, saved filters,
and workspace members — alongside the workflows your team already uses.

items.name: athenahealth (beta)
items.subtitle: Your athenahealth records, securely connected to Claude
items.description: Link Claude to your athenahealth medical record using the athenaPatient MCP connector to better understand your health information. Ask Claude to explain a lab result, review what happened at a recent visit, or create charts of lab values or vitals (like blood pressure and heart rate). Claude helps you understand your existing records; it doesn't diagnose conditions or make clinical decisions, and always points you back to your care team for medical advice. You decide what information Claude can access, and you can update or revoke that permission at any time.

items.name: AthenaHQ
items.subtitle: Analyze and improve your brand's AI visibility with metrics, sources, competitor benchmarks, and content workflows in Claude.
items.description:
AthenaHQ is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) platform for measuring and improving how brands appear across AI answer engines. Authorized users can analyze visibility and manage their AthenaHQ workspace from Claude.
Key capabilities:
• Analytics: share of voice, mention rate, citation rate, average position, trends, prompts, sources, attributes, and competitor benchmarks
• Workspace management: create and manage prompts, topics, locations, tags, saved views, brand facts, content pillars, and tracked URLs
• Content workflows: create, revise, approve, publish, move, restore, and delete briefs, drafts, and content
• Account context: accessible websites, date ranges, authorized user lookups, and credit usage
Access is limited to the organization and websites available to the authenticated AthenaHQ account. For Claude-authenticated sessions, Claude-sourced answer text and the prompt, source, and finding records derived from those answers are excluded from returned results. Other supported engines remain available. Authentication uses AthenaHQ OAuth or an API key.

items.name: Atlar
items.subtitle: Query your live treasury data: accounts, balances, transactions, and forecasts—directly from Claude.
items.description: Atlar is the AI-native treasury platform for finance teams, unifying cash management, payments, forecasting, bank reconciliation, and investments across 100+ countries of bank and ERP connections. This connector lets Claude query your live Atlar data, e.g. bank accounts, balances, cash flows, transactions, payments, forecasts, and treasury policies—with the same role-based permissions and audit trail as inside Atlar itself.

items.name: atlasFindings
items.subtitle: Search, investigate, and act on Atlas data
items.description: Investigate findings, query assets, and act on tickets across your eSentire Atlas environment.

items.name: Atlassian MCP
items.subtitle: Search, read and update Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Loom and other Atlassian apps with your existing Atlassian permissions.
items.description: Atlassian's Rovo MCP Server enables secure, permission-aware access to Jira, Confluence, Loom, Bitbucket and more. It supports summarization, creation, and multi-step actions, helping teams tap into structured enterprise knowledge wherever they work—all while preserving data privacy and leveraging Atlassian's open, interoperable Teamwork Graph foundation. Claude sees a core set of Jira, Confluence, Loom, Rovo Search and Teamwork Graph tools directly and can discover additional tools for Bitbucket, Goals, Projects, Teams, Focus and Talent on demand. Every action runs with your existing Atlassian permissions; which read, write and delete operations are available (Jira delete and project-administration tools are off unless your organization admin enables them) is controlled in your admin's Rovo MCP server settings, and every tool call is recorded in your organization's audit log.

items.name: Attention
items.subtitle: Search, analyze, and act on client conversations
items.description: Search, analyze, and take action on your sales conversations directly from Claude. Attention captures every call and email, extracts key insights, and syncs intelligence to your other apps automatically. With this connector, you can query call transcripts across your team, surface objections and trends, review scorecards, analyze deal health, and create shareable snippets - all through natural language. Turn every customer conversation into structured data, coaching opportunities, and closed deals without leaving Claude.

items.name: Attentive
items.subtitle: Attentive, inside the AI tools you already use.
items.description:
The Attentive MCP server connects your Attentive account to Claude and other AI assistants. Marketers can build, launch, and analyze messaging programs by describing what they want in plain language. Available channels and features depend on your Attentive account and enabled capabilities.
If you manage more than one account, you can switch between the Attentive accounts you have access to. The MCP server instructs AI assistants to request your confirmation before creating or changing content, scheduling sends, or changing live programs.
Key features:
Campaigns: Create campaigns and message groups, write SMS, RCS, push, and email content, and schedule, pause, or resume sends.
Journeys: Build automated journeys from templates or supported triggers. Add and edit steps and branches, and publish, pause, or archive journeys.
Segments: Create and update audience segments from your account's subscriber and product attributes, and check segment sizes before you send.
Email design: Create and edit email templates, apply brand kit styles and fonts, and use your existing brand assets.
Copy generation: Draft message copy that follows your brand voice settings or guidance you provide, and create tracked short links.
Reporting: Query campaign and journey performance using the metrics available for your account.

items.name: Attio
items.subtitle: Search, manage, and update your Attio CRM from Claude
items.description: Access your entire CRM directly from Claude. Look up contacts and companies, find decision makers, and discover email addresses. Log notes from calls and meetings, track engagement history, and create follow-up tasks with deadlines. Search and filter your pipeline by stage, funding round, role, or location. Tap into meeting intelligence—search call recordings, access transcripts, and surface key insights. Make Attio a seamless part of your AI workflow, so you can manage relationships and close deals faster without switching tools.

items.name: Audible
items.subtitle: Ask for audiobook recommendations & preview audiobooks
items.description:
Use this connector to get audiobook recommendations and previews from Audible. Ask by genre, mood, topic or anything else that comes to mind.
Note: If you're outside the United States, results may redirect you to your local marketplace. Audiobook availability varies by region.

items.name: august
items.subtitle: Understand your users with august Digital Twins
items.description:
august builds digital twins of your users trained on your own data to think, decide, and respond the way each person actually would.
This connector lets you interview your twins one-on-one, run full focus groups or send surveys to whole segments directly in Claude.
Pressure-test messaging, validate a positioning shift, or get a read on a launch in minutes instead of weeks. Built for product, marketing, and research teams who need user insight at the speed of the work.
Getting your twins ready
No workspace yet? Just ask to "set me up on august" and Claude will create one on the spot (name it, pick your vertical, done). From there, connect your data and let august build twins from your user data.
Try these prompts first:
"Ask a power user what almost made them cancel last month"
"Run a focus group on our new onboarding flow and show me where the segments disagree"
"Survey trial users on the one feature they went looking for and could not find"
"Ask my support lead’s twin what is eating their week"
"How would a skeptical new signup describe what we do after five minutes?"

items.name: Aura
items.subtitle: Company intelligence & workforce analytics
items.description: Enables users to search company databases, analyze employee headcount trends, track hiring and attrition rates, explore corporate structures, and benchmark workforce metrics across industries

items.name: Aurora
items.subtitle: Search your Consilio matters, docs, and more.
items.description: Aurora is a read-only connector that puts your Consilio engagement, document, and other data at Claude's fingertips. Ask Claude to find a matter by client or alpha-code, list the workspaces inside it, run a full-text search across documents. AI-powered investigations let Claude follow an answer across matters, workspaces, and documents in a single conversation — automatically narrowing ambiguous queries to the right context and citing a direct source URL on every record. Every response is scoped to what you're already entitled to see on the Consilio web products.

items.name: Autodesk Fusion
items.subtitle: Create, modify, and inspect CAD geometry in Fusion
items.description:
The Fusion MCP server connects Claude to a live Autodesk Fusion session, allowing Claude to send tool requests and perform real-time modeling and command-based operations directly in Fusion.
Key features:
• Real-time interaction with Fusion: Send commands to an active Fusion session and see results immediately in your design workspace.
• Session-based modeling: Create, modify, and inspect 3D geometry, sketches, and features through natural language prompts.
• Live command execution: Execute Fusion operations such as creating primitives, applying modifications, and querying design data without leaving Claude.
• Local-only connection: The MCP server runs on your machine, keeping your design data private and secure.
This server requires Autodesk Fusion. If you don't already have it, [download Fusion](https://www.autodesk.com/products/fusion-360/overview) to get started.
Requirements:
• Fusion must be installed and running locally.
• The MCP server must be enabled in Fusion under Preferences > General > API > Fusion MCP Server.
• Claude Desktop must be installed and configured with the correct port.
**Terms:** Your use of this connector is subject to the Autodesk [Terms of Use](https://www.autodesk.com/company/terms-of-use/en/general-terms).

items.name: Autodesk Product Help
items.subtitle: Securely access Autodesk's help documentation
items.description: The Autodesk Product Help MCP Server connects AI agents directly to Autodesk's official product documentation, enabling accurate, real-time answers across 110+ products. As a secure, read-only interface, it allows AI tools to search, navigate, and retrieve trusted Autodesk help content. This enables support for natural language queries, accelerates onboarding, and provides a reliable foundation for intelligent agents built on authoritative Autodesk product documentation.

items.name: Automox
items.subtitle: Talk to your Automox console in natural language. Manage devices, patches, and policies.
items.description: The official Automox MCP server, packaged as a Claude Desktop Extension. Connects Claude to your Automox environment so you can manage devices, check compliance posture, run policies, prepare for Patch Tuesday, browse the worklet catalog, drive Splashtop remote-control sessions, and more — all by asking. Exposes 133 MCP tools across 18 domains (devices, policies, patches, groups, webhooks, worklets, vulnerability sync, audit, reports, Splashtop remote control, and more), 14 MCP resources (including interactive MCP App UIs for compliance triage, patch-approval review, policy blast-radius review, remediation-apply review, and RBAC access certification), and 6 workflow prompts (audit_policy, investigate_device, onboard_group, patch_tuesday, security_posture, triage_failure). Read-only mode and modular tool loading are supported via optional configuration.

items.name: AUTONOMAD
items.subtitle: Flights, hotels and tours booked in one payment, and changed when plans change, all from Claude
items.description:
Tell Claude the trip you want, and AUTONOMAD finds real flights, hotels and tours. When you've picked, Claude gives you one link to book them all together with a single payment, confirmed in seconds and saved to Apple Wallet. No booking each piece separately.
Once you're booked, Claude can tell you what changed on your trip, like a moved flight. Add Trip Concierge and you can just ask Claude to rebook or cancel, even mid-trip.
Planning with friends? Group trips, where everyone votes and pays only their own share, are only on the AUTONOMAD website, IOS & Android app.

items.name: AutoRFP.ai
items.subtitle: Search your RFP content library, check live project status, and draft with approved answers in Claude.
items.description:
AutoRFP.ai is an AI RFP Software with source-grounded answers. This connector brings your live RFP, DDQ and security questionnaire projects and AI library into Claude.
Ask what's outstanding across your current RFP projects, list the questions still waiting on answers, and search every record in your content library without leaving the conversation.
Draft with content your team has already written and approved. When you're answering a security questionnaire, building a proposal section, or replying to a due diligence questionnaire, Claude works from your reviewed answers for an accuracy-first response.
Requires an AutoRFP.ai account.

items.name: Autosheet
items.subtitle: Agent for Google Sheets work
items.description:
Autosheet lets Claude run a specialized spreadsheet agent directly in Google Sheets. Describe what you need in plain language and give it a Google Sheets URL — the agent inspects the spreadsheet, plans the steps, performs work, and reports back.
Delegate most work involving a Google Sheet including simply reading data or inspecting structure — it's reliable, fast, token-efficient, and helps keep context clean.
Everyday tasks:
Create, fix, and explain formulas
Build charts, pivot tables, analyses, reports, and dashboards
Format and style cells, ranges, and entire sheets
Clean up and restructure data into organized rows, columns, and sheets
Consolidate multiple spreadsheets into one
Row-by-row bulk processing with AI at up to 1,000 rows per minute:
Classify large datasets
Enrich and categorize product catalogs for e-commerce and merchandising
Generate, rewrite, and translate content at scale for SEO and localization
Enrich and score leads for sales outbound through bulk web search
Clean, standardize, and deduplicate messy data
Teams use Autosheet wherever work lives in a spreadsheet: accounting, finance, HR, inventory, education, and more.
How it works:
Give Claude a prompt and a Google Sheets URL or ID. Autosheet launches an agent on that spreadsheet and returns the result.
Authentication through OAuth: you grant access to your own Google Sheets. Works with any spreadsheet you can edit.
Built by Talarian, the team behind GPT for Sheets – Autosheet (7M+ installs on the Google Workspace Marketplace). New accounts start with free trial credits.

items.name: Avanquest PDF API Extension
items.subtitle: MCP server for the Avanquest PDF API, offering scalable tools for PDF conversion, merging, compression, splitting, and advanced document processing automation.
items.description: MCP server enabling Claude Desktop to access powerful PDF tools via the Avanquest PDF API. Features include converting PDFs to multiple formats and back, merging and splitting files, compression, page editing, password protection, watermarking, and advanced analysis of tags, forms, signatures, and attachments.

items.name: AWS API MCP Server
items.subtitle: The AWS API MCP Server lets AI assistants manage AWS resources using AWS CLI commands. It acts as a secure bridge, enabling creation, updates, and management across all AWS services.
items.description: The AWS API MCP Server lets AI assistants manage AWS resources using AWS CLI commands. It acts as a secure bridge, enabling creation, updates, and management across all AWS services.

items.name: AWS Marketplace
items.subtitle: Discover, evaluate, and buy solutions for the cloud
items.description: Access AWS Marketplace directly from Claude to discover, evaluate, and procure cloud solutions. AWS Marketplace MCP helps you find the ideal technology solution from over 30K software, data, and services on AWS Marketplace, compare alternatives, and request private offers from sellers. Get contextual suggestions, relevant insights, and next best action suggestions as your explore AWS Marketplace catalog - all within Claude.

items.name: AWS MCP
items.subtitle: Give agents secure access to AWS via MCP
items.description:
The AWS MCP Server is a managed server that gives agents access to AWS through MCP. Agents can search AWS documentation and retrieve service information without authentication. To execute AWS API calls, run Python scripts in a sandboxed environment, or follow curated skills, agents authenticate through your existing IAM credentials.
All capabilities are available through a single endpoint with CloudWatch metrics and IAM-based access controls. CloudTrail logs all API calls for audit visibility.

items.name: AWS Web Search
items.subtitle: Current, cited web results for Claude from an Amazon-operated web index, served through your own AWS account.
items.description: Give Claude current information from the web with Web Search on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Each result includes a title, URL, publication date and an extract relevant to the query, so Claude can cite every claim. Searches run through an AgentCore Gateway in your own AWS account, and queries are served inside AWS rather than sent to a third-party search engine. Administrators can set a domain blocklist on the gateway that applies to every search, and Claude can narrow a search to specific domains or a publication-date window.

items.name: Azure MCP Server
items.subtitle: Provides Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration and tooling for Azure.
items.description: All Azure MCP tools in a single server. The Azure MCP Server implements the [MCP specification](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) to create a seamless connection between AI agents and Azure services.

items.subtitle: Provides Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration and tooling for Azure.

items.subtitle: Provides Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration and tooling for Azure.
items.description: All Azure MCP tools in a single server. The Azure MCP Server implements the [MCP specification](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) to create a seamless connection between AI agents and Azure services.

items.name: B12 Website Generator
items.subtitle: Create a website in seconds! Generate, design, write code, and write copy for your website. Powered by B12. Contact: hello@b12.io
items.description: This extension allows you to create a professional, engaging, and user-friendly website in seconds using AI. To create a website, you need to provide a name for your project/business, along with a description of the project/business (goals, structure, etc.).

items.name: Backlog
items.subtitle: MCP Server
items.description: Backlog MCP Server connects Claude to Nulab's Backlog — a project management, issue tracking, and Git/SVN platform used by teams worldwide. Manage projects, issues, comments, wikis, and version-control activity directly from your conversations.

items.name: Backstory
items.subtitle: Get answers on every deal
items.description: Backstory connects Claude to your team's deal and account history - every email, meeting, call, and CRM record. Ask about pipeline risk, stakeholder engagement, or next steps. Get answers based on what actually happened, not just what got logged in your CRM.

items.name: Badger Maps (Standard)
items.subtitle: Badger Maps is the #1 field sales platform
items.description:
Badger AI brings a new layer of intelligence to the platform your team already uses. Opt into the features that make sense for your workflow — from AI-built routes to automated CRM updates — and let Badger handle the busy work so your reps can spend more time selling.
AI Route Planner: Your optimal week, built automatically
Stop deciding who to see and when. Badger AI analyzes your accounts and builds your entire week automatically — prioritizing your stops by last visit date, follow-up status, and opportunity size, all built around the existing meetings in your calendar.
Automated Follow-Up Emails: No deal goes cold. No follow-up gets missed.
Deals die in the silence between meetings. Badger AI reads your meeting notes and automatically drafts and sends personalized follow-up emails to every customer — so the right message goes to the right person at the right time, without you lifting a finger.
Automated Scheduling Emails: Scheduling, without the back and forth
Before you even leave for the field, Badger AI analyzes your routes and sends targeted email blasts to prospects in the areas you're visiting — so by the time you're on the road, meetings are already being set up around your existing schedule.
The old way of field sales is over.
Reps planning routes by hand. Hours of admin after a long day in the field. Follow-ups that fall through the cracks. Badger AI eliminates all of it — so your team can focus on what actually moves the needle.
The future of field sales is automated. Start today.

items.name: BambooHR
items.subtitle: Look up employees, check time off, run reports, and manage goals and hiring
items.description: Connect BambooHR to Claude to look up employee records, manage time off, run HR reports, track hiring, and keep goals moving. Claude can tell you who reports to whom and pull an employee's job history, check who's out this week and how much PTO someone has left, submit and approve time off requests, run reports saved in BambooHR or build ad hoc queries against your employee data, review applicants and where they sit in the pipeline, and create or update goals and milestones. Customers hiring through BambooHR's employer of record offering can also see global workers, outstanding onboarding steps, and which countries they can hire in. Useful for answering people questions in the middle of another task, pulling headcount or turnover numbers before a meeting, clearing a backlog of time off requests, or checking a candidate's status without opening the ATS. Every request runs as the BambooHR user who connected and operates under that account's access.

items.name: Baremetrics
items.subtitle: Read-only access to Baremetrics SaaS analytics — metrics, customers, subscriptions, plans, charges, and events.
items.description: Read-only access to Baremetrics SaaS analytics — metrics, customers, subscriptions, plans, charges, and events.

items.name: Base44

items.description: Create, edit, and manage Base44 apps directly from Claude. Query your app's data, update entity schemas, and iterate on existing projects without ever leaving Claude. Make Base44 a native part of your AI workflow — an AI-powered app builder that turns ideas into production-ready apps, faster.

items.name: beehiiv
