Use it to streamline your operations and spend more time on the work that matters.

items.name: Belvo MCP
items.subtitle: Understand your finances on your own terms
items.description:
Ask Claude about your own financial life and get answers grounded in your real data.
Add Belvo as a connector and Claude can use your own financial information when you ask about your money. Get a clearer picture of where you stand, understand patterns you might not notice on your own, and think through decisions with answers based on your real numbers. Available for bank accounts and INSS records in Brazil, and SAT and IMSS records in Mexico.
Connect in minutes: add Belvo and link your first source.
Secure access: Belvo reads your data and can refresh your connections, but never moves money or changes your accounts.
You're in control: you decide what to connect and can disconnect anytime.

items.name: Benchling
items.subtitle: Access Benchling's scientific AI for research in Claude
items.description:
Benchling is the leading R&D platform built for AI-first science. This connector brings Benchling's best-in-class scientific AI directly into Claude, giving scientists, informaticians, and R&D leaders access to purpose-built research intelligence without leaving their workflow.
Ask complex questions about your research and get back structured, traceable answers drawn from your Benchling data, with the domain depth that general AI tools can't match.
To use, AI Chat must be enabled in your Benchling account.

items.name: Benevity
items.subtitle: Find and engage with verified nonprofits
items.description: Search for trusted causes to donate to or volunteer with from Benevity's database of more than 2.3 million verified nonprofits.

items.name: mcp.betterstack.com
items.subtitle: Better Stack plugin for Claude: observability for AI agents (logs, metrics, dashboards, uptime, incidents).
items.description: Connect Claude to your Better Stack Uptime and Telemetry data. Your agent can query logs and metrics, build dashboards, manage uptime monitors, and respond to incidents, all in natural language.

items.name: Bigdata.com
items.subtitle: Financial news, SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, fundamentals, sentiment, market data and stock research for AI, with every answer cited. The sources that move markets.
items.description:
Bigdata.com is the grounding layer for AI in business and finance: search financial news, SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, analyst research, fundamentals and market data, with every answer grounded in licensed, cited sources instead of guesses.
Ask Claude in plain language across billions of documents spanning 25+ years: 200+ premium news sources including Benzinga and MT Newswires, 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K filings plus filings from 50+ countries, broker research, 30+ years of fundamentals and sentiment signals.
Pull company, ETF and market tearsheets and check the earnings calendar. Entity resolution maps companies and tickers automatically, with no fabricated numbers or invented quotes: every claim links back to its source. Search your private documents alongside public content, and pay only for the excerpts you use.
Built for investors, analysts and portfolio managers: stock research, earnings previews and recaps, pre-FOMC briefings, 10-K comparisons, competitor tracking and due diligence. Connect in seconds, with no setup.

items.name: BiggerPockets
items.subtitle: Underwrite real estate deals and search BiggerPockets' investing library.
items.description:
BiggerPockets brings real estate investment analysis into Claude.
Run the same deal calculators investors use on BiggerPockets.com — buy-and-hold rental, BRRRR, fix-and-flip, wholesale, rehab estimate, mortgage payment, and the 70% rule — and get back the headline numbers: monthly cash flow, cap rate, cash-on-cash ROI, NOI, maximum allowable offer, and total cash needed. Optional multi-year projections show how a deal pencils out over a 30-year hold.
You can also search BiggerPockets' library of forum discussions and blog articles in natural language. Results combine semantic and keyword matches, each labeled with its source, title, link, and relevance score, so you can follow any answer back to the original thread.
Connect by signing in with your BiggerPockets account. Content search is available to all members; the deal calculators require BiggerPockets Pro or an active free Pro trial.

items.name: Bigin by Zoho CRM
items.subtitle: Simplify sales and customer management for small businesses
items.description:
The Zoho Bigin connector enables users to manage their sales pipeline and customer relationships directly through AI. It can help with:
Managing contacts, companies, deals, and pipelines
Creating, updating, and retrieving customer records
Tracking deal stages and sales activities
Managing tasks, notes, and follow-ups
Searching and retrieving customer information
Updating sales records and keeping pipeline data current
Supporting day-to-day sales and CRM workflows through natural language

items.name: Google Cloud BigQuery
items.subtitle: BigQuery: Advanced analytical insights for agents
items.description: Integrate analytical data into your agent workflows to achieve superior business results. By connecting your agents with BigQuery, you can provide actionable insights directly to them. Move past standard analytics and utilize BigQuery's advanced features, such as forecasting, to generate higher-value intelligence.

items.name: BILL
items.subtitle: Finance answers, where you need them.
items.description: Connect BILL to Claude for instant visibility into your company's payables, receivables, and spend. Search bills, payments, invoices, and card transactions, and summarize what's due, outstanding, or trending. Access is read-only and runs as each signed-in user: same data, same access, same permissions as BILL itself.

items.name: BillingMart
items.subtitle: BillingMart.com MCP Server- Invoice drafts, estimates, client lookup, expenses, and billing reports
items.description:
BillingMart’s MCP server connects Claude to a user’s BillingMart workspace, allowing them to manage billing and business records through natural language.
Key features include creating draft invoices and estimates, finding clients, reviewing invoice statuses and payment records, managing recurring billing, tracking time, expenses and mileage, and accessing accounts receivable, accounts payable and financial reports.
Users connect through OAuth with scoped permissions. Each tool operates within the connected user’s existing access rights. Writes create drafts, while actions that send communications or move money become requests for human approval in BillingMart. The server uses BillingMart’s first-party API and supports sandbox workspaces for testing without affecting live customers.

items.name: BioRender
items.subtitle: Search the BioRender library, find your files, and generate new scientific figures directly from Claude.
items.description: Search BioRender's library of scientific templates, find your files, and generate custom first-draft figures with AI. Results and previews appear right in your conversation, and every item links back to BioRender so you can open and keep editing.

items.name: bioRxiv
items.subtitle: Access bioRxiv and medRxiv preprint data
items.description: The bioRxiv Connector gives Claude access to bioRxiv and medRxiv preprint servers, hosting research papers in biological and medical sciences posted before peer review.

items.name: Bird
items.subtitle: Send email, SMS, and WhatsApp, place calls, verify users, and run your agent's inbox
items.description:
Bird is the communications infrastructure AI agents operate. Every agent eventually has to reach a human — verify a sign-up, confirm an order, chase an invoice, answer an inbox, place a call. Connect Bird and Claude does all of it for real: email, SMS, and WhatsApp on Bird's own sending infrastructure and carrier connections, calls on Bird SIP trunks, live events to every open browser and app over Bird Realtime — with a delivery timestamp or the exact failure reason instead of a guess.
And Claude doesn't just send through Bird — it can own the endpoints. It claims its agent a durable email address in one call and answers what arrives there. It buys a phone number, gets it verified for texting, and registers the 10DLC campaign behind it. It sets up a SIP trunk and proves the caller ID with a real verification call. Addresses, numbers, trunks, and the compliance behind them — acquired in conversation.
Whatever your account can do, Claude can do here. The tools are generated from Bird's live API — the same surface Bird's own dashboard runs on — so the list your client shows is always the current one and grows as Bird does. Some of it works before you even connect: grade any domain's live email authentication, analyze headers and DMARC reports, or search Bird's docs, no account needed.
You sign in with Bird when you connect, so there is no API key to paste and no secret sitting in a config file. Claude gets only the permissions you already hold, and you can revoke them from your Bird profile.
A good first ask: "Send me a test email and tell me the moment it's delivered." Building an agent? "Claim yourself an email address and reply to whatever arrives."

items.name: Bitly
items.subtitle: Shorten links, generate QR Codes, and track performance
items.description: Create, track, and manage Bitly links and QR Codes directly from Claude without switching contexts. Access 27 comprehensive tools spanning link creation, analytics, organizational management, and more—making this the most complete link management solution available in any AI assistant.

items.name: Bitmovin
items.subtitle: Connect Bitmovin to access player, observability, encoding, ads and more in one place
items.description: Your entire Bitmovin platform, now in Claude. Analyze Observability data, get insights on your ad performance, stream video with Player, manage Encoding jobs, run Stream Lab tests, manage support tickets, and much more. With MCP Apps, visualize QoE and ad metrics through interactive charts and stream DASH or HLS playback directly in the chat.

items.name: Bitrise MCP
items.subtitle: Set up and manage mobile CI/CD on Bitrise: build, test, and distribute iOS, Android, Flutter, and React Native apps from your AI assistant.
items.description: The Bitrise MCP Server gives AI assistants secure, full access to the Bitrise mobile CI/CD platform. Manage your entire mobile delivery pipeline conversationally: register and configure apps, trigger and monitor builds, manage artifacts and caches, orchestrate pipelines, and ship releases to the App Store and Google Play.

items.name: Black Diamond
items.subtitle: Client, portfolio, and performance data for advisors
items.description:
Connect Claude to Black Diamond and get answers from your data in plain language, without switching screens or running manual lookups.
Look up clients and accounts, pull performance and holdings down to the tax lot, track private fund activity, and review fees and transactions. Find rebalancing and tax loss harvesting opportunities, launch rebalance sessions, and run client reports on demand.
Built for advisors and operations teams prepping for client meetings, researching billing questions, or scanning the book for opportunities.

items.name: Black Duck Security Scanner
items.subtitle: AI-powered security vulnerability scanning via Black Duck Signal.
items.description: Black Duck MCP brings Signal's AI-powered security analysis directly into Claude Desktop. Scan git changes, individual files, or full projects for security vulnerabilities. Results are exposed as MCP resources for detailed AI-driven analysis. Note: scanned source content is transmitted to Black Duck's remote analysis endpoint for processing.

items.name: Blackbaud
items.subtitle: Search, explore, and query Blackbaud data
items.description: Query, explore, and combine Blackbaud data directly from Claude. The Blackbaud MCP server brings your nonprofit data into Claude's AI workspace—securely surfacing constituent details, event records, and donation insights without writing a single line of code. Ask natural questions and get live answers, powered by Blackbaud's SKY API and MCP integration.

items.name: BlackRock Advisor Center
items.subtitle: Build, analyze, and compare portfolios for advisors
items.description:
Description
Analyze client portfolios, understand risk, stress test market scenarios, and compare investment alternatives. BlackRock Advisor Center brings Advisor Center 360° insights and analytics into Claude, so financial advisors can review a portfolio, see what drives risk, evaluate concentration and cost, and explore changes across ETFs, mutual funds, individual bonds, SMAs, model portfolios, and alternatives.
What you can do:
• Analyze a portfolio across asset allocation, exposures, expenses, risk factors, and concentration
• Understand what drives risk across holdings, asset classes, sectors, and factors
• Stress test historical or hypothetical scenarios and see which positions drive the outcome
• Identify triggers such as excess cash, concentrated stock, fund concentration, or unintended exposures
• Compare investment alternatives, including ETFs, mutual funds, individual bonds, SMAs, model portfolios, and alternatives, and evaluate potential changes
• Browse model portfolios and construct proposed allocations.
Try prompts like:
• "Review this client portfolio and tell me what stands out"
• "What's driving the risk in this portfolio, and which holdings contribute most?"
• "Is this portfolio too concentrated in any single stock or sector?"
• "Stress test this portfolio against a 20% market drop"
• "How would this portfolio hold up in a recession or if rates rise?"
• "Is this portfolio holding too much cash, and what if I put it to work?"
• "Show me the impact on risk and cost if I replace this fund"
• "Compare this client portfolio against this model portfolio"
• "Find a model portfolio for a moderate-risk income client"
• "Show me ETFs, mutual funds, individual bonds, SMAs, model portfolios, or alternatives I could evaluate for this portfolio"
All analysis is advisor driven. You bring the questions and client context, and the connector provides objective portfolio insights and analytics. It does not provide investment advice, recommend or place trades.

items.name: Blackthorn Forge MCP for Native Salesforce Event Management
items.subtitle: Blackthorn's MCP server for Salesforce events: create, query, and report on events, attendees, tickets, sessions, forms, and email campaigns, over 100 available tools, live against your org.
items.description:
Blackthorn Events turns Salesforce into an event platform; this MCP server lets Claude operate it directly, no exports, no copy-paste.
Connect with Salesforce OAuth 2.0 + PKCE and Claude gets 94 tools across the event lifecycle:
- Reporting: dashboards, event metrics, ROI, pipeline/finance snapshots, registration funnels, attendee status, session popularity, email performance, donation reports, CSV export.
- Events, sessions & tickets: create/update events, ticket types, sessions; clone an event (dry-run preview first) in seconds.
- Attendees & registrations: create, update, look up, and manage records.
- Speakers & sponsors: create and update records tied to your events.
- Forms: build registration forms, add questions, create managed dropdowns.
- Email & audiences: browse templates, list segments/audiences, schedule campaigns, pull performance metrics.
- Escape hatch: a SOQL query tool (SELECT-only, LIMIT-enforced) and an object-describe tool for anything else.
- Every write is guarded: deletes require an explicit confirm flag, and the server resolves event names to Salesforce IDs for you, it never asks for a raw record ID or echoes internal field names into chat.
Salesforce stays the system of record. Reads/writes go through standard Salesforce APIs into the Blackthorn-managed objects your team already uses, no shadow database, no bulk copy of your CRM data. Claude never sees your Salesforce password; refresh tokens are encrypted at rest.
Typical asks: "What's registration looking like for the Q3 conference, give me the funnel and where people drop off," "Clone last year's user conference into a new event for October," "Add a dietary-restrictions question to the registration form," "Which sponsors haven't been invoiced yet," "Export the VIP segment as a CSV," or "Schedule the reminder email for everyone who hasn't checked in yet."
Built for planners, marketers, and ops teams running events on Blackthorn's Salesforce-native package.

items.name: Blaze SQL
items.subtitle: Let claude query any SQL Database or warehouse with accuracy, context, governance, and observability. BlazeSQL is a full BI Layer with visualizations, dashboards, scheduled reports, and more.
items.description:
BlazeSQL lets Claude query your database or warehouse with all the necessary context to get the correct answers.
Connect to Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS Athena, MariaDB, SQL Anywhere, Databricks, Clickhouse, and Oracle.
With context management, observability, and comprehensive access controls, BlazeSQL turns claude into an enterprise-ready AI Data Analyst for reliable self-service across your entire company.
As a comprehensive Business Intelligence layer, BlazeSQL also enables visualization, dashboards, advanced statistical analysis, predictive analytics, scheduled reports, and custom PDF or interactive HTML reports.

items.name: Blender
items.subtitle: Natural language interface with the Python API and documentation
items.description:
Blender MCP offers a natural language interface with Blender's Python API, improving access to documentation, and allowing users to explore and understand complex setups.
An add-on is required to use the MCP Server, please follow the [instructions](https://lab.blender.org/mcp-server/#addon).

items.name: Bling MCP
items.subtitle: Access and manage your Bling directly in Claude.
items.description:
Bling MCP is the official Model Context Protocol connector for Bling, Brazil's leading e-commerce platform. It seamlessly connects your Bling ERP account to Claude, allowing you to query, manage, and automate your retail and online operations in natural language without writing a single line of code.
Key Capabilities:
- Sales & Orders: Query open sales orders, track order statuses, and monitor fulfillment across multiple marketplaces.
- Inventory Management: Check real-time stock balances across warehouses and identify items near stockout.
- Invoicing & Fiscal (NF-e): Verify tax document status, check pending NF-e invoices, and monitor fiscal compliance.
- Financial Health: Get instant visibility into daily revenue summaries, accounts receivable/payable, and cash flow.
- Token-Efficient Design: Features a curated set of 49 targeted commands designed to minimize token usage and keep AI sessions cost-effective.
- Pre-built Business Skills: Access ready-to-use workflows, including Daily Retail Cockpit, Stockout Radar, and Financial Health diagnostics.
Security & Governance:
Your ERP data remains secure with Bling as your single source of truth. Authentication requires direct OAuth login, strictly respecting your existing user permissions and LGPD privacy standards.
Who It's For:
E-commerce sellers, multi-channel merchants, and developers who rely on Claude to manage, analyze, and automate their daily business operations.

items.name: BlockchainQuery
items.subtitle: Free blockchain data access across 60+ networks. Live lookups for balances, transactions, blocks, tokens, staking, governance, and domain resolution — powered by Pocket Network's decentralized RPC infrastructure. No API key required.
items.description:
BlockchainQuery gives Claude real-time access to blockchain data across 60+ networks through Pocket Network's decentralized RPC gateway. Query balances, transactions, blocks, smart contracts, token metadata, staking positions, governance proposals, and domain resolution — all without API keys or authentication.
Supported protocols: EVM (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon, Optimism, and 35+ more), Solana, Cosmos (Osmosis, Pocket, Akash, and 10+ more), Sui, Near, and Tron.
Provided as a free public good by the Pocket Network Foundation.

items.name: Blockscout
items.subtitle: Access and analyze blockchain data

items.name: Bloomberg Law

Built for legal teams that need reliable docket research, case monitoring, and workflow integration powered by Bloomberg Law.

items.name: BlueConic
items.subtitle: Connect Claude to your BlueConic CDP and explore tenant data through dynamically generated MCP tools.
items.description: BlueConic MCP runs locally, loads your tenant's OpenAPI specification at startup, and exposes BlueConic's read-only GET endpoints as MCP tools. The same codebase also works with Cursor, VS Code, and other stdio-based MCP clients.

items.name: BoardWise
items.subtitle: Calm board-defense guidance for licensed pros.
items.description: BoardWise is a read-only educational MCP server for licensed professionals — nurses, physicians, pharmacists, social workers, CDL holders, and others — facing state licensing-board matters. Claude can use it to look up jurisdiction-specific response deadlines, generate structured outlines for response letters, search BoardWise's library of educational guides, and surface curated resources for situations like complaints, CEU audits, consent agreements, hearing notices, and self-reports. All responses are general educational information (not legal advice). No personal or case data is transmitted, stored, or sent to third parties.

items.name: bolna
items.subtitle: Manage Bolna voice AI agents and review call history and transcripts from Claude.
items.description:
Bolna is a voice AI platform for building and running phone-calling agents. This connector lets Claude manage your Bolna agents: list and inspect agent configurations, review call history and full transcripts, view call batches, check your account info and wallet balance, and create or update agents.
This connector cannot place calls, start batches, purchase phone numbers, or spend balance.
Read tools: list agents, get agent details, list call history, get call details and transcript, list call batches, get account info and wallet balance.
Write tools: create an agent, update an agent's prompts and settings and deleting an agent.
Sign in with your Bolna account via OAuth. Requires a Bolna account.

items.name: Boltz API
items.subtitle: Predict molecular structures and binding interactions, screen libraries, and design binders with the Boltz API.
items.description: The official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Boltz API. Predict molecular structures and binding interactions, screen small-molecule and protein libraries against a target, and design small molecules and protein binders — all from chat. Each workflow estimates cost before running, then downloads structured results to your workspace when the job completes.

items.name: Bonsai
items.subtitle: Manage your CRM, client projects and invoices from Claude
items.description:
Bonsai is where independent consultants and small service businesses run client work: CRM, deals, projects, tasks, time tracking, proposals and invoices in one place.
Connect Bonsai to run your business from Claude.
**Key features:**
• **Ask about your business** - Your tasks for today, where a deal stands, what's outstanding, or a project summary you can send a client.
• **Keep your CRM current** - Add contacts and companies, log activity, and move deals through your pipeline.
• **Create proposals** - Ask Claude to set up a proposal in Bonsai for you to review and send.
• **Turn won work into a project** - A closed deal becomes a project with tasks, owners, and due dates, ready to start.
• **Track time and bill for it** - Log hours against a project, then draft the invoice when the work is done.

items.name: Booking.com
items.subtitle: Find hotels, homes and more
items.description: Get your trip started with Booking.com directly on Claude. Search, compare, and find your next stay – from a pet-friendly beach house in Miami to a sleek 5-star hotel near the Eiffel Tower, just ask. Filter by what matters most to you, like price, ratings and facilities. Finding what you're looking for has never been easier. Your ideal stay – just a prompt away.

items.name: Botify MCP
items.subtitle: AI search visibility, from insight to action
items.description: See how AI search engines find, cite, and recommend your brand, then fix what’s holding you back without leaving Claude. Ask how often AI answers mention your brand, which pages AI bots crawl or skip, and where traffic is slipping. Every answer combines your Botify site crawls, log files, Search Console history, and AI visibility tracking with live search results, AI answers, and keyword trends. When you’re ready to act, draft optimizations in Claude and deploy them to your site from Botify.

items.name: Box
items.subtitle: Search, edit and get insights on your Box content
items.description: Connect Claude to your content stored in Box. Enable Claude to search and access files, use AI to query documents, create or update content, extract metadata fields, and more, while enforcing existing Box security and access policies.

items.name: Brandfetch
items.subtitle: Make everything Claude creates on-brand
items.description: Make everything Claude creates look and sound on-brand. Brandfetch pulls a brand's full identity, its logos, colors, fonts, and voice, into your conversation, so Claude can generate decks, emails, and assets grounded in how a company actually looks and talks. Backed by Brandfetch's index of 50M+ brands.

items.name: Brave (AppleScript)
items.subtitle: Control Brave Browser tabs, windows, and navigation
items.description:
This extension allows Claude to interact with Brave Browser, enabling tab management, navigation, page content reading, and browser automation. It uses Brave's AppleScript API to control the browser programmatically.
This extension is not affiliated with or endorsed by Brave Software, Inc.

items.name: Braze
items.subtitle: Braze Marketers can use this connector to answer questions, analyze trends, and provide insights.
items.description: Provides access to Braze tools across 16 categories including campaigns, canvases, catalogs, events, KPIs, templates, media library, and more. Limited write support covers content blocks, email templates, and media library asset uploads.

items.name: Breezing
items.subtitle: Crypto accounting for Xero, QuickBooks and Bexio Alternative: Categorize, reconcile and book crypto in your ledger
items.description:
Breezing is crypto accounting software for accountants, finance teams and Web3 businesses. It imports transactions from more than 70 blockchains and exchanges, prices them in your base currency, computes cost basis and net gain or loss, and books journals to Xero, QuickBooks Online and Bexio.
The Breezing connector gives Claude the same Public API your team uses behind the dashboard. Claude can list companies, wallets, transactions, balances, contacts, rules, reports and tasks. It can categorize transactions by assigning accounts from your chart of accounts, create and apply rules for recurring patterns, group trades and internal transfers, lock closed periods, start balance and net gain or loss calculations, generate token and account reports, and trigger the sync to your accounting platform.
What it never does: the connector cannot move funds. Breezing reads blockchain and exchange data through public addresses and read-only exchange keys, and it has no ability to sign transactions or transfer assets. It also never deletes records. Destructive actions stay in the Breezing dashboard.
Every tool that changes data is flagged, so Claude asks you to confirm before it writes. Access uses a Breezing API key you create in your company settings, scoped to the companies you choose with read or write permission per company, and you can revoke it at any time.
Setup: sign in to Breezing, create an API key under Company settings, then add the Breezing connector in Claude and paste the key on the authorization page. Documentation: https://learn.breezing.io/mcp/introduction

items.name: Breezy HR MCP
items.subtitle: Turn a conversation with Claude into actual work. Connect to Breezy to manage your hiring workflow, from job creation to reporting on hiring activity
items.description: The Breezy MCP server connects Claude directly to your Breezy Hire instance to view and interact with position and candidate data. The integration enables users to complete a wide range of tasks using natural language, from viewing candidate and position data to emailing candidates and analyzing hiring pipelines and workflows. This conversational approach streamlines and simplifies recruiting functions across your hiring team.

items.name: Brek - Hotel Wholesale Booking
items.subtitle: Search and compare hotels with public and private wholesale rates.
items.description: Search hotels, compare public and private wholesale rates, and book on Brek with transparent markups. Brek also helps travelers inspect property details, compare room offers, and review breakfast, refundability, and cancellation terms. Exact private prices, sign-in, payment, and booking are completed securely on brek.com.

items.name: Brevo
items.subtitle: Analyze campaigns, know your audience and create drafts
items.description: Connect Brevo to Claude to analyze email campaign performance and A/B test results, look up contacts, and explore audience segments in plain language, all without leaving your conversation. Claude can also generate HTML email templates, draft email campaigns, and draft SMS campaigns, saved directly to your Brevo account for you to review before sending. Claude will never send or schedule email campaigns, and will never delete anything on your behalf. Available on all Brevo plans.

items.name: Brex
items.subtitle: Intelligent finance automation
items.description: Connect Brex to Claude for automating your company's finances. Finance monitors compliance and runs powerful queries. Employees get personalized memo guidance, policy answers, and status updates. Permission-based access ensures admin oversight while streamlining management.

items.name: Brightcove
items.subtitle: Manage Brightcove videos, players, live streams, analytics and more from Claude.
items.description:
Brightcove is a leading video platform for hosting, managing, and delivering video. The Brightcove MCP server connects Claude to your Brightcove account so you can work with your video content in plain language.
With it you can:
- Search, create, and update videos, playlists, folders, labels, and custom fields
- Start and monitor ingests, and manage captions, audio tracks, and metadata
- Create and configure players and embeds
- Create and manage live jobs and schedules
- Query video and account analytics
- Manage playback authorization, playback rights, and delivery rules
- Work with Gallery, Interactivity, Audience, and Social
- Manage Cloud Playout channels and SSAI ad configurations
The server exposes roughly 460 tools across the Brightcove platform. Read-only tools run immediately; tools that change or delete data are marked as destructive, so your assistant asks for confirmation before it runs them.
You need an MCP client that supports remote servers with OAuth, and a Brightcove account with the MCP server enabled. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.0, and every action runs under your account's permissions.

items.name: Brightdeck
items.subtitle: Create presentations and slides, compatible with PowerPoint
items.description:
Use A.I. Slides by Brightdeck to create PowerPoint presentations right inside Claude. Describe the deck you need and Brightdeck generates a beautifully designed presentation with tables, charts, and illustrations that exports to native PowerPoint (.pptx) and is fully compatible with PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Keynote.
Brightdeck can also add slides to a deck you already have or edit your existing decks. New slides match your existing fonts, colors, and layouts, so the rest of the presentation stays exactly as your team built it.
Available features include:
- Generate a full presentation from a topic, outline, or prompt
- Turn documents, reports, and rough notes into a slide deck
- Add new slides to an existing PowerPoint without breaking its design
- Speaker notes on every slide
- Refine slide content in a chat-based conversation
- Export and download as PowerPoint (.pptx) or PDF — fully editable shapes and text, not flat images

items.name: Brightflag

items.description: Brightflag is the intuitive, AI-powered Enterprise Legal Management platform that empowers corporate legal teams and outside counsel to unlock business growth. Connect to Brightflag to interact with matter, vendor and spend data within Claude.

items.name: BrightHire
items.subtitle: Search, summarize and analyze hiring data
items.description: Retrieve and analyze hiring data, including scheduled interview context and prep materials, AI-generated notes and post-interview summaries, interviewer scorecards and candidate assessments from your ATS (e.g., Greenhouse), structured interview guides with questions and competencies, and job descriptions for open positions.

items.name: Brisk Teaching
items.subtitle: Turn your ideas into interactive student activities, standards-aligned materials, and teaching resources
items.description: The Brisk Teaching connector brings your classroom toolkit into Claude. Create interactive student activities, quizzes, standards-aligned lessons, and more right in the tools you already use. Just describe what you need, and Brisk builds it in your account with easy-to-share links, so you can turn your ideas into classroom-ready materials in seconds. Edit, refine, and bring them to your students whenever you're ready.

items.name: Bronto
items.subtitle: Query your Observability data in plain language, then turn what you find into monitors, saved searches, and Investigation Reports.
items.description:
Bronto is an observability data platform built for petabyte scale: sub-second search across 12 months of always-hot retention, no rehydration, no waiting on archives.
This connector gives Claude direct access to your live telemetry. Ask what's happening in production and Claude works the way an engineer would: find the relevant datasets, inspect their schemas and field values, build precise filters, then search raw events or aggregate them into trends and percentiles. You describe what you're looking for instead of needing the query language up front.
Investigations don't have to end when you find the answer. Claude can turn the query that exposed a problem into a monitor so it's caught automatically next time, save the useful views for your team as timeseries, top-lists, tables or geomaps, and attach an investigation playbook that runs when the monitor fires — so on-call starts from a diagnosis rather than a blank page. Monitors are always created muted, so nothing pages anyone until you've reviewed it in Bronto.
You can also ask about coverage itself: which datasets are ingesting but unmonitored, which are heavily ingested but never searched, which have gone stale, and where errors are concentrated.
What Claude can do:
Discover datasets, inspect schemas, and search raw telemetry events over any time range
Aggregate with counts, sums, averages, percentiles, grouping, and time bucketing
Create, find, and re-run saved searches with tags and custom visualizations
Create threshold and no-data monitors, muted for review, with optional AI investigation prompts
Health-check existing monitors to spot ones that have silently stopped working
Audit per-dataset monitoring, search, and ingestion coverage, and pull org-wide error summaries at no search cost
Authentication uses your existing Bronto login — OAuth, SSO, or Google Social — and admins control which login methods are permitted for MCP access. Connect the endpoint for your data region, EU or US.

items.name: BusyCal
items.subtitle: Manage your calendars, events, tasks, and availability in BusyCal.
items.description: Search events and tasks, check your availability, find free time, and create or update calendar items — all through BusyCal on your Mac.

items.description: CAISey is an AI-assisted research and information tool embedded directly into the CAIS platform. It helps financial advisors who are CAIS platform users quickly evaluate and compare alternative investment products available on the CAIS platform using plain-language information drawn from materials made available by asset managers.

items.name: Calendly
items.subtitle: Manage scheduling and access meeting recaps
items.description: Schedule smarter and stay on top of meetings with Calendly in Claude. Create and update Event Types, share scheduling links, adjust availability, and book meetings through simple conversations. Plus, find and summarize meeting recaps, revisit key decisions and action items, and access transcripts — all without leaving Claude.

items.name: Campfire
items.subtitle: Search, analyze, and export Campfire data
items.description: Search, analyze, and retrieve data from your Campfire ERP directly in Claude. Ask questions about projects, contacts, and financials in natural language. Create board decks, generate insights from your data, and make informed decisions as a native part of your AI workflow.

items.name: Canary Data
items.subtitle: Perform world-class investment analysis
items.description: Generate new investment ideas and perform in-depth analysis of any publicly traded business using proprietary Canary datasets, intelligence and synthesis within Claude. Canary plays well with other financial MCPs to combine to make Claude into a world-class investment analyst.

items.name: Candid
items.subtitle: Research nonprofits and funders using Candid's data
items.description: Bring the power of Candid's comprehensive nonprofit and funder data directly into Claude. Search millions of organizations, discover funding opportunities, and access expert knowledge and social sector news—all through natural conversation.

items.name: Canva
items.subtitle: Search, create, autofill, and export Canva designs
items.description: Browse, summarize, autofill, and even generate new Canva designs directly from Claude. Make Canva a native part of your AI workflow—an AI-powered design agent that helps you create polished visuals faster, with less friction.

items.subtitle: Instant air cargo rates, quotes & tracking
items.description: Browse rates and track air cargo directly from Claude. Make CargoAi a native part of your AI workflow — an AI-powered freight agent that helps forwarders get instant quotes and monitor shipments faster, with less friction. Bring your CargoMart operations into the conversation.

items.name: CarGurus
items.subtitle: Find, buy, and research cars
items.description:
Find the right new or used car by describing what you're looking for in plain language.
Search vehicle listings using specific criteria like price, make, model, or mileage - or broader needs such as "cars that are safe in the snow," "great family cars," or "reliable commuter vehicles."
Explore matching listings with high-quality photos, full vehicle specifications, safety information, and dealer details. Whether you're comparing options or narrowing down to a shortlist, the app helps you translate real-world needs into confident car-buying decisions.

Une idée de recette, un événement à venir, le plein de courses… demandez à Claude, Carrefour vous répond !

items.subtitle: The connected ERP for private capital
items.description: Access cap table and investor data directly to your AI workflow. Cap table customers can pull cap table ownership, 409A valuations, and stakeholder details. Model pro-forma rounds and analyze exit scenarios. For investors, access investment metrics, fund performance, accounting data, and company financials instantly. Ask questions, run scenarios, and uncover insights without context switching—your Carta data remains secure and integrated.

items.name: Order by Cash App

items.description: Order by Cash App brings local food ordering into Claude. Discover nearby restaurants, compare menus, customize your order, and check out, all in the conversation. On clients that support it, an interactive ordering view opens right in chat.

items.name: Cashfree

items.description:
Connect Claude with Cashfree and manage your entire payments ecosystem through natural conversation. Access merchant dashboard data instantly — including payments, orders, refunds, settlements, payouts, payment links, reconciliation reports, transaction activity, and workflows — without jumping between tools or dashboards.
Built for both operational visibility and developer workflows, the connector is evolving beyond dashboard actions to support the full suite of Cashfree, Payouts, SecureID, PPI, and Partners APIs used in real-world integrations. From tracking live payment flows and debugging transactions to managing settlements and analyzing business performance, Claude becomes your unified AI-powered Cashfree assistant for every payments-related task.

The Codex plugin helps developers use Catalyst services directly from their coding workflow, making it easier to create backends, manage databases and storage, deploy applications, automate tasks, and integrate with Zoho and external services without switching between multiple tools.

items.name: CB Insights
items.subtitle: Predictive intelligence on private companies
items.description: Unleash Claude as your private markets research agent. Source companies, build market maps, draft investment memos, and monitor competitors — all powered by CB Insights' predictive intelligence. Tap into 11M+ double-validated company profiles, leading coverage of recent equity deals, proprietary taxonomies, unique scores, hidden signals, and over 20 years of bleeding-edge technology research to identify and analyze relevant, high-potential companies ahead of your competition. Built for corporate strategists seeking acquisition targets, VCs screening deal flow, and business development teams hunting new partners. If your work involves private companies, CB Insights delivers the insight you need to make your next move first.

items.name: CData Connect AI

items.description: Connect Claude to read, write, and act on 350+ enterprise data sources like Salesforce, Snowflake and NetSuite in real-time through one fully hosted remote MCP server. Connect AI is the only managed MCP platform built with semantic intelligence that understands your data's metadata and relationships across systems for multi-source analysis. Ensure trusted boundaries with enterprise security, granular permissions, and complete audit trails. Set up any source in minutes and get started free.

items.description: Celigo's integrator.io is an intelligent automation platform built for limitless scale and mission critical use cases, from deterministic to fully agentic. Investigate business performance, identify growth opportunities, uncover churn drivers, explore customer relationships, and answer complex questions about your SaaS business. items.name: Chaser

items.description: Chaser is a Slack-native project management and task app built for teams that already work in Slack. Instead of switching to a separate tool, your team creates, assigns, and tracks tasks right inside Slack conversations—no new app to learn and no training required.

items.name: Chatbase
items.subtitle: Manage Chatbase agents, sources, conversations, tickets.
items.description: Chatbase lets teams build and operate AI agents trained on their own business content, and run support end to end - chat widgets, help-desk tickets, and the sources those agents are trained on. This connector gives an MCP client direct access to a connected Chatbase account: list and inspect agents, create and update knowledge sources, update agent configuration, export conversations, and read, create, and update help-desk tickets and their messages.

items.name: Checkatrade
items.subtitle: Find trusted local tradespeople and book fixed-price jobs — without leaving Claude.
items.description:
Checkatrade connects Claude to the UK's trusted network of vetted,
reviewed tradespeople — plumbers, electricians, builders, handymen,
roofers, plasterers, carpenters and joiners, painters and decorators,
tilers, kitchen and bathroom fitters, locksmiths, gardeners and
landscapers, plus Gas Safe registered heating engineers and many more
trades.
Just give a UK postcode and describe the job in plain English. Whether
it's a leaking or dripping tap, a broken boiler, no hot water, a blocked
drain or toilet, a burst pipe, faulty wiring, a tripping fuse box, a roof
leak or missing tiles, damp, an odd job for a handyman, a repair, an
emergency callout, or a bigger project like a renovation, loft conversion
or extension — Claude returns ranked local results with star ratings,
review counts, Checkatrade badges, contact numbers and direct profile
links, so you can compare trades and get in touch.
For common, straightforward jobs — boiler servicing and repair, gas
safety certificates (CP12), central heating maintenance, and basic
plumbing or electrical work — Claude can also surface fixed-price
Checkatrade Express options and guide you through booking one from start
to finish: collecting your details, gathering the time slots that suit
you, and handing off to secure payment.
Every tradesperson is background-checked and rated by real customers, so
you can hire with confidence. No account, sign-up or login needed — just
a valid UK postcode and a description of what needs doing.

items.name: Checkout.com
items.subtitle: Investigate, troubleshoot, and understand payment operations.
items.description:
The Checkout.com MCP provides direct access to the documentation, guidance, and operational tools for onboarding and investigating payments in natural language. Explore our documentation and API schemas, look up payment details, payment history, entities and processing channels in your Production account (read-only).
GET ONBOARDING GUIDANCE: Ask your AI agent to use the Guide tool to help you choose the best integration path for your use case and tech stack.
FIND INFORMATION: Search through the docs, browse API schemas, read integration guides, or troubleshoot issues directly from your code editor.
INVESTIGATE PAYMENT OPERATIONS: Query payment data and statuses, and review your payment operations.

items.description: The Chronograph MCP server allows users to query portfolio data, analyze investments, search for entities, retrieve performance metrics, and access Chronograph's help documentation. The connector is designed for private investment workflows, providing programmatic access to portfolio analytics and reporting data.

items.name: Circleback
items.subtitle: Search and access context from meetings
items.description: Bring context from Circleback into Claude. Search and access meeting notes, transcripts, calendar events, emails, people, companies, and more.

items.name: CircleCI
items.subtitle: Manage CI/CD pipelines, debug failed builds, and optimize test suites directly from Claude - no terminal required.
items.description:
The CircleCI MCP Server is a remote server hosted by CircleCI that connects Claude directly to your CI/CD pipelines, giving you a conversational interface to the same pipeline, workflow, job, and artifact data you'd normally reach through the CircleCI CLI or dashboard.
With this connector, you can ask Claude to check the latest pipeline status for a project or roll back a deployment - all without leaving your conversation. When something breaks, Claude can pull the failure logs for a specific build and help you understand what went wrong, or dig into test results for a job to pinpoint which tests failed and why.
Beyond troubleshooting individual runs, the server supports broader pipeline health and efficiency work. Claude can identify underused resource classes to help you right-size compute and control costs, and list artifacts produced by your builds so you can retrieve build outputs without hunting through the UI.
It also helps with day-to-day project management: checking component versions across your fleet, and pulling usage data for cost and consumption analysis. For configuration work, it can act as a config helper - assisting with validating and troubleshooting your .circleci/config.yml setup.
In short, this MCP Server turns Claude into a working partner for CI/CD: monitoring pipeline health, debugging build and test failures, managing releases and rollbacks, and keeping an eye on cost and reliability - all through natural conversation rather than manual dashboard digging or CLI commands.

items.name: Civic IQ
items.subtitle: Sales intelligence for selling to US state and local government: open RFPs, pre-RFP meeting signals, agency contacts and vendor spend.
items.description:
Civic IQ helps companies that sell to US state and local government find and win public-sector work, from inside Claude.
Ask in plain language and Civic IQ searches its government data:
- Open and past solicitations (RFPs, RFQs and bids), filtered by keyword, agency, state, agency type and status
- Pre-RFP signals: projects agencies discuss in public council and board meetings, often months before a solicitation is published
- Decision-maker contacts at an agency, by name and job title
- Vendor spend: which vendors agencies pay, and for what, line by line
- Public contracts and purchase orders
- Government agencies near a location
- Signals from your saved Civic IQ digest workspaces
Results link to the source document, so every answer can be checked.
Civic IQ can also save a search as an alert and email you new results daily or weekly. Managing your own alerts is the only thing it changes; everything else is read-only.
Requires a Civic IQ account. A free plan is available with no credit card; it includes RFP search, signal search and limited contact lookups. Vendor spend, contracts, nearby agencies, digest workspaces and alerts are part of paid plans.

items.name: Civitatis
items.subtitle: Search, plan, and book tours and activities worldwide with Civitatis.
items.description:
Civitatis helps travelers discover and book guided tours, day trips, and activities in destinations worldwide. Ask about a city and get an interactive carousel of top-rated activities with prices, duration, and categories — filter by type (walking tours, museums, food experiences, free tours, and more).
Tap into any activity to see full details: real photos, description, cancellation policy, and traveler ratings. Check live availability by date and time slot, including options for adults and children. Add a session to your cart and get a secure checkout link to complete the booking on civitatis.com.
Planning a multi-day trip? Ask for a day-by-day itinerary and Civitatis builds one automatically from the destination's top activities, or lets you customize it with specific tours you've already found.
Built on real-time inventory and pricing from Civitatis, one of the leading online marketplaces for tours and activities, covering destinations across Europe, the Americas, and beyond.

items.name: CKAN MCP Server
items.subtitle: Explore open data portals based on CKAN (dati.gov.it, data.gov, open.canada.ca, ...)
items.description: MCP server for interacting with CKAN-based open data portals. Provides tools for advanced dataset search with Solr syntax, DataStore queries for tabular data analysis, organization and group exploration, and complete metadata access.

items.name: Clarify
items.subtitle: Query your CRM. Create records. Ask anything.
items.description:
Connect Clarify and work with your CRM using natural language. Retrieve, create, and update records, analyze your pipeline, and generate insights—all through conversation.
Query deals, companies, people, and meetings without switching apps. Find and import new leads that match your ICP directly from the conversation. Create tasks, lists, and outbound sequences automatically.
Build and configure Clarify Agents from Claude to automate your entire GTM motion.
Your Clarify data is retrieved in real-time, and permissions are respected.
Stop clicking through interfaces. Just ask what you need.

items.name: Clarity AI
items.subtitle: Simulate fund classifications under proposed SFDR 2.0
items.description: Assess how investment funds may be classified under the European Commission's proposed SFDR 2.0 framework — directly from Claude. Search funds by name, ISIN, or CUSIP and get simulated Article classifications based on Clarity AI's regulatory disclosure data and proprietary modelling of the November 2025 proposal. Ideal for ESG analysts, portfolio managers, and compliance teams preparing for the regulatory transition before final rules are published. This is a live tool that will evolve as we learn more from ongoing EU discussions and guidance.

items.name: Clarivate IPOne CompuMark Trademarks
items.subtitle: Trusted Trademark Intelligence from Clarivate CompuMark
items.description: Clarivate IPOne CompuMark Trademark MCP helps teams search, review, and validate trademarks faster across global trademark registers. It combines broad jurisdiction coverage with flexible search options for mark names, phonetic variations, applicants, classes, goods and services, and filing details. Users can quickly assess result volumes, retrieve record details, access goods text, and open full-text records—making the server a strong fit for brand clearance, watch support, and trademark research workflows.

items.name: Claude Academy
items.subtitle: Search and read Claude Academy courses and tutorials
items.description:
Claude Academy (academy.claude.com) is Anthropic's free learning site for Claude: courses, lessons, tutorials and use cases covering Claude.ai, Claude Cowork, Claude Code, the Claude Platform, and more.
This connector lets Claude search that catalogue and read it directly in the conversation. It is read-only and needs no account or sign-in: ask Claude to find a course or tutorial on a topic, list what is available for a product, or open a specific tutorial and work through it with you. Results always include the academy.claude.com link, so you can continue on the site.
Three tools: search_academy (keyword search across courses, lessons, tutorials and use cases; filter by kind or product), get_content (read one item by path or URL — tutorials and use cases in full; courses as summary, objectives and ordered lesson list; lessons as outline), and list_content (browse everything published, optionally filtered). English content only. No personal data is collected; the server logs tool names and result counts, not query text or who asked.

items.name: Claude Motion to Mirage
items.subtitle: Import a Claude Motion video into Mirage
items.description: Importing a Claude Motion video into Mirage to edit your videos further.

items.name: Clay
items.subtitle: Find prospects. Research accounts. Personalize outreach
items.description: Prospect with Clay inside Claude: run deep company and contact research without leaving your conversation. Use Clay's contact databases, enrichment providers, and AI agents to research target accounts, surface verified, enriched contact info, and draft personalized outreach—all in Claude. Ask things like "Find VP-level finance leaders at Okta who joined in the last 6 months," and Clay will return results directly in your chat.

items.name: Clear Street
items.subtitle: Research and Analyze Stocks and Options.
items.description: Clear Street MCP lets you access your Clear Street account information such as balances, positions, orders, and portfolio history along with real time market data and finance news. Use it to research opportunities, analyze portfolio performance, assess risk scenarios and evaluate sophisticated trading opportunities and hedging strategies.

items.name: Clerk
items.subtitle: Add authentication, organizations, and billing
items.description: Add Clerk authentication to your app directly through Claude. Access up-to-date SDK snippets and implementation patterns for sign-in flows, session management, and route protection. Build multi-tenant B2B apps with organizations and role-based access, configure waitlists and early access flows, and implement billing. Get framework-specific examples for Next.js, React, Expo, and more through natural language prompts.

items.name: Clerq MCP
items.subtitle: AI-powered patent retrieval and analysis capabilities
items.description: The Clerq MCP provides powerful semantic patent retrieval and analysis capabilities for your LLM driven workflows. Connecting to the Clerq MCP will dramatically improve patent research workflows by giving your LLMs access to Clerq's proprietary semantic patent search engine and retrieval capabilities. The MCP allows you to search for patents using natural language or patent numbers as queries. Clerq's patent corpus covers over 169M patents across over 60 patent jurisdictions.

items.name: ClickFunnels
items.subtitle: Connect Claude to ClickFunnels to view, create, and update your funnels, contacts, courses, and store data.
items.description:
Connect Claude to your ClickFunnels account to work with your business data conversationally. Ask Claude to look up contacts, review store orders, check funnel performance, update course content, manage form submissions, draft email campaigns, and more — across every major area of ClickFunnels, including funnels, contacts, courses, emails, store, forms, blogs, sites, and workflows.
The connector uses a discovery-based design: Claude first explores what's available in a category, then reads, creates, or updates records on your behalf. Every write action is performed through the ClickFunnels V2 API with your permissions.
Access and security: When connecting, you choose exactly which workspaces Claude can access and grant per-category read/write permissions. Access is scoped to those grants on every request — Claude can never reach workspaces you didn't authorize. Connections are made via OAuth; no passwords or API keys are shared with Claude.
Requirements: A ClickFunnels account with team admin access is required to connect.

items.name: ClickHouse
items.subtitle: Query and explore your ClickHouse Cloud data
items.description: Connect Claude to your ClickHouse Cloud databases. Browse organizations, services, databases, and table schemas. Run read-only SQL queries against your data and get instant analytical answers. Monitor service backups, review billing costs, and inspect ClickPipe configurations - all through natural conversation.

items.name: ClickUp
items.subtitle: Project management & collaboration for teams & agents
items.description: The ClickUp connector enables secure, real-time interaction between AI agents like Claude and your ClickUp workspace. Unlock powerful AI-driven automation by connecting your favorite AI tools directly to ClickUp tasks, docs, Chat, and more.

items.name: ClickUp
items.subtitle: Search, create, and retrieve tasks and documents, add comments, and track time through natural language commands.
items.description: Search, create, and retrieve tasks and documents, add comments, and track time through natural language commands.

items.name: Clinical Trials
items.subtitle: Access ClinicalTrials.gov data
items.description: The Clinical Trials Connector gives Claude access to ClinicalTrials.gov, the NIH/NLM registry of FDA-regulated clinical studies conducted worldwide.

items.name: Clio
items.subtitle: Research the law, analyze dockets and develop case strategy with Clio Library and Clio Docket, with citations back to the sources.
items.description:
Bring Vincent's legal intelligence into Claude. Research the law, analyze dockets and develop case strategy with access to Clio Library and Clio Docket, with citations back to the underlying sources.
Research and reason. Search case law, legislation and commentary in Clio Library, and read the full text of any decision or statute. Hand harder questions to Vincent, Clio's legal AI agent. It plans its own research, reads the sources and returns a cited answer. Claude shows its progress and asks you before Vincent takes any step that needs your approval.
Analyze dockets. Review filings in US federal and state cases, build procedural timelines, and see how a judge or opposing counsel has handled similar matters.
Draft. Turn research into memos, letters, clauses and motions. Revise them in conversation and export them to Word or PDF.
Review documents at scale. Ask the same questions across a set of contracts or filings, and get a review table with one row per document and one column per question.
Check citations. Verify the authorities cited in a document you supply.
Work with your firm's records. Check a matter's status, parties and deadlines, find documents and notes, review tasks and the calendar, and log time in Clio Manage. Vincent asks before it creates or changes a record, and Claude puts that request to you.
Pick up where you left off. Continue earlier conversations instead of starting over.
Your matters and firm data stay securely governed in Clio. Claude reaches only what your Clio permissions allow. Requires Clio Work. Available features and jurisdictions depend on your plan.

items.name: Close
items.subtitle: Connect Claude to Close CRM to securely access and act on your sales data
items.description:
The Close MCP server is a secure, standardized interface that lets Claude directly access and interact with your Close data. Core functionality with Claude:
• Connects Close to Claude via the Model Context Protocol so Claude can use Close as a trusted system of record.
• Read data (e.g., leads, contacts, opportunities, activities) based on your Close permissions.
• Optionally write data — you can allow only safe writes (e.g., create a lead) or full writes (e.g., edit/delete) during setup.
• Enables Claude to answer questions, summarize information, and perform actions in Close.

items.name: CloudBees Unify MCP Server
items.subtitle: Connect AI agents to CloudBees Unify: feature flags, CI/CD, release orchestration, and security
items.description: CloudBees Unify is a DevSecOps platform for building, releasing, and securing software. This connector gives an AI agent direct access to it: inspect components and environments, run and troubleshoot workflows, manage feature flags and their targeting, orchestrate releases, and review security findings and policy results. Agents authenticate with the same sign-in used for the web interface, and tool access can be scoped per request so an agent receives only the tools relevant to its task.

items.name: Cloudflare Developer Platform
items.subtitle: Build applications with compute, storage, and AI
items.description: Enables users to build applications on Cloudflare Workers using built-in storage, AI, and compute primitives. Deploy code to production, create and query databases, manage KV stores, and more.

items.description: Analyze, search, and extract structured data from video collections using Cloudglue's video understanding platform.

items.description: The Cloudinary MCP servers enable you to upload, manage, transform, and analyze your media assets.

items.name: Cloudinary Asset Management

Connect your Cloverleaf account and ask about the people you work with: "How do I work best with Dana?", "Help me prep for my 1:1 with my manager," or "How should I give this feedback?" • See the relationship dynamics between two to four people for a specific situation. See where you align, where you may clash, and what each person needs as an interactive card

• Guidance grounded in validated assessment data, not stereotypes

The connector is offered as a pilot and may be modified, suspended, or withdrawn at any time, in whole or in part, without notice.
Connector use is governed by your organization’s agreement with Thomson Reuters for CoCounsel Legal (”Agreement”), and the terms on this page (“Usage Terms”). Thomson Reuters content, and any output containing it, that you access through the connector remains Thomson Reuters content and stays subject to the Agreement and Usage Terms; connecting through the connector does not give you any additional rights to Thomson Reuters content it, and you may use it only for your organization’s ordinary internal business purposes.
You must not, whether directly or through any tool, agent, model, or interface (including a model context protocol (MCP) connection): (i) provide or make Thomson Reuters content available to another Professional AI Tool (meaning a third-party application or service whose primary purpose is to perform legal, audit, tax, compliance, or accounting research, analysis, drafting, summarization, automation, or similar tasks using artificial intelligence); or (ii) use Thomson Reuters content to train, fine-tune, or improve any AI or machine-learning model, or as a knowledge base, index, embeddings store, or retrieval or inference source for any AI system (including for retrieval-augmented generation).
You are responsible for configuring your connected environment so that Thomson Reuters content is not routed or exposed to any such tool, including by not relying on any “always allow” or “auto-approve” setting that would permit it.

The data is kept fresh by our own crawler and reviewed by All Too Human, a small technology company in Motueka, Te Tauihu, that builds tools for iwi, community groups and local businesses. Configure which tools are exposed to AI clients on an environment-by-environment basis, scoping access to only what each team or workflow needs.

items.name: Countersignatory
items.subtitle: Let an agent buy a verified human's approval, verification or judgment at a published spot price, paid by x402 (USDC on Base) or card, answered by hand or refunded.
items.description:
Countersignatory is an exchange where software buys a bounded human judgment at a published price. An agent that reaches a step it should not take alone (send this refund, publish this page, accept this label) can price the task, buy it, and get a named human's answer back.
What you can buy today: Check (check.general), one screened human, $1.25 at a 24-hour deadline. Three task templates: approval (approve or reject, with a reason), verification (true, false or cannot_tell, with a reason) and judgment (one label from up to 10, with a reason). Each answer says who gave it and how they are disclosed.
How it works:
1. countersignatory_quote prices a task, free and read-only.
2. countersignatory_place_order creates an unpaid order and returns two ways to pay: an x402 payment request (USDC on Base) for an agent with a wallet, and a card checkout link for a person.
3. A responder answers within the deadline, or the order is refunded in full automatically.
4. countersignatory_get_order returns the status and the answer.
countersignatory_spot_index shows the going rate for every market, with urgency multipliers, the published responder wage floor ($0.25 net per active minute) and the derivation of each price. Markets not yet live (Consensus of 3 or 5, named-expert Countersign, notarisation) can be quoted but not bought; countersignatory_register_interest records demand for them.
Refused at intake: CAPTCHAs and bot checks, logging in or entering credentials, contacting third parties, medical, legal or financial advice, and anything sexual or involving minors.
No account or key is needed to quote or order. While volume is low, orders are answered by hand by a named group (currently the founder, disclosed as such), so deadlines are at least one hour.

With the Craft.io MCP server, Claude works with full awareness of your product context: it can query and manage backlog items, draft PRDs grounded in real customer evidence, and prioritize work across workspaces and portfolios - all without leaving your AI workflow.
Capabilities include:
Backlog management: Create, update, and prioritize work items across all your workspaces, including statuses, priorities, sprints, labels, and custom fields.
Specs: Draft PRDs and break them into user stories with full awareness of your feedback, OKRs, and existing work items.
Feedback triage: Submit, update and analyze customer feedback to surface feature requests, cluster themes, and connect insights directly to work items.
Strategy: Align tactical work with high-level strategy by managing portfolios, initiatives, objectives, and key results.
Execution planning: Build data-driven roadmaps, plan sprints against team capacity, and map dependencies between items.

items.name: Crossbeam
items.subtitle: Explore partner data and ecosystem insights in Claude
items.description: Connect your Claude workspace to Crossbeam and bring Ecosystem Intelligence into every AI workflow. The Crossbeam MCP Server lets Claude securely access your partner and account data — surfacing overlaps, partner activity, and warm paths directly in chat. Use it to enrich AI responses with real-time ecosystem context, power smarter prioritization, and uncover co-sell opportunities without leaving your conversation.

items.name: Crunchbase
items.subtitle: Access reliable company data, market signals, and forward-looking predictions to research organizations, compare performance, uncover emerging trends, and make faster, more informed business decisions
items.description:
Trusted private market intelligence, right inside your conversation.
Crunchbase MCP brings private market data and predictive signals into the AI tools and agents you already use. Built for investors, go-to-market teams, product builders, and anyone else who needs answers, not just search results.
Ask in plain English. No code, no technical training. Crunchbase figures out the filters, fields, and connections you might not have known to ask for, and returns a complete, sourced answer. Most other MCP servers only offer raw search and list data.
Supercharge your workflow. Identify high-growth companies, run diligence in seconds, and act on opportunities before other firms catch on, or give your customers foresight into market movements directly in your product, without the engineering lift.
Build lists you can return to. Save companies as you find them. A search today becomes a pipeline you monitor over time.
Predictions you can act on. Forecasts of what a company is likely to do next such as: funding, acquisition, IPO, growth, shutdown, or headcount cuts, plus an estimated current valuation. Every prediction carries a confidence tier, so you can rank an entire market by likelihood instead of reading profiles one at a time. Powered by 15M+ predictions refreshed weekly.
Why Crunchbase? The only dataset combining the aggregated activity of 80M users, 1,000+ public sources, and 600k+ data team members, VC partners, and subject-matter experts.

items.name: Crustdata
items.subtitle: Search and enrich B2B company and people data
items.description: Search, enrich and watch people and companies from a single conversation in Claude with Crustdata. Build TAM, prospect and candidate lists using 150+ search filters such as job title, industry, funding and more. You can also enrich people and company profiles with 350+ datapoints such as verified emails, full work experience, education, funding, headcount, web traffic, job postings and more.

items.name: Crypto.com
items.subtitle: Real time prices, orders, charts, and more for crypto
items.description: Real time price quotes, order books, conversions, candlestick charts and more for cryptocurrency tokens from Crypto.com

items.name: Cube Software
items.subtitle: Bring trusted Cube financial context into Claude. Analyze performance, model scenarios, and move decisions into action, with your Cube permissions enforced on every request.
items.description:
Cube is the agentic FP&A platform that helps finance teams shape what happens next. The Cube MCP server brings finance to where decisions happen. Claude works directly on your governed Cube data, so every answer and every change uses the same definitions, models, and numbers your team already trusts.
Understand what is happening:
- Explore your model: companies, chart of accounts, and dimensions like Department, Entity, Product, Time, and Scenario.
- Analyze performance: budget vs. actuals, forecast variance, opex by department, revenue and margin by product, headcount vs. plan, and cash burn.
- Trace to the source: drill from any number to the transactions behind it.
Evaluate what should change:
- Model scenarios: duplicate a scenario and test assumptions without touching the plan of record.
- Extend your model: create formulas, dimensions, and tags.

items.name: Cucumber Studio MCP
items.subtitle: MCP server for Cucumber Studio API integration - access test scenarios, action words, and execution data
items.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides LLM access to Cucumber Studio's testing platform. This server enables AI assistants to retrieve test scenarios, action words, test runs, and project information from Cucumber Studio. Features include project management, scenario browsing, reusable test steps access, and test execution monitoring with comprehensive error handling and type safety.

items.name: Customer.io
items.subtitle: Create automations, segments, and emails, analyze campaign performance, and manage customer data in your Customer.io workspace.
items.description:
Connect Claude to your Customer.io workspace with full read, write, and delete access — granted independently, per workspace, via OAuth.
What Claude can do today:
• Build and edit automations (campaigns), broadcasts, and newsletters
• Create segments from plain-English audience definitions
• Inspect and update customer profiles and attributes
• Draft, QA, and publish emails in Design Studio
• Analyze deliveries, opens, clicks, and conversions; diagnose deliverability
• Manage CDP Data Pipelines: sources, destinations, and reverse ETL
• Guide SDK setup and app integration end to end
The connector exposes Customer.io's Journeys UI API and Data Pipelines API through verb-scoped tools — cio_read_api (GET), cio_write_api (POST/PUT/PATCH), and cio_delete_api (DELETE) — so reads, writes, and deletes are approved separately. Built-in schema introspection (cio_schema) and server-maintained skills (cio_skills_list / cio_skills_read) give Claude authoritative, always-current guidance for complex workflows like automation wiring, segment conditions, and email design patterns, scoped to your account's plan.
Safety is built in: every write and delete supports a dry-run preview before execution, and credentials never pass through Claude — authentication is OAuth, with workspaces and permission scopes selected at connect time.
Try: "Analyze last month's welcome automation performance." "Build a segment of users inactive for 90 days." "Draft a re-engagement email and QA it." "Why did deliveries drop this week?"

items.name: D&B Digital Audiences
items.subtitle: Discover the Right Audiences Faster
items.description: Dun & Bradstreet enables marketers and media teams to discover and explore over 80,000 audience segments across Dun & Bradstreet and our data partners directly within Claude. Use natural language to discover relevant business and consumer audiences, explore targeting opportunities, and accelerate campaign planning using trusted audience intelligence from Dun & Bradstreet and Eyeota, a Dun & Bradstreet Company.

items.name: D&B Hoovers
items.subtitle: Access trusted D&B intelligence, contacts, and signals to uncover opportunities and take the next best action.
items.description:
D&B Hoovers brings trusted commercial intelligence directly into Claude, helping sales and revenue teams identify, prioritize, and act on buying signals. By combining company and contact intelligence with buyer intent, website activity, trigger events, news, and contextual business insights, Claude with D&B Hoovers data can help users understand who to engage, when to engage, and why now.
Use the connector to research accounts, identify decision makers, analyze buying signals, map corporate hierarchies, uncover industry and competitor insights, monitor business changes, and prepare for customer conversations. Access trusted D&B intelligence including company profiles, contacts, financials, news, trigger events, technologies in use, and website visitor intelligence directly within Claude.
Built for prospecting, account planning, sales research, revenue operations, and solution engineering, D&B Hoovers helps teams move from signal to insight to action faster with AI-powered workflows and trusted commercial intelligence.

items.name: Daffy MCP
items.subtitle: Check your Daffy fund, donations and charities
items.description:
Daffy is a donor-advised fund: one account for all your giving. Add cash, stock, or crypto, get your tax deduction when you contribute, invest it to grow tax-free, and give to any of 1.5 million+ US charities whenever you're ready.
With Daffy in Claude, your giving is one question away:
• Know where you stand. Ask for your balance, how much you can give right now, how your fund is invested, and how it has performed.
• See your giving history. Pull up donations by year or charity, review your contributions, and export a fund statement as CSV for tax time.
• Find the right charity. Search 1.5M+ US nonprofits by name or cause, or look one up by EIN, and get its mission, location, website, and Daffy profile.
Everything runs through your existing Daffy account with your normal login. Read-only questions never change anything.

items.name: Dagster+ MCP
items.subtitle: Investigate issues and take action in your Dagster+ deployment from Claude.

items.name: Darwinbox
items.subtitle: Apply leave, track attendance, manage hiring and onboarding, file expenses and more in Darwinbox with your existing Darwinbox permissions.
items.description:
Darwinbox’s MCP server gives Claude secure, permission-aware access to the Darwinbox HR platform across Leave, Attendance, Recruitment, Onboarding, Expenses, Helpdesk, Performance, Talent and Payroll self-service. Employees can check balances, apply for leave or WFH, regularize attendance, raise helpdesk tickets and pull payslips.
Managers can review team attendance, goals and reportees. Recruiters and HR teams can search candidates, move them through the pipeline, schedule interviews, submit feedback, trigger offers and run onboarding end to end.
Every action runs as the signed-in user with their existing Darwinbox role permissions, so people only see and change what they already can in Darwinbox. Available tools depend on the modules and the tool visibility configuration your organization has enabled for you.

items.name: Dash

List installed docsets, search across documentation and code snippets, load full documentation pages, and enable full-text search for specific docsets. items.name: Databricks Genie
items.subtitle: Ground your agent in Genie's trusted data insights.
items.description: The Databricks Genie connector exposes Genie as an agentic analytics tool over MCP. items.name: DataCamp
items.subtitle: DataCamp catalog and team admin for your AI assistant

items.name: Prophecy DataGPT
