Go from raw data to a trusted report in plain language, using your team's definitions
Turn messy, multi-tab Excel workbooks into clean tables on your data platform
Check any number: every answer comes with the workflow and code behind it
Rerun approved workflows on new data the same way every time, or schedule them
For data teams and IT:
Review and approve AI-built workflows instead of rebuilding them, backed by open code in Git
Run everything on the Snowflake, Databricks or BigQuery you already own, with no separate engine
Keep business-built work governed: traceable to source, separated by team, access by invite or domain
Grow a knowledge graph from your catalogs that learns from every approved workflow
About Prophecy: since 2017, Prophecy has built governed, code-backed data workflows for the world's largest enterprises. DataGPT brings that engine into the AI tools your teams already use.

Ask things like "which clients have high-severity data health issues?", "what's the VAT position for my practice this quarter?", or "where did the team's time actually go last month?" - and get an answer grounded in live Dext data.
What you can do:
Portfolio - list and filter clients by accounting integration, product, managed status, health score or next deadline. See who manages what and who has access.
Data health - surface active insights by severity, review workflow checks, and verify critical accounts (PAYE, dividends, DLA, entertainment) are configured correctly before you file.
Workflow - track flows by status, due date or assignee to see what's in progress, in review, or at risk across the practice.

Connect DocSend to Claude to manage document workflows, analyze engagement, and take action using natural language.
Use the DocSend connector to support workflows such as:
- M&A and due diligence: Create and manage data rooms, add content, grant or update access, create secure links, review buyer activity, and identify the most engaged parties.
- Fundraising: Share pitch decks and fundraising materials, track investor engagement, identify interested investors, and prepare personalized follow-ups.
- Sales: Create links for proposals and presentations, manage prospect access, understand how buyers are engaging, and prioritize your next steps.
- Financial services: Manage sensitive client and stakeholder workflows, control access to shared materials, monitor engagement, and quickly answer questions about your DocSend data.
The connector lets Claude work with your authorized DocSend Spaces, content, links, permissions, and engagement data while respecting your existing access controls.

items.name: DocuSeal
items.subtitle: Sign, send & manage documents with DocuSeal
items.description: DocuSeal lets you create document templates, send them for signing, and track submission status — all through Claude. Search your existing templates by name, upload new PDFs to create signable forms with auto-detected fields, send documents to multiple signers via email, and search signed or pending submissions by submitter name, email, or template. Built for teams that need fast, simple e-signatures without leaving their workflow.

items.name: Docusign
items.subtitle: Intelligent, secure contract management by Docusign
items.description: Simplify contract management with intelligent automation powered by Docusign. Go beyond simple execution to make complex agreement workflows effortless. Use natural language to connect with your agreement data, instantly surface insights like renewal dates and key obligations, and create automated workflows that keep your business moving faster and with less friction.

items.name: Domino's India
items.subtitle: Discover, customise, and order your favourite Domino's meals—all without leaving the conversation.
items.description: From quick lunches to late-night cravings and weekend celebrations, Domino's is ready whenever hunger strikes. Browse the latest menu, customise your meal how you like it, unlock exciting offers, and order with ease for a fast, delicious experience. Domino's India ordering MCP (India only). Menu browse and store lookup may work without sign-in. All transactional and personal-data tools require an OTP-authenticated session .

items.name: Dovetail
items.subtitle: Turn scattered feedback into decisions grounded in customer evidence
items.description: Connect your customer intelligence to Claude and put real customer data behind every answer.

items.name: Drafts
items.subtitle: MCP server for interacting with the Drafts app on macOS
items.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants to interact with the Drafts app on macOS through AppleScript. Manage drafts, workspaces, tags, and run actions programmatically.

items.name: Drata
items.subtitle: Agentic Trust Management on demand.
items.description: Drata's MCP server allows automating all aspects of GRC covering the full lifecycle of controls, policies, risks, evidence, frameworks, vendors, personnel, and devices directly inside the Drata platform.

items.name: Dremio Cloud
items.subtitle: Analyze and get insights from your lakehouse data
items.description: Dremio provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows AI agents to securely access, query, and reason over enterprise lakehouse data through Dremio's unified semantic layer. With Dremio's MCP offering, agents interact with data exactly as users do in Dremio—respecting fine-grained access controls, row- and column-level security, and shared business definitions. Queries are executed directly on data in your lakehouse (Iceberg, Parquet, Delta), with no data duplication or movement. Dremio's MCP server ensures that AI agents see only what they're authorized to see, while benefiting from the same semantic consistency and performance that teams rely on for analytics and BI.

items.name: Dropbox
items.subtitle: Search, organize, and take action on your Dropbox content
items.description: The Dropbox connector for Claude connects your Dropbox files directly to Claude, so you can search, organize, save generated content, and create sharing links without switching tools. It respects your existing Dropbox permissions, and Claude only works with files you already have access to.

items.name: droplinked
items.subtitle: Discover and verify products across droplinked's KYB-attested merchant network. Read-only agentic-commerce discovery.
items.description: Discover and verify products across droplinked's KYB-attested merchant network. Read-only agentic-commerce discovery.

items.name: DualEntry
items.subtitle: Search, create, and manage your DualEntry accounting data
items.description:
Run your books without leaving the conversation. Access and create financial records across your ledger, draft revenue recognition contracts with automated billing and recognition schedules, and capitalize fixed assets with full depreciation schedules. Review bank-match suggestions to speed up reconciliation, look up any transaction by number, trace audit trails, and fuzzy-match customers, vendors, and accounts.
Access is governed by your existing DualEntry role and permissions.

items.name: Duvo
items.subtitle: Create, monitor, and manage your Duvo automations
items.description: Connect your Duvo workspace to start and monitor agent runs, manage case queues, and pull up Clarity processes and Pulse dashboards.

items.name: Dynatrace MCP Server
items.subtitle: [DEPRECATED] Access Dynatrace observability data: logs, metrics, problems, vulnerabilities via DQL and Dynatrace Intelligence
items.description: ⚠️ This package is deprecated and no longer maintained. For local development (VS Code, Cursor, Claude Code, IntelliJ, …), migrate to Dynatrace-for-AI + dtctl: https://github.com/Dynatrace/dynatrace-for-ai/. For agent-to-agent use cases (Atlassian Rovo, GitHub Coding Agent, …), use the Dynatrace Remote MCP Server: https://www.dynatrace.com/hub/detail/dynatrace-mcp-server/

items.name: EasyPost
items.subtitle: Make smarter shipping decisions, instantly
items.description:
Connect your EasyPost account and manage your shipping from Claude. Ask Claude to get rates, buy labels, check delivery status, confirm live carriers, add insurance coverage, or check a claim.
EasyPost brings shipping intelligence into Claude. See where your packages are, what you paid, and how your account is set up, all without leaving the conversation. It's the fastest way to get a clear read on your shipping operation before you make your next move.
Buying a label or adding insurance charges the payment method on your EasyPost account. Claude shows the carrier, service, and price and asks you to confirm first.

items.name: Anthropic Economic Index
items.subtitle: Explore public data on how the world uses Claude
items.description: Query the Anthropic Economic Index — a public dataset tracking how Claude is used across countries, occupations, and tasks, measured from Claude conversations. Get worldwide usage patterns, country and subregion profiles, occupation and task breakdowns, and side-by-side regional comparisons. Read-only.

items.name: EDEN by Basecamp Research
items.subtitle: Design antibiotics and prioritise vaccine targets against drug-resistant pathogens using EDEN, Basecamp Research's biological foundation model
items.description:
EDEN is Basecamp Research's frontier biological foundation model, trained on BaseData — the
world's largest biological dataset, encompassing over 10 billion novel genes from more than a million species collected across 200+ sampling expeditions in 30+ countries.
This connector gives Claude access to two EDEN capabilities:
Antibiotic design (EDEN-AMP): Generate novel antimicrobial peptide candidates with predicted
potency against 11 drug-resistant bacterial strains, including MRSA, Acinetobacter baumannii, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa. 97% of EDEN-designed AMPs are active in the lab; one candidate showed efficacy in mice comparable to last-resort antibiotics.
Vaccine target prioritisation (EDEN-Immunogenicity): Predict the probability that a protein-coding antigen will trigger an immune response, using EDEN embeddings with AUROC 0.85 on external validation data. Reduces weeks of empirical target selection to a single workflow. Every BaseData sequence is collected under informed-consent and benefit-sharing agreements, with each sequence traceable to country-specific collection permits. For research use only.

items.name: eDreams
items.subtitle: Find flights and hotels
items.description:
Skip the hassle of comparing dozens of tabs. eDreams helps you search and compare flights and hotels in one place, but through a simple conversation.
Just tell it where and when you want to travel, and it quickly shows the cheapest and best options so you can decide faster.

items.name: Eedi
items.subtitle: Access Eedi's high quality math questions
items.description: Find Diagnostic Questions that go beyond right and wrong to reveal student thinking and deepen insights. Quickly find questions that are aligned to your topics and standards, build sets of quizzes, and reveal student strengths and misconceptions.

items.name: Egnyte
items.subtitle: Securely search and analyze your Egnyte content
items.description: Egnyte MCP server enables AI agents to securely search, retrieve, and analyze content stored in any Egnyte domain. It wraps Egnyte’s public APIs and enforces native permissions, compliance rules, and audit logging.

items.name: Elastic Cloud Serverless
items.subtitle: Search, Observe, and Protect your Elasticsearch Data
items.description: Connect Claude to your Elastic Cloud Serverless project to search and analyze your data using natural language. Run ES|QL queries, explore indices, investigate logs, manage cases, create visualizations, orchestrate workflows, and more — all powered by Kibana's MCP Server.

items.name: ElevenLabs
items.subtitle: Manage your ElevenAgents voice agents in your chat
items.description:
Connect Claude to your ElevenLabs workspace to build with ElevenAgents without leaving your chat.
ElevenAgents: create AI natural-sounding voice and chat agents for customer support, phone answering, appointment scheduling, billing questions, and lead qualification by describing what you want.
Update prompts, voices, languages, and first messages. Compare configurations, duplicate your best performers, and get shareable widget links to deploy. Review conversations and read transcripts, explore the topics your agents handle, and estimate LLM usage and cost before making changes.
Sign in with ElevenLabs to get started.

items.name: Elfcare
items.subtitle: Explore your Elfcare test results
items.description: Connect your account to ask Claude questions about your published health results, including your doctor summary, biomarkers, imaging results, body composition data, and trends over time. Access is read-only and requires your consent.

items.name: Elicit
items.subtitle: Search and analyze scientific papers
items.description: Access a corpus of over 125 million academic papers. Search for relevant literature using natural language queries, create structured reports that extract and synthesize data across papers, and retrieve detailed report results — all programmatically. Built for life sciences R&D workflows, the server enables agents to rapidly survey evidence, compare findings across studies, and surface key data points without manual literature review, accelerating everything from target discovery to systematic evidence assessment.

items.name: Embat
items.subtitle: Ask Embat about cash, debt, payments, and accounting
items.description: Query your cash, debt, treasury forecasts, accounting, PSP reconciliations, payments, and intercompany positions in plain language — answered with your real numbers from Embat. TellMe is read-only and inherits your existing permissions, so every reply is scoped to what you can already see. Make your treasury management system a native part of your AI workflow, without leaving the conversation.

items.name: Energy Aspects
items.subtitle: Access Energy Aspects' energy market research and data
items.description:
Energy Aspects gives AI agents direct access to expert energy market intelligence — research reports, real-time analyst commentary, and timeseries data across oil, gas, power, and related markets.
Energy Aspects is an independent research firm trusted by traders, investors, and energy professionals worldwide. The connector draws on three content types: in-depth research publications with analysis and forecasts; EA Live posts with intraday market commentary from analysts; and a library of quantitative timeseries covering supply, demand, inventories, flows, and prices — including point-in-time queries against historical releases.

items.name: Enrichr MCP Server
items.subtitle: Gene set enrichment analysis using Enrichr API with multi-library support
items.description:
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides gene set enrichment analysis using the Enrichr API. This server supports all available gene set libraries from Enrichr and returns only statistically significant results (adjusted p < 0.05) for LLM tools to interpret.
Features:
- Multi-Library Enrichment Analysis: Query multiple Enrichr libraries simultaneously
- Comprehensive Library Support: Access to hundreds of gene set libraries including GO, pathways, diseases, tissues, drugs
- GO Enrichment Analysis: Specialized tool for GO Biological Process enrichment analysis
- Configurable output formats: detailed, compact, or minimal
- Export results to TSV files

items.name: Entendre
items.subtitle: Manage accounting and reporting with agents
items.description: Connect Claude to Entendre’s Unified API and work across your accounting data from a single conversation—browse accounts, query transactions, review balances, classify activity, create journal entries, generate reports, and keep your general ledger in sync without exporting data or switching tools.

items.name: Enterpret
items.subtitle: Get answers from unified feedback of your customers.
items.description: Turn customer feedback into answers you can act on, directly in Claude. Query your Enterpret knowledge graph across support tickets, Gong calls, app reviews, NPS surveys, Slack, and more. Every insight is traced back to real customer conversations with direct links. Just ask a question in plain language. No query language or setup needed.

items.name: Era Context
items.subtitle: Manage your personal finances using Claude
items.description: Era Context is a secure place to manage your finances. Set up automations, fix overspending, figure out your portfolio, or tell Claude a goal and get your full financial life in context.

items.name: Eraser
items.subtitle: Generate, manage, and update Eraser diagrams and files
items.description: Generate, create, read, and update diagrams, documents and files in your Eraser workspace directly from Claude. Make Eraser a native part of your AI workflow — describe a system in natural language and have your agent generate a complete diagram, create rich technical docs from code or conversations, and manage files across your workspace. All changes are saved to your Eraser account and accessible from the app.

items.name: Etherscan
items.subtitle: Explore wallets, tokens, transactions, contracts, logs, blocks, and gas across 60+ EVM chains with Etherscan
items.description:
Etherscan is the most-used block explorer in crypto. This connector gives Claude read-only access to authoritative onchain data through the Etherscan API V2, covering 60+ EVM chains — Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, and more — through a single endpoint. No API key or account is required.
With it, Claude can:
• Look up native coin balances and ERC-20/721/1155 token transfer history for any address
• Retrieve normal, internal, and token-transfer transaction history
• Fetch a transaction by hash and check its status and receipt
• Read verified smart-contract source code and ABIs, and find a contract's creator and creation transaction
• Query event logs by address and topics over a block range
• Resolve a block by timestamp and read live gas-oracle prices
• List all supported chains
Every tool is read-only: it retrieves public blockchain data and never signs transactions, moves funds, or modifies state. Results preserve exact addresses, hashes, amounts, and timestamps so you can verify them on Etherscan. An optional interactive dashboard renders wallet, transaction, token, and contract results as a clean visual card.
Use it to investigate wallets and transactions, inspect and audit contracts, trace token flows, monitor gas, and answer onchain questions in plain language — across every major EVM network from one connector.

items.name: etoro
items.subtitle: etoro. Where Our Collective Intelligence Meets Your Claude
items.description: Connect your etoro account to Claude and explore markets through conversation. Ask about your portfolio, open positions, balances, live and historical prices across stocks, ETFs, crypto and commodities, and how Popular Investors are positioned. This official connector is read-only. It cannot place, close, copy, or transfer. To trade, Claude will send you to etoro (app or web) to review and confirm there.

items.name: EULER
items.subtitle: Manage your partner program and access your Partner Data Lake with Claude.
items.description: Manage your partner program and access your Partner Data Lake with Claude — instant actions and answers on deals, commissions, onboarding, and partner performance, no dashboard required. Partners can register deals and access live data across their pipeline, enablement, certifications, payouts and more.

items.name: Eulerian Marketing Platform
items.subtitle: Ask Claude about your Eulerian data — analytics, multi-touch attribution, audience segments, and campaign activation — in plain English.
items.description:
Eulerian Marketing Platform MCP connects Claude directly to your Eulerian Technologies account, giving you conversational access to the full suite of Eulerian's marketing analytics, attribution, and activation tools.
Analytics & Reporting
Query real-time and batch analytics data across any dimension or metric. Run flat aggregate reports, explore data-mining exports (sales, shopping carts, outbound clicks, search engine data), schedule automated reports, and generate AI-powered insights from your traffic and conversion data.
Attribution
Access multi-touch attribution models, marketing mix modeling (MMM) with saturation curves, incrementality testing, view-augmented attribution, and full customer journey analysis. Manage media categories and real-time attribution model configurations.
Audiences
Build, search, and manage audience segments and external segments, configure the audience engine, run saved queries, sync partner segments, and manage server-side user data workflows.
Activation
Deploy and monitor server-to-server (S2S) and tag management system (TMS) activations, clone and estimate campaigns, and troubleshoot activation errors.
Collect & Tracking Configuration
Manage the full tracking setup: campaigns, publishers, products, goals, funnels, profiles, sections, labels, custom parameters, SEM accounts/campaigns/creatives, websites, and tracking hostnames.
Consent & Cookie Management (CMP)
Configure cookie consent rules, TCF v2 vendors, consent categories, and query the Cookiepedia database for vendor and tool information.
Data Warehouse (EDW)
Launch, schedule, and monitor EDW jobs and templated data exports.
Documentation
Ask natural-language questions against Eulerian's official documentation to get guidance on report queries and platform usage.

items.name: Everlaw
items.subtitle: Search and explore your Everlaw database in Claude.
items.description: Combine Everlaw's powerful AI and analytics with your Claude-based workflows. Connect Everlaw to Claude to search, analyze, and pull case insights in seconds—right from your documents. Stay in control and move faster on live matters without risking confidentiality or defensibility.

items.name: Evernote
items.subtitle: Connect Evernote to search, edit, and organize your notes, create new ones, and bring your knowledge into every conversation.
items.description:
The Evernote MCP server connects your Evernote account to your AI tools, so they can work from the notes, documents, and files you've already collected. Search across years of captured material, edit and organize what's there, and file new work straight back into your notebooks.
Key features:
• Search by keyword or by meaning - Use Evernote's search grammar to filter by notebook, tag, and date, or search semantically to surface notes by what they're about, even when you can't remember the words you used.
• Find what you never typed - Search reaches text inside scanned documents, photos, and images, and inside transcribed audio and video — so handwritten pages, whiteboard shots, receipts, and recorded meetings are all searchable alongside your written notes. Attached files can be downloaded and new ones uploaded.
• Read, write, and edit real notes - Fetch a note's full content, tags, and attachments; create new notes in the right notebook; update titles and bodies; and restore anything that ends up in the trash.
• Keep your account organized - Move notes between notebooks, add and remove tags, rename and re-parent tags, and create notebooks and Spaces as your work grows.
• Manage tasks inside your notes - Create tasks, update status and due dates, and find the ones you own or have been assigned, filtered by priority.
Everything happens inside your own account, under your existing permissions.

items.name: Exa
items.subtitle: Web Search + Code Docs Search
items.description: Exa MCP gives you real-time web searches and can extracts content from any URL. It also finds the best code examples and documentation, searches billions of GitHub repos, docs sites, and StackOverflow to give you fresh coding context.

items.name: Excalidraw
items.subtitle: MCP for creating interactive hand-drawn diagrams in Excalidraw
items.description: The official Excalidraw MCP app allowing you to build interactive visual applications right in Claude. Ask Claude to create hand-drawn style diagrams using Excalidraw with smooth viewport camera control and interactive fullscreen editing.

items.name: Expedia
items.subtitle: Plan trips, flights and hotels
items.description: Discover and search flights and hotels worldwide. Get real-time pricing and availability to plan your perfect trip.

items.name: Expensify
items.subtitle: Search and analyze your Expensify data
items.description: The Expensify MCP server lets you connect Claude directly to your Expensify account. Once connected, you can ask questions about expenses, reports, reimbursements, receipts, trips, chats, tasks, invoices, and spending trends directly from Claude.

items.name: Expo
items.subtitle: Build, ship, and monitor apps with Expo
items.description:
Build, ship, and monitor React Native apps with Expo and EAS, directly from Claude. Get answers from the latest Expo docs, kick off cloud builds and CI/CD workflows, submit to the App Store and Google Play, and track how your app is doing in production.
Key features
- Docs & setup — search and read the Expo docs, learn key topics, and add Expo libraries to your project
- EAS builds — start, cancel, and inspect cloud builds, read build logs, and submit to the App Store
- CI/CD workflows — create, validate, run, and monitor EAS workflows and job logs
- Store monitoring — track App Store and Google Play reviews, crashes, and TestFlight feedback — and reply to reviews

items.name: Extend
items.subtitle: Turn documents into structured data
items.description: Parse, extract, classify, and split documents from chat: pull fields, tables, and line items out of PDFs, images, Office files, and spreadsheets, identify document types, break bundles into separate documents, and fill PDF forms. Build and test reusable extractors, classifiers, and workflows on real documents, then run them at scale in your Extend workspace.

items.name: FactSet AI-Ready Data
items.subtitle: Access institutional-quality financial data and analytics
items.description: Access, comprehensive financial data and analytics through AI-powered tools. Connect to FactSet global prices, fundamental analysis, earnings estimates, and research insights into Claude, to enhance your financial analysis, earning estimates and investment research with trusted, institutional-quality data.

items.name: Fantastical
items.subtitle: Read events and tasks, create new items, make basic edits, and delete items from Fantastical for Mac.
items.description: Read events and tasks, create new items, make basic edits, and delete items from Fantastical for Mac.

items.name: Fastmail
items.subtitle: An MCP server for Fastmail customers and accounts
items.description:
MCP is an open standard, not tied to any one AI provider, for how AI clients talk to external data and tools. Think of it as another API sitting alongside IMAP, CalDAV, and CardDAV, except instead of being designed for mail apps or calendar clients, it’s designed for AI models to use directly.
If you point Claude at our MCP server, you can ask it things like “what’s on my calendar tomorrow?”, “draft a reply to Sarah’s email about the Q3 budget”, or “find my dentist’s address in my contacts” and it will do them against your real Fastmail account.

items.name: Fathom – Your Meeting Intelligence Layer
items.subtitle: Your meeting notes, transcripts, and context – now part of every Claude conversation
items.description: Access your meeting summaries, transcripts, and action items so you can ask questions and build deliverables grounded in what was actually said on your calls. No copy-pasting summaries. No context switching. Just better outputs, faster.

items.name: Fax.Plus
items.subtitle: Send and receive faxes securely from Claude
items.description: Fax.Plus brings secure, cloud-based fax to Claude. Send faxes with attachments, check delivery status, and view received faxes, all through natural conversation. Trusted by healthcare, legal, and financial teams in 180+ countries, Fax.Plus handles compliant document transmission without a fax machine. Whether you're sending a signed contract, a patient referral, or an insurance form, Fax.Plus lets you manage your fax communications directly from Claude without switching apps.

items.name: Fellow.ai
items.subtitle: Chat with your meetings to uncover actionable insights
items.description: Access your meeting knowledge instantly. Fellow connects Claude to your meeting ecosystem, letting you search transcripts, pull key insights from summaries, and track action items with natural-language queries.

items.name: Felt Maps
items.subtitle: Map and analyze your geospatial data
items.description: Felt is a modern GIS platform for creating, analyzing, and sharing interactive maps. The Felt MCP server lets Claude run geospatial analysis end-to-end: query connected databases and storage (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, S3) with spatial SQL, build and style map layers with Felt Style Language (FSL), upload files, manage annotations like pins and polygons, share maps, and tap into Felt's curated library of public datasets covering boundaries, demographics, infrastructure, and climate.

items.name: Fever Event Discovery
items.subtitle: Discover live entertainment events worldwide
items.description: Discover and explore live entertainment experiences worldwide through Fever. Search events by city, date, location, or keyword across concerts, shows, festivals, immersive experiences, and more. Filter by popularity, price, rating, or proximity. Get event details including schedules, venues, ratings, and pricing.

items.name: Fibery
items.subtitle: Build your modular workspace with Claude: describe any process, from roadmaps and CRM to hiring and OKRs, and get it set up in Fibery, a work platform for orgs run by nerds
items.description:
Fibery is an operating system for orgs run by nerds: a modular work platform where you build the tools your team runs on. Startups, agencies, enterprises and non-profits use it for everything from product roadmaps and customer feedback to sales CRM, hiring, OKRs and client projects. Everything can link to everything else, so work never gets lost between teams.
This plugin connects Claude to your workspace and teaches it how to build in Fibery.
Describe how your team works, and Claude builds it.
Sprints and bug tracking, a content calendar, a company wiki, or a process no template covers: explain it in your own words, or start from a process doc or a ready-made recipe like Shape Up. Claude asks what it needs to know, then sets up the databases, workflows, views and automations, with sample data to try it on. Want a priority field or a board grouped by stage? Just ask. Happy with the result? Save it as a recipe for the next team.
When views aren’t enough, ask for an app.
Claude can build a custom app on your Fibery data, like a step-by-step intake form or a dashboard your CEO actually reads. Your data stays in Fibery, with its permissions and history intact.
Ask the way you’d ask a colleague.
“Which customers asked for the features we shipped last month?” “What happened with the Acme deal this week?” “Who’s still waiting on interview feedback?” Claude searches records, documents, comments and activity history to answer, and turns the answers worth keeping into live reports.
Let routine work run itself.
Set up rules and buttons in plain words: when a deal is won, create the onboarding project; when a bug turns critical, assign it and set a due date.
Put your data to work.
Draft release notes from what shipped this month, write a client update from open tasks, turn meeting notes into assigned tasks, or update a hundred records at once.

items.name: Figma
items.subtitle: Generate diagrams and better code from Figma context
items.description:
The Figma MCP server helps you pull in Figma context and generate high-quality code that aligns with your codebase and design intent. Use the MCP server to retrieve code resources from Figma Design or Make files, and turn your ideas into production apps.
**Key features:**
• **Generate code from selected frames or nodes** - Select a frame in Figma or provide a node URL to have an AI agent turn your design into code.
• **Extract design context from layers** - Pull out variables, components, and layouts from a design to ensure builds adhere to design patterns.
• **Code smarter with Code Connect** - Boost output quality by reusing your actual components, the MCP server informs AI agents about existing components derived from Code Connect information.
• **Map your flows with diagrams** - The Figma MCP server can turn your Claude prompts into flow charts, Gantt charts, or other diagrams in FigJam.
**Note:** The get_screenshot tool is currently limited to returning a descripton of screenshots in Figma when called in Claude and Claude Code. See developer term [here](https://www.figma.com/legal/developer-terms/)

items.name: Files.com
items.subtitle: The Secure File Orchestration Platform
items.description: The Files.com MCP connector brings your Files.com site into Claude, making it easy to find, access, upload, organize, and share business-critical files directly from your AI workflow. It uses your existing Files.com permissions and access controls, so Claude can only work with the files and folders your connected account is authorized to use.

items.name: Filesystem
items.subtitle: Let Claude access your filesystem to read and write files.
items.description:
This extension allows Claude to interact with your local filesystem, enabling it to read and write files directly. This can be useful for tasks such as file management, data processing, and automation of repetitive tasks. The extension provides a set of tools that can be used to navigate directories, read file contents, and write new files or modify existing ones.
Underneath the hood, it uses @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem v2026.7.4.

items.name: Filevine
items.subtitle: Connect Claude to Filevine through the Filevine API to securely access and work with Filevine data and functionality.
items.description:
The Filevine API Connector gives Claude access to the Filevine API through an MCP server, enabling users to interact with Filevine directly from Claude. Use it to retrieve and work with Filevine data, including projects, contacts, documents, notes, tasks, and other supported Filevine resources and workflows.
The connector uses the Filevine API as its underlying interface, allowing Claude to perform supported Filevine API operations while respecting the permissions and access available to the connected user.

items.name: Finance Toolkit
items.subtitle: Give AI assistants access to 200+ financial metrics calculated transparently from raw financial statements, not pulled from third-party endpoints.
items.description:
The Finance Toolkit gives AI assistants access to 200+ financial metrics calculated transparently from raw financial statements. This includes financial statements, historical prices, analyst estimates, 80+ fundamental ratios, 30+ technical indicators, 20+ risk and performance metrics, and 50+ macro and fixed income indicators.
A Financial Modeling Prep API key is required to access 30+ years of financial data. Obtain one at [jeroenbouma.com/fmp](https://jeroenbouma.com/fmp). Authenticate once via OAuth, no key is stored on the server. Rate limit fallback to Yahoo Finance is built in, and macro databases from OECD and GMDB are accessed independently.

items.name: Financial Datasets
items.subtitle: Access stock market data
items.description: Financial Datasets gives Claude access to structured, real-time stock market data for 27,000+ active and delisted U.S. tickers. Research companies and markets with real-time and historical prices, primary-source SEC filings, financial statements and metrics, earnings, operating KPIs, news, insider and institutional ownership, index fund holdings, interest rates, and stock screening.

items.name: Find Your Great
items.subtitle: Understand your work impact — ask about what you actually did, decided, and changed.
items.description:
Find Your Great turns the work you already do into a record of what you have actually accomplished. It connects to Slack, GitHub, Linear and your meetings, then works out what you worked on, what you decided, and what changed as a result.
This connector gives Claude read-only access to that record, so you can ask about your own work in plain language instead of reconstructing it from memory.
Ask things like:
- "What did I work on this week?"
- "How are my evaluation scores trending?"
- "Draft an impact update for my manager covering the last two weeks."
- "What decisions did I make on the authentication project, and why?"
- "Where did my time actually go last quarter?"
What Claude can read — you choose which scopes to grant on the consent screen:
• Work Activity — activities, projects, decisions and meetings, including message content and meeting transcripts
• Career Signals — evaluations, scores against your level, the reasoning behind them, written day/week/month summaries, and the dated evidence each score rests on
• Patterns — recurring strengths, growth areas, reputational traits, and the dated moments that evidence them
• Plans & Goals — team goals, development plans and personal narratives
• Impact Updates — stakeholder updates about your work, and their status
• Team — members, teams, and how work connects to business outcomes
All 44 tools are read-only — the connector never writes to your account on behalf of an AI client. Every tool is scoped to the account that authorized the connection, so it can never read another member's data. You can revoke access at any time from Settings → Connections.
You will need a Find Your Great account and at least one connected work integration; the tools read the activity those integrations capture.

items.name: FINNY
items.subtitle: Your FINNY campaigns, website visitor tracking, and prospect uploads in Claude.
items.description:
The FINNY connector lets FINNY users work with their FINNY account by asking in plain language. With the connector, you can:
* See your campaigns, newest first, with each one’s status, channels, and launch date. You can also search campaigns by name.
* Review a campaign’s results as FINNY’s campaign page shows them: people contacted or scheduled, plus messages sent, opens, replies, clicks, and social connections, with rates by channel and by step.
* Upload prospects to FINNY. Claude previews the list first and shows which rows FINNY can use and which it can’t. Nothing is uploaded until you approve.
* Follow the progress of your recent uploads.
* Search the FINNY help center and read full articles.

items.name: Firecrawl
items.subtitle: Search and extract web data
items.description: Firecrawl helps users search the web, extract page and document content, discover structured data providers, and research developer documentation and scientific papers. It also supports browser interactions, multi-page crawls, structured research jobs, website change monitoring, and account credit-usage checks.

items.name: Fireflies
items.subtitle: Analyze and generate insights from meeting transcripts
items.description: Extract valuable insights from meeting transcripts and summaries.

items.name: Firefox Control
items.subtitle: Control Mozilla Firefox: tabs, history and web content (privacy aware)
items.description:
This MCP server provides AI assistants with access to the browser's tab management, browsing history, page search, and webpage text content through a local MCP (Model Context Protocol) connection.
Before accessing any webpage content, explicit user consent is required for each domain through browser-side permissions.
**Note:** This extension requires a separate Firefox add-on component, which is available at [https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/browser-control-mcp/](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/browser-control-mcp/). Start by installing the Firefox add-on, then copy the secret key from the add-on settings page (it will open automatically) and paste it into this extension's configuration.

items.name: Fiscal.ai
items.subtitle: Clean Public Equity Fundamental Data
items.description: Access institutional-grade financial data directly within Claude. Fiscal.ai delivers fundamental metrics and ratios minutes after earnings are reported, with every figure verifiable via direct links to the source filing. Beyond core financials, the server provides company-specific KPIs, revenue segments, and adjusted metrics. Combined with historical and current market quotes, it enables grounded, audit-ready equity research with unmatched speed.

items.name: Fitch Solutions
items.subtitle: Fitch credit intelligence, inside your AI workflow
items.description: Access trusted Fitch Ratings credit research and data, CreditSights intelligence, and BMI country and sector risk analysis — all through a single, governed MCP connection. Query ratings, financials, key rating drivers, research, and deal insights directly inside your AI workflows. Built for regulated environments with enterprise-grade authentication and entitlement controls. Fitch intelligence, where you work.

items.name: Flexport
items.subtitle: Make global trade so easy that there will be more of it.
items.description: Flexport helps users search logistics reference data, track and browse shipments, review quote requests and pricing, request rates, and create freight bookings through Anthropic.

items.name: FlitIQ — FMCSA Carrier Intelligence
items.subtitle: Look up U.S. motor carriers, check CSA safety scores, verify insurance, and save carriers to your FlitIQ pipeline — all inside Claude. Requires a FlitIQ Pro or Team subscription.
items.description: FlitIQ is an FMCSA carrier intelligence tool used by brokers, shippers, and 3PLs to vet motor carriers before they book a load. This MCP plugin gives Claude access to the same data the FlitIQ web and iOS apps use: carrier identity, CSA BASIC scores, real insurance carrier names and policy detail (BIPD primary/excess, cargo, trust), recent inspections, recent crashes, and per-docket operating authority. Pro and Team subscribers can also save carriers to their pipeline directly from a Claude conversation. Per-carrier lookups only — no bulk export or list-all-carriers operation.

items.name: Floot
items.subtitle: Build and host websites and mobile apps using your own Claude subscription.
items.description:
Build and launch real apps from Claude. Describe what you want, and Claude writes the code in a Floot project and puts it online as a web app at its own address. It can also ship it as an iOS and Android app to the App Store and Google Play.
Every project comes with a database, user sign-in, file storage, email and push notifications, so you don't need to set up any servers. A live preview updates while Claude works, and you publish when it looks right.
Claude does the building with your existing Claude subscription, so you don't buy any AI credits from Floot. Works in Claude, Claude Code and Cowork.

items.name: Flourish Financial
items.subtitle: Securely access and analyze Flourish client data from Claude
items.description: The Flourish MCP Server empowers financial advisors to securely explore client data and unlock insights directly within Claude. Access client details, manage invitations, and review account information. By connecting Flourish with Claude, you can accelerate routine analysis, streamline client meeting prep, and support recurring tasks. Permission-based access ensures that client information is protected while giving firms the power of AI-driven discovery.

items.name: Flourish
items.subtitle: Turn data into interactive charts you can edit
items.description: Flourish Connector turns Claude into a chart-making assistant for real Flourish projects. Give it data and describe the insight you want to highlight or the story you want to tell. It chooses a suitable template, prepares the data, creates the visualization in your Flourish account, and gives you an edit link. You stay in control of the final polish and publishing in Flourish. No screenshots or throwaway code. Just interactive, editable charts with the access, collaboration, branding, and publishing features your plan includes.

items.name: FMP
items.subtitle: Comprehensive financial market data
items.description: Real-time and historical financial data through a suite of tools covering stocks, ETFs, crypto, forex, commodities, SEC filings, economic indicators, and more. Users can look up company fundamentals, pull financial statements, screen stocks, read earnings transcripts, track insider and congressional trades, and more. Elevate your financial analysis and investment research with trusted, institutional-quality data.

items.name: Fourthwall
items.subtitle: Make custom merch & streetwear
items.description:
Make custom apparel, merch, and streetwear with Fourthwall, right inside Claude. Turn a logo or image into real products: t-shirts, hoodies, hats, mugs, stickers, plushies, or whatever swag / apparel you can dream up. Type your ideas and get live previews for different colors and design placements. Once you're happy, you can place an order. No minimums required.
You can also sell your products online or run a campaign with Fourthwall: manage promotions, track orders, and see what's selling without leaving the chat. Fourthwall handles the hard parts: manufacturing, fulfillment, shipping, customer support, and sales tax. No upfront costs, no inventory, no monthly fees.

items.name: Framer
items.subtitle: Design, update, and publish websites with Framer
items.description:
Design, update, and publish Framer websites from your chat. Connect your Framer account, share a project link, and describe what you want to build or change. Create pages using your existing styles and components, adjust layouts, update copy, and manage CMS collections.
Keep iterating with your agent, or open Framer to review and refine the result in the visual editor. When you’re ready, publish your changes yourself or ask your agent to publish them for you.

items.name: Franklin Templeton Funds and Insights
items.subtitle: Explore public Franklin Templeton fund information, document links and published investment insights.
items.description: Access public Franklin Templeton fund information, fund document links and published investment insights through two read-only tools. Ask about a fund or product, find available documents, or search recent investment research. If a fund name is ambiguous, the connector returns candidates so you can select the intended fund and share class before continuing. Responses provide available source links, dates and disclosures. Insights coverage is currently focused on the last three months. The connector does not access client accounts, holdings or transactions and does not execute trades. Content is informational and is not personalized investment advice.

items.name: freee
items.subtitle: freeeの各種プロダクトへのデータ下書作成、自動登録、登録済みデータの分析 / Draft, register, and analyze data across freee products
items.description:
freee会計、人事労務、請求書、工数管理、販売、IT管理、サインなど、freeeの様々なプロダクトをclaudeに接続して、データの登録や分析を行いましょう。claudeに話しかけるだけで、やりたかったfreeeの操作が完了し、あなたの見たい形でデータを見たり、アドバイスを得ることができます。
Access freee's full product suite—Accounting, HR, Invoicing, Sales, and Project Management—through natural conversation. Draft journal entries, automate data registration, and get instant analysis of your business data. Generate financial reports in freee Accounting, calculate complex payroll allowances in freee HR, import spreadsheet-based estimates into freee Invoicing, compute client margins in freee Sales, or log work hours in freee Project Management—all by simply describing what you need. Turn everyday back-office tasks into effortless conversations.

items.name: FreshBooks
items.subtitle: Ask Claude how your business is really doing — straight from your FreshBooks financials
items.description:
FreshBooks — Ask Claude how your business is really doing
Skip the spreadsheets and log-ins. With the FreshBooks connector, you can ask Claude about your business finances in plain language — and get clear, accurate answers pulled directly from your FreshBooks account.
Know Your Profitability, On Demand
Ask Claude how profitable your business was last month, last quarter, or all year. Get a clear breakdown of your revenue, expenses, and profit — no reports to run, no dashboards to dig through.
Understand Where Your Money Goes
Ask Claude to break your expenses down by category so you can see what's driving your costs and spot trends before they become problems.
Track Revenue and Cash Position
Get a real-time read on money coming in and going out. Ask Claude to compare periods, flag slow months, or summarize your overall cash position.
Your Data, Just Easier to Understand
The FreshBooks connector is read-only — it answers questions about your business, it doesn't make changes on your behalf. Your financial data stays exactly where it is; Claude just helps you make sense of it faster.

items.name: Freshservice
items.subtitle: Manage tickets, assets, changes, and IT requests
items.description: Manage IT service requests, incidents, and assets directly from Claude. Browse, create, and update tickets, incidents, and service requests in Freshservice without leaving your conversation. Fetch asset details, check ticket statuses, assign agents, and automate routine IT workflows using natural language. Make Freshservice a native part of your AI workflow—an intelligent IT service management agent that helps your team resolve issues faster and keep operations running smoothly.

items.name: Frontify
items.subtitle: Access your brand guidelines, assets and creative templates
items.description: Your brand knowledge, stored in Frontify, travels wherever you're working in Claude. Ask in plain language to search brand guidelines, assets, and templates. Generate on-brand creative from approved templates. Upload files, sort them into folders or collections, and apply metadata. Route assets straight through review workflows. A faster, more governed way to create and manage your brand content.

items.name: Fullstory
items.subtitle: Product analytics with receipts. Build segments, compute metrics, and analyze conversions from your Fullstory behavioral data. Then pull the real sessions to back it up.
items.description:
See what actually happened behind every number.
Fullstory MCP gives Claude both halves of product investigation: (1) analytics to size a problem and (2) session replay to see why it happened.
Ask where checkout is leaking, why a metric moved, or how to reproduce a bug. Claude discovers your pages and elements, computes the metric or funnel, and opens the sessions behind the drop. Every answer links to Fullstory, so you can check the work in 1 click.
Analytics tools give you numbers; error logs only catch code exceptions.
Fullstory shows what users actually experienced - including silent failures that never threw an error - so "conversion dropped 12%" becomes "the coupon field fails 5x more for logged-out users."
Because every answer links to the proof, you can give Claude a standing job as a scheduled task:
(1) Silent-failure watch.
Checks key flows hourly for frustration without a logged error and flags anything new.
(2) Bug scoping.
Opens the session behind a new ticket, diffs the screen when it broke, and counts who else hit it.
(3) Opportunity engine.
Compares converters with drop-offs every Monday and ranks fixes by users recovered.
What Claude can do:
(1) Map a session, then zoom to the moment. Read a compact timeline first, then jump to the timestamp where it broke to pull the screenshot, DOM, and before/after screen diff - keeping context light.
(2) Review sessions at scale. Because sessions load as compact structured data, read dozens of replays in 1 run and surface why users gave up.
(3) Build segments, metrics, & funnels in your own words. Discover your pages, elements, and events so questions map to your product.
(4) Compute on demand. Run counts, rates, trends, funnels, journeys, dashboards, and friction breakdowns by device, browser, geography, or user property.
Fullstory autocaptures clicks, page views, form inputs, console & network errors, and frustration signals (rage and dead clicks), so many questions need no instrumentation at all.

items.name: Function Health
items.subtitle: Lab test insights, health answers, nutrition plans
items.description: Function members can securely view lab test results, ask health questions, and get nutrition plans. Function includes 160+ lab tests per year to monitor 1,000+ diseases, help uncover possible causes of unexplained symptoms, and create a roadmap for feeling your best. Test your heart, hormones, thyroid, liver, kidneys, toxins, nutrients, inflammation, autoimmunity, immunity and more.

items.name: Funnel
items.subtitle: Cross-channel marketing analytics across 600+ connectors
items.description: Funnel brings all your marketing data, semantics, and business context to Claude in one trusted integration covering Google Ads, Facebook Ads (Meta), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads), Shopify, HubSpot and 600+ other platforms. Ask questions like "Compare my spend, CPA, ROAS, and revenue across all my marketing channels in the last 6 months", "How am I pacing towards my budget and revenue target?", or "Which campaigns generated the most HubSpot pipeline?" and get the answers right where you do your work.

items.name: Fyxer
items.subtitle: Search your inbox, and draft replies in your voice
items.description: Ask questions across your inbox and meeting notes to surface action items, decisions, and key discussions. Pull up meeting summaries and transcripts. Describe what you want to say and get a reply drafted in your voice, ready to send.

items.name: G2
items.subtitle: Bring real buyer signals into AI workflows
items.description: The G2 MCP server brings real-time Buyer Intent and review insights into AI workflows. It lets AI summarize in-market buyer research, competitive interest, and customer sentiment from the G2 platform. Teams can automatically prioritize accounts, personalize outreach, inform messaging, and uncover market trends—turning trusted, first-party buyer data into action.

items.name: Gainsight (CS)
items.subtitle: Query, write back and automate with real-time CS data
items.description: Connect Claude directly to Gainsight CS to query customer health scores, renewal timelines, and product usage in natural language. Take action by updating records, managing CTAs, logging activities, and building success plans with write back to Gainsight. Power autonomous, multi-step workflows for risk escalation, renewal playbooks, QBR prep, and expansion plays. With unified, real-time context from Gainsight CS, your AI workflows can identify and execute actions across your entire customer book of business.

items.name: Gainsight (Customer Communities)
items.subtitle: Ask your AI for the community insights you need
items.description: The Gainsight Community MCP connects your Customer Community to Claude. Surface unanswered questions, identify content gaps, and pull engagement trends through natural language. Review moderation queues, browse leaderboards, and audit community structure without waiting on a custom export. Purpose-built for community managers who'd rather ask their AI than navigate multiple dashboards.

items.name: Gainsight (Staircase AI)
items.subtitle: Power AI Workflows with Customer Context
items.description: Bring in live customer intelligence from Gainsight's Staircase AI including customer sentiment, risk, engagement and insights - so every answer, insight, and recommendation is grounded in real customer context.

items.name: Gamma
items.subtitle: Create presentations, docs, socials, and sites with AI
items.description: Transform ideas into presentations, documents, social media posts, and websites directly from Claude. Gamma generates beautifully designed content from prompts or notes, with smart layouts, customizable themes, and AI visuals. Work in 60+ languages, control tone and detail level, and export to PDF or PPTX — all without leaving your workflow in Claude.

items.name: Gem
items.subtitle: Access, analyze, and manage your Gem data in Claude
items.description: Connect Gem with Claude to bring your recruiting data to where you work. With the Gem MCP, you can query hiring analytics, pull applications, rediscover past talent, and take bulk actions in natural language.

items.name: Gemini
items.subtitle: Connect AI assistants to live crypto markets, prediction markets, your trading accounts, all through our secure read-only plugin
items.description:
Gemini MCP brings the Gemini digital-asset exchange directly into Claude. Through a single connection, your assistant gains real-time access to Gemini's public market data — live prices, tickers, order books, candles, and trade history across spot and derivatives — as well as prediction-market events and their tradable contracts. Ask a natural-language question and get grounded, answers drawn straight from Gemini's APIs, with no copy-pasting, custom scripts, or manual data wrangling.
For account-level insight, Gemini MCP adds secure, read-only access to your own trading data including balances, positions, open and historical orders, account summaries, and your trades. The server never stores your credentials or moves funds. The result is a safe, transparent bridge that lets AI assistants reason over both the market and your portfolio while keeping you firmly in control.

items.name: General Legal
items.subtitle: Submit contracts for attorney review, answer their questions, and get redlined documents back — without leaving Claude.
items.description:
General Legal is a law firm that combines world-class attorneys with AI-native execution. With the General Legal connector, you can kick off new legal projects right from the conversations and workflows you're already in--leveraging the same elite counsel in a new, seamless package. Open matters, ask questions, respond to your attorney's comments, and download the redlined document, all through Claude.
What you can do: start a matter from a question or a document · upload .docx/.pdf contracts via a secure one-time link (file contents never pass through the model) · track review status across your matters · message your attorney in the matter thread · download reviewed, released versions.
Sign in with your General Legal account or create one while connecting. Your documents are only visible to your own organization.

items.name: GetYourGuide
items.subtitle: Book Tours & Activities
items.description:
Plan your trip with ease—build your itinerary, find inspiration, and organize everything in one place. Whether you’re booking ahead or looking for last-minute ideas, explore experiences across culture, food, adventure, nature, and more.
From iconic landmarks like the Colosseum and Eiffel Tower to hidden local gems, we help you make the most of every destination. Enjoy expert-guided tours in cities like Paris, Dubai, New York, Berlin, and beyond—with insider access and flexible booking options.

items.name: GIS Cloud
items.subtitle: Run your entire GIS workflow in plain language: maps, data, analysis, field apps, and reports
items.description:
GIS Cloud is an AI-native, cloud GIS platform. Instead of clicking through a desktop GIS, you describe what you want and Claude does it across your whole account, covering the full lifecycle from field data capture to maps, analysis, apps, and reports.
The GIS Cloud MCP server lets Claude create and style maps and layers, add, edit, and query features, run spatial analysis and structured SQL over your data, build Mobile Data Collection forms for field teams, import files into PostGIS tables, manage tables, datasources, and bookmarks, render live interactive maps, and generate PDF and Excel reports.
It works through a propose-confirm model, so you approve every write and destructive actions are clearly flagged, with account-scoped OAuth access. ISO 27001 certified, serving organizations in 60+ countries.
Where GIS Cloud fits your workflow:
In the field: "Create a Mobile Data Collection form for pothole inspections with severity, surface type, and photo fields, then bind it to a new layer so my crew can start collecting today."
On the map: "Import this CSV of asset locations, put it on a new layer, and color the points by condition rating."
Through analysis: "Find every parcel within 200 meters of the flood zone, then list the ten largest by area."
End to end, in one ask: "Map last month's bridge inspections, flag anything rated poor, and generate a PDF report with the inspector photos and notes."

items.name: Givebutter
items.subtitle: Manage your fundraising
items.description:
Givebutter is the fundraising and donor management platform trusted by tens of thousands of nonprofits. This app connects your Givebutter account to Claude so your team can work with your fundraising data conversationally — no exports, no dashboards, no switching tabs.
Use it to:
- Look up donations, transactions, and payout activity across your campaigns
- Find and summarize donor and contact records, giving history, and engagement
- Check how a campaign, event, or fundraising page is performing
- Pull the numbers you need for board updates, grant reports, and end-of-month reconciliation
Ask things like:
- "How much did we raise in our spring appeal?"
- "Who are our top recurring donors this year?"
- "Summarize new donors from last week."
Claude retrieves the answer directly from your live Givebutter data and respects your existing account permissions — it can only access what your connected account can see.
Built and maintained by Givebutter. Authentication is handled securely through OAuth; you stay in control of access and can disconnect at any time.

items.name: Glean
items.subtitle: Bring enterprise context to Claude and your AI tools
items.description: Bring enterprise context to Claude and your AI tools with Glean's Remote MCP server. Search across all your organization's connected data sources—documents, wikis, code repositories, and more. Find employees by name, role, or expertise. Read specific documents, access Gmail and Outlook emails, and lookup meeting details. Custom agent workflows enable powerful automation tailored to your organization. Make Glean your AI assistant's enterprise memory—ensuring Claude and other MCP-enabled applications have deep knowledge of your company's context wherever you work.

items.name: GLG
items.subtitle: Expert intelligence, instantly in your workflow
items.description: GLG gives you instant access to the world's largest expert network directly in Claude. Search thousands of expert transcripts, explore insights across industries, and review content from your own research calls — all without leaving your workflow. Every response is grounded in named, verified experts from moderated GLG-hosted conversations, giving you the primary intelligence you need to make faster, more confident decisions.

items.name: Glovo
items.subtitle: Anything delivered in minutes
items.description:
Glovo in Claude helps you find anything you need in your city and get it delivered wherever you are in just minutes. Just ask in your own words for what you need: skincare, gifts, clothes, electronics, pet supplies, supermarkets, or even flowers.
You can also refine results by budget, brand, features, ratings, and your preferred stores, and view live availability, prices, and store details.
When you're ready to order, Claude takes you directly to the Glovo app or website to complete your purchase. As easy as that.

items.name: Gmail
items.subtitle: Draft replies, summarize threads, & search your inbox
items.description: Connect Gmail to Claude to quickly find important emails and understand long conversations. Claude can search through your messages, read entire email threads to give you context, and help you stay on top of your inbox. Perfect for finding that message you remember sending, catching up on email chains you missed, or preparing for meetings.

items.name: GoCardless
items.subtitle: Build GoCardless payment API integrations
items.description: Get intelligent, context-aware guidance for building GoCardless payment integrations directly from Claude. The GoCardless MCP provides comprehensive knowledge of API endpoints, integration patterns, webhooks, and code samples across all supported languages. Use it to generate integration code, set up payment pages, handle recurring billing, and follow best practices for error handling and security.

items.name: GoDaddy
items.subtitle: Search domains and check availability
items.description: Use GoDaddy to find available domains and get smart suggestions based on your ideas and keywords.

items.name: Goodnotes
items.subtitle: Turn AI insights into documents
items.description: Goodnotes instantly converts AI conversations into editable Goodnotes files. Create custom vector graphics and illustrations from SVG code for freeform drawings, icons, logos, and artistic designs. Generate structured diagrams from Mermaid syntax including flowcharts, mindmaps, and timelines. Render markdown content as beautifully formatted rich text documents. Whether you've got text, flowcharts, or images, move your ideas from the chat to the page to refine, annotate, and share in the Goodnotes app.

items.name: Google Calendar
items.subtitle: Manage your schedule and coordinate meetings effortlessly
items.description: Connect Google Calendar to Claude to view your schedule, manage events, and coordinate meetings. Claude can search your calendar for events, check your availability, find free time slots, create and update events, respond to invitations, and help you prepare for meetings. Useful for understanding what's coming up, scheduling new meetings by finding mutual availability, managing your calendar by creating or updating events, coordinating schedules across multiple people, or preparing for meetings by reviewing attendee lists and details.

items.name: Google Compute Engine
items.subtitle: MCP server for Google Compute Engine
items.description: Enables you to agentically manage your cloud compute infrastructure spanning deployment and operations.

items.name: Google Drive
items.subtitle: Search, read, and upload files instantly
items.description: Connect Google Drive to Claude to search through your documents, read file contents, upload new files, and analyze your data. Claude can find specific documents even when you don't remember the exact name, read and analyze the content of Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and PDFs, and upload files directly to your Drive. Useful for finding project notes, extracting data from spreadsheets, preparing meeting materials, or organizing files scattered across your Drive.

items.name: GoPlus AgentGuard
items.subtitle: Security guard for AI agents — blocks malicious skills, prevents data leaks, protects secrets.
items.description: GoPlus AgentGuard is an AI-agent security framework. It exposes MCP tools for scanning skills, looking up and managing a trust registry, evaluating runtime actions against policy, and simulating Web3 transactions. 20+ detection rules cover dangerous commands, secret exfiltration, and risky on-chain actions.

items.name: GoVola
items.subtitle: Search for the best flight offers and get refunded if the ticket price drops even after you book
items.description:
GoVola helps you find flight offers without the usual hassle. Search and compare
routes and prices across airlines, and discover smarter alternatives (including
multi-airline combos) so you can pick the best fit for your time and budget.

items.name: GovTribe
items.subtitle: Search government procurement & spending data
items.description: Search government contracts, awards, and vendors directly from Claude. GovTribe brings U.S. procurement intelligence into your AI workflow — find relevant opportunities across federal, state, and local agencies; analyze vendor competition; explore teaming partners; and track agency spending patterns.

items.name: Grafana Cloud
items.subtitle: Query metrics, logs, and traces and manage dashboards and alerts
items.description:
Connect Claude directly to your Grafana Cloud stack to query metrics, logs, traces, and profiles, investigate incidents, and act on dashboards and alerts—all through a single hosted MCP endpoint with no self-hosting required.
Requires a Grafana Cloud account. An administrator must accept the Grafana Assistant terms and conditions, and you need the Assistant Cloud MCP User role (Editor or higher has it by default).

items.name: Grafana MCP Server
items.subtitle: An MCP server giving access to Grafana dashboards, datasources, alerting, and more
items.description: An MCP server giving access to Grafana dashboards, datasources, alerting, and more

items.name: Grain
items.subtitle: Put your meetings to work
items.description: Grain captures and transcribes your meetings where you have them: Meet, Zoom, Teams, Slack, and more. Grain builds an AI Meeting Data Layer of transcripts, notes, and enriched context that Claude uses to power your work. Example prompts: "Draft a proposal for AcmeCo using context from every call we've had with them." "What pain points came up most across our user interviews this month?" "Summarize the team meetings I missed this week and flag anything I should weigh in on." "Find and clip recent moments where customers pushed back on pricing to share with sales." "Create a project for AcmeCo with every meeting we've had with them so I can prep for our QBR."

items.name: Granola
items.subtitle: The AI notepad for meetings
items.description: Connect Claude to your meeting history. Ask questions about your work and use your conversation context to get things done.

items.name: Granted
items.subtitle: Discover every grant opportunity in existence.
items.description: Search virtually every grant opportunity in existence - federal, state, and private foundation - using natural language. Most databases cover the big programs. Granted also surfaces the long tail: niche state grants, small family foundations, and hyper-local opportunities that nonprofits never find because no single database indexes them all. Research 133,000 US foundations with IRS 990 financials and key officers. Analyze 7 million federal award records to see who's actually winning.

items.name: GraphOS MCP Tools
items.subtitle: Search Apollo docs, specs, and best practices
items.description: Apollo GraphOS Tools is a hosted MCP server that gives AI coding agents direct access to Apollo's official documentation and the Apollo Connectors specification. It provides three tools: Docs Search lets agents query across Apollo's documentation to find relevant guides, examples, and best practices for GraphQL, GraphOS, schema design, and deployment. Docs Read retrieves the full Markdown content of any documentation page so agents can provide complete, detailed guidance. Connectors Spec gives agents access to the official Apollo Connectors specification for creating and modifying REST-to-GraphQL integrations. No authentication or setup is required — just point any MCP-compatible client at the endpoint and start building.

items.name: Grasp
items.subtitle: Find, screen and analyse private-market opportunities
items.description: Grasp brings the most exhaustive private-market database into Claude — 100m+ companies, 500k+ buyers and 500k+ deals, with data straight from the source. Run deal research end to end: build target, buyer and transaction lists; refine with structured research; analyse financials and ownership; query and export exhaustive data tables; and pull company profiles or decision-maker contacts. Move from a broad investment thesis to final insights — surfacing the opportunities no one else can.

items.name: Grasshopper Bank
items.subtitle: Query and analyze your financial data
items.description: The Grasshopper Bank MCP server connects Claude to your banking data, enabling AI-powered access to account information, transactions, and other insights. Query balances, analyze spending patterns, retrieve transaction history, and surface financial trends — all through natural language. Purpose-built for Grasshopper Bank customers, this connector brings your banking data into Claude workflows without switching tools. Accelerate routine analysis, support financial decisions, and unlock deeper visibility into your banking operations.

items.name: Greenhouse
items.subtitle: Connect Claude to Greenhouse. Search, analyze and update candidates, applications, jobs, interviews, scorecards, offers and more in plain language.
items.description:
The official Greenhouse MCP server connects Claude to your entire Greenhouse recruiting workspace, with more than 150 tools to search, analyze and update your hiring data in plain language.
Candidates and prospects
Search and update candidates, track education and employment history, manage tags and attachments, add notes, merge duplicates, and work with prospect pools.
Applications and pipeline
See every application by job and stage, move candidates forward, reject or unreject with the right reason, convert prospects, and record hires.
Jobs and job posts
Create and update jobs, openings, hiring teams and job posts, including post locations, and review each job's interview plan and job boards.
Interviews and scorecards
Schedule and update interviews, see interviewers and interview kits, and read or create scorecards and their answers.
Offers and approvals
Create and update offers, run approval flows, and manage approver groups.
Organization setup
Manage users, job permissions, departments, offices and custom fields, and look up roles, sources, referrers, email templates, close and rejection reasons, and pay inputs.
Reporting and compliance
Pull EEOC and demographic data, AI opt-out statuses and rejection details for reporting.
Put it to work: "Which candidates for the backend engineer role have been in Onsite for more than two weeks?", "Summarize the scorecards for Priya's final round", or "Create an opening for the new Design Lead role in our London office."

items.name: GrowSurf
items.subtitle: Build and manage GrowSurf referral and affiliate programs with Claude.
items.description:
Create and manage referral and affiliate programs with GrowSurf. Use Claude to set up a draft program, configure rewards, manage participants, track referrals and affiliate sales, read analytics, and troubleshoot referral tracking. Get installation guidance for web, iOS, and Android.
Connect securely with your GrowSurf account and choose which program to work with.

items.name: Growthbook
items.subtitle: MCP Server for interacting with GrowthBook - an open source feature flagging and experimentation platform
items.description:
The GrowthBook MCP Server enables AI assistants to interact with GrowthBook, an open source feature flagging and experimentation platform. Create feature flags, set up A/B tests, analyze experiment results, and manage your experimentation workflow directly from your AI coding assistant.
## Usage Examples
Ask Claude to:
1. Create a feature flag called `new-checkout` that defaults to `false`
2. Summarize my last 20 experiments
3. Create an A/B test comparing two checkout button colors - control with `#007bff` and variation with `#28a745`
4. Search the GrowthBook docs for how to set up a fact metric

items.name: grtwo-docs
items.subtitle: Publish -docs. from Claude and get a shareable link.
items.description: grtwo-docs lets you publish and manage shareable documents directly from Claude. Publish Markdown or HTML as public or restricted grtwo-docs links without leaving the conversation. List your documents, retrieve content by slug, update titles and body text, or delete documents you no longer need. Each publish returns a URL you can share. Connect with OAuth using your grtwo-docs account. Requires a Pro or Pro Plus subscription.

items.name: Guidepoint
items.subtitle: Real-time access to trusted expert knowledge
items.description: Embed trusted expert insights directly into your research and decision making workflows in real-time. Powered by Guidepoint's in-house team of former investment analysts, we combine institutional-grade quality with the volume needed for decision-critical work. Claude pulls verbatim excerpts from 100,000+ compliance-reviewed expert interview transcripts — with every source transcript linked inline for verifiable, trusted data.

items.name: Guru
items.subtitle: Search and interact with your company knowledge
items.description: Guru's MCP Server connects Anthropic's Claude to your company's trusted knowledge layer, so every AI answer is grounded in verified, permission-aware information—not outdated docs or hallucinations. It links Claude to the same governed context your teams use, ensuring consistent, cited, and explainable responses. With built-in verification and lineage, the Guru MCP Server makes it easy for Claude to deliver answers you can trust across every workflow.

items.name: Gusto
items.subtitle: Query and analyze your Gusto data
items.description: Connect Claude to your Gusto account to query and analyze your payroll and people data. Ask questions in natural language, build custom reports, and create charts to uncover trends and insights—no exports or tool-switching required. Eligible customers can also run payroll in Claude.

items.name: Haloo Trademark Clearance
items.subtitle: Full trademark clearance search, direct in Claude.
items.description:
Connect to Haloo for trademark clearance workflows directly in Claude.
Haloo performs a deep, full clearance search, not a knockout. Built on examiner methodology and trained on real-world trademark outcomes, it scans hundreds of millions of records across live global trademark registries using 62 retrieval algorithms that identify identical, phonetic, visual, conceptual, and related conflicts. Results are ranked by likelihood of confusion with legal rationale for each. Every search generates a ranked retrieval set with conflict scores and an editable clearance memorandum with a stoplight risk assessment, key citations, and jurisdiction-specific legal analysis.
Ask Claude to run a clearance search for a new brand name, suggest alternative name options if conflicts are found, or draft a trademark application with the best filing strategy given the results.
Each search covers one mark in one jurisdiction. Global clearance runs as separate jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction searches.

items.name: Hanover Park
items.subtitle: Run your investment firm in real-time with access to portfolio, accounting, performance and LP data.
items.description: Connect Claude with your data in Hanover Park. View and work with your investment data across funds, specific companies, and LPs. With your data easily reachable in Claude you can run analyses, generate investor reports, quarterly letters, slide decks and more in minutes. Surface insights for your partners that would previously take days to produce by hand.

items.name: Harmonic
items.subtitle: Discover, research, and enrich companies and people
items.description: Search, enrich, and research startups and companies using Harmonic's proprietary data on millions of companies and the people behind them.
