Get detailed company profiles with funding, location, founders, and network connections. Use natural language to find companies matching specific criteria. Create and manage lists of companies and people. Access your team's network mapping and saved searches. Discover startups earlier, research them faster, and act with confidence—an AI-powered research agent built into your workflow.

items.name: Harness
items.subtitle: Build, Ship and Secure your apps on Harness Platform
items.description: Ask Claude to ship a build, trace a failed deployment, toggle a feature flag, or check cloud costs. It acts directly on Harness, no tab switching required. Numerous resource types across CI/CD, GitOps, security, and FinOps, all through conversation.

items.name: Harness MCP Server
items.subtitle: Connect AI agents to Harness for CI/CD, code repositories, pull requests, services, environments, and feature flags.
items.description: The Harness MCP Server gives MCP-compatible clients access to Harness platform workflows through consolidated tools, resources, and prompts. It supports local stdio usage and can be bundled as a Node-based MCPB extension.

items.name: Harvey
items.subtitle: Answer legal queries, search vaults, and research
items.description: Bring Harvey's legal intelligence into Claude. The Harvey MCP server supports general legal inquiries, analysis over Vault projects, and research questions for select knowledge sources. The server also exposes discovery tools to list available Vault projects and knowledge sources, so you always know what is available for access.

items.name: Have I Been Pwned
items.subtitle: Check email addresses and domains for data breaches
items.description: Search email addresses and domains against the world's most widely used data breach corpus. Have I Been Pwned helps individuals determine whether their accounts have appeared in known breaches and enables organisations to investigate exposure across verified domains. Explore detailed breach information, identify exposed data types, review paste and stealer log exposure, and gain trusted security intelligence to better understand account compromise and cyber risk.

items.name: Health Data Avatar (HDA)
items.subtitle: Your complete health history structured for Claude
items.description: Connect Claude to your complete longitudinal health history and ensure every important detail is finally visible. Health Data Avatar helps you securely collect, structure, and search your medical data across lab results, handwritten letters, prescriptions, PDFs, scans, clinical notes, health journals, and soon wearables and apps. HDA parses files in multiple languages, summarises them in your preferred language, builds timelines, and turns fragmented records into AI-readable context. Review and edit transcriptions anytime, compare them with originals, and continuously enrich your health history so nothing gets lost.

items.name: HealthEx
items.subtitle: Connect your health records for personalized insights
items.description: HealthEx connects Claude to your health records, enabling personalized insights and proactive health management through secure data access.

items.name: Hebbia
items.subtitle: AI for financial rigor
items.description: Bring Hebbia's institutional intelligence into Claude. The Hebbia MCP server lets you tap into your firm's knowledge to make better decisions on deals and investments and run financial workflows from research to building reports, slides, and financial models.

items.name: Helena by Enrich Labs
items.subtitle: Your AI marketer for paid ads, SEO, email, social, and analytics
items.description:
Helena by Enrich Labs connects Claude to an autonomous AI marketing agent that plans and executes growth marketing across connected channels from a single chat.
What Helena does:
- Paid ads: analyzes performance and, when requested, launches, manages, and optimizes campaigns on Google Ads, Meta, and TikTok Ads.
- SEO: researches keywords and drafts or publishes blog posts and landing pages.
- Social media: drafts, schedules, and publishes posts for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, and Facebook.
- Analytics: tracks cross-channel performance and reports on traffic, leads, conversions, CPA, and ROAS.
Helena works with the brand and integrations already connected to your Enrich Labs account. Each reply returns the final answer, relevant links, actions and tools used, and a sessionId to continue the conversation.
The connector does not provide AI image, video, or audio generation.
Helena is the default agent. Enterprise plans can also route requests to Angela for email, Kai for social listening, Sam for SEO and content, or Paul for paid advertising.
The connector can also execute arbitrary shell commands in an isolated sandbox with outbound network access.

items.name: Helium 10
items.subtitle: Access your Helium 10 data directly in Claude
items.description:
Access your Helium 10 data directly in Claude. Query keyword and ASIN data, analyze campaign performance and profitability, and extract insights from your listings and rank tracking.
Make Helium 10 a native part of your Claude workflows without switching between dashboards or exporting a single file. Built for active brands with real account data across Research, Ads, and Commerce.
Requires an active Helium 10 Diamond plan. Lower-tier accounts are not supported.

items.name: Helix GenoSphere
items.subtitle: Query human genomics & longitudinal clinical data
items.description: Bring Helix GenoSphere™ — a growing research clinico-genomic dataset of more than 500,000 exome-sequenced participants with linked longitudinal EHR data — directly into Claude. Query gene-level carrier counts and pathogenic variants, determine target genes on curated panels, search standardized medical vocabularies (conditions, drugs, labs), and obtain privacy-protected patient counts for any concept. All responses are aggregated and statistically de-identified, with small groups suppressed to protect participant privacy. A read-only window into population-scale genomics, no SQL required.

items.name: Hex
items.subtitle: Answer questions with the Hex agent
items.description: Connect to your Hex workspace to get data insights directly in Claude. Find Hex projects and answer questions with the Hex agent.

items.name: Highspot
items.subtitle: Search, share content, and take action to win deals
items.description:
Search for content, get answers, see analytics, and take action with personalized guidance from Highspot by Seismic.
Embed Highspot by Seismic tools, insights, and agents directly in your sellers' AI workflows to accelerate sales velocity and increase productivity to win more deals. Part of Seismic, the Go-To-Market Performance company.

items.name: Hive
items.subtitle: Manage projects, tasks, approvals, resources, and customer work in Hive.
items.description: Connect Claude to your Hive workspace to find and update projects, actions, comments, approvals, goals, resources, timesheets, CRM records, and more. Hive respects your existing workspace permissions and authenticates through your Hive account. Use it to answer questions about current work, create or update records, and move workflows forward without switching tools.

items.name: Honeybadger
items.subtitle: Investigate production errors, query logs, and manage dashboards and alarms from your AI assistant
items.description: Honeybadger's official MCP server gives your AI assistant the production context it needs to debug issues. Search errors, inspect stack traces, identify affected users, query logs and events with BadgerQL, and manage dashboards, alarms, and check-ins. Grant read-only or read/write access to your account.

items.name: Honeycomb
items.subtitle: Query and explore observability data and SLOs
items.description: Query and explore observability data from OpenTelemetry or dozens of other sources in your honeycomb.io account.

items.name: HubSpot
items.subtitle: CRM context for every answer, insight, and action
items.description: Bring HubSpot customer context into Claude. Search and update contacts, companies, deals, tickets, campaigns, and more - without leaving Claude. Analyze campaign performance across emails, landing pages, and blog posts. Forecast pipeline, qualify leads, and update deal stages in seconds. Useful for pre-call prep, pipeline reviews, campaign attribution, and full account visibility. Permission-aware, real-time, secure.

items.name: Hubstaff
items.subtitle: AI-ready workforce insights
items.description: The Hubstaff MCP server enables AI tools to understand and work with workforce data in real time. Analyze productivity trends, identify workload imbalances, surface operational insights, and interact with Hubstaff data through natural language and agent workflows.

items.name: Hugging Face
items.subtitle: Access the Hugging Face Hub and thousands of Gradio Apps
items.description: Provides access to Hugging Face Hub information and Gradio AI Applications.

items.name: HyperFrames by HeyGen
items.subtitle: Build animated slides and motion graphics with HTML
items.description: Claude can now help you create animated slides, explainer videos and motion graphics to communicate and visualize your ideas. HyperFrames is an open source solution developed by HeyGen that turns HTML code into videos.

items.name: IBISWorld
items.subtitle: Financials, risk data and analysis on 50,000 industries
items.description: Turn Claude into your personal industry analyst, powered by IBISWorld's coverage of thousands of industries and 10 million data points. Access revenue and employment statistics, financial ratios, risk scores, cost structures, trade data, analyst-written insights, and other industry statistics. Size markets, forecast trends, and assess risk across banking, consulting, accounting, sales, and other strategic workflows without ever leaving Claude.

items.name: ICD-10 Codes
items.subtitle: Access ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS code sets
items.description: The ICD-10 Codes Connector gives Claude access to the complete ICD-10-CM (diagnosis) and ICD-10-PCS (procedure) code sets for medical classification and billing.

items.name: ICE Data Services
items.subtitle: Analyze U.S. fixed income trade and reference data
items.description: Query real-time and historical bond trades across corporate, agency and securitized products reported to FINRA TRACE, and municipal bond trades reported to MSRB RTRS. Look up bond reference data including coupon details and maturity dates.

items.name: Internet Computer
items.subtitle: Ask questions and perform actions across Internet Computer (ICP) apps using your Internet Identity.
items.description: ICP MCP connects your AI assistant to Internet Computer (ICP) applications. Discover an app's canisters and the services they provide, query app data, and make authorized non-financial updates. Internet Identity provides your app-specific identity. Calls to canisters require the application's published agent-access declaration. Financial transactions, canister funding, creation, and deployment are unsupported.

items.name: idealista
items.subtitle: Find properties to buy or rent
items.description:
The easiest way to buy or rent properties is now on Claude 😊
By connecting idealista with Claude, you’ll get access to the largest selection of property listings in Spain, Italy, Portugal and France (beta), including photos, property descriptions, and idealista maps, combined with Claude’s conversational capabilities.
Try asking Claude, by voice or text, things like:
• show me flats with a lift in the Malasaña area of Madrid for under €1,000 a month
• find a motorcycle garage in Lisbon
• any rooms with a private bathroom and terrace in Florence?
You can also refine your search by telling Claude your specific requirements.
Try it now and connect idealista with your Claude.

items.name: Idiolect
items.subtitle: Make Claude write in your real writing voice.
items.description: Idiolect makes Claude write in your real writing voice instead of generic AI. Capture your voice once from a few things you've actually written, and Idiolect builds a portable profile of how you write. After that, every draft or rewrite the connector returns comes back sounding like you — and each is scored on a validated voice-fidelity metric (LUAR), so the match is measured, not guessed. Your writing samples stay private. Free to capture your voice, get your voice card, and score text; Pro unlocks full ghostwriting.

items.name: IFTTT
items.subtitle: Connect, control, and automate 1,000+ apps with IFTTT
items.description: Connect IFTTT to Claude to run actions, query data, and manage your automations across 1,000+ services. Claude can search your apps for info, execute tasks on demand, and create or update Applets for you. Use simple natural language to let Claude save you time by handling repetitive tasks, syncing data between productivity apps, and controlling smart home devices directly from the chat.

items.name: IHME GBD
items.subtitle: Explore IHME Global Burden of Disease data: causes of death, disease burden, and risk factors worldwide.
items.maker: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation
items.description:
Ask Claude questions about the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation's Global Burden of Disease (GBD) study — the largest and most comprehensive effort to quantify health loss across places and over time — for any country, region, cause, or risk factor. The connector retrieves results directly from the GBD database; it does not model or generate new values.
Query deaths, DALYs, YLLs, and YLDs; risk factor exposures and attributable burden; life expectancy, healthy life expectancy (HALE), child mortality, population, and fertility; and detailed injury, impairment, and pathogen data — with Socio-demographic Index (SDI) context for development comparisons.
Beyond direct queries, five ready-made profiles generate narrative overviews with tables, charts, and maps: Location, Location Comparison, Disease, Sub-cause Comparison, and Risk-Outcome. Ask naturally, then narrow, broaden, or challenge the results through follow-up — no special commands required.
Example questions:
• What are the top causes of death in Nigeria?
• How has life expectancy in China changed over time?
• Which risk factors drive the most cardiovascular disease in Latin America?
• Compare child mortality across India's states.
Think of it as a fast, conversational front-end for exploring GBD data — complementing IHME's GBD Compare and Results Tool rather than replacing them.

items.name: iManage Work
items.subtitle: Governed knowledge. AI ready.
items.description: iManage Work Connector for MCP securely connects governed iManage content to Claude. Replace custom integrations with one open protocol, keep documents in iManage without bulk exports or replication, and ensure permission-bound, auditable Claude access as your AI strategy evolves.

items.name: incident.io
items.subtitle: See and manage everything in incident.io
items.description: Manage your full incident.io workspace from one place. Declare and triage incidents, ack pages, check who's on call, and track follow-ups - without switching tools. Analyze incident trends, escalation response rates, and alert noise across your organization. Browse your catalog, query telemetry from connected observability tools, and run structured operational reviews. Everything your team needs to stay on top of things, without the tab juggling.

items.name: Indeed
items.subtitle: Search for jobs on Indeed
items.description: Search and retrieve job listings, access detailed job descriptions and requirements, and provide direct job links to users. This integration streamlines the job search process by bringing Indeed's extensive job database and company information directly into Claude conversations, enabling seamless career exploration, job searching, and employment research capabilities.

items.name: Inductive Bio
items.subtitle: State-of-the-art ADMET prediction models for drug discovery
items.description:
Inductive Bio’s absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) models predict the chemical and pharmacokinetic properties that determine whether a molecule can become a viable drug. When these predictions are surfaced directly in conversation, scientists can evaluate compounds, triage ideas, and prioritize which molecules to synthesize, without leaving their existing workflow.
Through this MCP server, users can access Inductive Bio’s models for the physicochemical properties LogD (lipophilicity) and pKa (acid/base ionization), key drivers of solubility and permeability.
Inductive’s full suite of models spans all tiers of ADMET assays, including microsomal stability, efflux, CYP inhibition, brain penetration, hERG inhibition, and more. Models are fine-tuned to each customer’s chemical space to advance predictive performance. To access the full suite, reach out to Inductive Bio here: https://www.inductive.bio/book-a-demo.

items.name: InfiniteWatch MCP
items.subtitle: Analyze customer interactions, identify trends, and uncover operational risks with InfiniteWatch in Claude
items.description:
InfiniteWatch MCP brings customer interaction data and operational context from voice calls, text conversations, and web sessions directly into Claude. Authorized sales, customer support, QA, CX, and operations teams can ask natural-language questions to uncover top issues, find supporting examples, analyze trends, compare channels, identify operational risks, evaluate agent performance, access relevant how-to guidance, and summarize customer interactions, all without leaving Claude.
The connector uses InfiniteWatch authentication and organization selection. Each connection and tool call is scoped to the user’s selected organization, ensuring users can access only the data available to them within that organization.
The connector is read-only. It retrieves and analyzes existing InfiniteWatch data but cannot create, modify, delete, perform bulk exports, or send customer interaction data.

items.name: Infobip Documentation
items.subtitle: Search and browse Infobip docs from Claude
items.description:
Build flexible workflows with industry-leading communication APIs.
Find, browse, and reference Infobip product documentation, API guides, setup instructions, and release notes directly from Claude. Useful for answering product, technical, and implementation questions fast.

items.name: Infobip Message
items.subtitle: Send SMS, RCS, MMS, and Viber messages through Infobip in Claude
items.description:
Infobip Message lets your AI agent send messages across SMS, RCS, MMS, and Viber through a single tool call, with possibility to get delivery reports back so your agent knows whether the message landed.
Built for straightforward notification and alerting use cases, like order confirmations, delivery updates, appointment reminders, and one-off customer notices, where you want simple, reliable delivery without managing channel-specific logic.

items.name: Informatica Catalog Discovery
items.subtitle: The Catalog Discovery MCP server allows your AI agents to discover and explore enterprise data assets in Cloud Data Governance and Catalog
items.description: This MCP Server is the AI agent's gateway to discovering and exploring enterprise data assets within Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC). It allows AI agents to search the catalog using natural language or structured keyword queries, retrieve comprehensive asset metadata, and understand relationships between data assets. This enables LLMs to ground their responses in governed, accurate enterprise data context.

items.name: Informatica Data Exploration
items.subtitle: Domain-agent MCP for data exploration and MDM entity discovery in IDMC. Exposes the Claire discovery agent's skills for exploring dataset content and mastered entities
items.description: This MCP server wraps Informatica's CLAIRE data-exploration agent, giving AI agents direct access to dataset contents, column-level insights, and MDM golden-record queries across IDMC. It sits one layer below the planner MCP, so callers who already know they want to explore data (rather than run a whole plan) can invoke discovery directly.

items.name: InfoTrack
items.subtitle: Australian legal, property and compliance searches
items.description: Access Australia's leading legal, property, and compliance search platform through Claude. Perform real-time searches across official government and regulated registries, including company records, property titles, bankruptcy checks, security interests, and more. InfoTrack delivers authoritative, source-of-truth data that powers due diligence, conveyancing, and compliance workflows directly within your Claude.

items.name: Inkbox
items.subtitle: Email, SMS, and iMessage for AI agents
items.description:
Inkbox gives an AI assistant its own communication identity: an email address, a phone number, SMS, and iMessage, reachable by humans and other agents alike. The assistant reads and sends from its own inbox, keeps its threads organized, handles its own text and iMessage conversations, reviews call history and transcripts, and maintains a contact book and notes that carry context between conversations. Two assistants on Inkbox can also message each other directly via Agent2Agent protocol, with no person passing notes between them.
Everything runs against a single identity you choose when you connect, and every action is scoped to that identity's own data. The assistant acts only when you ask it to: Inkbox does not watch your inbox in the background, wake the model, or send anything on its own.
Note: Voice is not part of this connector. It cannot place, answer, or end calls, and it generates no audio or synthetic speech. Calls are read-only here; the assistant can review the history and text transcripts of calls that already took place.

items.name: Insider One
items.subtitle: Query Insider One CDP and APIs using natural language
items.description:
Insider MCP enables AI-powered clients to securely query Insider One CDP and APIs using natural language. It provides controlled, read-only access to Insider CDP and APIs, while fully respecting existing authentication, permission, and governance models.
Designed for enterprise use, Insider MCP allows teams to explore data, retrieve insights, and query platform objects without navigating dashboards or writing custom queries. All requests are permission-based, transparent, and executed through predefined APIs, ensuring security, control, and scalability as capabilities expand over time.

items.name: Insight Timer
items.subtitle: Emotional health & sleep
items.description: Used by 32 million people worldwide, Insight Timer is home to the world's largest free library of meditation, sleep tracks, breathwork, music, and spiritual talks. Want to wind down before bed, calm pre-meeting nerves, or find a Yoga Nidra session for tonight? Just ask and Claude will surface the right tracks, teachers, or talks. With Insight Timer in Claude you can: ask for guided meditations, breathwork, ambient soundscapes, or dharma talks and play them in Insight Timer. Find a teacher you love and hear more from them. Refine by duration, language, voice, or simply ask for "more like this."

items.name: Instacart
items.subtitle: Groceries and more delivered as fast as 30 minutes
items.description: Find nearby stores, check product availability, turn meal ideas and recipes into groceries delivered.

items.name: Instrumentl
items.subtitle: Find, evaluate, and manage your grants
items.description: Instrumentl integration for nonprofits. Make Instrumentl a native part of your AI workflow — an intelligent partner that helps you find, win, and manage grants faster, directly in Claude.

items.name: Intapp Celeste
items.subtitle: Securely, compliantly access Intapp Celeste products
items.description: Search, create, and update records across the Intapp Celeste portfolio with secure, compliant retrieval via Intapp Celeste connector with Claude. Ensure the workflows you rely on from Intapp Celeste are available to integrate into your Claude projects with the governance your clients demand.

items.name: Interactive Brokers (IBKR)
items.subtitle: Trade, invest, analyze, and manage global markets
items.description: Connect your Interactive Brokers account to Claude and manage your portfolio through natural language. Ask about positions, balances, P&L, allocations, and open orders, or request real-time quotes and historical market data. You can also prompt Claude to draft trade instructions — for example, "Buy 100 shares of AAPL at a limit of $200" — which are sent to your IBKR account for your review and approval. Claude never submits orders directly to the market. Any trading symbols displayed or discussed are for illustrative purposes only and are not intended to portray recommendations. Member SIPC.

items.name: Intercom
items.subtitle: Access to Intercom data for better customer insights
items.description: The Intercom MCP Server gives your AI tools access to customer data—conversations, tickets, and user data. This lets teams across your business, not just support, use that data in their workflows: from spotting bugs and shaping the product roadmap to refining messaging and preparing for QBRs. Every team can act with clearer visibility into what customers need.

items.name: Introhive
items.subtitle: Power your AI with firm-wide relationship intelligence
items.description: Purpose-built for professional services firms, the Introhive MCP Server gives Claude real-time access to your firm's collective relationship network. With this agent, Claude can identify who knows a key prospect, pinpoint at-risk accounts, surface cross-sell signals, generate meeting briefs, and more in your team’s everyday workflow. Powered by live relationship scores, engagement trends, and network paths, your agents move from answering questions to responding like they've been at your firm for years.

items.name: Intuit Credit Karma
items.subtitle: Credit score factors & insights
items.description: Credit Karma helps you understand your credit health. Get a breakdown of the key factors affecting your credit score – including payment history, credit utilization, credit age, credit mix, new credit inquiries, and total accounts – and see how you're rated on each to help you take action toward improving your credit.

items.name: Intuit Developer
items.subtitle: Build and test integrations with Intuit APIs.
items.description: Intuit Developer helps developers set up an Intuit API integration from an AI-enabled development environment. It guides users through the onboarding flow for a first QuickBooks API call, including developer authentication, workspace selection, app setup, scope selection, OAuth setup, sandbox setup, API discovery, endpoint details, and first request generation. It is designed for developer onboarding and API setup, not for managing QuickBooks business workflows or production accounting data.

items.name: Intuit Mailchimp
items.subtitle: Create marketing campaigns
items.description: Go from business goals to omnichannel campaigns in seconds. Provide your business goals, and we'll generate a data-backed omnichannel strategy with ready-to-use layouts, not just the text, to ensure brand consistency while saving you hours of manual work. Ready to send? Simply connect or create a Mailchimp account to import your assets and reach your audience.

items.name: Intuit QuickBooks Labs
items.subtitle: (Beta) Categorize bank transactions, reconcile accounts, send invoices, and run reports with Quickbooks in Claude.
items.description:
QuickBooks Labs (Beta) brings everyday QuickBooks Online bookkeeping and accounting work into Claude. Connect your bank and card accounts, then categorize and match transactions as they arrive, reconcile each account to its statement, and keep your chart of accounts, products, customers, and vendors current. Ask in plain language for a profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance, general ledger, or A/R and A/P aging report, break down sales by customer or product, or benchmark results against similar businesses in your industry and region.
It covers the transaction work too. Create, update, send, and duplicate invoices and estimates, set up recurring invoices, and record bills, expenses, payments, deposits, transfers, and journal entries. Send payment links and reminders with a clear preview and your confirmation before anything goes out. Look up payroll details, add an employee, or set base pay. If you manage more than one company, including client books, switch between them in a single conversation.
New to QuickBooks? Create your company during setup, connect your bank, and QuickBooks Labs (Beta) starts categorizing and analyzing your transactions right away.
How this relates to the Intuit QuickBooks connector: QuickBooks Labs (Beta) includes everything in the Intuit QuickBooks connector and adds bank feed categorization, account reconciliation, bills and expenses, journal entries, and multi-company switching. items.name: Intuit TurboTax
items.subtitle: Estimate tax refunds and connect with live tax experts
items.description:
Get fast federal tax estimates and discover filing options with Intuit TurboTax-powered tools. Start with a simple tax estimator that guides you through the info you need and see your refund or amount owed as you go. When you're ready for expert help, connect with trusted tax pros. Confident tax filing starts here.

items.name: Invesco for Advisors
items.subtitle: Tools to help solve your investing and business challenges
items.description:
Connect with Invesco for solutions and practice support that can help you simplify complexity, strengthen client outcomes and grow what matters for your business.
We exist to help you and your clients succeed by solving investing problems – whether that's making better-informed portfolio decisions, finding clearer ways to navigate changing markets, strengthening client conversations and relationships, or bringing practical thinking to the challenges of building a successful practice.
Together, we can rethink what’s possible for your clients and your business.

items.name: IP Author
items.subtitle: Patent search and analysis

items.name: Ironclad Contracts
items.subtitle: Plain language search for faster contract answers and manage your contractual obligations
items.description: Ironclad's MCP server lets Claude search your contract repository and workflows using plain language. Ask things like "which MSAs are expiring in the next 90 days" or "show me vendor agreements with termination for convenience clauses" - and get back the right contracts and answers instantly. The set of Obligation Management tools require the Obligations add-on, and access follows the same repository-record permissions as the product.

items.name: isolved People Cloud
items.subtitle: Your isolved data, inside Claude
items.description:
The isolved People Cloud connector gives employees self-service access to their own HR data inside Claude. Check time off balances, submit requests, view pay history with full earnings and deduction detail, see withholding in plain language and review direct deposit splits with account numbers always masked.
For payroll teams, The Guardian analyzes every payroll run in real time, flags potential errors before the run closes and prepares fixes for administrator approval. Nothing commits without sign-off.
Authenticates via OAuth and only accesses data your role is authorized to see. Capabilities vary based on your organization's isolved configuration and enabled services.

items.name: Isometric
items.subtitle: Agentic certification for the industrial economy
items.description: Isometric is the agentic certification platform for the industrial economy. Its AI agents work alongside human verifiers, reviewing every data point so expert judgment is freed for the calls that matter. From carbon removal and superpollutant reduction to low-carbon energy, fuels, and materials, Isometric brings them all onto a single platform.

items.name: item
items.subtitle: Search, analyze, and act on CRM data
items.description: Browse, summarize, update, and analyze customer data directly from Claude. Connect live context from contacts, companies, deals, lists, saved views, notes, and relationship history so your assistant can answer account questions, find the right records, and help move work forward without jumping between tabs. Turn scattered CRM data into usable context for research, planning, follow-ups, and customer-facing work.

items.name: iubenda: Privacy policy & cookie banner
items.subtitle: GDPR and CCPA compliance: cookie consent, cookie scanner, and terms and conditions
items.description: Handle your website's privacy compliance by asking Claude. Generate a privacy policy, cookie policy, and terms and conditions for your website or app, then set up a cookie banner that collects cookie consent from your visitors. iubenda's privacy policy generator builds your policy from the services your site actually uses. Add them from iubenda's catalog of thousands of services, or run the cookie scanner to find the trackers and third-party services on your live site, then add what it finds to your policy. Configure your cookie consent banner (position, colors, and consent behavior) in plain language, and update your documents whenever your site changes. Built for founders, agencies, and developers who need to meet the requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the EU ePrivacy Directive, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and other US state privacy laws, and privacy rules across markets. Works with every iubenda plan, including the free one. Claude asks before anything final or permanent, like finalizing a policy or deleting a site.

items.name: Ivo
items.subtitle: Explore your contracts, ask questions with supporting evidence, and build renewal calendars with Ivo.
items.description:
Connect Claude to Ivo to ask contract questions, compare terms, and retrieve extracted data with supporting quotes. Build renewal calendars with the renewal-calendar skill, or create AI-field definitions and extract missing field values in accessible rooms through Ivo Assistant. Existing answers are skipped; contracts and existing field definitions are not edited or deleted. Each query and Ivo Assistant’s reply are saved as a chat thread in your Ivo workspace, identified by chatId.
Requires a paid Ivo account with Intelligence access and permission to the relevant contract rooms. Connect using your workspace’s MCP URL and OAuth.

items.name: J.P. Morgan Asset Management (55ip)
items.subtitle: Develop and analyze personalized, tax-aware portfolio transition scenarios
items.description:
Evaluate the potential tax implications of transitioning a client portfolio to a new investment strategy. 55ip's ActiveTax Technology® enables advisors to generate personalized Tax Transition Proposals and compare different realized capital-gain scenarios based on the client's investment and tax-budget preferences.
Consider using 55ip when you want to:
- Evaluate a proposed portfolio transition. Explore the potential tax implications of moving a client's existing holdings into a recommended investment strategy.
- Compare different tax-budget scenarios. Review multiple potential scenarios to understand how different estimated realized capital-gain levels could affect a proposed transition.
- Address appreciated or legacy holdings. Assess how a portfolio with embedded gains may transition toward a new strategy while managing potential tax consequences.
- Prepare for a client conversation. Generate a personalized Tax Transition Proposal to help illustrate transition scenarios for the client. The existing workflow allows the advisor to create a PDF from the results.
- Explore a transition before taking action. Use the proposal to evaluate alternatives before deciding how to proceed. The 55ip MCP generates proposals only; it does not create transactions.
This Connector capability is for existing 55ip clients only.

items.name: Jam
items.subtitle: Record screen and collect automatic context for issues
items.description: Jam's MCP is the fast lane between Jam recordings and your dev tools. Drop a Jam link into VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude and the whole recording – video, console, network, logs – arrives pre-packaged. No hand-typing repro steps, no copy-paste stack traces, no screen-share drama. Your tools get instant context, you stay in flow.

items.name: Jasper
items.subtitle: Keep every Claude session on-brand
items.description: Bring the power of Jasper into Claude, including your brand voices, audiences, style guides, knowledge as context, product details, and agents for GEO and multi-language translation. Instead of relying on PDFs or isolated skill.md files, Jasper brings your brand, knowledge, and guardrails into Claude, so every output is on-brand and grounded in your business.

items.name: Jaz Accounting
items.subtitle: Fastest way to manage money
items.description: Built for accountants, finance teams, and the businesses they serve. IFRS-first, multi-currency, multi-user by default. The 358 operations listed here are all reachable, but this extension does not load them all at once: it lists 3 meta-tools and loads the operations you need on demand, so it costs about 600 tokens of context instead of 78KB. Ask the agent "what can you do?" for the full map.

items.name: Jedify
items.subtitle: Governed, live business context for you and your agents - so they reason and act on your organization’s trusted data, definitions, and knowledge.
items.description:
Jedify gives you and your AI agents a governed context layer over your organization’s data and knowledge. It connects metrics, entities, business rules, terminology, and source systems into a living Context Graph, so agents can reason, answer, and act with the right business meaning, without users needing to know where the underlying data lives.
The context stays synchronized as your data and business logic change, helping agents deliver more accurate, consistent, and trustworthy results across analytical and agentic workflows.

items.name: Jentic
items.subtitle: Search 10,000+ APIs and get the one you need
items.description:
Finding the right API usually means a dozen tabs, a few directories, and an afternoon reading docs. Jentic turns that into one question. Search more than 10,000 APIs from inside Claude, describe what you're building in plain language, and get back the ones that fit, along with their endpoints, auth, and rate limits. Every other connector adds a single integration. This one adds the ability to find thousands.
You can use Jentic to:
Find an API by use case:
"I need to send transactional email at scale. Which APIs fit, and how do they price?"
Compare your options:
"Compare geocoding APIs on rate limits, auth, and free tier."

items.name: Jobber
items.subtitle: Get answers and take action with context from your Jobber account
items.description: Bring your Jobber business context into Claude. Get answers and take action across your clients, quotes, jobs, invoices, payments, and schedule. Use it to see what needs your attention, check who owes you money, plan upcoming work, or turn a customer email into a ready-to-review quote. Review and approve changes before they’re made.

items.name: Jotform
items.subtitle: Create forms, surveys, quizzes & analyze submissions
items.description:
Create, edit, and analyze forms directly inside Claude. Simply describe what you want to collect, and Jotform generates complete forms you can refine through conversation. Whether you're creating surveys, research questionnaires, client intake forms, or internal request workflows, you can update forms, review submissions, and analyze responses using natural language - all without leaving Claude.
Build surveys, research questionnaires, application and intake forms, request forms, lead generation forms, assessments, evaluation forms, feedback forms, quizzes, registration forms, RSVP forms, appointment booking forms, order forms, and more. Add, remove, and reorder fields, customize layouts and themes, and update your forms at any time through conversation.
View submissions in real time, filter responses using natural language, summarize feedback, compare results, identify trends, uncover recurring themes, and generate actionable insights from your form data.
You can use the Jotform connector to:
Create forms with natural language:
"Create an employee satisfaction survey with a 1–5 rating scale, department field, and optional comments."
"Create a language proficiency quiz with 20 multiple-choice questions and automatic scoring."
Edit existing forms:
"Open my 'Job Application' form and add a required LinkedIn profile field and an optional portfolio URL."
"Update my IT Support Request form by adding a priority dropdown and department selector."
Review and analyze submissions:
"Summarize the latest customer feedback responses and identify the most common feature requests."
"Analyze submissions from my employee evaluation form and highlight recurring strengths and improvement areas."

items.name: Jotform App Builder
items.subtitle: Build and manage no-code apps with AI. Create CRM apps, event apps, school apps, and internal tools. Customize layouts, automate workflows, and publish and share apps.
items.description:
Create and customize fully functional apps directly in Claude. Simply describe what you want to build, and Jotform App Builder generates a ready-to-use app that you can refine through conversation. Create apps for a wide range of use cases, including internal tools, team workspaces, CRM apps, customer portals, employee onboarding, event registration, booking systems, product catalogs, service directories, membership communities, and business dashboards. Customize layouts, add forms and widgets, manage users and permissions, configure payments and workflows, and publish your app—all without coding or leaving the chat.
You can use the Jotform App Builder connector to:
Create apps with natural language:
"Create a menu app for my restaurant with food categories, prices, and online ordering"
Customize existing apps:
"Open my 'Employee Onboarding' app and add a welcome page, onboarding form, and resource section for new hires"
Manage users, data, and workflows:
"Update my 'Customer Portal' app to manage customer information, set user permissions, and automate service request workflows"
Configure and publish apps:
"Update my 'Event App' with attendee registration, payment collection, and event resources, then get it ready to share"

Generate agreements, forms, and other signable documents from simple prompts, then customize fields, recipients, signing order, and workflows through conversation. Send documents for signature and streamline approvals with legally binding e-signatures that work on any device.
Perfect for creating contracts, onboarding paperwork, consent forms, and other documents that require signatures — without starting from scratch.
Key Features

NDAs and confidentiality agreements

Internal approvals, policies, and acknowledgments

For any business user who needs to work with contracts or their data, Juro's MCP server enables you to access contract intelligence directly from Claude.

Bring the power of the world's leading frontier AI lab into your contract repository - and let your business colleagues work in their AI platform of choice. Connect Juro's MCP server with Claude to agree contracts faster today.

items.name: Kahoot!

Transform any topic, document, or link into a live, interactive learning session in seconds. Onboarding prompts:

items.name: Kapture Browser Automation

items.name: Keel
items.subtitle: Build & backtest Hyperliquid strategies
items.description:

With Keel in Claude you can:
- Build and edit strategies by describing them
- Backtest them and compare runs side by side
- Start from a verified strategy in the Keel library
- Keep notes on strategies and share a result by link
- See how the strategies you run in Keel are doing
Everything you create stays in your Keel workspace. Nothing is public unless you share it.
Claude can't move money, place orders, or run a strategy with real capital. You start and stop strategies in the Keel web app.
Keel measures the strategies you design. It does not give investment advice or recommendations, and backtest results do not predict future returns.

items.name: Kepler

items.name: Kick
items.subtitle: Search, categorize, edit, and report in Kick.

items.name: Kindora Funder Discovery
items.subtitle: Find funders who support causes like yours

items.name: Kit
items.subtitle: Search, analyze, draft, and manage your email marketing

Tag subscribers, manage segments, draft and schedule broadcasts, enroll contacts in sequences, and more. Your data, your AI tool, your workflow all in your control.

items.subtitle: Securely connect AI assistants to your Kiteworks instance for file, folder, and search operations

The Kiteworks MCP Server enables Large Language Model (LLM) applications to securely interact with your Kiteworks instance through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). items.name: Kiwi.com
items.subtitle: Search flights in Claude
items.description: Brings flight search directly into Claude. The Kiwi connector supports one-way/round-trip, flexible dates, multiple passengers, all cabin classes. Works with Claude and Claude Desktop.

items.name: Klaviyo
items.subtitle: Report, strategize & create with real-time Klaviyo data
items.description: Chat directly with Klaviyo to report, strategize, and launch faster. Ask for performance summaries, content and copy, optimization opportunities, and profile insights – AI responds with the full context of your Klaviyo data.

items.name: Klue
items.subtitle: Access competitive intelligence, win-loss, & deal support
items.description:
Connect Klue to Claude to get instant, cited answers based on trusted competitive intelligence and win-loss data.
With Klue’s MCP, sellers get real-time, cited answers on positioning, objections, and what to do next in their specific deals that are in flight. PMMs can analyze win-loss patterns and competitive signals, research voice of buyer, and directly update content in Klue via Claude.

items.name: Kpler

Ask questions in plain English instead of writing API calls or SQL. Built for the analysts, traders, compliance officers, and operators who already use Kpler day-to-day. items.name: Krisp
items.subtitle: Add your meetings context via transcripts and notes
items.description: Connect your meeting history to AI tools so past decisions, action items, and conversation context are easy to find and use.

items.name: Kubernetes MCP Server
items.subtitle: MCP server for interacting with Kubernetes clusters via kubectl
items.description:
MCP Server that can connect to a Kubernetes cluster and manage it.
By default, the server loads kubeconfig from `~/.kube/config`.
The server will automatically connect to your current kubectl context. Make sure you have:
1. kubectl installed and in your PATH
2. A valid kubeconfig file with contexts configured
3. Access to a Kubernetes cluster configured for kubectl (e.g. minikube, Rancher Desktop, GKE, etc.)
4. Optional: Helm v3 installed and in your PATH.
You can verify your connection by asking Claude to list your pods or create a test deployment.
If you have errors open up a standard terminal and run `kubectl get pods` to see if you can connect to your cluster without credentials issues.
## Features
- [x] Connect to a Kubernetes cluster
- [x] Unified kubectl API for managing resources
- Get or list resources with `kubectl_get`
- Describe resources with `kubectl_describe`
- List resources with `kubectl_get`
- Create resources with `kubectl_create`
- Apply YAML manifests with `kubectl_apply`
- Delete resources with `kubectl_delete`
- Get logs with `kubectl_logs`
- and more.

- Stay Ready with Kuliko

- Build real understanding instead of memorizing answers

- Prepare for exams, interviews, presentations, and more

Finding an answer isn't the same as being ready.
Stay Ready.

items.name: La Growth Machine
items.subtitle: Connect La Growth Machine to Claude — manage campaigns, leads, audiences and conversations directly from AI.
items.description:
La Growth Machine (LGM) is a multichannel sales outreach platform. items.name: lastminute.com

items.name: LatchBio

items.description: The Latch MCP lets you connect Latch to Claude, allowing you to browse data, start bioinformatics workflows and monitor workflow executions. Run serverless bioinformatics pipelines written in Nextflow or Python without leaving Claude.

items.name: Lattice

items.name: Leadfeeder

Leadfeeder shows you which companies are visiting your website and how well they fit your ideal customer. Connect Leadfeeder to Claude and just ask: find the right-fit companies showing interest this week, see what they viewed, enrich them with the right contacts, build and tag lists, and check your usage — all in plain language. Start from the demand your website already creates, not a cold database. You sign in with your own Leadfeeder account and stay in control of what the assistant can do.
Leadfeeder provides business contact data from its B2B database, built from publicly available sources. The legal basis for processing this personal data is Leadfeeder's legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) in providing and marketing our services to our users and clients. Individuals can request removal, object to processing, or opt out at https://privacycockpit.leadfeeder.com/ or by contacting privacy@leadfeeder.com. More information available on our Privacy Center: https://www.leadfeeder.com/privacy/privacy-center/

items.name: Learning Commons

items.description: Connect Learning Commons to Claude to align with all 50 states’ academic standards, break them into granular learning components, and trace learning progressions. Generate more precise, standards-aligned instructional content that supports coherent learning and reflects educational best practices and learning science.

items.name: dot.
items.subtitle: Get feedback on anything you build in Claude.
items.description: Build something in Claude. Get feedback in seconds. Say "add dot. feedback to my artifact" and Claude creates a shareable review link — anyone can click anywhere on the page to leave pinned comments. No deploy, no signup for reviewers, no switching tabs. Works with Claude artifacts, Vercel previews, Lovable, v0, or any URL. You can also ask Claude to check your feedback or list your projects without leaving the conversation.

items.name: Legal Brain Agent
items.subtitle: 日本最大級の法律データベースを基盤にした、法務特化AIエージェント
items.description:
「LegalBrain エージェント」MCPサーバーを使うと、Claudeから日本屈指の法律データベースに直接アクセスできます。法令・判例・書籍・ガイドラインといった膨大な情報源を横断的に検索し、複雑な調査や作業を自律的に進める、法務に特化したAIエージェントです。
「LegalBrain エージェント」のすべての出力には出典が明記され、信頼性の高い情報源に基づくため、実務でそのまま使える根拠のある回答が得られます。
さらに、その回答をもとに、法的書面、経営陣向けの報告書、交渉資料、社内規程といった文書をClaude上で作成することもできます。
※ご利用には、LegalBrain エージェントのご契約（有料）が必要です。
The Legal Brain Agent MCP server enables lawyers and corporate legal professionals to access Japan's top legal database directly from Claude, providing a legal-specialized AI agent that autonomously executes complex tasks. Developed by Bengo4.com, Japan's leading legal platform, it cross-searches vast information sources including statutes, case law, books, and guidelines. All outputs include citations and are grounded in highly reliable sources, delivering substantiated answers that are practical for real-world legal work. Based on those answers, users can also draft practical documents directly within Claude, such as reports for executives, negotiation materials, and internal regulations.

items.name: Legal Data Hunter
items.subtitle: Search 23M+ legal docs in 160+ jurisdictions.
items.description: Legal Data Hunter is trying to build the world's first omni-jurisdictional legal database, giving Claude access to 23M+ documents from 160+ jurisdictions in one MCP server. We ingest directly from official registries : Légifrance, EUR-Lex, BOE, RIS, the Bundesgerichtshof, the European Court of Human Rights, and 180+ more, covering EU consolidated law, supreme and constitutional court case law, and official doctrine. Resolve loose citations (ECLI, CELEX, case numbers), search with hybrid semantic + keyword filters, and fetch full document text. Authoritative primary sources only, no scraped web copy.

items.name: LegalZoom
items.subtitle: Attorney guidance & tools for business & personal needs
items.description: AI-powered document review meets attorney guidance. Connect to LegalZoom for real-time scans of legal documents to identify critical risks and important clauses, advise on when to engage an attorney, and share notes in advance—all within one workflow. When matters require professional expertise, users will be routed directly into LegalZoom's network of vetted attorneys for timely, jurisdiction-specific guidance. From contract questions to small business matters, LegalZoom helps users get the right support quickly and securely.

items.name: Legora
items.subtitle: Ask legal questions and get grounded answers with citations.
items.description: Bring Legora’s legal intelligence into Claude. The Legora MCP server supports legal questions and jurisdiction-scoped research using Legora’s legal research capabilities where available. Claude can ask Legora a question and receive a grounded text answer with links back to Legora for citations, source review, and auditability.

items.name: Lens Studio
items.subtitle: An agentic AI system that help you build, debug, and generate Lenses for Snapchat and Spectacles
items.description:
**Important: Launch Lens Studio 5.15 or later before installing this extension. The extension requires an active Lens Studio session to connect properly.**
---
The Lens Studio AI extension brings intelligent AR development assistance directly into your workflow. This agentic AI system lets you build, debug, and generate Lenses through natural language interactions.
**Key Features:**
- Build complete Lenses from text descriptions
- Manipulate scene objects, components, and assets conversationally
- Generate 3D models, textures, and face masks with GenAI
- Debug and analyze your Lens with AI-powered insights
- Search and install packages, music, and assets from libraries

Learn more about [how the system works](https://developers.snap.com/lens-studio/features/lens-studio-ai/overview).
**Setup and Usage:** Make sure you have Lens Studio open. When you first use the extension, accept the authentication permission prompt. You won't need to do this again in subsequent sessions.

items.name: LetsBot
items.subtitle: Manage your Letsbot conversations and get smart reports
items.description: LetsBot is a WhatsApp Business management platform. This connector lets Claude read and act on your own LetsBot data — contacts, conversations, messages, labels, bot settings, and campaigns — and turn it into reports. Everything is scoped to your account via OAuth; you only ever see your own data.

items.name: LetsFG | Book the best flights or hotels
items.subtitle: Don't book before checking here: same hotels often 20% cheaper, every airline in the world, real trip costs. Then we book it for you.
items.description:
The cheapest ticket is not always the cheapest trip, and the same hotel room is not the same price everywhere. LetsFG checks before you pay, then books your flight or your hotel for you.
Hotels: the same room, for less. In our last check of 15 well-known hotels in Paris and New York against a major booking site (same dates, same guests, taxes included), LetsFG was cheaper on all 15, typically by 20%. Photos, reviews, breakfast, free cancellation and the total you pay.
Flights: ask Claude in plain words. LetsFG then:
1. Searches every airline in the world, low-cost carriers included, plus the major booking sites and travel agencies.
2. Opens the map: every airport in both cities, and split tickets when two one-ways beat a return.
3. Prices the whole trip: bags, airport transfers and Uber into the city, so a cheap flight to the wrong airport does not fool you.
4. Checks the flight's history: its on-time record over its last 14 departures and how often it is cancelled.
5. Hands you three picks instead of three hundred: best overall, most convenient, cheapest, each with the reason.
Booking: you press Approve in one e-mail, and a LetsFG booking agent buys the ticket or room in your name and sends the confirmation. Flights and hotels are separate bookings, not a package: after you book one, the other can be booked 24 hours later. LetsFG tracks delays and cancellations, sends rebooking options and checks your compensation.
Cheap flights, plane tickets, airfare, hotel deals, business class, refundable fares, flexible dates, direct flights, last-minute trips, city breaks.
Your money:
- The price shown is the total you pay.
- Nothing is booked without your Approve click in an e-mail from LetsFG.
- Your card is charged only once the booking is confirmed. If a price changes, LetsFG asks first.
- Payment runs on letsfg.co, outside the chat. Neither Claude nor LetsFG sees your card details.
Works in 15 languages: tanie loty, vuelos baratos, günstige Flüge, vols pas chers.

items.name: Light
items.subtitle: Work with your Light finance data in Claude
items.description:
Light is the finance platform for your company's spend, bills, cards, and accounting. This connector lets Claude work with your Light data on your behalf, scoped to your account and your permissions.
Once connected, you can ask Claude to:
- Search bills and vendors and manage payables
- Look up cards and card transactions and edit draft transactions
- Draft expenses and submit them for reimbursement
- Search the chart of accounts and tax codes
- Find team members and see pending approvals
- Answer questions from your company policy and Light help articles
- Run and edit financial reports scoped to your company

items.name: Lightbringer
items.subtitle: Patent and invention management for your AI assistant — search your portfolio, draft, validate and submit inventions, and collaborate on patent reviews without leaving the chat.
items.description:
Lightbringer brings patent and invention management into Claude. Connect your Lightbringer organisation and work with your IP directly in the chat.
With Lightbringer connected, you can:
- Search and read your portfolio — inventions, patent applications, strategies, and reports.
- Draft new invention disclosures against the Lightbringer authoring template, validate them against the schema, and update or submit them for review.
- Run Lightbringer's patent-analysis suite on a disclosure to get structured feedback on clarity, problem framing, and completeness.
- Collaborate on patent reviews — list reviews, read the document and comment threads, respond, and add or reply to comments anchored to specific passages.
Because Claude can use all of your connected tools in one conversation, it can pull in the engineering work you've already done — code, design docs, tickets, and chat — and help you capture the inventive parts straight into Lightbringer.
Access is scoped to your authenticated Lightbringer organisation via OAuth, with separate read and write consent.

items.name: Lightfield
items.subtitle: CRM that remembers everything and works for you.
items.description: Access and manage your CRM directly from Claude. Search, create, and update accounts, contacts, opportunities, notes, tasks, and lists — all through natural language. Look up records, filter by any field, track deals through your pipeline, and manage your workspace without leaving the conversation.

items.name: LILT
items.subtitle: High-quality translation with human verification
items.description: Seamlessly integrate high-quality, guaranteed translation capabilities directly into your Claude instance, bringing your brand's unique context where you already work. Submit content for brand-aligned translation via customized AI or human-verified translation with a simple prompt, ensuring the highest quality while you maintain full control.

items.name: Lindo AI
items.subtitle: Create websites, pages, and blog posts with AI. Manage clients and credits.
items.description: Lindo AI is a website builder platform for agencies. This extension lets you create websites, pages, and blog posts using AI directly from Claude. You can also manage clients, assign websites, generate magic login links, and allocate credits — all without leaving the conversation.

items.name: Linear
items.subtitle: Manage issues, projects & team workflows in Linear
items.description: Manage issues, projects, and team workflows in Linear with natural language. Create and update issues, track progress, plan cycles, and coordinate development tasks using Linear’s streamlined project management interface for faster, more efficient workflows.

items.name: LinkedIn Hiring Pro
items.subtitle: Draft, review, and post one free LinkedIn job from Claude.
items.description: LinkedIn Hiring Pro helps eligible LinkedIn members draft and post one free job from Claude. Share or confirm a job title, company, location, workplace type, employment type, responsibilities, and skills. Claude drafts a clear job description, then LinkedIn opens an interactive review with the complete job and applicable Jobs Terms. Nothing is posted until you select Agree and post. The connector can resolve ambiguous company and location matches, complete work-email verification when required, and show whether the job is live or under review. It does not create paid or promoted jobs, edit or close existing jobs, or manage applicants.

items.name: LinkSquares
items.subtitle: Automate legal intake and contract intelligence — create agreements, manage legal requests, and search your contract data directly from Claude.
items.description: LinkSquares brings contract lifecycle management and contract intelligence into Claude. Create agreements, manage legal requests, search your contract repository, and take action on legal work without switching applications. Purpose-built for legal and business teams, LinkSquares helps you move work forward faster with trusted contract data and AI-powered workflows, directly within Claude.

items.name: Listen Labs
items.subtitle: Analyze user insights from Listen Labs
items.description: Browse your Listen Labs studies, pull response data, review study designs, and surface analysis insights directly from Claude. Make Listen Labs a native part of your research workflow, an AI-powered research assistant that helps you synthesize qualitative findings faster, with deeper insight.

items.name: Litmus MCP
items.subtitle: Connect Claude to Litmus Edge industrial devices through your Litmus MCP Server.
items.description: Gives Claude access to your Litmus Edge deployment: browse DeviceHub devices and tags, read real-time and historical process data, manage Digital Twins, inspect system health, and reach the full Litmus SDK surface. This extension bridges Claude Desktop to a Litmus MCP Server you run on your own network (see https://github.com/litmusautomation/litmus-mcp-server); your credentials are stored in the operating system keychain and sent only to that server.

items.name: Livestorm
items.subtitle: Manage and analyze your webinars from Claude
items.description:
Manage your Livestorm events, sessions, and attendees directly from Claude. Create and update events, register and segment participants and monitor engagement. Pull attendance, chat and contact data from sessions that already ran to measure event impact and feed it into your workflows. Claude cross-references registration, attendance, and session activity in a single conversation, turning raw event data into next steps for marketing and sales.
Event & Session Management:
"Create a product demo event for next Wednesday with a morning and afternoon session"
Attendee Registration:
"Register these 50 signups for Thursday's product webinar'"
Engagement & Lead Scoring:
"Show me which registrants attended more than 30 minutes of yesterday's webinar and rank them by engagement"
Event Impact Analysis:
"Pull attendance and registration numbers for last month's events so I can calculate the show-up rate"
Team Management:
"List all team members with admin role across our Livestorm organization"

items.name: LlamaParse
items.subtitle: Turn your documents into agent-ready context for Claude
items.description:
Connect Claude to LlamaParse to read, search, and pull structured data from your documents. LlamaParse helps you achieve the Pareto frontier in cost and accuracy, enabling you to read documents at 4x lower token costs and up to 5x higher accuracy.
LlamaParse is especially helpful when dealing with documents that include:
- Complex page layouts with multiple columns or nested sections that need dedicated layout parsing, not just text extraction
- Embedded visuals like charts, images, and tables that require structured visual parsing to extract accurate numbers
- Low-quality scans or handwriting that need specialized document processing beyond what general-purpose models provide
LlamaParse provides multiple SOTA capabilities for document understanding, including the ability to:
- Parse entire documents into structured markdown, JSON, or HTML, ready for downstream agentic reasoning
- Extract defined schemas of information from long documents to pull out only what's relevant
- Index documents and search across them with filesystem-style tools: locate relevant files, grep for pattern matches, read a file in full, or run hybrid retrieval
- Classify documents into known types
- Split document pages into individual pre-defined sections
We also offer LiteParse, our open-source parser, which works well for text-heavy PDFs with straightforward single-column layouts and no tables, charts, or scanned pages to interpret.
Requires a LlamaParse account.

items.name: Lloyd by The L Suite

items.name: Local Falcon

items.description: Local Falcon gives Claude access to real-time local search data across Google Maps, Apple Maps, and AI search platforms. With 37 tools spanning geo-grid rank tracking, competitor intelligence, campaign management, Google Business Profile monitoring, and AI search visibility tracking, Claude becomes a full-service local search and AI visibility analyst.

items.name: Local Falcon
items.subtitle: Monitor and improve visibility across AI search platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Google AI Overviews, AI Mode) and in local search (Google Maps, Apple Maps) with 37 tools for AI visibility tracking, geo-grid rank analysis, competitor intelligence, campaign management, and Google Business Profile monitoring.
items.description:
An MCP server for the Local Falcon AI Visibility and local SEO platform. Connect Claude to your Local Falcon account to track how businesses appear across AI search results and traditional map platforms.
Capabilities include running geo-grid scans that check visibility from dozens of surrounding coordinates simultaneously, retrieving scan reports with AI-powered analysis, tracking visibility trends over time, managing scheduled campaigns across multiple locations and keywords, monitoring Google Business Profiles for unwanted changes with Falcon Guard, analyzing reviews with sentiment and topic breakdowns, and researching competitors to identify strategic opportunities.
Supported platforms: Google Maps, Apple Maps, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok.

items.name: LOIS
items.subtitle: Ask questions about your Filevine matter documents and get answers grounded in them.
items.description: LOIS is Filevine's legal AI assistant. This connector lets you ask about the documents in one Filevine matter from inside Claude and get an answer drawn from them, without opening the LOIS console. It is read only and cannot change anything in Filevine. Everything runs as the signed-in user, so it reaches only the matters and documents that user can already access in Filevine. Requires a Filevine account with the LOIS product.

items.name: LSEG
items.subtitle: Access best in class data & analytics across a broad spectrum of asset classes.
items.description: The LSEG Connector provides real-time access to LSEG's comprehensive financial market data ecosystem, spanning across asset classes and domains. It enables seamless integration of institutional-grade market data, analytics, and valuation tools directly into conversational AI workflows, allowing users to access deep market insights, perform complex calculations, and analyze financial instruments through natural language interactions.

items.name: Loops
items.subtitle: Run Loops with Claude
items.description: Work with Loops without leaving Claude. Manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional emails, work with events, and access everything else available through the Loops API. Just tell Claude what you want to do.

items.name: Lorikeet
items.subtitle: A universal concierge for complex businesses
items.description: Lorikeet is a platform that complex and regulated businesses use to provide their customers with a universal concierge. Lorikeet does this with AI agents that work across voice, chat and email. The agents are built on a unique architecture that focuses on flexibility and the ability to take actions to solve customers' problems (not just tell them to self serve) in the most challenging circumstances. Our customers include global FinTech, HealthTechs, crypto marketplaces, and other complex businesses.

items.name: Lovable
items.subtitle: Build, iterate, inspect, and deploy Lovable apps
items.description: Lovable MCP Server lets you create, iterate on, inspect, and deploy Lovable projects.

items.name: LSEG AI
items.subtitle: Data Analytics and Trading
