It enables users to analyse instruments, perform complex calculations and move from analysis to execution through natural language interactions, governed by their existing LSEG account entitlements.

items.name: Lucid
items.subtitle: Ideate, diagram, and align teams
items.description: Simplify your workflow by using Claude to generate foundational Lucidchart diagrams directly from your conversation. Beyond seamless diagram creation, this integration acts as a digital bridge, allowing you to instantly search, retrieve, share, and summarize your existing Lucid documents right within Claude. Whether you are jumpstarting a new process map or extracting insights from complex boards, you can now eliminate the bottleneck of context-switching and provide your AI with the visual context it needs to accelerate your work.

items.name: Lukka Prediction Markets Data MCP
items.subtitle: Prediction market intelligence across several venues, including Kalshi and Polymarket: market discovery, classification, pricing, open interest and volume.
items.description:
Lukka Prediction Markets Data MCP brings prediction market intelligence to Claude, normalized across several venues, including Kalshi and Polymarket.
Ask for markets on a topic, a specific event, or a price history and get back structured data: events with their outcomes, current and latest pricing with bid/ask, open interest, traded volume and trade counts over 1-hour and 24-hour windows, and OHLC price history per outcome. Because venues are normalized behind one interface, the same question listed on two platforms can be compared side by side.
Events are classified under PMCS, the Prediction Market Classification System - a hierarchy from category through supersector, macrosector and midsector down to subsector - so you can navigate by subject matter rather than by venue-specific tags. Embedding-based similarity surfaces related markets on the same underlying question, and each venue carries its Lukka VASP identifier, classification, jurisdiction and quality grade.
Typical uses: finding what markets exist on a given topic, comparing implied probabilities across venues, tracking how a market's pricing moved, measuring open interest and volume trends, and using market-implied odds as a signal alongside other research.
Lukka is a digital-asset data company serving institutional clients, and this connector exposes the same prediction market data behind its commercial products. Access is read-only.

items.name: Lumin
items.subtitle: Send documents for signature, track them to completion, and generate agreements from templates — without leaving the chat.
items.description:
Lumin turns a chat into a working e-signature and agreement desk.
Send a PDF or a saved Lumin template out for signature, set signing order and expiry, then check status, fetch the signed copy and the Certificate of Completion, or cancel a request — all in the conversation. You can also draft a document in Markdown and convert it to a signature-ready PDF, or generate a document from an AgreementGen template with your own variables and line-item tables.
What you can do:
• Send a signature request from an uploaded file or a saved template, with ordered or parallel signers, viewers, custom email copy and an expiry date
• Track status per signer, then download the signed agreement, the Certificate of Completion, or a merged copy
• Cancel an in-flight request — the audit trail is preserved
• Browse your templates and inspect their fields, variables and signer roles before sending
• Generate a document or an AgreementGen agreement from a template
• Convert Markdown into a PDF with signature, initials, date and text fields
Try:
• "Send this NDA to alice@acme.com and bob@acme.com for signature, due in 14 days."
• "What's the status of the sent agreement?"
• "Generate a sales proposal from our Proposal template for Acme with a $1,500 line item and send it to Jane."
• "Download the signed copy and the certificate of completion."
Requires a Lumin account. Sending a signature request emails your recipients, so you'll always see the recipient list before it goes out.

items.name: Lumin
items.subtitle: Smarter Workflows for Files and Signatures
items.description: This extension empowers developers to build smarter, more automated document workflows. Access user profiles, browse workspaces, and manage signature requests from start to finish—sending, retrieving, or canceling with ease. Upload documents on demand and convert Markdown into high-quality PDFs in seconds. Designed for seamless integration, these tools reduce friction and simplify how files, signatures, and collaboration flow through any Model Context Protocol–powered system.

items.name: Lumonic
items.subtitle: Analyze portfolio data and reporting in Claude
items.description: Lumonic connects Claude to permission-aware portfolio monitoring and reporting data. Use it to discover entities, fields, dimensions, and metrics; build portfolio tables; summarize reporting status; identify missing submissions; validate LX expressions; generate refreshable Excel formulas; and inspect source context or traceback links. Claude can only access the Lumonic workspaces and data available to the authenticated user.

items.name: LunarCrush
items.subtitle: Add real-time social media data to your searches
items.description: Access comprehensive social analytics and market intelligence for companies, brands, stocks, and cryptocurrencies through LunarCrush's AI-data platform. Stream real-time social metrics, sentiment analysis, trending topics, and market data directly into your AI workflows.

items.name: Lusha
items.subtitle: Find and enrich B2B contacts and companies
items.description: Connect Lusha to Claude to access verified B2B contact and company data without leaving your chat. Lusha is a sales intelligence platform with 300M+ verified contacts, direct emails, phone numbers, and mobile numbers, plus actionable buyer signals used across sales, marketing, and RevOps workflows. Backed by GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27701 compliance. Perfect for building prospect lists, researching accounts before a call, qualifying inbound leads, and natural language prospecting inside Claude.

items.name: Lyrenth
items.subtitle: Read any web page as a clean, token-efficient AIDocument.
items.description:
Lyrenth turns any public URL into an AIDocument: clean Markdown plus title, description, and structure, with navigation and boilerplate stripped. Each read carries a provenance header showing the token count and how much smaller it is than the raw page.
**read_url** reads one page. **read_urls** batches up to 20 in a single call, with per-URL error isolation so one failure does not block the rest. **check_usage** reports your plan tier, credits used, credits remaining, and the reset date.
Reads resolve through Lyrenth's shared cache, so a page many agents want is served without hammering the origin. Backed by Lyrenth's independently built web index, over 1.9 billion pages and growing about 50 million a day.
A free API key takes about a minute at https://lyrenth.com/signup.

items.name: LZ Virtual Mail
items.subtitle: Manage your physical mail from anywhere
items.description:
LegalZoom Virtual Mail digitizes your business and personal postal mail and now you can find, understand, and manage it directly in Claude.
Ask about new or unread mail, search for specific items, and read or summarize scanned documents. You can also organize mail with folders and tags, review mailbox status and alerts, and check the progress of mail-handling requests.
What you can do:
• Find mail by sender, recipient, date, status, tag, or content
• Read and summarize scanned mail
• Request eligible items to be opened and scanned
• Archive, organize, or securely shred eligible mail
• Track shipments and available check-forwarding activity
A LegalZoom Virtual Mail account is required. Some features depend on your account, plan, verification status, and the actions available for each mail item. Physical mail requests may require processing time.

items.name: Macaly Cloud
items.subtitle: Claude writes the code, Macaly runs it - a git repo, cloud sandbox, database, live preview and production hosting for the apps you build in chat.
items.description:
Macaly Cloud turns Macaly into the infrastructure behind Claude. Claude writes every line of code; Macaly supplies the git repository, the cloud sandbox, the database and platform capabilities, the build, a shareable live preview, and production hosting on macaly.com.
What you can do:
Create a new app, or continue one you already have. Every app lives in your Macaly workspace from the first file, so you can open it in the Macaly visual editor at any time and keep building there - or hand it back to Claude later.
Read, write and delete source files. Each change is its own commit in the project’s git history, so nothing is silently lost.
Run commands in the project’s isolated cloud sandbox: type checks, package installs, database setup and the scripts behind Macaly’s platform capabilities - Convex database, authentication, payments, media generation, search.
Read build and dev-server logs when a check fails, so Claude can fix the error instead of guessing.
Get a live preview URL to share, publish to production when you explicitly ask, and connect a custom domain.
Apps are TanStack Start + Vite + Tailwind with Convex as the backend. Claude reads a project briefing and per-capability guides from the server before it writes code, so what it produces fits the platform.
You connect in one click with OAuth (or a team-scoped API key). Claude can only reach the Macaly workspaces your account can reach - never your local machine, never another user’s projects. Publishing and domain changes are separate, explicit actions that are never taken on their own.
Docs: https://www.macaly.com/docs/en/integrations/macaly-cloud

items.name: MacOS-MCP
items.subtitle: Lightweight MCP Server for macOS desktop interaction
items.description:
MacOS-MCP is a lightweight, open-source MCP server that bridges AI agents with the macOS operating system. It enables LLM agents to perform real-world tasks such as app launching, window management, UI interaction, browser automation, desktop state capture, and shell execution using native macOS accessibility and automation APIs.
**KEY FEATURES**
- **Native macOS Integration**: Interact with applications, windows, and UI elements through the macOS Accessibility API and Quartz event system.
- **Bring Your Own LLM/VLM**: Works with any language model and optionally provides visual snapshots when needed.
- **Rich Toolset for Desktop Automation**: Pre-built tools for application control, mouse and keyboard input, scrolling, shell commands, and desktop state capture.
- **Lightweight and Open Source**: Minimal setup with a focused Python package and MIT license.
**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**
- Python 3.11 or higher
- macOS 12 or higher
- Accessibility permissions granted to the terminal or application running the MCP server
- UV Package Manager
This MCP server uses UV for running the package in a managed Python environment.
Installation:
`curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`
For detailed installation instructions, [see the UV documentation](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)

items.name: Macrobond Assist
items.subtitle: Spend your time on the analysis, not on finding the data
items.description:
Macrobond Assist connects Claude to 290M+ licensed macroeconomic time series, enabling trusted data discovery, retrieval and analysis directly from AI workflows.
Describe what you want to investigate in plain language. Macrobond Assist finds the relevant data, shows you where it comes from, and charts it so you can check it is the right data before you use it.
Private by design.
Grounded in trusted macro intelligence.
Ready for institutional AI deployments.

items.name: Magic Patterns
items.subtitle: Discuss and iterate on Magic Patterns designs
items.description: Discuss and iterate on Magic Patterns designs directly from Claude. Magic Patterns is an AI agent specialized in frontend design.

items.name: MagicSchool AI
items.subtitle: Save teaching materials directly to your MagicSchool Resource Library
items.description:
The MagicSchool Connector allows educators to save teaching content directly into their MagicSchool Resource Library. When your organization has enabled the connector, you can import classroom-ready materials such as lesson plans, activities, planning notes, and reusable instructional resources, then access and edit them later in MagicSchool.
The connector is designed to be import-only. It can save new content that you choose to send into MagicSchool, but it cannot read, search, retrieve, or export your existing MagicSchool documents, Resource Library items, chat history, student data, classroom data, connected school systems, or district knowledge. It also does not use Raina, MagicSchool tools, or MagicSchool AI providers to generate content.
Imported content is stored in your MagicSchool Resource Library under MagicSchool’s normal retention and privacy policies, the same as if you saved the content manually in MagicSchool. Your organization controls whether this connector is available.
Save teaching content to MagicSchool: “Save this lesson plan to my MagicSchool Resource Library.”
Create reusable classroom resources: “Turn this activity into a MagicSchool resource I can edit and use later.”
Import planning materials: “Save these unit planning notes to MagicSchool so I can reuse them with my class.”

items.name: MAIA
items.subtitle: The geospatial research engine: get answers from the physical world, built as map and table datasets.
items.description: MAIA is the geospatial research engine for questions about places in the United States, in any field. Ask in plain language and MAIA's agent researches it and builds the answer as a project with a map and a table: which places or properties match your criteria, who owns them, what is near them, how many there are in an area, or a list of them with contacts or other details MAIA researches for each row. Data can include parcels, owners, zoning, buildings, contacts, businesses and points of interest, schools, roads and land use, and MAIA's agent can find and add suitable public map layers. Through this connector you can start a project for a county, send follow-up requests, answer MAIA's questions and approve larger steps during a run, check progress, review your projects' layers and views, and save notes and reusable skills that MAIA uses in later projects. Each answer links to the full map and table in MAIA.

items.name: MailerLite

- **Test emails** using Mailtrap's sandbox environment
- **Manage email templates** (create, update, delete, list).

items.name: Malwarebytes
items.subtitle: Check links, phones, and emails for scams

Report suspicious indicators back to Malwarebytes to help protect others.

items.name: Manatal

items.name: Mapbox
items.subtitle: Live Mapbox geocoding, place search, routing, isochrones and interactive maps.
items.description:
The MCP server connects your AI agent to live Mapbox data: geocoding, routing, and isochrones, so it can build real maps and location features using current, accurate data.
Features:
- Location grounding. Responses use current geospatial data (addresses, coordinates, places, routes),
not whatever the model remembers from training.
- Map visualization. The server renders static map images for a location, route, or dataset, so an agent
can show a result instead of just describing it.
- Geocoding and search. Convert addresses to coordinates and back, search for places by category or
keyword, and look up details like hours and contact info for a specific location.
- Routing and navigation. Get directions, travel-time matrices, isochrones, optimized multi-stop routes,
and map-matched GPS traces.
- Geospatial analysis. Offline geometry tools handle distance, bearing, area, buffering, centroids,
convex hulls, unions, intersections, and simplification.
- Read-only. Every tool queries or analyzes data. None of them can modify an account.
- Deployment. Use Mapbox's hosted endpoint for quick setup, or self-host the open-source server for full
control.

items.name: Mary

items.name: Maryland Community Compass
items.subtitle: Maryland's neighborhood development data platform.
items.maker: Maryland State Innovation Team, Office of Governor Wes Moore
items.description:
Maryland Community Compass is the State of Maryland's free neighborhood development platform that centralizes data insights, funding resources, and support to foster thriving businesses and communities statewide, built by the Maryland State Innovation Team in partnership with Anthropic. Since December 2025 it has served over 15,000 active users and helped guide nearly $14 million in state funding to high-need areas.
Its MCP server exposes 20 read-only tools that let Claude answer questions about any Maryland address, parcel, or geography. No authentication is required, though requests must come from a US-based network.
Find Funding: 2,600+ federal, state, and philanthropic programs aggregated from 100+ sources, spanning grants, loans, tax credits, and technical assistance. One of the most comprehensive databases of public and private funding in Maryland. Full-text search, filters, and profile-based recommendations that help assemble a capital stack for any project.
Site Feasibility: parcel-level evaluation across hundreds of federal, state, and local datasets. Property records, Maryland place-based program overlays (Opportunity Zone, Enterprise Zone, Sustainable Community, and more), environmental cleanup sites, historic register listings, conservation easements, green infrastructure, and Baltimore City Vacant Building Notices. Includes full zoning ordinance text for all 23 Maryland counties and 96 municipalities with independent planning authority.
Community Plans: nearly 200 published comprehensive, small-area, and neighborhood plans. Search inside any plan (for example, "what does the Fell's Point plan say about parking?") with citation-ready PDF URLs.
Neighborhood Insights: 58 census-tract-level metrics (poverty, tenure, cost burden, rental vacancy, permits, and more) with state and county medians for comparison.

items.name: Mastercard Developers
items.subtitle: Up-to-date Mastercard APIs, docs, and guides
items.description: Connect your AI assistant to Mastercard's developer platform. items.name: Maven Bio
items.subtitle: Biopharma catalysts, pipelines, trials, deals, and the citable primary sources behind them
items.description:
Maven Bio gives Claude real-time structured life sciences data. Drug products, companies, clinical trials, indications, deals, financings, mechanisms, and targets, linked to each other and to the source documents behind them.
Ask in plain language. Claude resolves the entity, pulls canonical records, then reads the primary source. "AZD6738" and "ceralasertib" land on the same drug. A landscape query returns the programs in a given indication. A claim about an approval traces back to the FDA letter itself.
The Maven Bio connector enables:
- Resolving messy names, aliases, and internal codes to canonical entities
- Proactively monitoring opportunities: FDA actions, trial readouts, and press releases scoped to the entities a monitor tracks, each signal carrying its source
- Discovery by criteria: "Phase 3 KRAS G12C inhibitors," "public oncology companies with late-stage pipelines"
- Competitive landscaping by indication, grouped by phase, company, or mechanism
- Evidence-based analysis: Search and read FDA filings, SEC filings, clinical papers, press releases, and conference abstracts as full text, structured sections, or extracted citations
- Deal benchmarking: Public-company financials, financing rounds, and BD deals filterable by indication
- Counts and aggregations across the entity graph
Maven Bio MCP server authenticates every call, enforces read-only access and response limits. Users sign in with OAuth 2.1 against their existing Maven Bio identity.

items.name: McAfee

items.name: MeetGeek
items.subtitle: MCP server for MeetGeek API integration, providing tools to manage meetings, transcripts, highlights, and insights.
items.description:
MeetGeek MCP Server provides programmatic access to MeetGeek.ai’s meeting intelligence capabilities through a structured API interface. This server exposes core MeetGeek features such as meeting management, detailed metadata, full transcripts, summaries, highlights, insights, team-level views, and recording uploads, allowing teams to automate post-meeting workflows and extend MeetGeek’s value beyond its native interface.
Designed for self-hosting and secure operation, the server uses a user-provided MeetGeek API key and provides a reliable way to embed MeetGeek’s meeting intelligence into enterprise systems, automation pipelines, and AI-driven products.

items.name: MeisterTask
items.subtitle: Create, search, and update tasks, projects, and notes.
items.description:
MeisterTask is the work management platform transforming how teams get work done. Hosted in Germany and built on simplicity, it brings together all your projects, tasks, and documentation in one place.
The MeisterTask MCP server connects your MeisterTask workspace to your AI assistant. Once authorized, your assistant can:
• Plan and structure projects from a brief or goal, creating sections and tasks in seconds
• Search across your work — tasks, projects, and notes — and pull the right context into any conversation

items.name: Meko
items.subtitle: Shared context for agents that work and learn together.
items.description:
Meko is a data-persistence cloud platform for hybrid teams (AI agents and humans). It gives you a place to keep shared context (agent memory, conversations, and knowledge base docs) without the need for you to stitch it together yourself. We have already done this behind the scenes, so everything just works out of the box with natural language. No knowledge of SQL required.
Meko stores "context," which enables sharing across agents and harnesses.
Meko stores and enables you to:
Save AI conversations and extract facts from them into searchable memory, so work from an earlier session doesn't have to be reprocessed from all the individual pieces of data.
Easily upload documents into a hosted knowledge base, so that you don't have to write complex data pre-processing pipelines.
Allow resuming your context over time or switching between LLMs and IDEs, so you can pick up where you left off. This is helpful if you run out of tokens, an LLM goes down for a while, or you want to use a different AI provider.
Share agent memory and knowledge base documents with other teammates (agents or humans) selectively, so everyone can work together and learn from each other.
Store agent traces in a visual portal, so you can see what the agent thought or did during conversations or agentic work.
Gain access through a remote MCP endpoint, so that any MCP-capable agent (Claude, Cursor, Codex, and other AI chat apps with MCP) can use it.

items.name: Mem

items.description: Give Claude the full context of your second brain by connecting your Mem knowledge base. Search your AI notebook for context, capture and recall ideas, save chats into new notes, edit and update living docs, and organize your AI workspace — simply by asking Claude. items.name: Menti

Participants can join from their phone or laptop to answer questions, share ideas and contribute in the moment.
Turn an idea for your next meeting into a Menti in seconds. Turn presentations into conversations with Menti by Mentimeter.

items.name: Merchkit
items.subtitle: AI-Native Product Catalog (PIM / PXM / Product Feed / Agentic Commerce Optimization)
items.description:
Merchkit is an AI-Native product catalog built for agentic commerce. Connect it to Claude and work on your live catalog in conversation - no exports, no spreadsheets, no switching tabs.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Search and inspect your catalog. Find products & data gaps by SKU, attribute value, or missing data across products, variants, images, vendors, categories.
• Enrich at scale. Create and update products and attribute values one at a time or in bulk, and let Claude fill the gaps that make products invisible to shoppers and AI agents.
• Audit channel readiness. See exactly which attributes a product is missing for Wayfair, Amazon, Google Shopping, or any channel you sell on - with the specific issues to fix.
• Manage your taxonomy & schema. Inspect and edit attribute definitions, acceptable values, AI generation instructions, and attribute classes.
• Track and audit changes to your product catalog across team members.
BUILT FOR SAFE AGENT OPERATION
Every write tool previews the exact change before it applies — nothing is written until you confirm. Permissions are scoped when you connect, so you can grant read-only access to an agent that should only inspect the catalog. Every tool is workspace-scoped and runs the same validation as the Merchkit API.
WHO IT'S FOR
Ecommerce teams at brands, distributors or retailers managing 500 to 5M SKUs across marketplaces, retail partners, and AI shopping surfaces.
REQUIREMENTS
A Merchkit account. Connect in one click with OAuth — there's no API key to create or paste, and you can revoke access anytime from Settings → API keys → Connected apps.
Full documentation: https://docs.merchkit.com/developers/mcp
