items.name: Minutes Conversation Memory
items.subtitle: The private, owned conversation-memory layer for AI. Record, transcribe, and search every meeting, voice memo, and dictation entirely on your own machine — nothing uploaded — then let any AI you connect recall it. Plain-markdown output you keep forever; no cloud, no API key, no vendor to outlive.
items.description:
Minutes is the private, owned conversation-memory layer. Record meetings, voice memos, and dictation; transcribe them on your own machine; and get structured markdown in `~/meetings/` that policy-aware local tools expose to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, and MCP-compatible clients — no proprietary SDK, no API key. Restricted meetings are excluded from agent results by default; explicit access requires a trusted launch policy, a per-call request, and a durable audit record. Minutes never uploads your audio; meeting text leaves your device only when you explicitly send policy-authorized context to a connected cloud agent or summarizer. When a cloud memory tool gets acquired or subpoenaed, your recordings aren't theirs to hand over. No vendor to outlive — ten years from now, `grep` still works on your corpus.
34 tools • 11 resources • Interactive MCP App dashboard • 6 prompt templates
What you get:
• On-device transcription with sealed local whisper.cpp and optional on-device summarization (Apple Foundation Models on macOS 26+) — your audio never leaves the machine. Retained Parakeet and Apple Speech preferences resolve to Whisper until those helpers support secure byte transport.
• Re-run the AI pass on edited meetings and memos with preview-first output, backup-on-apply writes, and edit-preserving merges.
• A native chat panel that recalls policy-authorized meetings, with token streaming and read-only policy-bound search.
• Dictation that types straight at your cursor, on the same local engine.
• Live sessions that promote into diarized, summarized meetings when you stop.
• Consent provenance in every file, and sensitivity gating agents must respect.
• Diarized speaker labels, structured action items and decisions, and policy-safe search over owned markdown. Cross-meeting relationship answers are rebuilt from bounded live policy-authorized snapshots; compatibility-only derived insight and annotation reads still fail explicitly until their source provenance can be revalidated.
**Before you start.** Minutes runs entirely on your own machine, so it needs the Minutes engine installed locally. The extension normally downloads it for you the first time it runs. If your machine cannot reach the internet, or you are on a platform we do not publish a binary for, install it yourself: on macOS and Windows get the free desktop app from https://useminutes.app, which includes the engine and keeps it updated; on Linux install the CLI from the same page. Until the engine is present the extension still starts and lists its tools, and each tool will tell you what is missing.

items.name: Miro
items.subtitle: Access and create new content on Miro boards
items.description:
Connect Claude to Miro to summarize existing boards or build new ones from scratch. Run sharper workshops, sprint planning, and product strategy sessions with Claude-generated layouts, frames, sticky notes, images, docs, diagrams, tables, and more.
Key use cases:
• Summarize and search boards: Drop a board URL into Claude to pull out themes, decisions, and open questions from retros, planning sessions, and strategy maps. Search across every board you have access to.
• Build new boards from scratch: Generate ready-to-run layouts for retros, sprint planning, and product strategy with frames, sticky notes, cards, tables, docs, and images.
• Bring research onto the canvas: Have Claude research a topic — competitors, user feedback, market trends, prior art — and lay the findings out on a fresh board as diagrams, sticky notes, tables, docs, and images, ready to share with your team.
• Visualize complex ideas: Turn a prompt, PR, or spec into architecture, sequence-flow, ERD, or user-journey diagrams directly on the canvas.
• Act on feedback agentically: Read and resolve comments, reply in-thread, and convert scattered team discussion into a clear list of action items right on the board.

items.name: mittwald
items.subtitle: Connect your agent to the mittwald managed container hosting platform
items.description:
Manage your mittwald hosting infrastructure through natural conversation — without leaving Claude.
This connector gives Claude direct access to the mittwald Cloud Platform:
- Projects & servers — create, inspect and update projects, check filesystem usage, manage memberships and invites
- Apps — install and manage PHP, Node.js, Python and static apps; track dependencies and apply upgrades
- Containers & stacks — deploy stacks, start/stop/restart containers, stream logs, manage registries and volumes
- Databases — administer MySQL and Redis instances and their users; get ready-to-run commands for dumps, imports, port forwarding and phpMyAdmin
- Domains, DNS & certificates — inspect domains, edit DNS zones, configure virtual hosts, request TLS certificates
- Mail — manage mail addresses and delivery boxes
- Cronjobs — schedule, trigger and inspect jobs and their execution logs
- Access — SSH and SFTP users, SSH keys, API tokens, sessions, organisation members
- Backups — create backups and schedules, list them, retrieve download URLs
Authentication runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE against your mittwald account, so Claude only acts with the permissions you grant — no API tokens to copy around.
For safety, the connector never opens shells, tunnels or file transfers itself. SSH access, database dumps and backup downloads come back as a command or URL for you to run locally, keeping credentials and data on your machine.

items.name: Mixpanel
items.subtitle: Analyze, query, and manage your Mixpanel data
items.description: Query and analyze your Mixpanel data directly in Claude. Run segmentation, funnel, and retention analyses, explore your event taxonomy, manage Lexicon metadata, analyze session replays, and resolve data quality issues. With Mixpanel as persistent context, Claude can reason about your product data alongside your code, documents, and decisions, across any conversation.

items.name: Mobbin
items.subtitle: Find UI & UX design references
items.description: Mobbin is the industry standard in UI & UX design references for mobile apps, web apps, and websites. The platform serves millions of product builders and designers across the world to help them design better digital experiences. Connect Mobbin with Claude to better research and explore UI & UX design ideas.

items.name: Moda - Slides and Designs
items.subtitle: Fully editable PowerPoints, Meta ads, motion graphics & social.
items.description:
Moda gives Claude a real design canvas for presentations, sales collateral, and marketing assets.
Create polished, on-brand work with fully editable text and layers - not flat images or HTML.
Connect Moda, add your brand, and create:
- Presentations that export natively to PowerPoint or Google Slides
- Sales one-pagers, ebooks, reports, and proposals PDFs
- Meta ads, social posts, carousels, images, and banners
- Print-ready flyers, posters, and event collateral
- Websites and landing pages you can edit and publish
- Animated posts, motion graphics and video overlays
Edit any element directly or ask Claude to revise the whole design. Every layer stays under your control, like Figma or Canva. No design skills needed.
Try: "Turn this sales call into a follow-up deck," "Make three Meta ad concepts in our brand," or "Create a one-page PDF from this brief."
Trusted by thousands of teams, from small businesses to large enterprises. Organize your work with team templates, sharing and permissions, and realtime collaboration.

items.name: Mollie
items.subtitle: Online and in-person payments, subscriptions, funding, reconciliation, and fraud prevention – so growth never means more providers.
items.description: The Mollie MCP server turns the Mollie API into a toolkit AI agents can use fluently – handling payments, subscriptions, and account data, while instantly searching Mollie's documentation and support library for accurate answers on demand.

items.name: monday.com
items.subtitle: monday.com project management & CRM for projects, tasks, portfolios, boards, workflows, milestones, dependencies, forms, dashboards, cross-project portfolio status, and critical paths.
items.description:
The monday.com AI Connector brings core platform capabilities directly to agents and AI assistants. It supports searching boards, creating and updating items and columns, assigning owners, setting timelines, and posting updates — enabling a wide range of work management and CRM use cases across teams and departments.
Teams of people and agents use monday.com as a task tracker and project tracking hub: planning campaigns and events, tracking milestones, dependencies, and workload, managing approval workflows and request intake, and sharing status updates across projects and portfolios — as well as a CRM for managing leads, contacts, and deals.
Beyond day-to-day work management, the connector lets agents answer questions using monday.com's official knowledge base, plan and build automations and multi-step workflows, run and save reusable code actions, and configure other monday.com agents.
Agents can convert meeting content into meeting tasks, create a campaign brief, produce a sprint summary, perform request triage, monitor SLA performance, and surface overdue work, at-risk work, and deadline risk across monday.com boards, items, owners, projects, and portfolios.

items.name: MongoDB Atlas
items.subtitle: Manage MongoDB Atlas resources and read & write cluster data
items.description:
Manage MongoDB Atlas and query your data directly through Claude. Connect to any MongoDB cluster or Atlas project to run queries and aggregations, inspect schemas and indexes, and read/write documents - all through natural language.
Key features:
* Query and manage data - Run finds, aggregations, and counts; insert, update, or delete documents; create collections and indexes.
* Manage Atlas infrastructure - Create and upgrade clusters, manage database users and IP access lists, and inspect cluster metadata across your projects and organizations.
* Optimize performance - Get index suggestions, schema recommendations, and slow query analysis from the Atlas Performance Advisor.
* Build streaming pipelines - Create, monitor, and manage Atlas Stream Processing workspaces, connections, and processors.
* Search MongoDB knowledge - Query official MongoDB documentation and expert guidance directly from the assistant knowledge base.

items.name: Monte Carlo
items.subtitle: Data & AI observability
items.description: The Monte Carlo MCP server gives Claude direct access to your data & AI observability platform. Query alerts, explore lineage, create monitors, and evaluate AI agent performance across your entire data stack.

items.name: Moody's Credit MCP
items.subtitle: Risk insights, analytics, and decision intelligence
items.description:
Moody's Credit MCP powers AI applications and analytics workflows with GenAI-ready data and research needed for comprehensive credit analysis.
Moody's Credit MCP provides a unified layer across core credit data categories commonly used in risk assessment, offering financial analysis, default risk metrics, and qualitative insights. It combines comprehensive entity information, such as financials, ownership, and management, with Moody's Ratings proprietary ratings and research, and probability of default metrics, all enhanced by unstructured data like company filings, earnings transcripts, news, and macroeconomic trends.
By bringing structured and unstructured credit inputs together in a single interface, Moody's Credit MCP enables faster data-to-insight workflows, supporting more rigorous, consistent credit assessment and continuous monitoring of entities, markets, and portfolios.
Data includes:
- Global entity firmographics and identifiers
- Entity hierarchies and ownership structures
- Detailed global entity financials
- Moody's Ratings credit ratings and research
- Expected default frequency
- Economic data and research
- News and media
- Annual reports
Use Moody's Credit MCP for:
- Credit Analysis – access comprehensive credit risk data and research to assess creditworthiness and compare risk across issuers and instruments
- Risk Management – monitor credit risk through forward-looking measures and scenario analysis
- Relationship Management – quickly evaluate credit health to support informed engagement and credit structuring
- Ratings Advisory – align issuer details with ratings methodologies and peer benchmarks
- Investment Research – get data-driven assessments to evaluate relative value and risk
- Market Analysis – analyze sector trends and credit risk signals to assess broader market conditions

items.name: Morning Consult
items.subtitle: Global market intelligence: brands, economy & politics
items.description:
Put Morning Consult intelligence to work in the AI tools your teams already use. Ask questions across syndicated brand, audience, industry, and economic data, alongside your custom research conducted with Morning Consult.
Get direct, on-demand answers without waiting for manual data pulls. Analyze trends, compare markets and consumer groups, and layer Morning Consult insights with internal data available in your AI environment.
Every answer is grounded in real survey data, with sample sizes and methodology included, helping your teams make faster decisions and get more value from the data and research that you already trust.

items.name: Morningstar
items.subtitle: Up-to-date investment and market insights
items.description: The Morningstar connector makes it simple to power your AI apps and tools with Morningstar’s trusted content. It provides access to a growing library of AI-ready capabilities, including global analyst research, market analysis, and key investment data.

items.name: Morningstar Credit Analytics
items.subtitle: Structured credit insights and analytics
items.description: Integrate Morningstar's comprehensive investment data and independent research directly into your AI workflows. Through our MCP-powered connector, clients can explore cross-asset coverage—including funds, equities, and beyond, enhanced by forward-looking insights from our global analyst teams. Access trusted, unbiased intelligence to support investment decisions, due diligence, and portfolio strategy in one seamless experience.

items.name: MoSPI
items.subtitle: India's official statistics via natural language
items.maker: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), Government of India
items.description: Access India's official government statistics through natural language. MoSPI's MCP server connects AI assistants to national datasets covering GDP, inflation, employment, industrial production, higher education, health, energy, environment, trade, and more. All data comes directly from the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), Government of India, via the eSankhyiki portal.

items.name: Motherboard
items.subtitle: Read your company's service tickets, equipment records, SOPs and service manuals in Claude, with your existing Motherboard permissions.
items.description:
Motherboard is the service knowledge platform for field service teams that maintain complex equipment and robotic fleets. This connector gives Claude read-only access to your company's Motherboard workspace, so you can ask questions about your own operation and get answers grounded in your records.
With it, Claude can look up and search service tickets, equipment, parts and assemblies; follow relationships such as which parts go into an assembly and how many; read your company's SOPs and the exact pages of service manuals and source documents, including their page images; and search service knowledge across all of them. Every answer can cite the exact record, SOP or document page it came from, with a link back to Motherboard.
The connector is strictly read-only: it cannot create, change or delete anything, take actions, or post messages. Claude sees only what you are allowed to see in Motherboard, because every request runs under your own account and role.
To connect, enter your company's Motherboard workspace name (the first part of your Motherboard web address) and sign in with your Motherboard account. You can disconnect at any time from Settings > Connected agents in Motherboard. Requires a Motherboard account provided by your company.

items.name: MotherDuck
items.subtitle: Get answers from your data
items.description: Connect AI assistants to your MotherDuck data warehouse. Explore, visualize, and manage data using natural language–no SQL skills required. Create Dives: interactive visualizations that let you save and share answers with your team, staying up-to-date with your latest data. Works with real-world data without requiring semantic models or pre-configuration. Your AI assistant acts like a data analyst, exploring, validating, analyzing, and visualizing data iteratively to answer your questions.

items.name: Motion Creative Analytics
items.subtitle: Analyze your Meta ad creative & competitor ad libraries
items.description: Motion connects Claude to your meta ad data. Analyze creative performance across campaigns — surface top performers, spot declining creatives, and understand what's working and why. Research competitor ad libraries for trends and inspiration. Access demographic breakdowns, creative transcripts, and performance reports. Motion helps marketers make faster, data-driven decisions about what to create next.

items.name: MSCI Connector
items.subtitle: Data you can build on
items.description: Entitlement-based access to our proprietary data and analytics spanning index, portfolio risk, sustainability, climate and private assets research.

items.name: MT Newswires
items.subtitle: Trusted real-time global financial news provider
items.description: MT Newswires' MCP server delivers real-time, low-latency financial news across equities, fixed income, commodities, FX, and macroeconomics. Structured and machine-readable, it integrates seamlessly into AI, trading, and analytics systems, providing scalable, reliable, event-driven intelligence from MT Newswires' global newsroom trusted by leading banks, brokerages, and data providers.

items.name: MuleSoft
items.subtitle: Govern, manage, and observe your entire Agent ecosystem
items.description:
The MuleSoft MCP server provides governed access to your entire IT landscape - APIs, Agents, MCPs & LLMs - to accelerate production ready AI, at scale.
Key features:
Scan - Automatically surface services across AWS Bedrock, Kong, Apigee, Google Vertex, and more, without manual cataloging.
Discover - Search and browse APIs, agents, MCP servers, and LLMs in one place.
Govern - Apply and enforce policies across your full landscape, including PII detection, semantic routing, and token controls, for the infrastructure you already run.
Monitor - Track traffic, cost, and performance across every service in a consolidated view.
The MuleSoft MCP server helps you scan, discover, govern, and manage your entire API, Agent, MCP, and LLM ecosystem.

items.name: MuuMuu Domain byGMO Pepabo
items.subtitle: ムームードメインと接続し、ドメインの空き検索・価格確認から購入手続きまでを会話で進められます。決済はムームードメインのサイト上でご自身が完了させる方式です。保有ドメインの一覧・詳細確認、ネームサーバーの確認・変更、DNSレコードの一覧・作成・更新・削除、更新日や自動更新設定の確認・変更にも対応します。
items.description:
Muumuu Domain is a domain registration service operated by GMO Pepabo, Inc. By connecting via a remote MCP server, users can securely integrate with external AI applications. Through conversation with AI, you can search for available domains and compare pricing, then start a purchase: the connector returns a secure checkout link that you complete yourself on muumuu-domain.com with 3-D Secure, so no card is charged from the conversation. You can also review the domains you already own with their expiration dates, check their details, view and update nameservers, turn auto-renewal on or off, and configure DNS records (create, update, delete), bringing your entire domain management workflow into your AI-powered workspace.
ムームードメインは、GMOペパボ株式会社が運営する独自ドメイン取得サービスです。リモートMCPサーバーを通じて外部AIアプリケーションと安全に接続することができます。AIとの会話を通じて、利用可能なドメインの検索と料金の比較を行い、そのまま購入手続きに進めます。購入はコネクタが決済リンクを返す方式で、3Dセキュアを含む決済はムームードメインのサイト上でお客様ご自身が完了させるため、会話の中でカードに請求が発生することはありません。保有ドメインの一覧と有効期限の確認、詳細の確認、ネームサーバーの確認と変更、自動更新設定のON/OFF、DNSレコードの設定（作成・更新・削除）など、従来は管理画面で行っていた操作をAIワークフローの中で完結させることができます。

items.name: MyChatBot
items.subtitle: Build and run an AI sales agent for your business
items.description:
MyChatBot gives your business an AI sales agent that talks to customers on your website, Telegram, WhatsApp, and Instagram — answering questions, recommending products, capturing leads, and taking orders around the clock.
This connector lets you build and run that agent from your Claude chat, in plain English, without opening a dashboard.
Set it up. Point Claude at your website and it drafts the agent — name, greeting, and how it should sell — then shows you one card to approve. Nothing is created until you say so. Add a chat widget to your site, or connect Telegram, WhatsApp, and Instagram with one link each.
Teach it your business. Tell Claude your shipping rules and returns policy and it writes the FAQ your agent quotes from. Point it at a product feed and it imports the whole catalog — indexed, searchable, and filterable by the attributes your customers actually ask about.
Sell, don't just answer. Turn on order taking and the agent collects what it needs — name, phone, delivery address — and records the order in conversation, instead of handing the customer to a human.
Run it day to day. Ask how the shop did this week and get orders, revenue, and the channels they came from. Read any customer conversation, see your newest leads, and check what your agent has learned.
Reach out. Send one customer a message on their channel, or launch an outreach campaign to a whole audience — Claude previews exactly who it will reach and waits for your approval before anything sends.
Improve it safely. Rehearse changes in a private test chat, and approve every change to your agent's instructions on a before/after card before a customer ever sees it.
You need a MyChatBot account; connecting from Claude signs you in and can create one on the spot. No API keys.

items.name: MyGeotab MCP
items.subtitle: Bring your fleet into Claude — analyze, manage, and act
items.description: Monitor vehicles, analyze trips and driver behavior, and stay on top of safety exceptions, diagnostics, maintenance, EV charging, and compliance across your fleet in MyGeotab. Bring that live data into Claude — then act on it: set up zones and rules, acknowledge faults, and generate reports without leaving the conversation. Surface speeding and utilization trends, answer fleet questions in plain language, and turn insight into action as part of your AI workflow.

items.name: MYOB
items.subtitle: Understand your MYOB business finances with Claude.
items.description:
See how your business is performing, directly from your conversation. MYOB MCP gives you a fast, read-only view of your MYOB Business numbers, from profit and loss to sales, receivables and payables, with plain-language summaries and clear tables. Make MYOB a native part of your AI workflow.
Note. This feature is currently in beta.

items.name: n8n
items.subtitle: Access and run your n8n workflows
items.description: Talk to your n8n instance directly from Claude - create and test automations, search and manage resources like workflows, data tables and projects

items.name: Natoma
items.subtitle: Access all your internal tools, enterprise apps & data.
items.description: Supercharge Claude by connecting it to all your internal tools, enterprise apps, and data to search knowledge and take real-world actions like updating CRMs, approving PRs, and resolving IT tickets from a single interface.

items.name: Navan
items.subtitle: Access and analyze your Navan financial and travel data
items.description: Book and manage travel, query and analyze transactions, reimbursements, cards, receipts, policies, bookings, and more. Take action on expenses (approving, rejecting, or requesting more info). All via Claude.

items.name: neimo.
items.subtitle: Answer any kids' privacy or age-assurance question for 200+ markets, with the law cited.
items.description: neimo. is k-ID's regulatory research assistant for children's digital safety. It answers questions about age thresholds, parental consent, data protection, advertising limits, and enforcement across 200+ markets, grounded in a structured knowledge base maintained by k-ID's legal team rather than generated from model memory.

items.name: Neon
items.subtitle: Postgres, Object Storage, Managed Better Auth, and more
items.description: Manage Neon projects directly through Claude. Run SQL and transactions on Lakebase Postgres, inspect and diff table schemas, apply migrations on a temporary branch before committing them, and provision Auth and the Data API. Create copy-on-write branches for isolated work, query logs from Serverless Functions and Object Storage for debugging, tune slow queries, and search Neon docs all through natural language commands. Connect with OAuth. During authorization, choose read-only or full access. Always review and authorize actions before execution.

items.name: NetDocuments
items.subtitle: Securely access your documents in NetDocuments
items.description: Search and retrieve documents from your NetDocuments repository directly from Claude. Ask questions, generate playbooks, and draft new documents based on your precedents — with full respect for your organization's permissions and governance policies.

items.name: Netlify
items.subtitle: Create, deploy, manage, and secure websites on Netlify.
items.description: Create, deploy, and manage websites on Netlify. You'll be able to control all aspects of your site from creating secrets to enforcing access controls to aggregating your form submissions. The full power of the Netlify platform available from your AI agent.

items.name: Nevis
items.subtitle: The AI platform for wealth management
items.description: The Nevis MCP connector lets you work with Nevis from Claude. Once connected, you can ask Claude to look up your clients, review and update your tasks, and capture notes, without leaving the conversation. You need an active Nevis account to use it.

items.name: Nimble
items.subtitle: Real-time web search & extraction for AI agents
items.description: Nimble connects AI agents to the live web with vertically-tuned search, extraction, mapping, and crawling. Each query is routed to the right sources and returned as structured JSON instead of noisy text. Headless browsers fully render JavaScript-heavy and anti-bot-protected sites that indexed search tools can't reach. Focus modes (shopping, social, news, geo, general) tune sourcing and extraction per domain, so agents get task-ready data without extra LLM parsing calls. SOC 2 compliant and built for production scale.

items.name: Ninout
items.subtitle: Design, publish, and analyze forms entirely in chat
items.description:
The official connector for Ninout, the platform behind Ask One, CREATIVE SURVEY, and Fan Fan Fan. Design, build, publish, and analyze forms entirely through conversation with Claude — no admin screen required.
What you can do:
- Design a form's structure, questions, choices, and branching logic interactively
- Create and publish forms for a wide range of use cases, from surveys to inquiry forms
- Analyze the structure and branching of existing forms
- Aggregate and analyze collected responses
- Configure AI-assisted input support, external data lookups, webhook notifications, and external service integrations
From a simple contact form to complex questionnaires with conditional branching and validation, Claude can build it through conversation — and once responses come in, analyze them right in the chat.
An account for Ask One, CREATIVE SURVEY, or Fan Fan Fan and a contract for the Ninout MCP option are required.

items.name: Nooks
items.subtitle: Search, access, and get insights on your Nooks data
items.description: Connect Nooks to Claude to analyze your outbound data in plain language. Search across prospects, sequences, tasks, and calls to surface insights, investigate performance, and answer questions about your pipeline.

items.name: Norton
items.subtitle: Verify scams from web & email
items.description: Stay protected while you chat with Claude. Norton brings real-time, AI-powered scam detection directly into your conversations, backed by the Norton Genie AI assistant. Share suspicious emails, texts, messages, images, or links for instant analysis and clear cyber safety guidance to help you avoid phishing, scams, and malicious content before you click. You can also ask everyday questions about security, privacy, identity protection, and device performance, and get trusted answers right where you’re already chatting.

items.name: Noteplan
items.subtitle: MCP server for interacting with the NotePlan app on macOS
items.description: Read, create, and edit notes and tasks in NotePlan. Manage calendar events and reminders via native macOS integration. Search across all notes with full-text and property filters. Control plugins, themes, and templates. Organize folders, spaces, and tags. All operations run locally on your device.

items.name: Notion
items.subtitle: Connect your Notion workspace to search, update, and power workflows across tools
items.description: Notion MCP helps you plug tools into your Notion workspace, allowing you to create, edit, search and organize content directly from Claude. Get contextual and relevant assistance from Claude, while keeping knowledge organized in Notion.

items.name: Notra
items.subtitle: Track AI search visibility
items.description: Notra helps teams understand how their brand appears in AI search and lets them to make improvements. Create buyer personas, test the conversations they have with AI assistants, see who gets cited instead of you, and then produce content and suggest backlinks to change the outcome.

items.name: Novasol
items.subtitle: Search holiday homes across Europe
items.description:
NOVASOL helps travelers discover holiday homes, holiday apartments, and vacation destinations across Europe.
Search thousands of bookable holiday properties across 18 European countries, all within a conversation.
Tell claude where you want to go, when, how many guests, your budget, and any must-have features, and it will surface a ranked carousel of matching homes with names, locations, prices, review scores, bedroom counts, and pet policies. Refine on the fly: change dates, shift your destination, tighten your budget, or add amenities and the results update instantly. Standout properties are highlighted so you can go straight to the card to see photos, full amenity lists, and booking options. This app covers self-catering holiday rental search only. It does not cover hotels, flights, car hire, package holidays, city apartments for short-term urban stays, aggregate price statistics, or any booking or payment action.

items.name: NPI Registry
items.subtitle: Access US National Provider Identifier (NPI) Registry
items.description: The NPI Registry Connector gives Claude access to the US National Provider Identifier (NPI) Registry, containing information about all HIPAA-covered healthcare providers in the United States.

items.name: NSDAP Archiv - DER SPIEGEL
items.subtitle: Search for NSDAP party members
items.description: DER SPIEGEL has made the Nazi Party membership records searchable: Was your grandfather a member of the Nazi Party, the SS, or the Waffen-SS? What does that tell you — and how can you dig deeper into your family’s history?

items.name: NumbersGame MCP
items.subtitle: Query and update QuickBooks Online and Xero from Claude — invoices, bills, reports, and reconciliations.
items.description:
Numbers Game connects your QuickBooks Online and Xero books to Claude, so you can ask questions about a client's ledger and act on the answers in the same conversation.
Pull the standard financials — P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance, general ledger, AR and AP aging, transaction lists — and drill from a total straight into the transactions behind it. Search invoices, bills, journal entries, purchases, deposits, customers, vendors, items, and accounts by any field the ledger will filter on.
Then write back: create and update invoices, bills, payments, journal entries, credit memos, estimates, purchase orders, and sales receipts; apply credits, convert a purchase order to a bill, void or delete what shouldn't be there; email invoices, estimates, and purchase orders to the customer; and attach supporting documents to any record.
Built for bookkeepers and accounting firms: connect several client companies under one login, invite your team with per-user access to only the companies they work on, and keep every tool call logged. Claude tells you plainly when a company's ledger or subscription tier can't answer a request, rather than guessing.

items.name: Nutrient DWS
items.subtitle: Process, sign, redact, and transform documents from Claude Desktop using Nutrient.
items.description: A local Claude Desktop extension for document processing with Nutrient. It runs as a stdio MCP server, reads files from a user-selected sandbox directory, opens a browser for OAuth on the first request that uses the Nutrient API, and writes processed results back to local output paths.

items.name: Nutrient PDF Editor
items.subtitle: View, annotate, fill forms, and redact PDFs directly from Claude.
items.description: Highlight, fill forms, redact, and review PDFs directly from Claude. The Nutrient Web Viewer renders inside your conversation so you and Claude share the same view — and every edit saves straight back to the file on your machine, without leaving the chat.

items.name: Nutshell CRM
items.subtitle: Connect Claude to Nutshell CRM to search leads, contacts, and companies, pull sales reports, and review deal timelines - all without leaving chat.
items.description:
Nutshell brings your CRM into the conversation. Connect your Nutshell account to Claude and instantly ask questions about your pipeline, look up contacts, track leads, and surface sales insights - without leaving your AI tool.
Whether you're prepping for a call, checking deal status, or reviewing team performance, your CRM data is always on question away.

items.name: Oak National Academy
items.subtitle: Free, national curriculum-aligned Oak teaching resources
items.description:
Bring Oak National Academy's free, fully sequenced resources for England’s national curriculum into your conversations with Claude.
When you connect Oak, Claude can draw on thousands of expertly sequenced curricula and teaching resources across 17 subjects and Key Stages 1 to 4. That includes keywords, common misconceptions, prior knowledge requirements, high-quality explanations, quiz questions, cross-phase topics and more.
Oak is a publicly funded, independent body sponsored by the UK Department for Education. Oak’s content is written and quality-assured by subject experts, so Claude can work from a solid curriculum base rather than generating material from scratch.
Expertly sequenced, curriculum-aligned resources
Use Claude to access Oak's extensive library of national curriculum-aligned lessons and resources, covering every national curriculum subject across Key Stages 1 to 4. It’s all planned for progression across these phases, with cross-curricular links between subjects.
Made by teachers, for teachers
Oak’s resources are all made and quality-assured by subject experts.
Oak is completely free to use
Every Oak resource is free to use and adapt for your pupils.
Safe and in your control
Oak does not store your personal data or your pupils' information through this connection.
Claude can draw on Oak's content, but will not always do this. Its outputs are AI-generated and not endorsed by Oak. You are the expert and know your pupils best. As with all resources, check carefully that what you create is right for your pupils and context.
Oak content is licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 and requires attribution to Oak. A small amount of Oak’s content is not available through this Claude connector due to copyright and licensing restrictions.
Explore the full library at thenational.academy.

items.name: OilPriceAPI — Oil, Gas & Commodity Prices
items.subtitle: Real-time oil, gas & commodity prices. 26 tools: spot, history, futures, alerts, market briefs.
items.description: The energy commodity MCP server. Live spot prices for Brent, WTI, natural gas, diesel, gasoline and 70+ commodities, plus historical data, futures curves, refining spreads, rig counts, OPEC production, price alerts and multi-commodity market briefs. Works instantly in demo mode (no API key) with a limited commodity set; a free API key from oilpriceapi.com unlocks everything.

items.name: Omega Point
items.subtitle: Turn market, index, and portfolio data into decisions: institutional risk, performance, and factor analytics in one place.
items.description:
Omega Point is the AI-native investment intelligence platform for hedge funds, asset managers, and allocators. This connector lets Claude reason directly over your portfolio — running the same risk and performance analytics that power Omega Point's institutional dashboards, grounded in your live positions and today's market rather than the model's best guess.
Ask in plain language and Claude returns deterministic answers that tie out to the platform:
* Intraday positioning — explore exposures and P&L drivers using the latest intraday update
* Performance & risk attribution — decompose return and risk by factor, sector, theme, macro, and crowding; long-only, long/short, or market-neutral
* Brinson attribution — allocation, selection, and currency effects versus a benchmark
* Stock move explainer — why a name moved today or over a window, from factor decomposition plus live news
* Security screening — search by factor, thematic, and risk characteristics
* Deeper analysis — historical stress tests, factor hedge finder, earned-vs-bought, and risk-model evaluation
Bring your own signals, too: host proprietary quant scores, per-security exposures, and custom classifications as content sets — so your whole team analyzes from one shared source of truth, alongside Omega Point's partner data ecosystem.
See your portfolio through multiple lenses to surface exposures other tools miss. Requires an Omega Point account; you authenticate with your own credentials and see only the data you're entitled to. Omega Point never trains models on your data. SOC 2 Type II certified.

items.name: Omni Analytics
items.subtitle: Query your data using natural language through Omni's semantic model
items.description: Query Omni using the same semantic model, permissions, and logic defined by your data team directly from Claude. Instantly answer questions about your business using natural language — no need to write SQL or navigate complex dashboards. Your Omni semantic model becomes Claude's knowledge of your data, enabling secure, governed, and consistent analytics workflows across your organization.

items.name: Omnisend MCP
items.subtitle: Analyze your Omnisend marketing performance
items.description: Get instant answers from your Omnisend data. Ask about campaign performance, automation drop-offs, and subscriber trends. Understand what's working and what to fix next, without touching a report.

items.name: OnChainDiligence
items.subtitle: Inspect autonomous payments before execution and independently verify evidence afterward.
items.description:
OnChainDiligence is independent evidence and reconciliation infrastructure for autonomous-agent payments. It does not custody funds, hold signing keys, or execute payments. It lets agents and developers inspect a proposed payment against caller-supplied policy, retrieve signed receipts, and independently verify receipt evidence.
Provider claims and independently observed evidence remain explicitly separated. OnChainDiligence helps answer what an agent was permitted to do, what an external provider claimed happened, and what verifiable evidence establishes afterward.
The public MCP connector exposes three read-only tools: inspect a payment proposal, retrieve a public signed OCD receipt, and verify a receipt proof. A VALID result proves receipt integrity and authenticity under the verifier contract only; it does not by itself prove safety, compliance, settlement, or service delivery.

items.name: OneSignal
items.subtitle: Agentic access to OneSignal’s customer engagement platform for messaging, users, and analytics.
items.description: The OneSignal MCP server gives AI agents direct access to OneSignal’s customer engagement platform. Agents can explore users, segments, messages, templates, and analytics; answer product and campaign questions; troubleshoot delivery and engagement issues; generate insights; and help create personalized omnichannel messaging across push, email, SMS, RCS, in-app messaging, and Live Activities.

items.name: Ontra
items.subtitle: Query your Ontra data directly from any AI tool
items.description: The Ontra MCP Server lets you query your Ontra data directly from Claude and other AI tools — no need to switch between applications. Ask questions about legal entities, ownership structures, funds, people, agreements, tax classifications, jurisdictions, and more. Results respect your existing Ontra permissions, so users only see data they already have access to. Setup takes about a minute via a quick OAuth flow with your Ontra credentials.

items.name: Open Targets
items.subtitle: Drug target discovery and prioritisation platform
items.description: This MCP provides a purpose-built interface and instructions to access and interpret the data and analyses in the Open Targets Platform. The Open Targets Platform is a comprehensive tool that supports systematic identification and prioritisation of potential therapeutic drug targets, integrating publicly available datasets to build and score target-disease associations. It also integrates relevant annotation information about targets, diseases/phenotypes, drugs, variants, GWAS and molecular QTL studies, and credible sets, as well as their most relevant relationships.

items.name: OpenReplay
items.subtitle: Query and explore your replays and analytics.
items.description: Query your OpenReplay data using natural language. Search and replay user sessions, and build interactive cards to track trends, explore web analytics, map user journeys, catch drop-offs with funnels, and monitor web vitals, errors, and slow queries.

items.name: OpenRush
items.subtitle: SEO and competitor analysis with live search data: keyword research, rank tracking, gap analysis, and site audits
items.description: Connect OpenRush to Claude to research keywords, analyze competitors, check live Google search results, and track your own search traffic and ad spend. Claude can pull real ranking data from live Google SERPs and a full search index, find your competitors and keyword gaps, audit a site for issues, and read your Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and Google Ads for real clicks, sources, positions, spend, and conversions. Useful for finding keywords to target, seeing why a competitor outranks you, tracking your website traffic over time, or seeing which campaigns are paying off.

items.name: OpenSEO
items.subtitle: SEO made simple.
items.description:
Without quality data, AI gives generic advice.
OpenSEO is approachable for entrepreneurs doing SEO for the first time, but powerful to grow with you as you learn.
You can do keyword research, competitor research, backlinks, site audits and much more.
Connect with popular integrations like Google Search Console & Analytics.

items.name: OpenSTAAD MCP Server
items.subtitle: MCP server for Bentley STAAD.Pro via the OpenSTAAD API
items.description:
The OpenSTAAD MCP server enables Claude to interact with your STAAD.Pro models and perform various time-consuming tasks like load cases definition, data extraction, repetitive property setting and more.
## Key Features
- **Fast and flexible**: Enjoy minimal latency, interact with every STAAD.Pro features covered by the OpenSTAAD API.
- **AI-friendly**: Provides documentation, guidance and feedback via dedicated tools to help your AI agent ramp up quickly on the STAAD.Pro API.
- **Multi-instance support**: Connects to multiple running STAAD.Pro instances simultaneously to parallelize tasks across models.
- **Privacy-first**: All processing happens locally on your machine. No data is sent to the cloud. No telemetry.
This server requires having STAAD.Pro installed locally and running. If you don't already have it, download [STAAD.Pro (www.bentley.com)](https://www.bentley.com/software/staad) to get started.
Terms: Your use of this connector is subject to the [Bentley Systems Terms of Use (www.bentley.com)](https://www.bentley.com/legal/web-properties-terms-of-use).

items.name: Optilogic
items.subtitle: AI-driven supply chain design and decision intelligence
items.description:
Make faster, better tactical decisions within the supply chain you have today and design the supply chain you need for tomorrow. Optilogic connects Claude to a platform that does both. Work with a live digital twin of your current supply chain powered by agentic AI that combines mathematical optimization, simulation, and demand modeling to support decisions across the full horizon, from day-to-day operational response to long-term network, transportation, inventory, and production strategies.
- Run what-if scenario analysis on network design and sourcing models
- Analyze demand at the SKU and location level, and trace how it's served across your network
- Answer strategic and tactical routing questions to drive cost savings and service level improvements
- Place safety stock across your full network and see what it costs to hit a given service level
- Score risk across your network: single-source dependencies, demand/facility/supplier concentration, geographic exposure, capacity, and transport-time risk, so you know where to focus before a disruption
- Model the impact of tariff scenarios
- Design and compare network strategy across sourcing, manufacturing, distribution, and nearshoring scenarios
- Stress-test a plan against real-world variability such as demand swings, delayed lead times, and capacity shocks
- Compare multiple scenarios, sensitivity analysis at-scale, with output and critical insights auto-generated
- Translate optimization model outputs into decision-ready formats for planners, finance, and executives
Best for: S&OP/IBP leaders, network design teams, transportation teams, supply chain modelers and analysts, operational planners as well as executives who want a straight answer to a "what if" question without needing modeling expertise.
Requires a free or paid Optilogic account. You will be redirected to Optilogic to sign in and authorize access. Your data and models stay secure and isolated in your own account.

items.name: OpusClip
items.subtitle: Turn long videos into viral short clips
items.description: OpusClip turns long videos into ready-to-post short clips, right inside Claude. Submit a video file or YouTube URL for AI clipping, then read the resulting clips and transcripts, refine edits (reframe, auto-captions, censor sensitive moments), and organize clips into collections. Generate platform-ready social copy and schedule or publish clips to your connected social accounts - all from chat. It works on the footage you provide and supports complete workflows, from raw upload to a published short.

items.name: NetSuite
items.subtitle: Connect Claude to NetSuite data for analysis & insights
items.description: A flexible and scalable way to connect Claude to NetSuite and use AI to query and analyze NetSuite data.

items.name: O’Reilly
items.subtitle: Discover O'Reilly's expert learning content
items.description: Connect Claude to O’Reilly’s extensive catalog of high-quality technical and professional skills development resources. Just tell Claude what you’re looking for and you’ll get top recommendations for O’Reilly books, video courses, upcoming live events, curated learning plans, and more.

items.name: Origin
items.subtitle: See what AI agents are doing across your endpoint fleet
items.description: See what AI agents are doing across your fleet — without leaving Claude. Origin Analytics connects Claude to your live endpoint telemetry through a typed analytics graph spanning endpoints, identities, sessions, prompts, and files. Ask in plain English which agents are running, who's using them, which prompts are being issued, and what files they're touching. Investigate suspicious sessions, audit AI usage for compliance, hunt shadow AI, or build adoption reports. Every answer comes from your real data — never inferred, never stale.

items.name: Orion by Gravity
items.subtitle: Get insights from your autonomous AI analyst
items.description: Orion works 24/7, analyzing trends, uncovering opportunities, and teeing up your next move before you even log in. Your data is only telling half the story. Orion connects your business metrics with external data sources.

items.name: Orion
items.subtitle: Bring Orion Connect portfolio data and Redtail CRM together in Claude — prep for client meetings, capture follow-ups, prioritize your pipeline, and turn reports into talking points.
items.description:
The Orion plugin connects Claude to Orion Connect, our portfolio accounting solution, and Redtail, our CRM, so that advisors can move from question to answer without leaving the conversation.
Instead of pulling reports, cross-referencing systems, and reconstructing context before every client touchpoint, advisors and their teams can simply ask.
Prepare for meetings and client interactions. Ask for a client update and get performance, holdings, recent activity, and relationship history pulled together into a meeting agenda with proposed talking points, grounded in the same data your firm already trusts.
Capture follow-ups. Turn meeting notes into a clean summary with clearly identified action items, owners, and next steps, so nothing is lost between the conversation and the CRM.
Understand business opportunities. Get a read on your opportunity pipeline where opportunities stand, what's stalled, what's close, and a prioritized list of prospects and clients worth reaching out to next.
Review a report. Point Claude at a report and get the notable activity called out, with talking points ready for your next client or team conversation.
Built for advisors, advisory teams, and operations staff who want less time assembling information and more time advising. The plugin respects your existing Orion and Redtail permissions.

items.name: Orshot
items.subtitle: Automate Videos, PDFs and Images from templates for marketing, post to social platforms, and track and grow engagement
items.description:
Orshot is an API for automated image, PDF and video generation from templates. Design a template once in the Orshot studio (or via Claude), then render on-brand images, PDFs and videos from it with new data.
With the Orshot connector, Claude works across your whole template workflow:
- Create and refine studio templates from a brief, with interactive inline previews
- Render any template with your data: OG images, ad creatives, certificates, invoices, carousels, reels
- Render true video: per-element animations and transitions, soundtracks from your brand kit, and free motion previews before you spend a render
- Start instantly with ready-made utility templates: tweet screenshots, website captures, bar and comparison charts, app store screenshots, phone mockups, background removal and more, no design needed
- Resize one design to every social format in a single call with Smart Resize
- Batch render personalized variations, like certificates for a list of names
- Pull free stock photos and video straight into your designs
- Keep everything on brand with your brand kit: colors, fonts, images, videos and audio
- Organize templates in folders, share them with your team, and switch between client workspaces
- Mint signed dynamic URLs for OG images and embeds
- Draft, schedule and publish social posts, learn your best time to post from your own engagement data, and read back reach and engagement analytics
- Build and run automation workflows that keep producing content on a schedule
Rendering is deterministic template rendering: your template plus your data produces the same output every time. Every action happens in your own Orshot workspace, isolated to your account via OAuth.
Getting started takes a minute: connect, authorize with your Orshot account (100 free credits every month, no credit card needed) and ask Claude to list your templates or render your first image.

items.name: Otter.ai
items.subtitle: Unlock your meeting intelligence
items.description: Otter's MCP Server integrates with Otter.ai's meeting intelligence platform, enabling users to search meeting transcripts, retrieve conversation records, and extract insights. It provides tools to find meetings by date, participants, or topics, and access full transcripts, summaries, and action items. This helps teams review past discussions and prepare for meetings without leaving Claude.

items.name: Otto Travel
items.subtitle: Plan, book, and manage business travel
items.description: Otto brings business travel bookings into Claude. Search flights and hotels, compare options, then book your choice. Your preferences filter search results (cabin class, seat, hotel brand, airline), and your loyalty numbers attach to reservations. When plans change, exchange or cancel a flight or hotel. It retrieves trip details on request: flight times, hotel addresses, confirmation numbers.

items.name: Outreach
items.subtitle: Unleash your team's best performance with Outreach AI
items.description: Bring Outreach knowledge and actions into Claude so your teams can move faster, combine insights across systems, and complete advanced revenue tasks without switching tools. Outreach is an end-to-end AI Revenue Platform for all go-to-market teams. By embedding agentic AI across every revenue workflow, Outreach increases sales productivity, boosts pipeline, and gives leaders the visibility and predictability they need to grow revenue at scale.

items.name: Owkin
items.subtitle: Interact with AI agents built for biology
items.description: Owkin build AI agents for biology to accelerate drug discovery and de-risk clinical trials. The Owkin connector currently powers HistoPLUS, an agent that transforms H&E slides from the TCGA database into granular, queryable insights. Researchers can use it to quantify distinct cell types, analyze complex spatial tumor microenvironments, and validate hypotheses through cohort-level survival analysis. Use this connector to bridge the gap between raw biological data and actionable patient stratification, starting with histopathology.

items.name: Oxford Economics
items.subtitle: Access Oxford Economics’ trusted economic analysis and data directly in Claude.
items.description:
The Oxford Economics MCP connector gives Claude access to Oxford Economics’ research, reports, and economic data and forecasts, helping users answer questions about economies, markets, sectors, and regions with trusted insight.
The connector includes two tools: EconomicAnalysis, which provides narrative answers grounded in Oxford Economics reports and research, and EconomicData, which returns numerical economic data and forecasts for single indicators or cross-region comparisons. Use it to generate concise explanations, summaries, report-backed analysis, assumptions, risks, conclusions, and data tables from Oxford Economics sources.
Contact Oxford Economics about upgrading your organisation's account for MCP access: https://www.oxfordeconomics.com/ai-data-solutions/

items.name: Padlet
items.subtitle: Create and manage padlets
items.description:
Padlet is a visual board platform used by teachers, students, and teams to collect, organize, and share content on collaborative boards called padlets. The Padlet connector links the user's own Padlet account via OAuth so they can work with their padlets directly in conversation.
With this connector, users can:
- Create padlets and organize them with sections, layouts, wallpapers, and appearance settings.
- Add, edit, arrange, pin, and sort posts, and draw connections between posts on Freeform boards.
- Read, search, and summarize board content, including AI analysis of images, videos, audio, and document attachments.
- Comment on posts and moderate discussion.
- Manage sharing settings by modifying permissions, passwords, collaborators, and email invitations.
- Schedule automations such as timed freezes, and freeze or unfreeze boards on demand.
- Grade student submissions and sync grades to a connected LMS (e.g. Canvas or Schoology) via LTI.
- For school and team library admins: manage membership and invitations, per-role permissions, SSO configuration (OAuth providers and SAML), approved email domains, content safety, and allowed attachment types.
The connector does not yet fully support Padlet's Sandbox (whiteboard) format; it works with Padlet's other board formats.
All actions run against the authenticated user's Padlet account and respect Padlet's permission model — the connector can only see and change what the signed-in user could see and change in Padlet itself. Deletions of posts and sections are soft-deletes that can be restored with a dedicated restore tool, and the small number of irreversible operations (deleting comments, automations, or custom fields, removing collaborators, invitations, or approved domains) are annotated as destructive so the assistant confirms with the user before proceeding.

items.name: PagerDuty
items.subtitle: Manage incidents, services and on-call schedules
items.description: Manage incidents, create services, schedule overrides, and track on-call rotations with your PagerDuty account

items.name: PandaDoc
items.subtitle: Create, send, sign and track documents
items.description: PandaDoc lets you create, send, and track documents for signature directly from your Claude conversation. Ask Claude to prepare an NDA from your existing templates, send a proposal to a client, check which contracts are still waiting to be signed, or pull the complete audit trail for any document. Connect your PandaDoc account to manage your entire document workflow without leaving the conversation.

items.name: PanOS MCP
items.subtitle: Control Palo Alto Networks PA-Series firewalls and Panorama with AI. 117 tools across 16 modules: security policies, NAT, objects, VPN, logs, WildFire, GlobalProtect, decryption, and more. Supports staged commits and read-only inspection. For multi-firewall setups use the CLI mode — see github.com/apius-tech/Palo-MCP.
items.description: Control Palo Alto Networks PA-Series firewalls and Panorama with AI. 117 tools across 16 modules: security policies, NAT, objects, VPN, logs, WildFire, GlobalProtect, decryption, and more. Supports staged commits and read-only inspection. For multi-firewall setups use the CLI mode — see github.com/apius-tech/Palo-MCP.

items.name: Papermark
items.subtitle: Manage your data rooms and tracked documents from Claude
items.description:
Connect Claude to your Papermark data room, the secure workspace where modern deal teams manage the documents that matter most.
Use natural language to create data room structures, upload documents and new versions, generate secure share links with expiration dates, NDAs, and dynamic watermarks, search across files, and review page-level analytics to see exactly what buyers and investors are reading.
No context switching. No security compromises.
Built for private equity, finance teams, venture capital, and founders, Papermark is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified.

items.name: PaperOffice
items.subtitle: Built for companies. Ready for AI agents. The headless DMS for Claude: search, read, extract, approve, send for signing and archive documents in your own account, with your permissions.
items.description:
Built for companies. Ready for AI agents.
PaperOffice is the headless DMS for Claude. Connect your company account, and Claude works with your business documents: invoices, contracts, delivery notes, HR files, scans and phone photos. No uploads into the chat. Your documents stay in PaperOffice, and Claude works on them in place, with more than 300 tools as a complete documents operations layer.
Try asking Claude:
• "Which supplier invoices are due this month?"
• "Find our lease agreement and tell me the last day for notice."
• "Check this delivery note against the order."
• "Start our approval workflow for the new invoices."
• "Redact the personal data in these HR files before I share them."
What Claude can do for you:
• Find documents by what they say, scans included: full text, OCR, meaning and entities.
• Read text and extracted fields, each value with its place in the original document.
• Import and classify documents, run AI-OCR on print, tables and handwriting, manage versions.
• Start workflows, send documents to human review, request e-signatures, place legal holds.
• Redact personal data, translate, convert, merge and compress PDFs.
• Get overviews of document volumes, due dates, finances and audit findings.
• Validate VAT IDs, addresses, email addresses and phone numbers.
Safe by design: Claude signs in with OAuth and acts only as you, with your existing permissions and workspace rules. Every tool is labelled as read-only, writing, or deleting and sending, so changes can require your confirmation. Signatures stay with people: Claude sends the signing request, and the signer signs on the signing page with an SMS code.
Your documents are stored in PaperOffice's own EU data center or on your own NAS or server (BYOS). PaperOffice holds ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II.
Claude provides the intelligence. PaperOffice provides the document infrastructure behind it.

items.name: Parallel Search
items.subtitle: Free token-efficient search using Parallel
items.description: Parallel Search MCP provides drop-in web search and content extraction capabilities. The tools invoke the Search API and Extract API endpoints but present a simpler interface to ensure effective use by agents. Parallel provides token-efficient search, so your agent can find the most relevant information from the web without using up your token budget.

items.name: Pasteapp
items.subtitle: Local MCP server bridge for Paste — give Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI tools access to your Mac clipboard history and pinboards.
items.description: Local MCP server bridge for Paste — give Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI tools access to your Mac clipboard history and pinboards.

items.name: Pathmode
items.subtitle: Connect AI agents to your Intent Layer. Get strategic context, dependency graphs, and implementation prompts.
items.description: Pathmode MCP Server connects Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI agents to your product team's Intent Layer. AI agents get structured specifications (objectives, outcomes, constraints, edge cases), dependency graph analysis (critical path, bottlenecks, cycles), and workspace strategy context — so they build the right thing, not just any thing.

items.name: Patlytics
items.subtitle: Prior art, claims, and portfolio search
items.description:
Patlytics brings concept-level, AI-native patent search into your assistant: semantic, not keyword-based. Describe an invention in plain prose and get the most relevant patents, look up any patent's claims, search the scientific literature, and pull your own organization's saved patents, all through structured, predictable tools (not a black box).
The connector's five tools are read-only: semantic patent search (optionally anchored to a reference patent), patent lookup (bibliographic data and full claims), non-patent literature search (via OpenAlex), and listings of your organization's private portfolios and vault. Search is semantic, so a richer description (how an invention works, the problem it solves, its components) returns better results.
Access is for existing Patlytics users: each member signs in with their own account (OAuth), and results are scoped to their organization. Deeper work like freedom-to-operate opinions, infringement and invalidity claim charts, and patent drafting runs in the Patlytics web app, linked from every result.

items.name: Paxton Legal Research
items.subtitle: Research U.S. law in Claude—with citations you can open and verify.
items.description:
Turn a legal research question into authorities you can inspect. Use Paxton in Claude to search U.S. statutes, regulations, rules, case law, and indexed EEOC and NLRB decisions. Open source links, retrieve full source text, and inspect case citation relationships and available status information.
Start with a jurisdiction and a specific question. Ask Claude to find relevant authorities, read the supporting passages, and distinguish holdings from arguments or quoted material. Follow the citations to review the source yourself.
Already a Paxton customer? Connect and sign in with your Paxton account. MCP is included without a separate MCP fee and uses your existing account and organization access. New to Paxton? Get started at https://app.paxton.ai/sign-up, then connect after your account has legal research access. Claude workspace administrators may need to enable the connector.
This connector is read-only: it searches legal sources, not your private matter files, and cannot edit or upload documents. Legal research requires professional review. Search results and citation relationships do not establish that an authority is controlling, current, or sufficient for a legal proposition.

items.name: Paybooc
items.subtitle: Paybooc Shopping Rewards links and reward rates for partner online stores
items.description:
Paybooc: Use when shopping for a product and asking about the lowest price, current price, price comparisons, value for money, discounts, sales, hot deals, coupons, cashback, or rewards, or how to buy it cheaper. On top of any discounts shown, it suggests Paybooc Shopping Rewards links to partner online stores, which only this tool can create, along with each store's reward rate and a QR code for PC. Rewards stack with store discounts, coupons, and card discounts for extra savings. Eligibility and payout follow partner terms.
It does not sell products, process payments, or look up prices. A product name is all it needs. It is not used for cash-equivalent items such as gift cards or precious metals.

items.name: Payhawk
items.subtitle: Ask and act on company spend: cards, invoices, travel
items.description:
Payhawk brings spend management into Claude. Ask about expenses, corporate cards, balances, budgets, suppliers and subscriptions in plain language and get a clear answer.
Employees can submit expenses and reimbursements, snap in receipts and let them auto-match, log mileage, check card balances and limits, request new cards, and track where a payment or approval stands — all conversationally.
Managers and approvers can see everything waiting on them, review an expense with its documents and policy context, and approve or return it without leaving Claude.
Finance teams can close the month without hopping between screens: find close blockers, uncoded or unexported items, failed exports and missing documents; review and recode expenses; manage suppliers and purchase orders; monitor budgets, balances and upcoming payments; and ask analytical questions — spend by team, trends, anomalies — answered server-side by Payhawk's insights engine.
Every action respects your organization's approval workflows, spend policies and roles. Writes are limited to what you could already do in the Payhawk app, and sensitive actions ask for confirmation before they run.
Requires an active Payhawk account. Connect with your Payhawk login via OAuth — no API keys to manage.
About Payhawk
Payhawk is an AI-native spend management platform that orchestrates global money across Cards, Expenses, Travel, Accounts Payable and Procurement for maximum control, automation and savings. It provides a global money account on top of your ERP combined with agents enforcing rules, policies, and budgets on every payment while giving employees an effortless spending experience. Headquartered in London with offices across Europe and the US, Payhawk serves mid-market and enterprise companies in 33 countries.

items.name: PayPal
items.subtitle: Access PayPal payments platform
items.description: The PayPal MCP server enables AI agents to interact with the PayPal platform. PayPal is a global online payments system that supports online money transfers and serves as an electronic alternative to traditional paper methods like checks and money orders. This MCP server allows AI assistants to programmatically access and manage PayPal account information, transaction details, payment processing, and potentially other financial services offered by PayPal.

items.name: Paytm Payment Gateway
items.subtitle: Make Claude your Paytm Payments assistant
items.description:
Connect your Paytm merchant account to Claude for intelligent access to your payment operations. Look up transactions, search payment links, track refunds, review settlement status, and reconcile payments - all through conversation. No dashboard switching, no API calls.
Claude becomes your payments co-pilot - it works directly with your Paytm merchant account. Built for merchants, developers, and operations teams.

items.name: PDF.net
items.subtitle: Generate and edit pdfs
items.description:
Connect pdf.net to edit, generate, and organize PDFs in Claude. Your pdf.net library connects directly — no re-uploading every time.
Edit PDFs in place: change text, fix dates, fill forms. Generate new PDFs from a prompt — invoices, contracts, proposals. Merge up to 20 PDFs, split by page range, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Organize your library into folders.
---
Working with PDFs can be slow. You convert to Word to edit, switch tools to merge, pay extra to translate, and dig through folders to find the file. pdf.net puts all of it in one chat.
Edit PDFs in place — no Word roundtrip. Generate invoices, contracts, and proposals from a prompt. Merge up to 20 files, split by page, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Your pdf.net library stays connected, so files are one message away.

items.name: PDF Tools
items.subtitle: Open any PDF already on your computer and work with it: read and search it in an interactive viewer, fill and sign forms, extract text and data, merge, split, and compare documents. Your files never leave your machine.
items.description:
PDF Tools turns Claude Desktop into a complete PDF workstation with local file operations. Claude can fetch PDFs from URLs, inspect them visually, fill forms, manage pages, add signature/date zones, apply local signatures or text, extract structured data, and return document content to the selected MCP host for analysis.
This package targets Claude Desktop and other local MCP hosts today. It does not yet include a remote Claude/Cowork connector.
**Interactive PDF Viewer:**
• View PDFs with page navigation, zoom, search, text selection, and fullscreen
• See form fields in a sidebar with fill status
• Use visual page management to reorder, rotate, and remove pages before saving
• Switch into Sign mode to work with signature/date zones on the PDF
**Sign Mode & Local Signatures:**
• Detect signature, initials, printed-name, and date zones with visible coordinates Claude can reason from
• Draw or reuse saved local signatures
• Place signatures, dates, or other text on detected or custom zones
• Inspect a region, preview it, and turn it into a typed signing zone when the automatic detector is not enough
• Keep edits local, with active-document tracking and automatic backup behavior for same-file mutations
**URL-to-PDF Workflows:**
• Fetch PDFs from HTTP(S) URLs to the user's local machine, including cases where Claude's WebFetch is blocked
• Open downloaded PDFs immediately in the viewer for fill, sign, page management, extraction, or analysis
• Use page-bounded reads, text search, page renders, and region renders instead of one brittle all-document operation
**Forms & Reusable Profiles:**
• Fill W-9s, 1099s, rental applications, waivers, and any fillable PDF
• Save personal or business details as reusable profiles
• List, load, and apply saved profiles so repeated forms take seconds instead of minutes
• Bulk fill many PDFs from CSV data and validate required fields before submission
**Page Organization Tools:**
• Merge multiple PDFs into one document
• Split PDFs by exact page ranges or regular intervals
• Rotate and reorder pages, or apply a full page plan in one pass
• Keep the original intact by saving organized output as a new file
**Extraction, Rendering & Analysis:**
• Read existing PDF text layers for summarization, question answering, and research workflows
• Read specific page ranges and search PDF text with page-numbered snippets
• Convert supported born-digital page ranges to deterministic Markdown with explicit coverage gaps
• Render full pages or bounded regions to PNG for host/model vision on scanned or image-heavy documents
• If a selected `read_pdf_content` extraction has no text, return a rendered image of page 1 when available
• Keep rendering and text recognition distinct: page and region renders are raster images, not OCR text
• Treat mixed text/raster documents and raster pages after page 1 as potentially unrecognized by broad text reads
• Extract structured data to CSV
• Inspect page-level details like orientation, text presence, images, and likely blank pages
• Review metadata such as page count, dimensions, form fields, and file size
**Local file operations and host-aware privacy:** PDF Tools reads, renders, edits, and saves files on the user's machine and does not upload them to a separate PDF service. Text, images, or metadata returned through MCP may be processed under the selected host or model provider's data terms. Claude Desktop users choose which folders PDF Tools may read from or write to.
**Works with many PDF types:** Forms, contracts, research papers, technical manuals, invoices, financial statements, scanned documents, municipal packets, and encrypted PDFs. The local runtime does not currently bundle OCR; optional local OCR remains planned rather than shipped.
**Best for:** People who need more than a viewer: operators processing forms, lawyers organizing contracts, accountants handling tax documents, researchers reviewing papers, and anyone who wants local PDF file operations with their chosen MCP host.

Local-first, single Rust binary, zero cloud dependencies.
items.description:
Perseus Vault gives Claude durable memory across sessions. It is a single Rust binary with an embedded SQLite database — no Docker, no Postgres, no cloud. Features include:
- **122 canonical MCP tools** for entity storage, hybrid search (FTS5 + dense vector), knowledge-graph traversal, journal audit trail, and state management
- **AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default** for fresh installations
- **Fully local** — never phones home, no telemetry, air-gapped by default
- **Agent-first design** — entity lifecycle with Ebbinghaus decay, auto-promotion, archiving
- **Works with any MCP host** — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Hermes Agent, Perseus, and more

Look up orders and transactions — find an order by Pine Labs order ID or your own merchant reference, pull orders and refunds over a date range, or search a transaction by ID, and see full status and payment-method breakdown.
Track settlements — check settlement status, amounts, and which transactions make up a given payout, by UTR or across a date range.
Monitor payment links — retrieve payment link details and current status, individually or as a date-range report.
Manage recurring payments — review subscription plans, subscriptions, and subscription presentations, with filters for status, frequency, amount, and date.
Monitor performance — check your transaction success rate over a recent window.

This connector lets Claude have full secure access to your PocketSmith data, so that you can work with your finances in plain language.
Understand your money: search, filter and categorize your transactions in plain language. Investigate patterns across all your accounts, check balances, and review your categories, labels and saved searches.

Keep things tidy: categorize your transactions, create new category rules, manage files and sync bank feeds.
Seamlessly jump to PocketSmith: describe the report you need to see in PocketSmith, and you'll get a deep link to that exact report in PocketSmith.
Claude connects to PocketSmith via OAuth - when you connect, you sign in with PocketSmith and can revoke access any time. A read-only version of this connector is also available, if you don't want Claude to ever modify your data.

Signals are synthesized from CDC systems, Epic Cosmos, wastewater monitoring, Google Health Trends, and more.
