items.subtitle: Financial data and AI infrastructure for company research.
items.description: Access structured first-party IR data from over 14,500+ public companies across 65 markets. Quartr delivers live and recorded earnings calls, real-time and historical transcripts with speaker identification, slide presentations, filings, reports, and event summaries. Best-in-class reliability and timeliness. Ideal for financial research, investment analysis, and building data-driven workflows on top of institutional-grade public company data.

items.name: Intuit QuickBooks
items.subtitle: Business Finances made simple
items.description:
QuickBooks turns your business's financial data into clear, decision-ready insights, and now takes action on it too. Analyze profitability, cash flow, and balance sheet health, and benchmark your performance against similar businesses in your industry and region. See who owes you money and which bills are coming due with A/R and A/P aging, and break down sales by customer or product to find what is driving revenue. Create, update, send, duplicate, and schedule invoices and estimates. Add customers and products, generate, and send payment links and reminders, always with a clear preview and your confirmation before anything is sent. Get fast read-only answers on payroll and QuickBooks Capital. Look up payroll details, and when you need to, add an employee or set base pay. Check your QuickBooks Capital loans and peer lending benchmarks.
No account yet? Upload CSVs, PDFs, or images, or paste transactions directly, and QuickBooks will sync and analyze your results as your business grows.

items.name: QuickNode
items.subtitle: Manage blockchain infrastructure right in Claude
items.description: Quicknode brings enterprise blockchain infrastructure management into Claude through a single connector. You can manage endpoints across 80+ chains and 135+ networks, monitor logs and usage, configure rate limits and security controls, and handle billing visibility from natural language.

items.name: QuickStart
items.subtitle: AI-powered accounting
items.description: Spend less time managing your finances and more time building your company. QuickStart brings your accounting, banking, subscriptions, SaaS metrics, and reporting into Claude so you can understand what’s happening in your business, get answers from your financial data, and take action without jumping between tools. Built for early-stage tech startups, with a path to NetSuite as you grow.

items.name: Quinbook
items.subtitle: Talk to your quinbook ticketing system in plain language — bookings, slots, calendar, contacts, coupons and cart/order operations as tools for Claude.
items.description: MCP server exposing the quinbook API. Read tools for slots, orders, coupons and contacts; write tools for cart, order lifecycle and contacts that execute immediately (the bundled skills require confirming with the user first). OAuth login with your own quinbook credentials; multi-tenant via me_switch_company.

items.name: Quo
items.subtitle: Surface call insights and missed opportunities
items.description: Quo is a next-generation business phone system that helps teams engage customers, collaborate internally, and scale communication with AI — without losing the personal touch. Connecting Quo gives Claude access to your customer conversations across calls, text messages, and contacts. You can ask questions about those interactions to uncover patterns in what customers are saying and where opportunities may be lost. Claude can search, analyze, and summarize conversations to surface insights like Why are we losing deals? What do customers love about our service? What complaints show up most often?

items.name: Railway
items.subtitle: Deploy, manage, and debug your apps and infrastructure on Railway
items.description:
The Railway connector lets Claude work with your Railway workspaces directly.
Claude can take actions: create new projects, deploy services from your connected GitHub repositories, redeploy services, manage feature flags, and publish self-contained artifacts (a static page, a React component, a diagram) to a public URL in seconds via Railway Functions.
It can also list your projects, services, and deployments, check the live status of an environment, and pull build, deploy, and HTTP logs to help you debug production issues without leaving the conversation.
For complex, multi-step operations, the connector includes railway-agent, a conversational bridge to Railway's own infrastructure agent, which can inspect services, diagnose failures, and apply configuration changes on your behalf. Destructive actions are gated behind explicit confirmation, and everything is scoped to the projects and workspaces your Railway account can access.

items.name: Rally MCP
items.subtitle: Find participant, pull study data and create studies
items.description: Rally's MCP server connects Rally to your agentic recruitment workflow. Search your participant pool using natural language, manage studies and interview sessions, access recorded transcripts and survey responses, and draft new studies through conversation. All access respects your existing Rally permissions—your assistant sees only what your account is authorized to view. Designed for research teams who want to accelerate synthesis, recruiting, and study planning without leaving their AI environment.

items.name: Ramp
items.subtitle: Search, access, and analyze your Ramp financial data
items.description: Enables secure, read-only access to Ramp data for customer-defined logic. Supports loading and querying transactions, reimbursements, bills, purchase orders, cards, vendors, and more, enabling dynamic data fetching and analysis via Claude.

items.name: Ramp Data
items.subtitle: Search and analyze Ramp spend across 50,000+ businesses
items.description: Ramp Data MCP enables Claude users to access Ramp Data from billions of dollars in real corporate spend across 50,000+ businesses, including Ramp Rate (vendor adoption, pricing, and switching trends) and the AI Index (how businesses are spending on AI). Ramp Data is used by founders, procurement leads, researchers, investors, and policy analysts and is cited by leading publications like NYT, WSJ, Bloomberg, and more.

items.name: Rapid7 Bulk Export
items.subtitle: Export and analyze Rapid7 InsightVM vulnerability data via SQL queries
items.description: Connects to the Rapid7 Bulk Export API to fetch vulnerability and asset data, loads it into a local DuckDB database, and exposes SQL query tools for AI-powered security analysis. Supports export reuse, EPSS-based prioritization, and cross-cloud vulnerability tracking.

items.name: Ratehub Mortgage
items.subtitle: Find and compare Canada’s best mortgage rates
items.description:
Ratehub makes it easy to compare the best mortgage rates in Canada in seconds. Instantly find the lowest fixed and variable mortgage rates from the Big Banks and top mortgage lenders.
Customize your results based on home price, down payment, and location to see personalized mortgage rates you can actually qualify for. Easily compare options side by side and find the best rate for your budget.
Whether you’re a first-time home buyer, renewing your mortgage, or refinancing, this tool compares real-time mortgage rates to help save you time and money.
Try asking:
What are the lowest mortgage rates in Ontario right now?
What is the best 5-year fixed rate from top 6 banks?
Show me the best variable rate options for a $600K mortgage in B.C

items.name: RavenDB
items.subtitle: Read-only MCP diagnostics server for RavenDB.
items.description: A local, read-only MCP diagnostics server for RavenDB. Point it at a cluster and your AI agent can inspect cluster, database, index, task, storage, and performance state, plus logs, support packages, and read-only data, across 21 read-only tools. Connection-string secrets are masked in the returned JSON.

items.name: Razorpay
items.subtitle: Turn Claude into your Razorpay Dashboard Assistant
items.description: Access your Razorpay merchant data directly from Claude. Query payments, orders, refunds, and settlements instantly through natural conversation. Track QR code transactions, monitor payment links, review payout history, and generate settlement reconciliation reports—all without leaving your AI workflow. Transform Claude into your intelligent merchant dashboard that retrieves real-time business insights, helping you understand payment trends and reconcile transactions faster, with less friction.

items.name: React Aria
items.subtitle: Build accessible UI components with React Aria.
items.description: Provides tools for browsing the React Aria documentation. Uses the React Aria documentation content available at https://react-aria.adobe.com.

items.name: React Spectrum (S2)
items.subtitle: Build apps with Adobe's React Spectrum component library.
items.description: Provides tools for browsing the React Spectrum (S2) documentation, including listing and reading pages, searching for available icons and illustrations, and looking up available styling token values. Uses the React Spectrum documentation content available at https://react-spectrum.adobe.com.

items.name: Read AI
items.subtitle: Bring your meetings into Claude
items.description: Your meetings are full of decisions, context, and next steps that shouldn't stay locked in a recording. The Read AI connector gives Claude direct access to your meeting data - including full transcripts, summaries, action items, key questions, topics, and engagement metrics. Browse recent meetings or pull up a specific session and use what was actually said as the starting point for follow-up work: drafting documents, extracting commitments, prepping for the next conversation, or synthesizing themes across multiple calls.

items.name: Read and Send iMessages
items.subtitle: Send, read, and manage messages through Apple's Messages app
items.description:
This extension allows Claude to interact with your macOS iMessage app, enabling sending, reading, and managing messages. Ask Claude to summarize your recent messages, help you understand what's most important.
It uses macOS automation features to interact with the Messages app and requires your explicit permission through macOS security prompts before accessing Messages or Contacts. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.

items.name: Read and Write Apple Notes
items.subtitle: Read, write, and manage notes in Apple Notes
items.description:
This extension allows Claude to interact with your macOS Notes app, enabling creating, reading, updating, and listing notes.
It uses macOS automation features to interact with the Messages app and requires your explicit permission through macOS security prompts before accessing Messages or Contacts. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.

items.name: Readwise
items.subtitle: Save, read, search, and learn
items.description: Access your full library of Readwise highlights and Reader documents: search them semantically, save new documents, create new highlights, move documents, tag them, etc. Using the exposed tools, you can trivially triage your library, organize your library, and give Claude access to every word of everything you've read.

items.name: Reclaim.ai
items.subtitle: Advanced scheduling for personal and work calendars
items.description: Reclaim.ai brings intelligent time management directly into Claude, helping you plan, protect, and optimize your schedule. With support for Microsoft Outlook and Google Calendar, it supports complex workflows like finding time to meet with coworkers, resolving conflicts on your calendar, and helping you block out time to get work done. All calendar changes are drafted for you to review holistically, with the option to visually see how your optimized schedule before applying it.

items.name: Reco
items.subtitle: SaaS & AI security context for AI-native investigations
items.description: Reco's MCP server connects Claude directly to your tenant, so you can query live security data (threat alerts, posture issues, identities, OAuth grants, discovered agents) in plain language. Connect via OAuth, which mirrors your existing Reco permissions, or a scoped API key for automated workflows; either way, access never exceeds what that credential is already authorized to see. Claude can also take action, like adding comments or updating a role, and comes with four guided workflows: resolving an identity across systems, investigating recent activity, running a compliance gap analysis, and surfacing your highest-severity open issues.

items.name: Redacta
items.subtitle: Pseudonymise patient identifiers and PII in text, and restore them — on-device, nothing leaves your machine.
items.description: Redacta replaces patient identifiers and personal data (NHS numbers with Modulus-11 validation, names, dates of birth, MRNs, emails, phones, postcodes, plus general PII like URLs, IPs, payment cards and account numbers) with labelled tokens, so text can be safely shared or processed by AI. It includes a HIPAA Safe Harbor mode and is fully reversible via a token map. All processing happens locally in the server process — it makes no network calls and stores nothing.

items.name: Reddit MCP Buddy
items.subtitle: Browse Reddit directly in Claude Desktop. Search posts, analyze users, explore communities - no API keys needed.
items.description:
Reddit MCP Buddy brings the entire Reddit ecosystem to Claude Desktop with zero configuration required.
**Key Features:**
• Browse any subreddit with sorting options (hot, new, top, rising)
• Search Reddit content across all communities
• Analyze user profiles with karma and post history
• Get full post details including comments
• Understand Reddit culture and terminology
**Why Choose Reddit MCP Buddy:**
• **No API Keys Required** - Works instantly in anonymous mode
• **Smart Caching** - Fast responses with intelligent caching
• **Rate Limit Optimized** - Up to 100 requests/minute with authentication
• **Clean Data** - Only real Reddit data, no fake metrics
• **Cross-Platform** - Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux
**Perfect for:**
• Market research and trend analysis
• Community sentiment monitoring
• Content discovery and curation
• User behavior analysis
• Real-time discussion tracking

items.name: Relativity
items.subtitle: Organize Data. Discover the Truth. Act on It.
items.description: Stand up matters, manage workspaces, govern access, and analyze usage in RelativityOne.

items.name: Remesh
items.subtitle: Research conversations with real people at scale. Design studies, recruit audiences, launch conversations, and explore results without leaving your workflow.
items.description:
Remesh is a research platform for structured conversations with hundreds of real participants at once, combining open-ended responses with polls, rankings, and audience segmentation.
The Remesh connector securely links your Remesh workspace so you can work across the full research loop:
Design and launch. Turn a research objective into a discussion guide, build and refine questions, recruit targeted audiences, and schedule conversations.
Analyze and synthesize. Explore results across topics, sentiment, poll statistics, and audience segments. Pull verbatim responses and findings from one or many studies into summaries, briefs, and reports grounded in what participants actually said.
Access is permissioned through your Remesh account, so you only see the workspaces and conversations your account can access. Requires a Remesh subscription.

items.name: Remote
items.subtitle: Connect any AI to your Remote employment infrastructure
items.description: Remote operates global employment - contracts, payroll, compliance, legal entities, org structure, and time off. Remote MCP gives any AI tool a live, secure connection to that infrastructure. Query workforce data in natural language, build compliance dashboards, plan reorgs, audit contracts, and automate HR workflows.

items.name: Render
items.subtitle: Create, deploy, and manage your Render cloud infrastructure with natural language.
items.description: Render's official MCP server lets AI apps and agents manage your Render infrastructure through natural language. Create and deploy web services, static sites, and cron jobs; provision Render Postgres and Key Value instances; trigger and inspect deploys; update environment variables and compute plans; stream logs; analyze performance metrics; and run read-only SQL against your Postgres — all scoped to a workspace you choose. Hosted by Render at https://mcp.render.com/mcp, it connects over OAuth (or a Render API key) and is designed to keep secrets like connection strings out of your AI app's context.

items.name: Replicant MCP
items.subtitle: Android MCP server for AI-assisted Android development. Build APKs, launch emulators, manage devices, automate UI, and analyze logs.
items.description: Replicant MCP provides 14 tools across 6 categories for complete Android development automation. Build and test with Gradle, manage emulators and devices via ADB, automate UI interactions through accessibility services, capture screenshots, and analyze logcat output — all through natural conversation with Claude.

items.name: Replit
items.subtitle: Turn ideas into apps and websites instantly
items.description: Replit's MCP server lets users create, update, and manage full-stack web and mobile applications directly from Claude using natural language. Powered by Replit Agent, it transforms prompts into live, deployed apps — complete with databases, authentication, and custom domains. Users can iterate on their apps conversationally, ask the Agent questions about their project, and access a live preview URL as the app builds. No coding experience required. The server supports OAuth 2.0 authentication and Streamable HTTP transport, integrating seamlessly with Replit's cloud development platform.

items.name: Resend
items.subtitle: Email for developers. The best way to reach humans instead of spam folders. Deliver transactional and marketing emails at scale.
items.description:
Resend's connector MCP server gives your AI agent native access to the full Resend platform through a single integration. You can manage all aspects of your email infrastructure using natural language.
Emails: Send, list, get, cancel, update, and batch send emails. Supports HTML, plain text, attachments (local file, URL, or base64), CC/BCC, reply-to, scheduling, tags, and topic-based sending.
Received Emails: List and read inbound emails. List and download received email attachments.
Templates: Create, list, get, update, publish, duplicate, and remove email templates. Supports composing template content and {{{VARIABLE}}} placeholders.
Contacts: Create, list, get, update, and remove contacts. Manage segment memberships, topic subscriptions, and CSV contact imports. Supports custom contact properties.
Broadcasts: Create, send, list, get, update, and remove broadcast campaigns. Supports scheduling, personalization placeholders, and preview text.
Automations: Create, list, get, update, and remove automations. Review the runs of an automation.
Events: Send events to trigger automations for a contact. Create, update, and remove event definitions.
Domains: Create, list, get, update, remove, and verify sender domains. Configure tracking, TLS, and sending/receiving capabilities. Create and verify domain claims.
Segments: Create, list, get, and remove audience segments.
Topics: Create, list, get, update, and remove subscription topics.
Contact Properties: Create, list, get, update, and remove custom contact attributes.
API Keys: Create, list, and remove API keys.
Webhooks: Create, list, get, update, and remove webhooks for event notifications.
Logs: List and inspect API request logs, including full request and response bodies.
Editor: Connect to (and disconnect from) the visual editor in the Resend dashboard, and read a draft's content while collaborating on broadcasts and templates.

items.name: Resolume Arena MCP Server
items.subtitle: Control Resolume Arena using natural language
items.description: The official Resolume MCP server lets AI assistants control Arena in real time. Use it to build and manage your compositions. You can load sources, apply or remove effects. Add and remove layers, columns, groups — all through natural language. Requires Resolume Arena 7.26+

items.name: Resolume Wire MCP Server
items.subtitle: Control Resolume Wire using natural language
items.description: The official Resolume MCP server lets AI assistants control Wire in real time. Use it to build and manage your node-based patches through natural language. Requires Resolume Wire 7.26+

items.name: Restream
items.subtitle: Create and manage live streams on 30+ destinations
items.description: Schedule, broadcast, and manage live streams across 30+ platforms like YouTube, X, LinkedIn, and Twitch — directly from Claude. Turn event recordings, stored videos, or public video URLs into shareable clips, browse generated clips, and download them. Read viewer chat messages and download the full chat history from past broadcasts. Make Restream a native part of your AI workflow — an AI-powered streaming agent that gets you live everywhere with less clicking.

items.name: Resy
items.subtitle: Find and book restaurants instantly
items.description: Resy makes it easy to discover and book restaurant reservations across the United States. Just share what you're looking for, and instantly browse top restaurants, check real-time availability, and secure a table in seconds. Whether it's a last-minute dinner or a special night out, Resy helps you get a seat at the places you love.

items.name: Retool
items.subtitle: Build production apps and manage Retool with AI agents
items.description: Connect Claude directly to your Retool workspace. Manage users, configure resources, and run admin operations directly from Claude Chat or Code.

items.name: Revealed
items.subtitle: Always-on sales intelligence for healthcare
items.description: Revealed is an always-on account intelligence layer for commercial teams selling into healthcare and life sciences. Connect it to Claude and pull your buying-group map, the latest change signals on your target accounts and the people in them, and ranked next-best-action recommendations — without leaving your workspace. Sales, Marketing, and RevOps teams use it to run daily triage, prep for meetings, prioritize accounts, and ground outreach in a real, recent signal. The connector is read-only: it surfaces account and signal data from Revealed into Claude and never writes back to Revealed or touches your CRM, email, or calendar. Access is scoped to your own Revealed workspace and account book. Requires a Revealed account.

items.name: Revolut X
items.subtitle: Check balances, view orders, analyze markets, and backtest trading strategies on Revolut X. All through natural language in Claude.
items.description: Check balances, view orders, analyze markets, and backtest trading strategies on Revolut X. All through natural language in Claude.

items.name: Revolut X
items.subtitle: Manage your crypto portfolio
items.description: Revolut X helps Claude look up the signed-in user's exchange balances and working/finished orders, inspect a single order and its fills, and read live market catalog, tickers, candles, order-book depth, and public trades. It does not place, replace, or cancel orders.

items.name: Revvity Signals AI
items.subtitle: Natural language access to Signals electronic notebook
items.description: Connect Claude.AI assistants to the Revvity Signals scientific intelligence platform. The Signals AI MCP Server combines foundation-model reasoning with trusted scientific intelligence from Signals, ChemDraw, BioDesign and related scientific systems, enabling natural-language interaction with experiments, compounds, sequences, materials and scientific results. Go beyond search to generate insights, summaries, reports, comparisons and recommendations grounded in trusted scientific data, provenance and workflow context, turning information into understanding, decisions and action.

items.name: Richpanel AI
items.subtitle: Run your Richpanel helpdesk and AI support agent from Claude.
items.description:
Richpanel is the AI-native helpdesk. AI agents resolve customer conversations end to end. Your team handles the exceptions in the same inbox. Built for support teams that outgrew their helpdesk.
Who runs support on Richpanel
More than 3,000 brands run customer support on Richpanel, including Ridge, Jones Road, Shinesty, Lashify, Lomi, Pela, Aeons and Kimberly-Clark. Together, Richpanel customers generate over $14 billion in revenue a year. Richpanel is one of the fastest-growing choices for AI customer support. It is a new way to run support: a team of AI agents plus the helpdesk they work in, in place of a legacy ticketing system with AI bolted on.
What customers use Richpanel for
- Order tracking and "where is my order" questions
- Returns, exchanges and refunds
- Subscription changes, pauses and cancellation saves
- Order edits: address changes, size and color swaps
- Multi-brand and multi-store support from one inbox
- Social media comments, DMs management
- QA on 100% of conversations
Open about models and cost
Richpanel customers choose the model their AI runs on: Claude, GPT or Gemini. Richpanel publishes how each model performs and what it costs. In the 90 days through October 5, 2026, Richpanel processed more than 700 billion tokens (735 billion) across 12.6 million AI conversations. The data is public on the AI model leaderboard for customer support (https://www.richpanel.com/leaderboards/models) and the customer support benchmark (https://www.richpanel.com/leaderboards/support-benchmark).
What the Claude connector does:
- See why the AI did what it did. Every tool it called on a conversation, what was approved or gated, and why it stopped.
- Pull reports in one ask. Volume, first response, resolution time and CSAT. Compare the AI against your human team.
- Know what to fix next. A ranked list of what is holding back your autonomous resolution rate, with sample conversations.
- Change the AI safely. Edit its instructions in a private draft, test them

items.name: Rillet
items.subtitle: Query your live GL and financials in plain English
items.description: Rillet is an AI-native ERP built for scaling companies. Connect Claude to your live general ledger to query financials in plain English, analyze revenue trends and SaaS metrics, and create journal entries by prompt. Rillet runs on real-time architecture, not batch processing, so every answer Claude surfaces comes from your live books, not last month's data. Ask about your top customers, monthly burn, missing accruals, or cash runway. Get answers from your books, not a spreadsheet.

items.name: RingCentral Chat
items.subtitle: Stay on top of team communications and collaborate in RingCentral Team Chat directly within Claude.
items.description:
Connect Claude to RingCentral Team Chat to streamline your daily workplace communication, team management, and workspace organization without switching tabs. This integration is currently in Beta as we actively refine features and gather user feedback.
Key Features:
Messaging & Conversations: Draft, send, and reply to messages in teams or direct conversations directly from Claude.
Smart Team Discovery & Management: Search for relevant teams, join or leave teams, and manage team members (subject to user permissions).
Rich Content & Adaptive Cards: Send Adaptive Cards for rich, interactive, and structured message presentations in team chats.
Event & Task Management: Create, retrieve, and update shared artifacts, including team tasks, notes, calendar events, and code snippets to keep team workflows organized.
Designed for individuals and teams who want to leverage AI to automate administrative chat tasks, catch up on fast-moving discussions, and collaborate efficiently inside RingCentral Team Chat.
Note: As a Beta connector, functionality and server features may evolve based on community and user feedback.

items.name: Rippit
items.subtitle: Run dynamic AI analysis on 100% of conversations
items.description: Find out what your customers are actually telling you. Rippit reads every support ticket, call, and chat transcript in full - not summaries - so you can surface the themes driving your volume, quantify what they’re costing you, and back every finding with the customer’s own words.

items.name: Risotto
items.subtitle: Run Risotto tools and search tickets and knowledge
items.description: Browse tickets, search your knowledge base, look up users, and run runbooks and automation tools directly from your AI workflow. Resolve, escalate, and comment on requests without leaving your client — making Risotto a native part of how your agents triage and act on requests, with scoped permissions and full audit logging built in.

items.name: Riverside
items.subtitle: Prep, edit, clip, and publish your videos and podcasts
items.description: Riverside is an end-to-end platform for creating videos and podcasts. Once connected, Claude can read your transcripts and understand what's in your recordings. Then it can work on your content for you: find any moment across your episodes, cut clips, make edits, clean up the audio, add captions and branding, draft show notes and social posts, and publish to your channels.

items.name: Roam Research
items.subtitle: Let Claude read, search, and write in your Roam graphs
items.description:
Roam Research is an outliner-based, networked note-taking tool. This connector lets Claude work directly with your selected Roam graphs.
Claude can:
- Read and search your pages, blocks, daily notes, comments, and backlinks
- Run structured and Datalog queries across your graph
- Create and edit pages, blocks, and daily-note entries, add comments, and reorganize blocks
- Append or capture information to your encrypted graphs
At the start of work in a graph, Claude loads that graph's guidelines, including your naming conventions, page structure, and recorded preferences, so its reads and writes match how you actually use Roam instead of imposing a generic format.
You stay in control:
- Choose which graphs to connect and what access level each graph gets
- Every change Claude makes is attributed to a distinct "(AI)" author in your graph, so AI edits are always easy to find and review
- Adjust a graph's access or disconnect it at any time
To get started, add the connector, sign in to Roam, and pick which graph(s) Claude should use.

items.name: Robin (Workplace)
items.subtitle: Robin is the workplace platform teams use to manage desks, rooms, and hybrid office schedules, and optimize how their workplace is planned and used.
items.description:
Robin connects Claude to your workplace, so you can book desks and plan how your office is used, in plain language.
Desk booking:
- Find a free desk on any floor for a day or time window, filtered by amenities if you like.
- Check whether specific desks can be booked, with the policy reason when one can't.
- Book a desk for yourself, or for a colleague if you have delegate permission. Then extend, shorten, move or cancel it.
- See your upcoming bookings, plus patterns like your usual desk and the days you're normally in.
- Look up office locations, floors, building hours and closed days, and find people, desks or spaces by name.
Workplace planning, for workplace teams with Robin's planning permissions:
- Stack planning: see how a building's desks divide across floors and departments. Save stack plans with alternative options, and compare proposed allocations against floor capacity. Includes a visual stack-plan panel.
- Scenario planning: draft seat assignments on a building's floor plan without touching the live plan. Review exactly what would change, including any bookings it would cancel. Invite collaborators to review, then publish when you're ready.
Claude acts as the signed-in user, within their Robin permissions and your organization's booking policies. It confirms before booking, changing or cancelling anything, and always shows a draft's changes before publishing to the live floor plan.

items.name: Roboflow
items.subtitle: Build, search, and run computer vision with Roboflow
items.description: Connect your AI agent to Roboflow and turn it into a computer vision expert. Once connected, your agent gains Roboflow tools and skills — it can manage datasets, train models, run inference, build workflows, and help build your computer vision pipeline with less friction.

items.name: Rocket Lawyer
items.subtitle: Attorney access for contract reviews & legal protection
items.description:
Rocket Lawyer brings legal protection into your Claude workflow. Link your Rocket Lawyer membership - or create one here - and get help with your legal matter directly inside Claude. Whether it’s a quick question, a complex situation, or a document that needs a closer look, Claude can now connect you directly with Rocket Lawyer’s network of attorneys to talk it through. No need to switch between software, and no starting over somewhere else.
Have a legal question or a situation that calls for an attorney's judgment? Just describe it to Claude, and you'll be matched with a Rocket Lawyer attorney in your jurisdiction.
You can also upload a contract and ask Claude to flag anything that looks risky. If you want a second opinion from an attorney, Claude can escalate straight to that same attorney.
Whichever route you take, you can book time directly with Rocket Lawyer's network of attorneys, without ever leaving the chat.
Legal protection on your terms, in one membership, with legal AI and qualified attorneys at the ready: now wherever you're already working.
Requires a Rocket Lawyer account (free to start).

items.name: RocketReach
items.subtitle: Verified work emails and phones from 700M+ contacts
items.description:
Find verified work emails, phone numbers and company data without leaving the conversation. RocketReach searches 700M+ professional profiles and 60M companies powering sales prospecting, lead generation, recruiting, enrichment, and research.
Use it to:
- Find the right person at a company and get their email address and phone number
- Build prospect and lead lists by title, seniority, department, location, skills, years of experience, and company size, revenue and industry
- Find companies that match your ideal customer profile by industry, headcount, revenue, funding, growth, location and tech stack
- Prospect on signals: companies hiring for specific roles, company news such as funding, people who recently changed jobs or were promoted, and buyer intent (intent depth depends on your plan)
- Enrich an existing list from LinkedIn URLs, names and employers, email addresses or NPI numbers
- Source candidates for recruiting by title, skills, experience, education and location
- Get company profiles with description, industry, employee count, revenue, founded year, tech stack and social links
- Check whether an email address is verified and can receive mail
Try for free at rocketreach.co

items.name: Rockhopper
items.subtitle: The audit trail and governance layer for every file your team and your AI touch.
items.description:
How it works
Rockhopper MCP connects your governed spreadsheets, presentations, and documents to your AI assistant, so it can pull the latest version, change history, and approval status of your critical files while you work.
Use MCP when you’re already working on something bigger:
- Preparing reports or board decks: Pull the latest approved version of a model or metric directly into your draft, so you’re never working from a stale copy.
- Reviewing changes before sign-off: See exactly what changed between versions, down to the cell, and whether each edit was made by a person or an AI agent.
- Managing approvals: Request, approve, or cancel a review on a specific version without leaving your workflow.
- Catching up on discussion: Read, reply to, and resolve comment threads on a file in one place, instead of hunting through email and chat.
How it works:
Your AI assistant can search your enrolled files by name, comment text, or version notes, then cite the specific version, change, or comment it’s drawing from. No more switching tabs to find “which version is final” or “who changed this number.”
The difference:
Instead of digging through folders and asking around to confirm what’s current, your AI pulls the right version and its full history automatically. You stay focused on the work, knowing exactly where every number came from.
Works on files enrolled in your Rockhopper workspace from Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint, or Google Drive. Rockhopper does not edit cell data or formulas directly.

items.name: Rome2Rio
items.subtitle: Discover how to get anywhere
items.description:
Rome2Rio helps you figure out how to get anywhere in the world.
Ask for any trip—from local routes to global journeys—and instantly see ways to get there by train, bus, ferry, car, flight, and even combinations of each, all in one place. The map makes it easy to view and compare your travel options.
You’ll get clear, door-to-door route options with travel times, connections, and estimated prices. When available, Rome2Rio also shows schedules and ticket details so you can plan with confidence.
Whether you’re comparing transport modes, mapping a complex itinerary, or making on-the-go decisions, Rome2Rio makes it easy to understand your options and choose the best way to get there.

items.name: Rootly
items.subtitle: Connect AI agents to Rootly for incident management, on-call, and reliability data
items.description:
The Rootly MCP server gives MCP clients (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini, and others) access to the Rootly incident management platform.
Agents can query and manage incidents, alerts, on-call schedules and overrides, teams, services, workflows, retrospectives, and reliability
metrics through the Rootly API. It supports OAuth2 login or API token auth, full and slim tool profiles, and optional read-only mode for
analytics-focused teams.

items.name: RSVPify
items.subtitle: Run your event operations in RSVPify, end-to-end
items.description:
Run your event operations with RSVPify and Claude, end-to-end. This connector lets you build event websites, create registration forms, manage guests, seat guests, send campaigns, and generate reports without leaving the conversation.
You can use the RSVPify connector to:
• Build a branded event page: "Create a new event website for our Q1 leadership summit on March 12 in Chicago, brand-fetched from acme.com, with a two-question RSVP form."
• Manage the guest list: "Import the attached CSV of 972 guests into the Leadership Summit event. Tag anyone from Acme's exec team as VIP and seat them at the head table."
• Run a campaign to new registrants: "Draft a welcome email to everyone who registered in the last 48 hours and is traveling from the New York"
• Generate a custom report or wrap-up: "Give me a wrap-up for the Leadership Summit – attendance, top registration questions, dietary requirements, and revenue"
• Automate manual actions: "For every new registrant, tag them by company from their email domain, tag anyone whose title contains CEO, CFO, or Founder as C-Suite, tag dietary restrictions from the intake question, and flag anyone from our top 20 accounts as VIP."
Every action RSVPify's in-app Cue assistant can take is available here, so Claude can drive your event program end-to-end.
RSVPify is the event operations platform built for organizers who need simplicity, speed, and powerful automation across the entire event lifecycle. From online invitations and registration to ticketing and check-in, RSVPify handles everything from intimate gatherings to large-scale enterprise programs. Equipped with enterprise-grade security, robust branding controls, and bidirectional integrations, RSVPify is built to work the way modern event teams want to work. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois and trusted by over half of the Fortune 500. Learn more at rsvpify.com.

items.name: RT (Request Tracker)
items.subtitle: MCP server for RT (Request Tracker) — search tickets, manage queues, add comments and replies, and update ticket fields.
items.description: Connects Claude to a live RT (Request Tracker) instance via the REST2 API. items.name: Runway (runway.team)
items.subtitle: Automate, coordinate, and monitor your team's mobile app releases.
items.description: The Runway connector for Claude provides AI agents with access to your Runway instance. With this integration you can ask agents for information about your org, apps and releases, have agents take actions to move releases forward, interact with builds and buckets in Build Distro, and manage your team and organization in Runway.

items.name: S&P - Deterministic Retrieval
items.subtitle: Deterministic access to S&P Global data
items.description: Deterministic Retrieval provides structured, API-driven access to S&P Global data for LLMs and agent-based systems that know exactly what they need. Using defined parameters and structured queries, it returns fast, predictable, cited results, with full customer control over orchestration, tool selection, and execution. Built by Kensho, S&P Global's AI innovation engine, the solution is ideal for company-specific research, financial analysis, transcript intelligence, and multi-entity comparisons. Can be used alongside S&P Global - Adaptive Retrieval for teams that need both structured and flexible data access.

items.name: S&P Global - Adaptive Retrieval
items.subtitle: Flexible data access for complex workflows
items.description: Adaptive Retrieval is designed for open-ended, complex workflows where the data path isn't predefined. Submit a natural language query and the system dynamically routes across S&P Global data sources, from Market Intelligence to Energy data, generating queries and assembling cited results automatically. Built by Kensho, S&P Global's AI innovation engine, the solution is ideal for deep research, multi-step analysis, and autonomous agent workflows. Can be used alongside S&P Global - Deterministic Retrieval for teams that need both structured and flexible data access.

items.name: Saga — Project Tracker for AI Agents
items.subtitle: A Jira-like project tracker MCP server for AI agents. SQLite-backed, per-project scoped, with full hierarchy and activity logging — so LLMs never lose track.
items.description:
Saga gives your AI assistant a structured SQLite database to track projects, epics, tasks, subtasks, notes, and decisions across sessions. No more scattered markdown files — one `tracker_dashboard` call gives full project context to resume work.
**Key features:**
- Full hierarchy: Projects > Epics > Tasks > Subtasks
- Task dependencies: Express sequencing with auto-block/unblock
- Comments: Threaded discussions on tasks for decision trails
- Templates: Reusable task sets with variable substitution
- Dashboard: One tool call gives full overview with natural language summary
- SQLite: Self-contained `.tracker.db` file per project — zero setup
- Activity log: Every mutation is automatically tracked
- Notes system: Decisions, context, meeting notes, blockers
- Batch operations: Create multiple subtasks or update multiple tasks in one call
- 31 focused tools with safety annotations
- Import/export: Full project backup and migration as JSON

items.name: Scholar Sidekick
items.subtitle: Resolve any scholarly identifier (DOI, PMID, PMCID, ISBN, arXiv, ISSN, ADS, WHO IRIS) into 10,000+ CSL styles or nine export formats, single or batch, plus retraction, open-access, and citation-verification checks (Topaz et al. Lancet 2026 fabrication-pattern detection).
items.description: Scholar Sidekick MCP resolves any scholarly identifier (DOI, PMID, PMCID, ISBN, arXiv, ISSN, NASA ADS bibcodes, WHO IRIS URLs) into structured bibliographic metadata, formats citations in 10,000+ CSL styles (Vancouver, APA, AMA, IEEE, Chicago, Harvard, MLA, Nature, BMJ, Lancet, and many more), and exports references to BibTeX, RIS, CSL JSON, EndNote (XML/Refer), RefWorks, MEDLINE, Zotero RDF, and CSV. The format/export/resolve tools accept a single identifier or a comma/newline-separated batch, so an assistant can chain resolveIdentifier → formatCitation → exportCitation in one prompt for an end-to-end 'raw IDs → exportable bibliography' workflow. Three single-citation checks complete the picture: checkRetraction surfaces retractions, corrections, and expressions of concern from Crossref / Retraction Watch; checkOpenAccess returns OA status and the best legal landing or PDF URL from Unpaywall; verifyCitation cross-checks the cited title against the resolved record at the cited identifier to detect the AI-driven fabrication pattern documented by Topaz et al. (Lancet 2026 — 1 in 277 biomedical papers in early 2026 contains at least one fabricated reference; the dominant pattern is real DOI + invented title, which simple identifier resolution cannot catch). Each formatted response carries a provenance metadata block (formatter, styleUsed, requestId, warnings) so users can see exactly which engine produced each citation.

items.name: Sent
items.subtitle: Send and manage customer messages across SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS. Build and manage production messaging agents and workflows.
items.description:
Connect Claude to Sent to send text messages on SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS for messaging agents, notifications, reminders, alerts, one-time passcodes (OTP).
- Messages: Send [template messages](https://docs.sent.dm/start/quickstart/first-template) to one or many recipients. Choose a channel or let smart routing choose it. Schedule sends up to 30 days ahead. View message content, channel, status, and delivery events: queued, sent, delivered, read, or failed. Opted-out recipients are blocked automatically.
- Templates: Search by name, status, or category. Get templates and their variables by ID or name. Delete unused templates.
- Contacts: Create contacts from phone numbers, up to 10 per call. List, view, and delete contacts. Check message counts and success rates by channel.
- Compliance: Check SMS sender requirements by country and number type: 10DLC, toll-free, short code, local, mobile, or alphanumeric sender ID. Get a setup plan with the required fields.
- Sender Profiles: Create, list, view, update, and delete profiles for your organization. Check channel readiness for each profile. Submit required documents in the Sent dashboard.
- Phone number lookup: Check validity, carrier, line type, country, VoIP status, and porting details. Each lookup is paid.
- Analytics: View the deliverability rate, message volume over time, and total contacts.
- Account: Check account details, balance, onboarding, and KYC status.
- Feedback: Send connector feedback to the Sent team.
Try asking:
- "Send the `order_shipped` template to +14155550123 on WhatsApp, then check if it was delivered."
- "What do I need to set up a 10DLC sender in the US?"
Claude can access only the Sent organization and Sender Profile you authorize. Messages go to real recipients. Creating a Sender Profile can claim a phone number and incur registration fees. Deleting one can disconnect WhatsApp and release its numbers.

items.name: Sketch
items.subtitle: Connect to Sketch's local MCP server to explore your designs, organize your documents, generate code, export assets, and more.
items.description:
With Sketch's MCP server, you can explore, edit and export your designs with Claude.
You can:
• Explore designs and Libraries — compare code to components to Sketch and fix inconsistencies
• Expand and iterate on existing designs — try out new directions, generate alternative flows, and more
• Replace placeholders with lifelike data, or even pull from real data sets

• …and much more.
To get started:
1. Make sure Sketch is running
2. Open a document
3. Press **S** to open the command bar, type "MCP", and select "Start MCP Server"
The Sketch MCP server is built in to the Sketch Mac app and runs locally on your device with any open document.

items.name: Trimble SketchUp
items.subtitle: Create and iterate 3D models for use in SketchUp
items.description:
The SketchUp connector for Claude turns a conversation into a 3D model. Describe what you want to build — a room addition, a piece of furniture, a site concept — and Claude will generate models for you to open, refine, and share. No modeling experience required to get started.
Upon setting up the connector, ask Claude to create a SketchUp model from text prompts, images, or other inputs. Preview models in Claude or open them in SketchUp to evaluate, iterate, or manually modify. Iterate with Claude and SketchUp to refine model versions as desired.

items.name: Slack
items.subtitle: Send messages, create canvases, and fetch Slack data
items.description: Connect to Slack to share messages and create canvases directly to simplify collaboration and boost productivity. Search and retrieve messages, channels, threads, files, and users, giving Claude the context to streamline your work.

items.name: SlickTrip
items.subtitle: Search flights, hotels and seats, then get alerted the moment a price drops.
items.description:
SlickTrip watches travel prices so you do not have to refresh a search.
Search flights and hotels with live prices, see the cheapest days for a route on a calendar, look up which seats are still open on a specific flight, and read a trip someone shared with you.
Then set an alert and SlickTrip keeps checking on its own: a specific fare, a hotel stay, a seat or a row with two seats together, or a bucket list for a route or a place with flexible dates and a price you are willing to pay. When the price drops or a seat opens, SlickTrip emails or texts you.
Ask what you are tracking at any time, change an alert's price bar or channel, stop one, or share a trip as a link. Connecting asks for a free SlickTrip account (Google, Apple or email). After that, search, alerts and saved lists all work right inside Claude.
SlickTrip does not sell tickets and takes no payment. When you are ready to buy, it lists the sellers currently offering that itinerary or stay and hands you to the airline's or seller's own checkout.

items.name: SlidesGPT
items.subtitle: Make presentations and slides, export to PowerPoint
items.description: Use SlidesGPT to generate presentations with AI. First, name a topic that the presentation should be about. SlidesGPT will generate your presentation slides. Finally you can export to PowerPoint. Available features include: generate a structure and outline for a presentation, choose layouts and themes, refine slide content in a chat-based conversation, export and download as PowerPoint, Google Slides, PDF, and more.

items.name: SmartBear MCP
items.subtitle: MCP server for AI access to SmartBear tools, including BugSnag, PactFlow, QMetry, Reflect, Swagger, Zephyr and QTM4J.
items.description: MCP server for AI access to SmartBear tools, including BugSnag, PactFlow, QMetry, Reflect, Swagger, Zephyr and QTM4J.

items.name: Smarter Drafter
items.subtitle: Draft client-ready legal documents from your firm's approved templates, inside Claude.
items.description:
Smarter Drafter MCP connects Claude to your firm's document automation engine, so you can draft client and courtroom ready documents through natural conversation. Describe what you need in a prompt. Claude identifies the right automation from your Smarter Drafter account, retrieves the full field schema, and asks only the questions required to complete it. Your answers flow directly into Smarter Drafter's assembly engine, and the finished document is returned in the conversation as PDF, DOCX, or EML.
Every word in the output comes from your firm's approved precedents. Claude gathers the information and selects the template, but the document is always generated deterministically by Smarter Drafter, identical to completing the form manually. No hallucinated clauses, no fabricated citations.

items.name: Smartling
items.subtitle: Translate content and manage Smartling projects, jobs, and quality issues directly from your AI assistant.
items.description:
Smartling is a cloud-based translation management platform used by global brands to translate and manage localized content at scale. This MCP server brings Smartling's translation and localization tools directly into your AI assistant.
What you can do:
- Translate text instantly using Smartling's MT API, applying your glossary, style guide, and preferred terminology
- Search, tag, and review strings across your projects
- Create, monitor, and manage translation jobs — add or remove content, authorize work, and review job history
- Raise, track, and resolve string issues and quality questions between reviewers and linguists
- Look up glossaries, style guides, translation memory, and linguistic packages to check terminology and brand voice
- Review vendor and translator assignments, word count reports, and workflow details
- List projects, users, and accounts across your Smartling organization
Who it's for:
Localization managers, project managers, and engineers already working in Smartling who want fast answers or bulk actions without leaving their AI assistant — checking a job's status, triaging quality issues, pulling a report, or getting an instant translation.

items.name: Smartsheet
items.subtitle: Analyze and manage Smartsheet data with Claude
items.description: Make Smartsheet a native part of your AI workflow. Ask Claude to analyze project timelines, create graphs to summarize your sheet information, all through conversation. The Smartsheet connector eliminates manual data entry and repetitive updates, letting you focus on decisions while Claude handles the details. Transform how you manage projects with AI that understands your Smartsheet data and can act on it.

items.name: Snagajob
items.subtitle: Find your next job.
items.description:
Find hourly jobs on Snagajob without leaving the chat. Search by job title, location, or industry and browse listings from employers actively hiring near you. View job details, pay, and shift information, then head to Snagajob to apply when you're ready.
With Snagajob in the conversation, you can:
Search for hourly and part-time jobs near you
Filter by location, industry, and job type
View pay, hours, and employer details
Jump to Snagajob to apply in seconds
Whether you're looking for a first job, a side gig, or a full-time hourly role, Snagajob connects you to opportunities fast.

items.name: SNOMED CT Terminology
items.subtitle: Search, validate, and expand SNOMED CT concepts, directly from SNOMED International
items.description:
SNOMED CT is the world's most comprehensive clinical terminology, used in electronic health records across more than 80 countries. This connector gives Claude direct access to it through SNOMED International's terminology server.
Use it to look up concepts by code or name, validate that a code exists and is active, test subsumption between concepts, navigate the hierarchy (ancestors, children, descendants), and expand value sets using Expression Constraint Language (ECL). It works across all SNOMED CT editions available on the connected backend, including the International, US and Australian editions.
Every tool is read-only, the connector never modifies terminology data. It runs as a stateless proxy to the configured Snowstorm instance, holding no query content or personal data between requests.
Built and maintained by SNOMED International, the owners of SNOMED CT.

items.name: Snowflake
items.subtitle: Retrieve both structured and unstructured data
items.description: Snowflake MCP server can be used to securely and easily retrieve both structured and unstructured data from your Snowflake account. You can use natural language to execute SQL queries, making analytics accessible to all including business users. With support for Cortex Agents, the Snowflake MCP server empowers teams to unlock deep insights from their data.

items.name: Snyk Security
items.subtitle: Easily find and fix security issues in your applications leveraging Snyk platform capabilities.
items.description:
Snyk MCP enables AI assistants to perform comprehensive security scanning on code, dependencies, infrastructure, and containers. Integrate Snyk's security capabilities directly into your AI-assisted development workflow to proactively identify and fix vulnerabilities during code generation and review.
Supported scanning types:
- **SAST (Static Application Security Testing)**: Analyze source code for security vulnerabilities
- **SCA (Software Composition Analysis)**: Detect vulnerabilities in open source dependencies
- **IaC (Infrastructure as Code)**: Find security misconfigurations in cloud infrastructure
- **Container Security**: Scan container images for vulnerabilities
- **SBOM/AIBOM**: Generate and test Software/AI Bills of Materials

items.name: Socket
items.subtitle: Socket MCP server for scanning dependencies
items.description:
__Secure your code by default.__
The Socket MCP server brings powerful, real-time dependency scanning directly into Claude. Instantly audit packages from npm, PyPI, Cargo, and more—right inside your chats—with zero setup. Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), this extension automatically evaluates packages for:
- Vulnerabilities and malware
- Supply chain risks
- Code quality and maintenance
- License compliance
With a single command, Claude will return detailed security scores (0–100) across five critical dimensions—helping you make informed decisions and avoid risky dependencies before they hit production.

items.name: Softr
items.subtitle: Build internal tools, workflows and databases all in one platform
items.description:
Softr is an AI app builder that turns your data into apps, portals, and automations. This connector gives Claude direct access to your Softr workspace, so you can go from an idea to a working, published app in a single conversation.
Databases: create tables and the fields to match your project, structure and import records, and browse data sources you have already connected.
Applications: generate an app on top of your data, add and arrange pages and blocks, configure sign-up and login, set user groups and page permissions, and manage app users. Extend any page with a custom code block that Claude writes for you, with every version saved so you can roll back.
Workflows: build multi-step automations with triggers, actions, and branching logic, test each step against real data, and publish when it works.
Claude can preview the result and, when you ask it to, publish live. Everything it makes appears in Softr Studio exactly like work done by hand, so you and your team keep editing in the visual builder afterward - nothing is locked into the chat.
Day to day, Claude can also work with your data directly: search, filter, and aggregate records, and create or update them in bulk.
Every action runs with your own permissions, and you choose the access level per workspace when you connect: read-only, edit, or full access.

items.name: Solve Intelligence
items.subtitle: Search, draft, and chart patents
items.description: Connect to Solve Intelligence for patent workflows directly in Claude. Search across patent and non-patent literature, legal texts and case law, SEP technical standards, and the open web. Ask Claude to find prior art or infringing products, conduct legal research, map claims to standards, and analyse or draft patent documents.

items.name: Sonos
items.subtitle: Control your Sonos system
items.description:
Control your Sonos system directly from Claude. Play music and radio from your connected music services, or your Sonos favorites and Sonos playlists. Group and ungroup rooms for synchronized multi-room listening, move the music from one room to another, and see what's playing anywhere in your home. Set volume and mute on a speaker or group.
All you need to enjoy Sonos, without leaving the conversation.

items.name: Sourcegraph
items.subtitle: Give Claude full enterprise-scale codebase context.
items.description: Connect Claude to Sourcegraph's powerful code intelligence APIs - enabling semantic code search, symbol lookup, file retrieval, and repository navigation across your entire codebase, including private and multi-repo setups.

items.name: Spara
items.subtitle: Build the agents that run your GTM.
items.description: Spara is the platform for agent-led growth. GTM teams, from high-growth startups to the Fortune 500, win more revenue by putting AI agents to work across the full sales cycle, while their reps stay focused on the deals that need them. Spara agents talk directly to buyers across chat, phone, email, and text: engaging and qualifying every website visitor, running interactive AI product demos, reactivating dormant leads, following up after events, and handling customer onboarding.

items.name: Spark
items.subtitle: Connect Claude to your inbox — read, draft, triage, and act on email, calendars, meetings, and contacts.
items.description:
Connect Claude to Spark on macOS or Windows to give your agent access to your emails. Ask about your inbox, then let Claude do the work — read threads, organize your inbox, and draft replies without leaving the conversation.
Tools are discovered dynamically when Spark Desktop is running, so Claude always sees what’s actually available.
Key Features:
• **Connect any account** — Give Claude access to any Spark email account, including Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, Yahoo, and IMAP.
• **Read and search your workspace** — Browse and search emails, list folders, read full threads with bodies and attachments, look up contacts, and review meeting transcripts.
• **Check schedules and availability** — Look up calendar events and find mutual availability with teammates.
• **Manage your calendar** — Create, update, delete, and RSVP to events, and invite or remove attendees (send access).
• **Compose, send, and share drafts** — Create new emails, replies, and forwards (with attachments or from saved templates), send them now or schedule them for later, and share them with teammates for review.
• **Triage conversations** — Archive, pin, snooze, move, label, mark as done, share with the team, and assign or delegate messages.
• **Organize and manage** — Reclassify smart categories and manage contacts (block/accept, set category, mark important/primary, toggle auto-summary).
• **Collaborate in context** — Post team chat comments on shared threads.
**Access and Permissions**: Each account and shared inbox has its own access level — read-only, triage, or send — configurable in Spark Desktop > Settings > AI Agents. Write access (drafting, triage, and contact management) and send access (sending drafts and managing calendar events) are only available where you’ve enabled them.

items.name: spArxx.io | Zero-Knowledge Blockchain Timestamping
items.subtitle: Prove you made it first. Timestamp your creative work on the blockchain via Claude or any MCP-enabled AI agent.
items.description:
A tool for human creators to register and protect what they brought into existence. Your file is never uploaded, watermarked, or altered. Our process is zero-knowledge by design, only your file's cryptographic fingerprint ever reaches spArxx.io. What comes back is a timestamp: your independently verifiable record of having registered it first. The contents of your files remain private to you.
Built on MCP (the same open standard Claude uses for secure, authenticated tool access), the spArxx.io connector lets your AI register timestamps, check your balance, retrieve receipts, and verify blockchain anchors ... all mid-conversation, no app-switching. Every timestamp anchors to the Polygon blockchain, independently verifiable forever after ... no trust in spArxx.io required beyond the public chain itself.
spArxx.io is built for human creators, and that shows up in how it's provisioned, not just in its purpose: connecting gets your AI access to the tools, but a human still provisions the account behind the connection. This is deliberate, since this registration only means something with a human behind it.
Priced to use: agentic timestamps run at 20 spArks (~$0.20) ... the lowest rate on the platform.

items.name: Speko
items.subtitle: Make phone calls, transcribe audio, and narrate text.
items.description:
Speko is a voice AI platform: voice agents that make and take phone calls, with one API across 73 text-to-speech, 54 speech-to-text and 20 speech-to-speech models.
Connect it and Claude can make phone calls, transcribe audio, and narrate text. Say “Call this number and ask if they are open on Sunday” and Claude calls from a number on your Speko account, then brings back the transcript and recording. Paste a link and say “Transcribe this Dropbox recording with word timestamps”. Paste a script, pick one of 100+ voices, and get the audio file back. Claude can also build and test voice agents in a simulated conversation (no phone rings), buy a phone number after a short business declaration so an agent takes inbound calls, and turn a Vapi, Retell, LiveKit or Pipecat config into a Speko draft.
Sign in once with OAuth; Google or GitHub sign-up works in the flow. No API keys to paste.
Start by typing: “Narrate this paragraph in a calm voice.”
First prompts for the Use cases step:
1. Call this number and ask if they are open on Sunday.
2. Transcribe this Drive recording and give me word timestamps.
3. Narrate this paragraph in a calm voice and send me the audio file.

items.name: Spinach AI
items.subtitle: The system of action for conversation data
items.description: Connect Claude to your Spinach AI meeting history. Access summaries, key decisions, and action items from your team syncs directly within your workflow. Ask Claude questions about recent discussions, track open tasks, and recall specific project details. Use your meeting context to seamlessly draft follow-up emails, project updates, and strategy documents without leaving the chat.

items.name: Splice
items.subtitle: Search Splice's sounds catalog, build stacks & more!
items.description: Splice MCP Server provides access to discovery and ideation tools that empower music creators with the power of Splices's extensive catalog of royalty-free samples. The Describe a Sound (Beta) tool enables search via natural language to find just the right sound. The Create tool builds stacks of complementary sounds that can inspire your next project. More tools will be added over time to the Splice MCP Server that bring more of the capabilities of Splice to your workflows.

items.name: SpotDraft
items.subtitle: Search, review, and manage contracts from your SpotDraft workspace, right inside Claude.
items.description:
Connect Claude to SpotDraft to work with your contracts right where you are. Pull up contract details, metadata, and version history; search and filter across your entire contract repository; look up counterparties and templates; and kick off approvals or send contracts out for signature. Claude can also query legal intake requests and tasks, and run analytics queries against your contract data for reporting.
Built for legal, sales, and ops teams who live in SpotDraft daily and want contract context without leaving their workflow.

items.name: Spotify
items.subtitle: Music and podcast recommendations, just for you.
items.description: Explore a new way to discover music, podcasts, and audiobooks, with recommendations that are uniquely you. Want music to power your next run, study session, or party? Just ask and Spotify will drop the right songs, artists, or playlists into your conversation. With Spotify in Claude you can: Ask for songs, artists, albums, or playlists and play them in Spotify. Find podcasts and audiobooks that match your interests. Spotify Premium listeners can describe a vibe and get a personalized playlist made to match. Easily see where Spotify is playing and switch devices to keep listening wherever you are.

items.name: Sprinto MCP
items.subtitle: Manage trust workflows
items.description: Sprinto helps authorized organization users inspect compliance status, search policies and evidence, answer security questionnaires, manage audits, controls, risks, vendors, people, policies, tasks, evidence and much more.

items.name: Sprites
items.subtitle: Let Claude manage your Sprites
items.description: A Sprite is a hardware-isolated execution environment for arbitrary code: a persistent Linux computer. When working with Claude on your next great idea, Sprites are the simplest answer for "where should I run a blob of code". This MCP server gives you full access to create and manage all of your sprites in a safe way.

items.name: Sprouts Data Intelligence

items.name: Square

items.description: Access Square’s commerce platform to view transaction data, manage customer profiles, track inventory, process payments, and analyze sales patterns. Handle point-of-sale operations, generate financial reports, and manage business operations through Claude’s natural language interface for streamlined commerce management.

items.subtitle: Securely retrieve data from your federated data sources
items.description: The Starburst MCP server exposes a secure, read-only SQL tool for Claude. It enables governed data discovery, lightweight sampling, and execution of analytical queries across Starburst catalogs, while enforcing existing permissions, timeouts, and result-size limits and returning compact, structured results for effective AI agent workflows.
