items.subtitle: Multiple data science tools for data loading, cleaning, visualization, and ML workflows
items.description: Multiple data science tools for data loading, cleaning, visualization, and ML workflows

items.name: Steadybit
items.subtitle: Find reliability risks in your systems: design, run, and analyze chaos experiments.
items.description:
Steadybit is a reliability and chaos engineering platform. This connector lets Claude work with your own Steadybit tenant: explore what you run, design and execute chaos experiments against it, and interpret the results.
**Discover your systems**
Browse environments, teams, and services. Search targets — hosts, containers, Kubernetes workloads, cloud resources — with Steadybit's query language, inspect their attributes, and see which chaos actions your teams are allowed to use.
**Design and run experiments**
Search and read existing experiment designs, draft new ones from a plain-language description, create them from your own templates, and start or cancel runs. Steadybit's AI can suggest experiments tailored to a service and its weak points.
**Understand what happened**
Review past executions step by step, read execution logs, query the metrics recorded during a run, and pull reliability advice and service risk reports. Ask why an experiment failed and get an analysis grounded in the actual run data, not guesswork.
Everything Claude sees is scoped to your own permissions: the connector acts as you, limited to your teams, their environments, and the actions they may run. Read-only tools are annotated as such, and starting an experiment is marked destructive, so Claude asks before injecting a fault.

items.name: Strava
items.subtitle: Analyze, summarize, and explore your Strava data
items.description: You'll be able to ask questions about your Strava performance. Use it to help spot training patterns, suggest improvements, cheer you on, or whatever else you can dream up.

items.name: Stripe
items.subtitle: Payment processing and financial infrastructure tools
items.description: The Stripe Model Context Protocol server defines a set of tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API and search its knowledge base (including documentation and support articles).

items.name: stub
items.subtitle: Super simple AI native accounting
items.description: Do any accounting operation via MCP, if it's possible in the application it's possible by AI.

items.name: StubHub
items.subtitle: Find tickets on the World's Largest Ticket Marketplace
items.description: StubHub makes it easy to explore live events directly from Claude. Access live ticket availability, pricing, and view quality in real time with an assistant that remembers your preferences. With over 50 million listings across 200+ countries, you can discover concerts, sports, theater, comedy, festivals, and more — all in one place.

items.name: Stytch
items.subtitle: Manage your Stytch Project
items.description: The Stytch MCP Server enables AI assistants to programmatically manage your Stytch Project like Redirect URLs, Email Templates, and more.

items.name: Subtext
items.subtitle: Session replay, built for agents. Give Claude a session link and it investigates the real production session—DOM, screenshots, console, network—to find the root cause.
items.description:
**Subtext is session replay built for agents instead of humans.**
Connect it and your Claude agents can open real production sessions and investigate them directly—no scrubbing a timeline, no video to watch. Learn more at https://subtext.fullstory.com/docs/introduction
Hand your agent a Subtext link from wherever it already looks—a Sentry issue, a Linear ticket, a support thread, a PR—and it jumps to the right moment, inspects screenshots and accessibility trees, diffs DOM state, and reads console and network activity to find the root cause. Then it files the fix or hands you the finding. You review the answer, not the replay.
What your agent gets:
* **Session tools it calls directly**: open a session, jump to a moment, inspect and compare state—purpose-built so agents traverse dense session data efficiently, with fewer tokens than pointing a general agent at raw replay.
* **Best-in-class capture from Fullstory**: Fullcapture behavior, pixel-perfect screenshots on demand, DOM diffs, and windowed console and network context.
* **Privacy built for production**: precision tools for agents to mask or exclude sensitive fields, plus agent-friendly DLP scanning tools over MCP.
* **Cost-effective**: Capture every session without sampling and never miss a critical user experience or bug report. Agents review the ones that matter most.
Works with Claude Code or any MCP-compatible agent. Code-first install, self-serve signup, generous free tier, usage-based pricing. Bring your own agent harness—Subtext is the session context it was missing.
Session replay used to be something humans watched. Now it's evidence your agents act on.

items.name: Sumble
items.subtitle: Deep research any account's teams, tech, and people
items.description:
Research any company directly from Claude. See what technologies an organization uses, who works there, and what roles they're hiring for. Explore team structures, reporting lines, and active initiatives inside your target accounts.
Find decision-makers by job function and seniority. Enrich contacts with email addresses. Track hiring signals from job postings. Build and manage account and contact lists without leaving your conversation.
Sumble turning hours of manual account research into a single query.

items.name: Sumsub
items.subtitle: Verify identities, businesses, and prevent fraud
items.description: Bring your compliance operations into Claude. Connect to your Sumsub account to onboard applicants, generate verification links, and pull live data on identities, businesses, transactions, AML screening cases, and fraud networks—all in plain language. Triage your review queue by risk, assemble due-diligence dossiers, investigate suspicious activity, and draft regulatory reports without clicking through the Dashboard. Turn full-cycle verification into an AI-powered workflow that moves at the speed of conversation.

items.name: Supabase
items.subtitle: Manage databases, authentication, and storage
items.description: Manage Supabase projects directly through Claude. Execute SQL queries on PostgreSQL databases, design and modify table schemas, deploy serverless edge functions, and configure user authentication. Access real-time logs for debugging, generate TypeScript types for your schema, create and apply database migrations, and manage development branches through natural language commands.

items.name: Super.com
items.subtitle: Compare hotels and find the lowest rate
items.description: Find hotel deals on Super.com, right inside Claude. Ask for the cheapest room at a specific hotel, or compare prices across an entire city to find the best value. Results include hotel ratings, amenities, photos, and a direct booking link, so you can compare options and book with confidence on Super.com.

items.name: SuperBooks
items.subtitle: Financial OS for small businesses
items.description:
SuperBooks is bookkeeping for freelancers and small teams: bank transactions with AI categorisation, invoices, customers, a receipt inbox and document vault, a time tracker, and financial reports. The SuperBooks connector lets Claude work your books from your own account - list and inspect transactions, fix a category or status, find unpaid or overdue invoices, draft a new invoice (never sent until you say so), look up or add customers, search receipts and documents, match a receipt to a transaction, track time, and pull profit & loss, burn rate, runway, spending, revenue, balances, top customers and recurring expenses. It serves Claude two tools, search_tools and execute_typescript, through which it reaches these operations.
Safety is built in. Every connection goes through OAuth with per-scope consent, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered. Destructive operations (deletes and voiding invoices) sit behind a team-level "Destructive AI tools" switch that is OFF by default, in addition to the credential's scope. Credentials are rate-limited to 120 calls a minute and can be revoked instantly from Settings > Developer.
The connector never moves money: bank connections, payments and billing exist only in the app. Sending an invoice emails it to your customer, and nothing else leaves your account. No purchases are made in-chat, no images, video or audio are generated, and no ads are served. Works on every SuperBooks plan.

items.name: Superhuman Docs
items.subtitle: Create, search, update docs and tables
items.description: Connect Claude with Superhuman Docs to bring your docs, tables, and data into your AI workflow. Create new docs and tables from simple descriptions; turn rough notes into polished, shareable write-ups; update existing tables & charts without leaving the conversation; and search your content right from claude without needing to dig through your workspace.

items.name: Superhuman Mail
items.subtitle: The most productive email app ever, for Gmail & Outlook
items.description: Connect Superhuman Mail to Claude, and build powerful workflows for email and calendar. Find anything in your inbox, draft replies that sound like you for every recipient, check read statuses, set reminders, schedule meetings, and send — all without leaving Claude.

items.name: Supermetrics Marketing Analytics
items.subtitle: Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Google Analytics, TikTok, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube & 200+ sources
items.description: Query data, analyze performance & manage ad campaigns across 200+ platforms — no account needed. Share Claude-generated live dashboards. Supports Google Ads, Facebook Ads (Meta), Google Analytics, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Shopify, Google My Business, Amazon Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing), Pinterest, Snapchat, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Salesforce. Covers advertising, analytics, social media, CRM, ecommerce & email marketing

items.name: Supersei CRM
items.subtitle: Run your Supersei sales CRM from a conversation: leads, calls, WhatsApp, meetings, campaigns, reports and workspace setup, with exactly your permissions.
items.description:
Supersei is a sales CRM for teams that live on WhatsApp and the phone. This connector lets Claude read and run your Supersei workspace on your behalf, as you, with exactly your permissions.
Ask in plain language and Claude does the work: find leads that have gone quiet, open a lead's full timeline, create or update leads with your custom fields, move pipeline stages, assign owners, add notes, schedule follow-up tasks, book or move meetings, place a call from your CRM number and log the outcome, send a WhatsApp message or email to a lead, reply in the shared inbox, and read reports, forecasts and your own numbers for the day. Managers get ready-made standup, end-of-day and weekly reviews. Marketing can preview an audience, prepare a WhatsApp or email campaign as a draft and launch it only after confirming the exact count. Admins can manage pipeline stages, custom fields, scoring rules, roles, users and workspace settings.
Safety is built in. Claude signs in with your Supersei email and inherits your role: an agent sees their own leads, a manager their team, an admin the organisation. Single sends and bookings show the exact text or slot first. Bulk actions are prepared as drafts and need a confirmed count. Deletes are two-step and lead deletes go to a recycle bin. Every change appears on the lead timeline with your name. Disconnect at any time from Claude or from Settings > API keys.
Works with any Supersei plan, including trials.

items.name: SurveyMonkey
items.subtitle: Design surveys, collect responses, and analyze results
items.description: Build surveys, analyze responses, and uncover trends in SurveyMonkey—right from Claude. Turn feedback into clear next steps without leaving your workflow.

items.name: Swagger
items.subtitle: Build, govern, and document APIs
items.description: Work with your APIs and documentation through natural conversation using Swagger. Generate APIs from natural language, explore and search your API library with full context, and validate specifications against organizational governance policies. Automatically standardize and fix non-compliant APIs, and create, manage, and publish documentation portals and API definitions.

items.name: Sybill

items.subtitle: Run your LinkedIn by talking to Claude. Schedule content, pull inspiration from 5M+ viral posts, and get your analytics as plain answers.
items.description:
Run your LinkedIn by talking to Claude. Schedule content, pull inspiration from 5M+ viral posts, and get your analytics as plain answers.
- "Turn my newsletter into a post and queue it for tomorrow morning."
- "Find three hooks that are working in my niche and draft each one."
- "How did my posts do this month, and what should I do next?"
Ask in plain language, and Taplio does the work for you. No tab switching, no copy and paste.
With Taplio tools, Claude **researches posts that are genuinely performing in your niche**, writes drafts that sound like you using your profile and preferences, attaches your images or video, queues posts for your best times, and reads your analytics back as plain answers instead of another dashboard to decode.
**Four guided workflows are built in:**
- **Post now.** From idea to queued draft in one exchange.
- **Performance debrief.** What worked this month, and what to do next.
- **Build a series.** Inspiration pulled from our 5M+ viral posts database.
- **Plan your week.** A full week of content, drafted and scheduled.
Media stays in the chat. Claude opens a panel showing the library you have already built, or a drop zone for a new file, and it lands straight on the draft.
It runs on your own Taplio account, connected to your LinkedIn. It is not a scraper driving a hidden browser. Nothing to install, nothing to host, no cookie or password shared.
Drafts can wait for you in Taplio, or just ask Claude to schedule them. **Nothing reaches LinkedIn until you grant Claude permission to schedule or publish.**
You will need a Taplio account on a plan that includes API access, with your LinkedIn connected.

items.subtitle: Backtest trading strategies written in plain English on real market data, with graded, honesty flagged reports.
items.description:
TextToQuant turns a plain English trading idea into a real backtest on real market data. Describe a strategy in words asset, timeframe, entry and exit rules, stops and targets and it parses it into exact rules, runs the backtest, and returns a graded report with honesty flags (zero fees, missing stops, thin sample) so a result is never over-trusted.
What you can do from Claude:
• Run and rerun backtests across crypto, forex and equities, then see the full report: price chart with trade markers, equity and drawdown, trade ledger, Monte Carlo and the metrics board.
• Stress test a strategy: parameter sweeps, walk-forward tests, multi-asset checks and an overfitting verdict (Deflated Sharpe, PBO).
• See where the edge lives: performance by market regime and by indicator context.
• Compare strategy variants side by side and build shared-capital multi-asset portfolios.
• Author custom indicators in Pine Script, JavaScript or Python and use them in strategies.
• Scan the crypto market, set alerts, export a strategy to Pine Script, and share any run as a public interactive report.
Research and education only: nothing is traded and nothing is sold inside Claude. Runs bill from the same plan and credits as your TextToQuant account.

items.description:
Tines 3B is an AI-native platform for building agents, apps, and automations. This connector lets Claude work directly in your 3B tenant — building, running, and shipping workflows, and managing the workspace around them — all through a conversation.

items.name: TinyFish
items.subtitle: Browser automation, web scraping, web search and fetch via a cloud browser agent: automate websites, log in to portals, submit forms, scrape social media, listings, prices, reviews, monitor changes.
items.description:
TinyFish gives Claude a cloud browser and web agent to search, read, and operate the live web. Use it for web automation and browser automation on real websites: navigating pages, clicking through multi-step workflows, logging in to websites and account portals, filling out and submitting web forms, online applications, and job applications, and extracting structured data that only appears after real page interaction.
Three core tools cover the workflow. Web search finds relevant pages and news across the public web. Fetch reads a web page or webpage and extracts clean, token-efficient content, including JavaScript-rendered pages, so Claude can read, summarize, or scrape up to 10 URLs at once. The web agent automates website tasks that static fetching can't reach: it runs in a remote stealth Chrome browser with built-in anti-bot protection and proxy rotation, can reuse saved logged-in sessions to log in and check account status or dashboards, and returns results as structured JSON. The same task can run across many sites in parallel for price comparison and shopping: compare prices, check product availability and stock availability, gather ecommerce product data, product listings, job listings, and real estate listings.
Website monitoring: TinyFish monitors websites for changes. Set up a recurring monitor on a web page or search topic for price tracking, change detection, content updates, and alerts when something new appears. For direct control, open a headless cloud browser session with CDP access for Playwright, Puppeteer, or Selenium.
Common uses include web scraping and data extraction behind logins and navigation, a web scraper for tables, app reviews, and local businesses for lead generation, a social media scraper for public profiles and posts, website screenshots, public records and trademark search, downloading invoices, receipts, and billing statements from a customer portal, research across many sources, and pulling live data from web apps.

items.subtitle: Bring your Trussi roofing CRM into Claude - find projects and customers, track pipeline and schedules, pull dashboards and reports, and log updates without leaving the chat.
items.description:
Trussi AI connects your Trussi roofing CRM to Claude so your team can run the business in plain language.
Ask about your work:
- Find and open projects and customers, with full job detail (status, quotes, files, measurements)
- Check your sales pipeline, dashboard, and leaderboard
- Pull month-by-month revenue, AR/collections, and marketing-channel performance
- See calendar, labor, and delivery schedules for any day or date range
- Review profit analysis, worksheets (signed value / collected / balance due), and insurance supplements
- Read project and per-user activity timelines, and run your saved reports
Take action (with your permissions):
- Add comments, create calendar events and quotes, and move projects through the pipeline
Built for security:
- OAuth 2.0 sign-in with PKCE - Claude only sees data your account already allows
- Every request is account-scoped and capability-checked, exactly like the Trussi app
- Read and write are separate scopes you approve when connecting
Scoped automatically by role and branch, so reps, production, and owners each see the right data.

items.name: Trustfull
items.subtitle: Bring Trustfull fraud intelligence and risk assessments into Claude.
items.description:
Trustfull is a fraud intelligence platform that helps organizations detect and investigate fraud using signals from phone numbers, email addresses and IP addresses.
Fraud teams use this intelligence across account creation, account takeover, payments, merchant risk and ongoing investigations.
The Trustfull connector brings this intelligence into Claude. Users can retrieve risk signals and reason codes, investigate multiple identifiers together, and ask Claude to analyze and explain the findings.
Where a custom risk model is configured, Claude can retrieve its rules and apply them to Trustfull results, providing a clear assessment of the risk and which rules were triggered.

items.name: Tseha.io
items.subtitle: Your coding standards, live in Claude
items.description:
Tseha is the authoritative source of truth for your organization's development standards - delivered directly to Claude so generated code matches how your team actually builds.
Instead of guessing component names, props, or design values from training data, Claude queries Tseha for live, organization-specific information before writing any code.
What Tseha provides:
• Components - the full list of UI components in your design system, with import paths and usage context, plus complete per-component specs (props, variants, examples, anti-patterns).
• Design tokens - colors, typography, spacing, radius, and shadows, so styling uses your real theme values instead of hardcoded ones.
• Development standards - your organization's coding conventions, project structure, and framework-specific rules.
• Package definitions - which component packages are assigned to a project, so imports always come from approved sources.
• Component updates - breaking changes and migration guidance between package versions.
Tseha is read-only and scoped per project. Connect it, sign in, and Claude automatically pulls your standards, components, and tokens whenever it helps with design or front-end work - keeping AI-generated code consistent with your system.

items.name: Turkish Airlines
items.subtitle: Search flights, plan trips, and manage bookings
items.description: The official Turkish Airlines MCP App. Search and compare flights, check live status, look up booking details and baggage allowance, browse city guides, and discover promotions — all directly inside Claude.

items.name: Turo
items.subtitle: Search Turo car rentals
items.description:
Search Turo's inventory with Claude to find any car you want, wherever you want it, from a vibrant community of trusted hosts.
Whether you need an SUV for Tahoe or a convertible for the coast, just describe your plans and get tailored recommendations in seconds to ensure you find the perfect vehicle for your trip.

items.name: Turquoise
items.subtitle: Query Turquoise's proprietary healthcare pricing data
items.description: Connect Turquoise to Claude to explore Turquoise Health's healthcare pricing data. You can search across healthcare entities, explore how they relate to each other, and analyze in-network rates across service categories. Useful for benchmarking reimbursement rates, sizing markets, understanding what a payer pays in a given geography, or comparing rates across providers and plans.

items.name: Twelve Data
items.subtitle: Real-time prices, 100+ technical indicators, and fundamentals for stocks, forex, crypto, and ETFs — ask in plain English, no API knowledge needed.
items.description:
Twelve Data gives Claude instant access to global financial market data through a single, AI-powered interface. Describe what you need in plain English and the connector automatically selects the right endpoint, builds the parameters, and returns clean results.
What you can do:
- Get real-time and historical OHLCV prices for stocks, forex pairs, cryptocurrencies, ETFs, commodities, and bonds across 50+ global exchanges
- Calculate 100+ technical indicators: RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, EMA, SMA, ATR, Stochastic, Ichimoku, SuperTrend, VWAP, and more
- Access company fundamentals: income statements, balance sheets, cash flow, earnings history, analyst ratings, insider transactions, and key executives
- Monitor earnings calendars, IPO calendars, dividends, splits, and market movers
- Search and filter instruments by exchange, type, or country
Getting started:
A free API key is available at twelvedata.com. Paid plans unlock higher rate limits, real-time data, and premium datasets including extended fundamentals and global exchange coverage.
Twelve Data is used by thousands of developers, quant researchers, and financial professionals worldwide.

items.name: Twilio
items.subtitle: Build powerful communications and customer engagement
items.description: Search Twilio’s APIs and build customer engagement experiences directly from Claude. Across more than 1,800 endpoints, Twilio MCP surfaces the exact specs and code patterns you need for channels like voice, email, and SMS/RCS, as well as user identity, customer data, contact center, and conversational AI. Get straight to the right API details and implementation guidance without loading full API docs into context or leaving your IDE.

items.name: TwinMind
items.subtitle: AI notes & Memory
items.description:
TwinMind is your AI meeting memory. It automatically captures and transcribes your meetings, then makes everything searchable and retrievable directly from Claude.
With the TwinMind connector, Claude can:
Search your meeting notes and summaries — ask "What did we decide about the Q4 launch?" and get answers grounded in your actual conversations
Retrieve tasks and action items — surface what was assigned to you across all your meetings
Pull full meeting context — fetch complete summaries and transcripts so Claude can draft follow-ups, recap decisions, or prepare you for your next call
Unlike reactive AI tools, TwinMind builds a persistent memory of your work conversations, so Claude always has the context of what was said, decided, and promised — without you re-explaining anything.
Works with your existing TwinMind account.

items.name: Typefully - Social Media Scheduler
items.subtitle: Social media scheduler for great writing on X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Substack, Threads, Bluesky, and Mastodon.
items.description:
Typefully is the social media scheduler top creators and brands use to write, schedule, and publish tweets, threads, and posts across X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Substack, Threads, Bluesky, and Mastodon.
Connect once and Claude can manage every social media account in your Typefully workspace.
Ask Claude to:
• Draft tweets, threads, and posts, then cross-post them on each platform
• Turn ideas, docs, voice notes, and meeting transcripts into drafts
• Schedule posts at your best times, or publish right away
• Plan your week ahead on your content calendar
• Collaborate with your team: add, reply to, and resolve comments on drafts
Every draft lands in Typefully with a realistic preview of exactly how it will look live, ready for you to review, polish, and publish. Nothing goes live immediately unless you explicitly confirm it.
Purpose-built for founders building an audience, creators trying to post consistently, and marketers running brand accounts.

items.name: Uber
items.subtitle: Get Uber price & time estimates for any ride option
items.description:
Get accurate, real-time Uber fare estimates between any two locations in the United States. This tool instantly shows you available ride options—such as UberX, UberXL, Comfort, and Black—along with pricing, estimated arrival times, and product details.
What You Can Do
- Check up-to-the-minute fare estimates for on-demand (immediate) trips
- Compare ride options across Uber products
- View ETA, pricing ranges, and key product features
- Jump directly into booking your trip in the Uber app — all ride requests are handed off to the official Uber app to be completed securely
- Request estimates for specific product types (e.g., "Book an Uber Black")
- Ensure accurate pricing by providing a precise pickup and dropoff location

items.name: Uber Eats
items.subtitle: Explore restaurants and dishes
items.description: Get food delivery to your doorstep from thousands of amazing local and national restaurants. Search and browse restaurants and dishes near you to find the meal you crave.

items.name: Ubersuggest
items.subtitle: Keyword research, competitor analysis, backlinks, site audits and AI search visibility — powered by Ubersuggest.
items.description:
Ubersuggest brings SEO research directly into Claude. Ask questions in plain language and get real search data from the same dataset that powers ubersuggest.com — no dashboards, no exports.
What you can do:
• Keyword research — search volume, CPC, SEO and paid difficulty, related keyword suggestions, Google autocomplete ideas, search intent and content ideas.
• Domain analysis — traffic estimates, domain authority, ranking keywords (organic and paid), top pages, top countries and estimated traffic value.
• Competitor research — find organic competitors, compare keyword overlap and uncover the pages driving their traffic.
• Backlinks — backlink and referring-domain data, anchor texts, backlink overview metrics and backlink opportunities from competitors.
• SERP analysis — see who ranks for a keyword, with page-level metrics and estimated click distribution.
• Site audits — run a crawl of your site, track its progress and get the list of technical issues and affected URLs, plus PageSpeed performance audits.
• Projects and rank tracking — create projects, add tracked keywords and competitors, check ranking positions over time and review suggested SEO opportunities.
• AI Search Visibility — see how your brand appears in AI assistant answers, with per-prompt visibility reports.
Connect your Ubersuggest account to get started. Data access follows your Ubersuggest plan limits, and the connector never deletes projects or publishes anything on your behalf.

items.name: Udemy Business
items.subtitle: Search and explore skill-building resources
items.description: Udemy Business MCP brings our comprehensive AI-powered skills development platform directly into your AI tools. Employees discover and access expertly curated courses via personalized search and recommendations. This enables just-in-time learning in the flow of work with enterprise-grade security and scalability.

items.name: UKG Bryte
items.subtitle: Bring your UKG HR and workforce data into Claude: find people and org charts, check time-off balances, and request and track time off.
items.description: UKG Bryte brings your organization's UKG HR and workforce data into Claude, using your own UKG sign-in. Read: employee directory, employment details, work locations, work email, reporting lines, team rosters and org charts; time-off balances, accrual history and request status; for managers, team balances, requests and time-off schedules. Write: submit time-off requests, only after you confirm the details. You see only what your UKG permissions allow. UKG Bryte is in Beta Early Access: UKG customer administrators can apply for access.

items.name: Ultipa
items.subtitle: Manage Ultipa Cloud instances and run GQL graph queries, algorithms, backups, and metrics from Claude.
items.description: Model Context Protocol server for Ultipa Cloud and any self-managed Ultipa GQLDB instance. Provision and operate instances, run GQL queries and graph algorithms, manage backups and firewall rules, and view metrics and billing — all through natural language.

items.name: Unblocked
items.subtitle: Bring full context to every agent and AI tools
items.description:
Unblocked is the context layer for agentic software development. It reasons across your code, conversations, issues, docs, product, and production systems so agents can complete work correctly with less human intervention.
Coding agents know the code. They do not know why it was written that way, which of two conflicting docs is current, what a ticket decided, or what production is doing right now. Unblocked gives them that organizational understanding by connecting the context scattered across your code, messaging platforms, issue trackers, documentation, and product and production data, reconciling conflicts between sources, and enforcing the permissions you already set in each tool.
One MCP server replaces a dozen. Context is ranked, compressed, and assembled server-side before it reaches the agent, so the agent reasons over higher-quality input. The result: reliable code that reflects how your team actually builds software, generated with fewer tokens and less back-and-forth.
Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and Codex over MCP, or through the Unblocked CLI and API. Connects to GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Google Drive, Sentry, Datadog, and more.

items.name: Unify
items.subtitle: Find, enrich, and sequence prospects from 40+ data sources.
items.description: Connect Unify to Claude to run your outbound end to end: build target lists, enrich contacts with verified emails and phone numbers, draft personalized sequences, and sync it all back to your CRM. Then ask what's working: reply rates by sequence, rep activity, and conversion. Try asking "Find champions from my customer accounts who recently started new roles, get their verified emails and mobile numbers, and draft a sequence," or "Show me the breakdown of tasks completed by reps over the last 30 days." Unify searches 1.1B+ people and 65M+ companies across 40+ data providers. Find, enrich, and sequence prospects in one chat.

items.name: Unsplash
items.subtitle: Find and use free HD images
items.description: Find and use high-quality, free images from Unsplash. Your visual companion for creating websites, blog posts, presentations, and more.

items.name: Unstructured Transform
items.subtitle: Turn any document into AI-ready structured data
items.description:
Unstructured Transform turns real-world documents into clean, structured, AI-ready data. Point it at a file — PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, email, scanned images, and ~70 other formats — and it returns the content as Markdown, element-level JSON, HTML, or plain text that an agent can act on immediately.
Under the hood it runs a configurable pipeline: partition documents into structured elements (titles, paragraphs, tables, lists, images) with layout and page metadata; optionally enrich them with vision-language passes (image and table descriptions, table-to-HTML, named-entity recognition, generative OCR); chunk the content for retrieval; and generate embeddings for a vector store. It can also extract structured JSON from a document against a schema you provide — or draft that schema for you.
Work is submitted as an asynchronous job, and results are delivered out of band through a short-lived download link, so even large documents never overwhelm the conversation. Each request handles up to 10 files, 50 MB per file.
Common uses: feed specification PDFs into a coding task, ground answers in policy or contract documents, build a searchable Q&A corpus over enterprise files, pull structured fields from forms, invoices, or contracts against a JSON schema, or prepare large document sets for a RAG pipeline.
Requires a free Unstructured account. Learn more at docs.unstructured.io/transform.

items.name: Unthread
items.subtitle: Manage and automate your support tickets
items.description: Search conversations, monitor SLAs, and analyze support metrics directly from Claude. Make Unthread a native part of your AI workflow—a support intelligence layer that helps you stay on top of your helpdesk's performance.

items.name: Unwrap
items.subtitle: Search and analyze customer feedback
items.description: Search and analyze your customer feedback with Unwrap. Pull in customer feedback themes and anecdotes, filter by metadata and analyze trends with issues over time. Use your customers feedback to build data backed roadmaps, PRD's, and more!

items.name: Upwork
items.subtitle: Hire talent or find work
items.description: Connect Claude directly to Upwork. Search and hire talent, post jobs, and manage contracts as a client, or find work, submit proposals, and track jobs as a freelancer. Claude handles the drafting and matching, while hiring, contracts, and payments stay on Upwork.

items.name: USAFacts Government Data Connector
items.subtitle: Give Claude a better source for government data
items.description:
Connect Claude to government data organized and maintained by USAFacts. Ask questions about the state of the nation and get answers centered in real data from dozens of federal sources like the Census Bureau, BLS, and Treasury, with added context to help Claude interpret and explain the numbers.
Start any prompt with "use usafacts" to use the connector. Then ask about topics like unemployment, housing, inflation, federal spending, and the national debt.
Not sure where to start? Try these prompts:
- What's the national debt, and how fast is it growing?
- How does unemployment in my state compare to the national rate?
- What's actually driving inflation right now... rent, groceries, or something else?
- Where does federal spending go, and which agencies spend the most?
- How is the population in my state changing?
We're starting with economic data and adding more government datasets over time. Learn more about this connector and see what data is currently available: https://usafacts.org/claude-connector/

items.name: v0
items.subtitle: Build Full-Stack Web Apps with AI
items.description: v0 MCP is Vercel's official MCP server for its AI app builder. Import designs, start and manage chats, send prompts, and get live previews of generated apps—all in one place.

items.name: Vaisala Xweather
items.subtitle: Access real-time, forecast, and historical weather.
items.description: Provides access to real-time, forecast, and historical weather intelligence for analysis and planning. Designed to support operational decisions outputs based on observed and forecast conditions.

items.name: Valuecase App
items.subtitle: Search, create and update Valuecase spaces
items.description: Valuecase MCP connects Claude to your Valuecase workspace, letting you create, manage, and monitor digital sales rooms and onboarding spaces directly from the conversation. Spin up personalised spaces from templates, set custom properties, and filter your Spaces – all without switching tools. Claude gets full context on your spaces, so you can review engagement, check progress, and keep customer-facing workflows moving from one place.

items.name: Vanguard Advisor Tools
items.subtitle: Access Vanguard models data and content from Claude
items.description:
Vanguard Advisor Tools brings Vanguard’s model portfolio data into Claude. Given a need to solve for a target portfolio, the connector returns detailed, model portfolio data, including expense ratios, asset class, start date and portfolio characteristics so that advisors can research and compare solutions and move from analysis to implementation with conviction.
Data Scope: The connector is read-only and exposes only publicly available US model data. It does not access, return, or store any client, account, or personally identifiable information (PII).
Third-party tools are provided for informational purposes only and do not constitute investment advice.

items.name: Vani by Zoho
items.subtitle: Create diagrams, visualize workflows, and manage Spaces in Vani.
items.description: Connect Vani to Claude and build your workspace by describing it. Say what you need and your Space takes shape - diagrams, shapes, text, connectors, Kanban boards, and more - without leaving the chat.

items.name: Vanta
items.subtitle: Connect to Vanta's trust management platform
items.description: Read from and manage your trust management program within Vanta. Available tools depend on the connected organization's enabled features and the user's permissions.

items.name: Vasara
items.subtitle: Search case law and legislation across Lithuania and the EU, with verifiable citations.
items.description:
Vasara gives Claude direct access to Lithuania's primary legal sources – with citations it can verify.
Search national legislation, EU regulations and directives, and case law from the Constitutional Court, Supreme Court, Supreme Administrative Court, the CJEU, and the ECtHR. Look up a decision by case number, search by topic, pull specific passages from long documents, or check guidance from state authorities and municipalities.
Read-only – doesn't create, edit, or submit anything. Requires a free or paid Vasara account.

items.name: Ideals
items.subtitle: Search, manage, and update your Ideals project from Claude
items.description: Run your Ideals data room from Claude – build project structures, manage users, search and summarise documents, track project activity, and more – all through natural conversation, no compromises on security, and without switching tools

items.name: Veltra Activities

your AI chat. Search and book tours, food experiences, and cultural
activities across Japan, Hawaii, Southeast Asia, and other destinations —

conversations into bookable plans without leaving the chat. Read-only and
unauthenticated; no account required to use.

items.subtitle: Model Context Protocol tools for Vendr software pricing insights. Get price estimates, company information, and product catalog data.
items.description: Model Context Protocol tools for Vendr software pricing insights. Get price estimates, company information, and product catalog data.

items.subtitle: Analyze, debug, and manage projects and deployments
items.description: Vercel MCP is Vercel’s official MCP server, allowing you to search and navigate documentation, manage projects and deployments, and analyze deployment logs—all in one place.

items.name: Verisk Underwriting Intelligence
items.subtitle: Ask questions. Get underwriting insights from Verisk.
items.description: Verisk Underwriting Intelligence brings select Verisk underwriting content, insights, workflows, and functionality into Claude for authorized customers through an intuitive, conversational experience. Designed for underwriters, actuaries, product teams, and other insurance professionals, it enables users to explore information, analyze risk, and support underwriting decisions through natural-language interactions.

items.name: Verisk XactRestore
items.subtitle: Natural-language estimating for XactRestore
items.description: Connect Claude to Verisk’s XactRestore so restoration and remodeling professionals can build and refine estimates by simply describing the work that needs to be done. Powered by Xactware’s pricing and material data, Claude can create rooms, add and adjust line items, apply Quick Estimates, and surface pricing details inside trusted XactRestore workflows, while keeping contractors in control of every change. Make estimating faster, more intuitive, and easier to review so teams spend less time wrestling with software and more time helping homeowners.

items.name: Vertiso Memory
items.subtitle: Portable, durable memory for every AI agent you use
items.description:
Vertiso Memory is a portable, user-owned memory layer for AI agents. Connect it once, and your assistant can capture and recall durable facts, decisions, preferences, and project context across every tool you use, rather than starting from scratch in each new conversation.
It exposes a small, composable toolset over MCP: remember to capture a durable fact, recall for hybrid search with synthesized answers, search for a ranked hybrid record lookup, and get_memory to inspect specific memories. Session tools like hello, handoff, and wrap-up let work continue cleanly across sessions and devices.
Your data is yours. We do not train AI models on your content. Memories are sent to third-party LLM providers solely for retrieval and synthesis, under those providers' standard no-training API terms, and are deletable upon request.
Works with any OAuth-capable MCP client. Connect by adding the server URL; client registration and sign-in happen in the browser, with no API key to paste.
Available worldwide except where prohibited by applicable law or unsupported by our service providers.

items.name: viaNexus vAST
items.subtitle: Power AI workflows with viaNexus: a financial data marketplace delivering prices, news, fundamentals, and global macro economic data directly from trusted provider partners.
items.description:
viaNexus is the leading financial data marketplace and fintech infrastructure for AI workflows, offering a unified integration for agentic finance, global macro, corporate actions, and equity research. Access real-time and historical stock prices, dividends, stock splits, IPOs, corporate actions, fundamentals, news, earnings transcripts, index data, estimates, and global macro data—sourced directly from over 30 premier institutional data partners (including EIU, MT Newswires, Aiera, BMLL, ExtractAlpha, and IndexOne).
Powered by vAST (viaNexus Agentic Service Technology), our MCP server delivers an agent-ready financial data layer built for LLMs and autonomous AI agents in Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, and custom Python/TypeScript environments.
Key Features & Capabilities:
Equities, Corporate Actions, Macro & Financial Data: Search and fetch bundled NexusCore reference data alongside premium NexusEdge partner datasets. Query real-time quotes, historical stock prices, corporate events (dividends, splits, spinoffs, IPOs), financial statements, analyst forecasts, news, and EIU global macroeconomic indicators.
Granular Entitlements & Compliance: vAST enforces row-level permissions server-side. Agents automatically discover and query only the datasets authorized by your subscription, guaranteeing institutional-grade license compliance.
Fintech-Grade Machine Auth: Built on OAuth 2.0 (PKCE) with signed software statements, replacing static API keys with short-lived, scoped tokens to eliminate credential leaks in production AI workflows.
Zero-Redeploy Dataset Upgrades: Connect once via standard MCP protocols. Expand your stock market, corporate event, and macro data subscriptions via the viaNexus console with zero client code changes.
Deliver compliant, normalized stock, corporate action, and financial market data directly to your AI workflows.

items.name: Viator
items.subtitle: Book travel experiences around the world
items.description: Discover and book unforgettable things to do with the Viator app. Search Viator's catalog of tours, attractions, and experiences using natural language. Just tell us where you're going and what you're interested in, and we will help you explore relevant options quickly and clearly. You can narrow results by destination, dates, price range, and categories, making it easy to move from a broad idea ("things to do in Paris") to options that fit your plans and budget. Ask Claude "what did we decide in Thursday's client call" and the answer comes from your Vibe AI record.

Use it to **find qualified leads**, **research prospects**, **create personalized outreach**, or **identify talent**, all directly within your chat. Vibe Prospecting provides fresh and compliant B2B data through a complete enrichment hub.

items.name: Vibe Prospecting
items.subtitle: Find and enrich company and contact data in Claude for prospecting, lead generation, recruiting, and CRM enrichment across 150M+ companies and 800M+ contacts
items.description:
Turn your Claude agent into a full B2B prospecting platform. Vibe Prospecting finds any company or professional right inside your chat.
Go beyond basic contact lookups: search company profiles, org charts, and company hierarchy to identify decision-makers and their reporting lines, run company search and contact search by name or industry, and track business events like funding rounds, hiring signals, and growth signals as they happen. Find actionable contact info from emails and numbers to social profiles.
Underneath, Vibe Prospecting covers the full stack sales, recruiting, and GTM teams expect: firmographics, technographics, intent data, buyer intent, website traffic, and industry classification by LinkedIn Industry, NAICS or SIC code, plus employee count, revenue data, funding events, and workforce signals for 150M+ companies and 800M+ professional profiles from 50+ live sources, including third-party and alternative data.
Use it to build lead lists, run people search, person lookup, and phone number lookups, source candidates for recruiting and candidate sourcing, and craft personalized cold email, outbound sales, phone number waterfall, and sales engagement sequences. Enrich any CRM or ATS record with fresh contact data and company data, run an email finder plus email verification, append missing fields, and resolve duplicate entities with entity and identity resolution — all without leaving Claude. Layer in market, competitive, and revenue intelligence to sharpen list building and sales enablement.
It's a modern alternative to Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, RocketReach, Clearbit, and Cognism: one connector for prospecting, lead generation, account-based marketing, sales intelligence, email customization, and revenue operations, so outreach starts the moment you find a qualified lead in the contact database. Export enriched lists straight to CSV or your CRM and keep every pipeline generation and ICP workflow running on live b2b data.

items.name: Viberate music data

items.description: Real streaming numbers, social metrics, playlist placements, audience geography, and chart rankings for millions of artists and tracks across Spotify, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Deezer, Shazam, and radio.

items.name: vidIQ

items.description:
vidIQ gives Claude access to creator intelligence and content workflows across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. Research YouTube keywords, trends, outlier videos, channels, competitors, transcripts, comments, and performance data. Analyze connected channels with YouTube Analytics, generate titles, scripts, clips, and comment-reply drafts, find stock B-roll, compose and edit media, render motion graphics, and manage competitor watchlists. items.name: Visier
items.subtitle: Find people, productivity and business impact insights
items.description: Ask Vee questions about your people and work data in Visier. Get insights on work performance, employee satisfaction, attrition predictions, and retention of key team members. Requires a Vee subscription.

items.name: Vital Care Finder
items.subtitle: Find and compare US doctors by specialty, medical need, location, and insurance plan.
items.description:
Vital Care Finder helps people find primary and specialist care across the United States. Describe the type of doctor or medical issue, provide a ZIP code or city and state, and optionally add an insurance carrier or plan to filter results.
Compare nearby providers using distance, ratings, areas of clinical focus, insurance match, relative cost indicators, experience, and location details. Open a provider’s profile, view locations on a map, and call the practice directly.
Vital Care Finder does not book appointments or guarantee insurance coverage. Confirm availability, network status, and benefits with the provider and insurer.

items.name: Voluum
items.subtitle: Manage and analyze your Voluum ad-tracking campaigns directly from Claude.
items.description: Connect Claude to Voluum, the performance-marketing tracking and analytics platform. Query campaigns, offers, landers, and traffic sources; run and break down reports; manage automation rules; and optimize paid-traffic campaigns — all in natural language. Uses your own Voluum OAuth login and acts on your behalf against the live Voluum API.

items.name: Vuetify MCP
items.subtitle: Official Vuetify docs, APIs, and bins for AI agents
items.description:
Vuetify MCP is the official hosted Model Context Protocol server for the Vuetify ecosystem. It gives Claude, Cursor, Grok, and other MCP clients live, queryable access to Vuetify 3/4 component and directive APIs, installation and feature guides, FAQs, release notes, v3→v4 upgrade guidance, and the Vuetify0 (headless) composable/component surface.
Public documentation tools work with no account. Creating or updating Vuetify Bins, Playground demos, and vtfy.link short URLs uses Vuetify One OAuth (not a pasted API key).
Use it when an agent needs current Vuetify APIs instead of training-cutoff guesses: install a Vite/Nuxt app the documented way, look up VBtn props, migrate a v3 project, or pull a v0 selection/form primitive before inventing one.
Hosted endpoint: https://mcp.vuetifyjs.com/mcp (streamable HTTP).

items.name: Vybit Notifications
items.subtitle: Send push notifications with personalized sounds via the Vybit platform
items.description: Integrates Claude with the Vybit notification platform. Create and manage notification endpoints (vybits), trigger push notifications with custom sounds, browse and subscribe to public vybits, manage access permissions, view notification logs, and monitor API usage.

items.name: Vylo
items.subtitle: Your meeting memory
items.description: Vylo records your meetings and writes clean English notes, across 18+ Indian languages. Connect it to Claude to ask about your own conversations — what was said, what you agreed to, and what you still owe someone. Read-only: Claude can see your meetings, summaries and transcripts, and can change nothing.

items.name: Wealth.com
items.subtitle: Bring your clients' estate plans, tax returns, and documents into Claude — with instant snapshots, risk analysis, and advisor-ready summaries.
items.description:
Wealth.com brings estate-planning intelligence into Claude for financial advisors and their teams.
Look up any client in your book and pull a complete picture of their estate in seconds — no switching tabs, no digging through PDFs. Ask Claude to walk you through a client's estate snapshot, flag planning risks and gaps, or draft an executive summary you can bring straight into a client meeting.
Key capabilities:
• Client lookup
• Estate snapshots
• Risk analysis
• Executive summaries
• Annual Tax Lookback reports
• Document intelligence (wills, trusts, tax returns, statements)
Built for the advisor workflow: ask in plain language, get answers grounded in your clients' actual documents and estate data — all within your firm's authenticated Wealth.com access.

items.name: Wealthbox
items.subtitle: Search, update, and manage Wealthbox data from inside Claude
items.description:
Wealthbox is a CRM built for financial advisors and wealth management firms. This connector brings your Wealthbox data directly into Claude.
Search and update contacts, review and add notes, and track opportunities across your pipeline. Manage projects and workflow templates, and look up or create tasks. Check calendar events and meetings tied to any client. Work with the custom objects and custom fields specific to your firm, add comments and tags to keep records organized, link related contacts together, and look up users, teams, and workspaces across your organization.
Built for financial advisors, enterprise RIA firms, and broker-dealers already running client relationships in Wealthbox. Ask Claude to prep for a client meeting, follow up on a deal, or update a record, and it works directly against your live CRM data.

items.name: Webex Meetings
items.subtitle: AI-powered workflows for Webex meetings
items.description: Streamline meeting management with automated scheduling, transcript access, and recaps.

items.name: Webex for Claude
items.subtitle: Access your Webex meetings, messaging, and Vidcast content securely in Claude.
items.description:
Webex Suite MCP gives you secure access to your Webex meetings, messages, and Vidcast content right inside Claude, everything you need is available where you work.
Meetings - View your upcoming and past meetings, check who attended and their status, create or update a meeting, get meeting summaries, and access recordings and transcripts all through a simple ask.
"What meetings do I have this week?"
"Summarise my last team meeting."
"Schedule a 30-min call with my team on Friday at 2pm."
"Show me the transcripts from yesterday's product review."
Messaging - Search across all your Webex spaces and messages, read or send messages, create and manage spaces, and share or download files without opening Webex.
"Find all my unread messages for today”
"Create a new space called 'FY27 Planning’”
"What's the latest update in the launch-readiness space?"
Vidcast - Browse your own videos, find content shared with you, search across org-wide Vidcasts, and get transcripts or highlights from any video so you can get the key moments from any video.
"Show me videos that were shared with me in this week.”
"Get the highlights from the yesterday’s all-hands video."
"Find Vidcast videos about the new product onboarding."
All of this works securely through your existing Webex account, no new logins, no extra setup required.

items.name: Webflow
items.subtitle: Design pages, manage CMS content, add motion, analyze traffic, and launch the whole site, all from a prompt and all inside the permissions your workspace already has.
items.description:
Webflow is a visual platform for building and running professional websites, and Webflow MCP connects Claude directly to it. Describe what you want in plain language, and your agent makes the change in your actual site, working from the design system, content, and data already there.
What you can do:
- Design and build: Create responsive pages, build reusable components, and manage the variables that hold your colors, fonts, and spacing.
- Manage content at scale: Set up and restructure CMS collections, the databases behind repeating content like blog posts and case studies, then write and update items in bulk.
- Bring it to life: Add motion and interactivity to a page, then fine-tune the result yourself on a visual timeline.
- Analyze and measure: Ask about traffic, top pages, and engagement over time, and get the answer in conversation.
Control stays with you. Agents work inside the roles and permissions your workspace already has, they follow the Agent Instructions you write to tell them how your site should be built, and every action is recorded in the site activity log. Point an agent at a page branch, a private copy of a page, and your live site stays untouched while you work. Anything an agent builds opens in Webflow's visual editor, where you review and adjust it before publishing.
New to Webflow? You do not need to learn the product first. What your agent builds is a real website with production hosting and a content management system behind it, not a code export you are then responsible for maintaining. Open the visual editor whenever you want to take over by hand.

items.name: WebMCP Evaluator
items.subtitle: Check whether a public page is ready for agents: tools observed, tools to add, what must never be exposed.
items.maker: John Williams at Sun Business Group
items.description: WebMCP Eval is a remote MCP for consultants, agencies, and operators preparing client sites for agentic traffic. Call evaluate_webmcp with one HTTPS URL. You get page intent, capability, tools already registered, recommended tools, and a do-not-expose list (no checkout, place-order, or card capture). tools/list and get_credits are free. A completed evaluation debits $2 from a prepaid Stripe wallet ($26 / 13). Empty wallet: unpaid reload_credits returns a Checkout URL; paying does not mint a new key. We do not keep a first-party history of evaluated URLs. Setup: https://www.webmcp-eval.com/connect.html. The URL and fetched page text are processed by Firecrawl (scraping) and OpenAI (analysis); no wallet keys or chat content are sent.

items.name: Website Auditor
items.subtitle: AI visibility + site audits: see if ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude & Gemini recommend a website.
items.description: Website Auditor checks and monitors how a website shows up in AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini) alongside a standard technical audit (SEO, security headers, broken links, performance). It returns an AI-visibility score, what changed over time, competitor comparisons, and specific fixes. Try it with no API key: get_sample_audit returns a complete sample report in the exact shape a real audit returns, with nothing to set up. Auditing your own site needs a Website Auditor subscription ($10/month; eligible new customers get a 7-day free trial — payment method required, no charge until the trial ends); check_upgrade_status reports your standing with any valid key.

items.name: Website Generator by B12
items.subtitle: Build a website or web app in minutes! Generate, design, write code, and create copy for your website. Powered by B12. Contact: hello@b12.io
items.description: The Website Generator MCP allows you to create a professional, engaging, and user-friendly website or web app in seconds using AI. To start, provide a name for your project/business, along with a description of what to build (goals, structure, etc.).

items.name: Webull
items.subtitle: Your Global Multi-Asset Trading & Analysis Powerhouse
items.description:
Connect your Webull account to Claude and explore global financial markets through natural conversation. Ask about account balances, positions, real-time quotes, historical price bars, K-line charts, futures and options data, analyst ratings and price targets, or manage your watchlists — all without leaving the chat.
Webull MCP brings institutional-grade market intelligence to your fingertips, combining real-time data, deep analytics, and portfolio visibility with bank-level account security, so you can research, monitor, and act with confidence.

items.name: WeTransfer
items.subtitle: Send files from your chat via WeTransfer — get a shareable link or email them to recipients, using your own WeTransfer account.
items.description:
Send files straight from your conversation with WeTransfer.
Connect your WeTransfer account and share any file from your chat — documents, images, exports, generated assets — without leaving the conversation. Just ask, and the connector uploads the files to WeTransfer and returns a clean, shareable download link. Prefer to send it directly? Add recipients and WeTransfer will email the transfer for you, sent from your own account.
What you can do
- Share one or many files at once and get a ready-to-share download link
- Email a transfer to one or more recipients, with an optional title and message
- Send large files without bloating the conversation
How it works
Every transfer is created in your own WeTransfer account, so it appears in your transfer history and follows your plan's limits and expiry. You sign in securely with your WeTransfer account — the assistant only ever gets permission to send files on your behalf, and never sees your WeTransfer password. You can disconnect at any time to revoke access.

items.name: WeWeb
items.subtitle: Build your WeWeb projects using Claude
items.description: WeWeb MCP let's you use all the features of WeWeb's nocode editor through Claude.

items.name: Whimsical
items.subtitle: Create flowcharts, mindmaps, wireframes and diagrams
items.description: Explain and visualize concepts with flowcharts, mindmaps, wireframes and sequence diagrams.

items.name: Windmill HR
items.subtitle: Draft performance reviews, manage 1:1s, send pulses, and collect feedback in Windmill, without ever leaving Claude.
items.description:
Windmill is the AI-powered performance review platform for People Ops teams, and this connector brings your whole review workflow into Claude. Instead of clicking through dashboards, just ask.
Key features:
• Performance reviews: Track review cycles, see who's done and who still needs a nudge, and pull full context (feedback, AI recaps, 1:1 notes) when drafting a review.
• Feedback: Give feedback and shoutouts, request feedback about anyone on your team, and query everything that's been shared.
• 1:1s: Create recurring 1:1s, prep and update shared agendas, and check upcoming meetings.
• Pulse surveys: Create and schedule pulses, send them instantly, nudge non-responders, and analyze results.
• People data: Query and update employees, manage groups, and invite workspace members.
• AI recaps: Pull weekly AI-generated summaries of each employee's work, surfaced automatically from connected work tools.
• Private notes: Keep running notes about colleagues that only you can see —
ready when review season arrives.
• Workforce insights: Query aggregated stats and surface each person's top collaborators through organizational network analysis.
All access respects your Windmill role and permissions.
Try asking: "Who hasn't finished their reviews in the Q3 cycle?" — "Send the engagement pulse to the engineering team now" — "What did Marcus ship last week?" — "Summarize the feedback Sarah received this quarter."

items.name: Windows-MCP
items.subtitle: MCP Server that enables Claude to interact with Windows OS
items.description:
Windows-MCP is an open-source project that enables seamless integration between AI agents and the Windows operating system. Acting as an MCP server, it bridges the gap between large language models (LLMs) and the Windows OS, allowing agents to perform tasks such as **file navigation, application control, UI interaction, QA testing, and more**.
**KEY FEATURES**
- **Seamless Windows Integration**: Interacts natively with Windows UI elements, opens applications, controls windows, simulates user input, and more.
- **Use Any LLM (Vision Optional)**: Does not rely on traditional computer vision techniques or fine-tuned models. Works with any LLM, reducing complexity and setup time.
- **Rich Toolset for UI Automation**: Includes tools for keyboard and mouse control, window management, and capturing window or UI state.
- **Lightweight & Open-Source**: Minimal dependencies with full source code available under the MIT license.
- **Customizable & Extendable**: Easily adapt or extend tools to suit custom automation workflows or AI integrations.
- **Real-Time Interaction**: Typical latency between actions ranges from `0.2` to `0.9` seconds, depending on system load, active applications, and LLM inference speed.
**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**
- **Python 3.13+**
- **UV Package Manager** — `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`

items.name: Windsor.ai
items.subtitle: Connect Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads + 320 more
items.description: Analyze multi-channel marketing, analytics, sales, and e-commerce data within Claude by connecting to your Windsor.ai data flows: Query metrics from over 325 sources. Fetch and blend data from top platforms like Facebook, Google Ads, Instagram, Google Analytics 4, TikTok, Shopify, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google My Business, and LinkedIn into actionable intelligence for smarter, faster decision-making with accurate, up-to-date business information.

items.name: Wingify
items.subtitle: Optimize digital experiences directly from Claude and supercharge your CRO workflow.
items.description: Wingify helps teams analyze experimentation performance, review behavior insights, and manage testing campaigns directly from Claude.

items.name: WisdomAI
items.subtitle: Trustworthy answers from your governed enterprise data
items.description:
WisdomAI is the enterprise data harness inside Claude, for the complex analytical questions where the answer has to be deterministic, traceable, and consistent.
Connectors provide access. Catalogs and semantic layers provide definitions. The WisdomAI harness applies both at runtime by selecting the right context for each question, enforcing row- and column-level security for the person asking, optimizing execution for the underlying platform, verifying results, and repairing failed queries.
Business context strengthens continuously as WisdomAI learns from documents, query logs, catalogs, semantic layers, dbt, and BI metadata, proactively identifies where it lacked sufficient context, and routes proposed changes through expert review and versioning. Corrections become governed organizational knowledge rather than one-time fixes buried in individual conversations.
WisdomAI works across data platforms, sources, and deployment environments, including fully on-premises for regulated data that cannot leave your environment. The harness, the context, and query execution stay behind your firewall; only the answer crosses.
Every answer is grounded in governed definitions, enterprise data, and visible sources making it trustworthy enough to run your business on.
Use WisdomAI in Claude to:
- Ask questions of governed business data: "How did Q3 net revenue track against plan in EMEA?"
- Follow up in the same line of analysis: "Break that down by segment and show the last 4 quarters"
- Investigate an open-ended question end to end: "We missed plan in EMEA last quarter. What drove it, which segments and accounts moved most, and what should we watch going into Q4?"
- Trace an answer to its definitions and sources: "Which definition of net revenue was used, and what data did it come from?"
- See what's available to you: "What data do I have access to, and which metrics are defined for finance?"

items.name: Wispr Flow
items.subtitle: Your meetings, notes, and tasks from Wispr Flow — now native context for Claude.
items.description:
Wispr Flow brings your meetings into Claude.
Connect Wispr Flow to let Claude work directly with everything you capture — recorded meetings, transcripts, scratchpad notes, calendar events, and action items. No copy-pasting, no switching tabs. Just ask.
What you can do:
- Search and recall meetings — "What did we decide about pricing last week?" Claude finds the meeting, reads the transcript, and answers.
- Summarize and extract — Pull action items, decisions, and open questions from any recording or series of meetings.
- Stay on top of your calendar — Look up upcoming meetings, resolve calendar invites, and prep before you walk in.
- Capture and track tasks — Create, update, and search action items so follow-ups never slip.
- Work across your notes — Search and reference scratchpad notes alongside your meeting history.
How it works:
Once connected, Claude can query your Wispr Flow account in natural language — surfacing the right meeting, transcript, or note exactly when you need it. Everything stays tied to your account, accessed only when you ask.
Whether you're recapping a standup, prepping for a 1:1, or chasing down a decision from three weeks ago, Wispr Flow gives Claude the context to actually help.
Get started with Wispr Flow at wisprflow.ai.

items.name: Within
items.subtitle: Explore your org's processes
items.description: Bring your organization's processes and operational knowledge into your AI assistant. The Within MCP connects to your Within workspace so you can query your organization's processes, explore the process index knowledge graph linking processes to systems and teams, and ground answers in how your business actually runs — not generic guesses.

items.name: Wix
items.subtitle: Manage and build sites and apps on Wix
items.description: The Wix MCP provides users with the ability to manage their account's websites and apps (Stores, Bookings, Blog etc.). In addition, the MCP also helps devs create new sites using Wix Headless, the Wix Design system and more.

items.name: Wolfram
items.subtitle: Inject precise, real-time computation and knowledge
items.description:
The Wolfram MCP Server transforms your AI environment into a rigorous computational powerhouse. By integrating Wolfram Language and Wolfram|Alpha, this server provides access to curated data and sophisticated algorithms. When a user submits a query, the LLM works with Wolfram to convert it into Wolfram Language for precise evaluation, and these exact results are incorporated into the response provided by the LLM.
Whether you are solving complex differential equations, analyzing chemical structures or querying real-time socioeconomic data, the MCP Server ensures your AI has the "computational brain" necessary to deliver verified, high-level technical results that can be trusted.

items.name: Wonder
items.subtitle: Create and edit designs with Claude on a canvas where every design is real code.
items.description:
Design on a canvas that Claude can read and write to. Generate UI from your code, sync designs and components, and ship faster.
Wonder MCP connects Claude directly to your canvas, where it can inspect existing designs, components, variables, and documentation, create new screens and flows, and edit designs in place. Because Wonder is built on real HTML and CSS, Claude works with the actual design structure and styling instead of screenshots.
Bring your product context onto the canvas, explore and refine UI, and move approved designs back into production without rebuilding them.

items.name: Word (By Anthropic)
items.subtitle: Control Microsoft Word with AppleScript automation
items.description:
This extension allows Claude to interact with Microsoft Word on macOS, enabling document creation, editing, formatting, and management.
It uses macOS AppleScript automation to control Word and requires your explicit permission through macOS security prompts before accessing Microsoft Word. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft Corporation.

items.name: WordPress.com
items.subtitle: Secure AI access to manage your WordPress.com sites
items.description:
Manage and create on your WordPress site through a conversation with Claude. Ask Claude to find a post, check your stats, draft something new, update a page, or pull up a comment thread. Your sites stay secure — Claude only gets access to what you approve, nothing more.
Your site already knows your style — your theme, your colors, your fonts, every creative decision you've made. Claude can see all of it, so when it helps you create, the content actually fits.
60+ abilities. Every change is confirmed by you. Available on all paid WordPress.com plans and any Jetpack AI or Complete-connected site.
For developers: Under the hood, this connector is powered by the WordPress.com MCP server. It uses OAuth 2.1 to ensure agents only access the resources you've explicitly approved, making it easy for you to build and extend AI-driven workflows on top of WordPress.

items.name: Workable
items.subtitle: Your AI assistant for Hiring and HR — inside Workable
items.description: Connect your AI assistant directly to Workable. With 40+ tools spanning the full hiring lifecycle, you can manage jobs, move candidates through pipeline stages, add reviews and comments, handle requisitions and offers, and access employee and HR data all without leaving your AI interface. Whether you're sourcing talent, tracking approvals, or pulling workforce insights, the Workable MCP server turns natural language into real actions across your recruiting and HR operations.

items.name: Workato
items.subtitle: Automate workflows and connect your business apps
items.description: Execute enterprise automation recipes, manage integrations between business applications, monitor workflow performance, and create complex data transformations through Workato’s enterprise automation platform. Build and deploy sophisticated business process automations using natural language commands for streamlined operations.

items.name: Sana from Workday
items.subtitle: Bring Workday agents, data, and actions into Claude
items.description:
Connect Claude to Sana and Workday Agent-Ready Tools. The connector lets Sana and other enabled agents use the worker and organization information each person is allowed to see, then complete supported actions in Workday.
Employees can check pay or time off, find policy answers, submit expenses, and manage supported approvals without leaving Claude. HR and finance self-service are available today, and the connector is built to support broader agent capabilities over time, including more specialized and multi-step work.
As Workday adds agents, admins can make them available in Claude through the connector already in place. Developers can also use Workday Agent-Ready Tools to build agents for their custom workflows, using the same connection.
Each request follows the roles, permissions, approval chains, and audit controls already configured in Workday.
Your organization must have an active Workday Universal Main Subscription Agreement (UMSA) subject to applicable Product Terms and the relevant Workday agents configured in the Agent Management Hub. Available capabilities depend on your organization’s entitlements and configuration. Check Workday Community for details.
The Sana from Workday connector is a Beta service. Workday admins can apply for access here: https://forms.gle/pz138pmAUE8x92B46

items.name: WorkOS
items.subtitle: Manage your WorkOS workspace from Claude
items.description:
The official WorkOS connector lets you manage your WorkOS workspace from Claude in plain language, backed by the same API that powers the WorkOS Dashboard .
Ask Claude to look up an organization, audit a user's memberships, check an SSO connection, inspect a Directory Sync (SCIM) setup, review roles and permissions, or make changes across 300+ operations spanning the WorkOS platform.
**What you can do**
- Query your data: organizations, users and memberships, SSO connections, Directory Sync directories and users, roles/permissions/groups (RBAC), audit logs and events, AuthKit applications, domains, webhooks, and more.
- Take action: create and update organizations, manage users and memberships, configure connections, and run other administrative operations.
- Discover what's available: Claude can list the supported operations and their inputs, then pick the right one for your request.
**Built for enterprise trust**
- Secure OAuth 2.0 authentication — Claude acts with your own WorkOS identity and permissions, never a shared API key, and only within a single environment.
- Destructive and billing-sensitive actions require explicit confirmation before they run.
- Admins can disable the connector or restrict it to read-only, and access is always scoped to what your role is allowed to do.
WorkOS is the enterprise-identity platform trusted by leading AI and SaaS companies for SSO, Directory Sync, AuthKit user management, RBAC, FGA, Vault, and audit logging. This connector brings that control surface into Claude.

items.name: Wrike
items.subtitle: Manage, update and move work forward from Claude
items.description: Access your Wrike workspace directly from Claude to plan, prioritise, update and track work. Turn chats into projects, tasks, and timelines your team can see and execute. Pull in meeting notes, assign owners, set due dates — all without switching tools. Keep your team moving forward, right from Claude.

Search hotels by city and travel dates, narrow options by amenities like pools or pet-friendly, and get quick, easy answers to your questions. Whether you're planning a weekend getaway, a family vacation, or a work trip, find the right Wyndham hotel for you faster using natural language and personalized results.

items.name: Zite

items.name: Zomato

items.description: The Zomato MCP server brings India's largest food ordering experience directly into Claude. Discover restaurants near you based on your taste, browse menus with up-to-date pricing and ratings, and build your cart in seconds. Place orders, track deliveries in real time, and pay securely with QR codes, all in one conversation. From craving to doorstep, every step of the ordering journey is collapsed into a single AI-powered workflow.

items.name: Zoom for Claude
items.subtitle: Search, recap, and act on your Zoom meetings
items.description: The Zoom for Claude connector allows users to search their Zoom meetings using natural language, retrieve meeting assets such as AI summaries, docs, recordings, and whiteboards, and access recording-specific resources including transcripts, summaries, next steps, and playback links. Users can ask questions to quickly locate the exact moment a topic was discussed in a meeting recording, generate agendas, capture notes, identify action items, and follow up using the transcript, summary, and shared materials.

items.name: ZoomInfo
items.subtitle: Find prospects. Research accounts. Enrich buyers with verified B2B data. Act on intent signals.
items.description:

items.name: Zscaler MCP Server
items.subtitle: Zscaler MCP Server — AI-powered management of the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange across ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, ZCC, ZTW, ZIdentity, EASM, Z-Insights, ZMS, and ZCell via the Model Context Protocol.
items.description: Zscaler MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for managing Zscaler products with LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.). It exposes hundreds of tools across the Zscaler services. Read-only operations are available by default; create / update / delete tools require explicit allowlisting via the 'Enable Write Tools' and 'Write Tools Allowlist' settings below, and destructive operations additionally require an in-session HMAC confirmation token.
